Ainnamaa zaal ikumu aush-shaytaanu yukhawwifu 'awleeaa'ahu fal aa takhaafoohum wakhaafooni 'in kuntum mmoomineen
Wal aa yuhzinka aal zeena yusaari'oona fi ail kufri 'innahum lany yyadurru aul laaha shaya yureedu aul laahu 'al laa yaj'al a lahum hazza fi ail aakhirati wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Ainna aal zeena aashtarawua aul kufra bial iaymaani lany yyadurru aul laaha shaya wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem
Wal aa yahsibanna aal zeena kafarooaa 'annamaa numli lahum khayr llianfusihimuaa 'innamaa numli lahum leeazdaadooaa 'ithma wal ahum 'azaab mmuheen

Mmaa kaana aal laahu leeazara aal moomineena 'al aa maa 'antum 'al ayhi hattaa yameeza aal khabeetha mina aat-tayyibi wamaa kaana aal laahu leeutli'akum 'al aa aal ghaybi wal aakinna aal laaha yajtabi mir rrusul ihi many yyashaa'u faaminu bial laahi warusul ihi wain toominu watattaqu fal akumuaa 'ajrun 'azeem

Wal aa yahsibanna aal zeena yabkhal oona bimaa 'aatyaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi hooa khayra llaahum bal hooa sharr llaahum sayutawwaqoona maa bakhil u bihi yawma aal qeeaamati wal il hi meeraathu aus-samaawaati waal aardi waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Llaqad sami'a aal laahu qawla aal zeena qaal ooaa 'inna aal laaha faqeer wanahnu 'aghneeaa'u sanaktubu maa qaal u waqatlahumu aul aanbeeaa'a bighayri haqq wanaqoolu zooqu 'azaaba aal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamata aydeekum waanna aal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed

Ail zeena qaal ooaa 'inna aal laaha 'ahida 'il aynaa 'al laa noomina lirasoolin hattaa yaateeanaa biqurbaan taakul uhu aun-naaru qul qad jaa'akum rusul mmin qabli bial bayyinaati wabial zi qul tum fal ima qatal tumoohumuaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fain kazzabooka faqad kuzziba rusul mmin qablika jaa'oo bial bayyinaati waaz-zuburi waal kitaabi ail muneer

Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatu aul mawti wainnamaa tooaffawna 'ujoorakum yawma aal qeeaamati faman zuhziha 'ani ain-nari waudkhil a aal jannata faqad faaza wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa mataa'u aul ghuroor

Latublawunna fiaa 'amwaal ikum waanfusikum wal atasma'unna mina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablikum wamina aal zeena 'ashrakooaa 'aza katheera wain tasbiru watattaqu fainna zaal ika min 'azmi ail uamoor
Waiza aakhaza aal laahu meethaaqa aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba latubayyinunnahu lin-naasi wal aa taktumoonahu fanabazoohu waraa'a zuhoorihim waashtarawa bihi thamana qal eela fabeesa maa yashtaroon
Laa yahsibanna aal zeena yafrahoona bimaa 'ata wwayuhibboona 'any yyuhmadu bimaa lam yaf'al u fal aa tahsibannahum bimafaazat mmina aal'azaabi wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Ainna fi khal qi ais-samaawaati waal aardi waakhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahari layaat lliooli ail aal baab
Ail zeena yazkuroona aal laaha qeeaama waqu'ooda wa'al aa junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fi khal qi ais-samaawaati waal aardi rabbanaa maa khal aqta haazaa baatil a subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaba aan-nar
Rabbanaa 'innaka man tudkhil i ain-naara faqada aakhzaytahu wamaa liz-zaal imeena mina aansar
Rrabbanaa 'innanaa sami'naa munaadeea yunaadi lil iaymaani 'ana aaminu birabbikum faamannaa rabbanaa faaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wakaffir 'annaa sayyiaatinaa watawaffanaa ma'a aal aabrar
Rabbanaa wa'aatinaa maa wa'adttanaa 'al aa rusul ika wal aa tukhzinaa yawma aal qeeaamati 'innaka laa tukhlifu aul mee'aad

Faastajaaba lahum rabbuhumuaa 'anni laa 'udee'u 'amal a 'aamil mminkum mmin zakarin aawu anthaa ba'dukum mmim ba'd faal zeena haajaru waukhriju min deeaarihim waoozu fi sabeeli waqaatal u waqutil u laukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal audkhil annahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru thawaaba mmin 'indi ail laahi waal laahu 'indahu husnu auth-thawaab
Laa yaghurrannaka taqal lubu aul zeena kafaru fi ail bil aad
Mataa' qal eel thumma mawyaahum jahannamu wabeesa aal mihaad
Laakini ail zeena aattaqawa rabbahum lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa nuzul a mmin 'indi ail laahi wamaa 'inda aal laahi khayr llil aabrar

Wainna mina aahli ail kitaabi lamany yyoominu bial laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aykum wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhim khaashi'eena lil hi laa yashtaroona biayaati ail laahi thamana qal eelaan awlaa'ika lahumuaa 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihimuaa 'inna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu ausbiru wasaabiru waraabitu waattaqu aul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auttaqu rabbakumu aul zi khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat wakhal aqa minhaa zawjahaa wabaththa minhumaa rijaal a katheera wanisaa' waattaqu aul laaha aal zi tassaa'al oona bihi waal aarhaama 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aykum raqeeb
Wa'aatu aul yataamaa 'amwaal ahum wal aa tatabaddal u aul khabeetha biat-tayyibi wal aa taakul ooaa 'amwaal ahumuaa 'il aa 'amwaal ikumuaa 'innahu kaana hooba kabeer

Wain khiftumuaa 'al laa tuqsitu fi ail yataamaa faankihu maa taaba lakum mmina aan-nisaa'i mathnaa wathul aatha warubaa'a fain khiftumuaa 'al laa ta'dil u fawaahidatan aaw maa mal akata aymaanukum zaal ika 'adnaa 'al laa ta'ool
Wa'aatu aun-nisaa'a saduqaatihinna nihlat fain tibna lakum 'an sha' mminhu nafsa fakul oohu haneeaa mmareea
Wal aa tootu aus-sufahaa'a amwaal akumu aul ti ja'al a aal laahu lakum qeeama waarzuqoohum feehaa waaksoohum waqoolu lahum qawla mma'roof

Waabtal u aul yataamaa hattaa 'izaa bal aghu aun-nikaaha faina aanastum mminhum rushda faadfa'ooaa 'il ayhimuaa 'amwaal ahum wal aa taakul oohaa 'israafa wabidaaraan aany yyakbaru waman kaana ghaniyya fal yasta'fif waman kaana faqeera fal yaakul bial ma'roofi faizaa dafa'tumuaa 'il ayhimuaa 'amwaal ahum faashhidu 'al ayhim wakafaa bial laahi haseeb
Llir-rijaal i naseeb mmimmaa taraka aal waal idaani waal aaqraboona wal in-nisaa'i naseeb mmimmaa taraka aal waal idaani waal aaqraboona mimmaa qal la minhu 'aw kathura naseeba mmafrood
Waizaa hadara aal qismata 'oolu aul qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeenu faarzuqoohum mminhu waqoolu lahum qawla mma'roof
Wal yakhsha aal zeena law taraku min khal fihim zurriyyat di'aafaan khaafu 'al ayhim fal yattaqu aul laaha wal yaqoolu qawla sadeeda
Ainna aal zeena yaakul oona 'amwaal a aal yataamaa zul maan ainnamaa yaakul oona fi butoonihim naara wasayaslawna sa'eer

Yooseekumu aul laahu fiaa 'awlaadikum liz-zakari mithlu hazzi ail uanthayayni fain kunna nisaa' fawqa aathnatayni fal ahunna thul uthaa maa taraka wain kaanat waahidat fal ahaa aan-nisfu wal iabawayhi likul li waahid mminhumaa aas-sudusu mimmaa taraka 'in kaana lahu wal ad fail llam yakul llaahu wal ad wawarithahuaa 'abawaahu fal iummihi aith-thul uthu fain kaana lahuaa 'ikhwat fal iummihi ais-sudusu mim ba'di wasiyyat yoosi bihaa 'aw daynin aabaa'ukum waabnaa'ukum laa tadroona 'ayyuhumuaa 'aqrabu lakum naf'a fareedat mmina aal laahi 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan hakeem

Wal akum nisfu maa taraka 'azwaajukumuaa 'il llam yakul llaahunna wal ad fain kaana lahunna wal ad fal akumu aur-rubu'u mimmaa tarakna mim ba'di wasiyyat yooseena bihaa 'aw dayn wal ahunna aar-rubu'u mimmaa taraktumuaa 'il llam yakul llakum wal ad fain kaana lakum wal ad fal ahunna aath-thumunu mimmaa taraktum mmim ba'di wasiyyat toosoona bihaa 'aw dayn wain kaana rajul yoorathu kal aal atan aawi aimraat wal ahuaa 'akhun aawu akht fal ikul li waahid mminhumaa aas-sudusu fain kaanooaa 'akthara min zaal ika fahum shurakaa'u fi aith-thul uthi mim ba'di wasiyyat yoosi bihaa 'aw daynin ghayra mudaarr wasiyyat mmina aal laahi waal laahu 'al eemun hal eem
Til ka hudoodu aul laahi wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu nudkhil hu jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wazaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Wamany yya'si ail laaha warasoolahu wayata'adda hudoodahu nudkhil hu naaraan khaal ida feehaa wal ahu 'azaab mmuheen

Waal ti yaateena aal faahishata min nnisaa'ikum faastashhidu 'al ayhinna 'arba'at mminkum fain shahidu faamsikoohunna fi ail buyooti hattaa yatawaffyaahunna aal mawtu 'aw yaj'al a aal laahu lahunna sabeel
Waal zaani yaateeaanihaa minkum faazoohumaa fain taabaa waaslahaa faa'ridu 'anhumaa 'inna aal laaha kaana tawwaaba rraheema
Ainnamaa aat-tawbatu 'al aa aal laahi lil zeena ya'mal oona aas-sooaa'a bijahaal at thumma yatooboona min qareeb faul aa'ika yatoobu aul laahu 'al ayhim wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem

Wal aysati ait-tawbatu lil zeena ya'mal oona aas-sayyiaati hattaa 'izaa hadara 'ahadahumu aul mawtu qaal a 'inni tubtu aul aana wal aa aal zeena yamootoona wahum kuffaarun awlaa'ika 'a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabaan aal eem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa yahil lu lakumuaa 'an tarithu aun-nisaa'a karha wal aa ta'dul oohunna litazhabu biba'di maa 'aataytumoohunna 'il laa 'any yyaateena bifaahishat mmubayyinat wa'aashiroohunna bial ma'roofi fain karihtumoohunna fa'asaa 'an takrahu shaya wayaj'al a aal laahu feehi khayra katheer
Waina aaradttumu austibdaal a zawj mmakaana zawj wa'aataytumuaa 'ihdyaahunna qintaara fal aa taakhuzu minhu shayaan aataakhuzoonahu buhtaana waithma mmubeen
Wakayfa taakhuzoonahu waqada aafdaa ba'dukumuaa 'il aa ba'd waakhazna minkum mmeethaaqaan ghal eez
Wal aa tankihu maa nakaha 'aabaa'ukum mmina aan-nisaa'i al laa maa qad sal afa 'innahu kaana faahishat wamaqta wasaa'a sabeela

Hurrimat 'al aykumuaa 'ummahaatukum wabanaatukum waakhawaatukum wa'ammaatukum wakhaal aatukum wabanaatu aul aakhi wabanaatu aul uakhti waummahaatukumu aul tiaa 'arda'nakum waakhawaatukum mmina aar-radaa'ati waummahaatu nisaa'ikum warabaa'ibukumu aul ti fi hujoorikum mmin nnisaa'ikumu aul ti dakhal tum bihinna fail llam takoonu dakhal tum bihinna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum wahal aa'il u 'abnaa'ikumu aul zeena mina aaslaabikum waan tajma'u bayna aal uakhtayni 'il laa maa qad sal afa 'inna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem

Waal muhsanaatu mina aan-nisaa'i al laa maa mal akata aymaanukum kitaaba aal laahi 'al aykum waahal la lakum mmaa waraa'a zaal ikumuaa 'an tabtaghu biamwaal ikum mmuhsineena ghayra musaafiheena famaa aastamta'tum bihi minhunna faatoohunna 'ujoorahunna fareedat wal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa taraadaytum bihi mim ba'di ail fareedati 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan hakeem

Wamal llam yastati' minkum tawlaan aany yyankiha aal muhsanaati ail moominaati famim mmaa mal akata aymaanukum mmin fatayaatikumu aul moominaati waal laahu 'a'lamu bieemaanikum ba'dukum mmim ba'd faankihoohunna biizni 'ahlihinna wa'aatoohunna 'ujoorahunna bial ma'roofi muhsanaatin ghayra musaafihaat wal aa muttakhizaati 'akhdaan faizaa 'uhsinna faina aatayna bifaahishat fa'al ayhinna nisfu maa 'al aa aal muhsanaati mina aal'azaabi zaal ika liman khasheea aal'anata minkum waan tasbiru khayr llakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yureedu aul laahu leeubayyina lakum wayahdeeakum sunana aal zeena min qablikum wayatooba 'al aykum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Waal laahu yureedu 'any yyatooba 'al aykum wayureedu aul zeena yattabi'oona aash-shahawaati 'an tameelu maylaan 'azeem
Yureedu aul laahu 'any yyukhaffifa 'ankum wakhul iqa aal iansaanu da'eef
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa taakul ooaa 'amwaal akum baynakum bial baatil i 'il laa 'an takoona tijaaratun 'an taraad mminkum wal aa taqtul ooaa 'anfusakumuaa 'inna aal laaha kaana bikum raheem
Wamany yyaf'al zaal ika 'udwaana wazul ma fasawfa nusleehi naara wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseera
Ain tajtanibu kabaa'ira maa tunhawna 'anhu nukaffir 'ankum sayyiaatikum wanudkhil kum mmadkhal a kareem

Wal aa tatamannawa maa faddal a aal laahu bihi ba'dakum 'al aa ba'd llir-rijaal i naseeb mmimmaa aaktasabu wal in-nisaa'i naseeb mmimmaa aaktasabna wasal u aul laaha min fadlihiaa 'inna aal laaha kaana bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Wal ikul l ja'al naa mawaal eea mimmaa taraka aal waal idaani waal aaqraboona waal zeena 'aaqadata aymaanukum faatoohum naseebahumuaa 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li sha' shaheeda

Air-rijaal u qawwaamoona 'al aa aan-nisaa'i bimaa faddal a aal laahu ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd wabimaa 'anfaqu mina aamwaal ihim faas-saal ihaatu qaanitaatun haafizaat llil ghaybi bimaa hafiza aal laahu waal ti takhaafoona nushoozahunna fa'izoohunna waahjuroohunna fi ail madaaji'i waadriboohunna faina aata'nakum fal aa tabghu 'al ayhinna sabeelaan ainna aal laaha kaana 'al iyya kabeer
Wain khiftum shiqaaqa baynihimaa faab'athu hakama mmina aahlihi wahakama mmina aahlihaa 'iny yyureedaa 'islaaha yooaffiqi ail laahu baynahumaa 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan khabeer

Waa'budu aul laaha wal aa tushriku bihi shaya wabial waal idayni 'ihsaana wabizi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waal jari zi ail qurbaa waal jari ail junubi waas-saahibi bial janbi waabni ais-sabeeli wamaa mal akata aymaanukumuaa 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaal a fakhoora
Ail zeena yabkhal oona wayaamuroona aan-naasa bial bukhli wayaktumoona maa 'aatyaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Waal zeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum reeaa'a aan-naasi wal aa yoominoona bial laahi wal aa bial yawmi ail aakhiri wamany yyakuni aish-shaytaanu lahu qareena fasaa'a qareen
Wamaazaa 'al ayhim lawa aamanu bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waanfaqu mimmaa razaqahumu aul laahu wakaana aal laahu bihim 'al eema
Ainna aal laaha laa yazlimu mithqaal a zarrat wain taku hasanat yudaa'ifhaa wayooti mil lladunhu 'ajraan 'azeem
Fakayfa 'izaa jeenaa min kul li 'ummati bishaheed wajeenaa bika 'al aa haa'ul aa'i shaheed
Yawma'iz yawaddu aul zeena kafaru wa'asawua aur-rasoola law tassawwaa bihimu aul aardu wal aa yaktumoona aal laaha hadeeth

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa taqrabu aus-sal awaata waantum sukaaraa hattaa ta'lamu maa taqooloona wal aa junubaan ail laa 'aabiri sabeelin hattaa taghtasil u wain kuntum mmardaa 'aw 'al aa safarin aaw jaa'a ahad mminkum mmina aal ghaa'iti 'aw laamastumu aun-nisaa'a fal am tajidu maa' fatayammamu sa'eeda tayyiba faamsahu biwujoohikum waydeekumuaa 'inna aal laaha kaana 'afoowaan ghafoora

Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena 'ootu naseeba mmina aal kitaabi yashtaroona aad-dal aal ata wayureedoona 'an tadil lu aus-sabeela  waal laahu 'a'lamu bia'daa'ikum wakafaa bial laahi wal iyya wakafaa bial laahi naseer

Mmina aal zeena haadu yuharrifoona aal kal ima 'am mmawaadi'ihi wayaqooloona sami'naa wa'asaynaa waasma' ghayra musma' waraa'inaa layyaa bial sinatihim wata'na fi aid-deeni wal awa aannahum qaal u sami'naa waata'naa waasma' waanzurnaa lakaana khayra llaahum waaqwama wal aakil lla'anahumu aul laahu bikufrihim fal aa yoominoona 'il laa qal eel

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba 'aaminu bimaa nazzal naa musaddiqa llimaa ma'akum mmin qabli 'an nnatmisa wujooha fanaruddahaa 'al aa 'adbaarihaa 'aw nal'anahum kamaa la'annaa 'ashaaba aas-sabti wakaana 'amru aul laahi maf'oola
Ainna aal laaha laa yaghfiru 'any yyushraka bihi wayaghfiru maa doona zaal ika limany yyashaa'u wamany yyushrik bial laahi faqadi aiftaraa 'ithmaan 'azeema
Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena yuzakkoona 'anfusahum bal i ail laahu yuzakki many yyashaa'u wal aa yuzlamoona fateela
Aunzur kayfa yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba wakafaa bihiaa 'ithma mmubeena
Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena 'ootu naseeba mmina aal kitaabi yoominoona bial jibti waat-taaghooti wayaqooloona lil zeena kafaru haa'ul aa'i aahdaa mina aal zeena 'aamanu sabeela
Awlaa'ika aal zeena la'anahumu aul laahu wamany yyal'ani ail laahu fal an tajida lahu naseera
Aam lahum naseeb mmina aal mul ki faiza llaa yootoona aan-naasa naqeera
Aam yahsudoona aan-naasa 'al aa maa 'aatyaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi faqada aataynaa 'aal a 'ibraaheema aal kitaaba waal hikmata wa'aataynaahum mmul kaan 'azeem
Faminhum mmana aamana bihi waminhum mman sadda 'anhu wakafaa bijahannama sa'eera
Ainna aal zeena kafaru biayaatinaa sawfa nusleehim naara kul lamaa nadijat jul ooduhum baddal naahum jul oodaan ghayrahaa leeazooqu aul'azaaba 'inna aal laaha kaana 'azeezaan hakeem
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati sanudkhil uhum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada llaahum feehaa 'azwaaj mmutahharat wanudkhil uhum zil la zal eela

Ainna aal laaha yaamurukumuaa 'an tooaddu aul aamaanaati 'il aa 'ahlihaa waizaa hakamtum bayna aan-naasi 'an tahkumu bial'adli 'inna aal laaha ni'immaa ya'izukum bihiaa 'inna aal laaha kaana samee'aa baseer

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'atee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola waooli ail aamri minkum fain tanaaza'tum fi sha' faruddoohu 'il aa aal laahi waar-rasooli 'in kuntum toominoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri zaal ika khayr waahsanu taaweela

Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena yaz'umoona 'annahumuaa 'aamanu bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika yureedoona 'any yyatahaakamooaa 'il aa aat-taaghooti waqadu amirooaa 'any yyakfuru bihi wayureedu aush-shaytaanu 'any yyudil laahum dal aal aa ba'eed
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awia ail aa maa 'anzal a aal laahu wail aa aar-rasooli rayta aal munaafiqeena yasuddoona 'anka sudood
Fakayfa 'izaa 'asaabathum mmuseebatu bimaa qaddamata aydeehim thumma jaa'ooka yahlifoona bial laahi 'ina aaradnaa 'il laa 'ihsaana watawfeeqa
Awlaa'ika aal zeena ya'lamu aul laahu maa fi qul oobihim faa'rid 'anhum wa'izhum waqul-laahum fiaa 'anfusihim qawlaa bal eegh

Wamaa 'arsal naa mir rrasoolin ail laa leeutaa'a biizni ail laahi wal awa aannahumuaa 'iz zzal amooaa 'anfusahum jaa'ooka faastaghfaru aul laaha waastaghfara lahumu aur-rasoolu lawajadu aul laaha tawwaaba rraheem
Fal aa warabbika laa yoominoona hattaa yuhakkimooka feemaa shajara baynahum thumma laa yajidu fiaa 'anfusihim haraja mmimmaa qadayta wayusal limu tasleem

Wal awa aannaa katabnaa 'al ayhimuaa 'anu auqtul ooaa 'anfusakumuaa 'awu aukhruju min deeaarikum mmaa fa'al oohu 'il laa qal eel mminhum wal awa aannahum fa'al u maa yoo'azoona bihi lakaana khayra llaahum waashadda tathbeeh
Waiza llaataynaahum mmil lladunnaa 'ajraan 'azeem
Wal ahadaynaahum siraata mmustaqeem
Wamany yyuti'i ail laaha waar-rasoola faul aa'ika ma'a aal zeena 'an'ama aal laahu 'al ayhim mmina aan-nabeeaaina waas-siddeeqeena waash-shuhadaa'i waas-saal iheena wahasuna 'ul aa'ika rafeeq
Zaal ika aal fadlu mina aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu khuzu hizrakum faanfiru thubaatin aawi ainfiru jamee'
Wainna minkum lamal llayubatteeanna faina aasaabatkum mmuseebat qaal a qada aan'ama aal laahu 'al ayya 'iz lama aakum mma'ahum shaheed
Wal a'ina aasaabakum fadl mmina aal laahi layaqoolanna kaal llam yakum baynakum wabaynahu mawaddat yaal aytani kuntu ma'ahum faafooza fawzaan 'azeem
Fal yuqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi ail zeena yashroona aal hayawaata aad-dunya bial aakhirati wamany yyuqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi fayuqtal a aaw yaghlib fasawfa nooteehi 'ajraan 'azeem

Wamaa lakum laa tuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ail laahi waal mustad'afeena mina aar-rijaal i waan-nisaa'i waal wil daani ail zeena yaqooloona rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa min haazihi ail qaryati aiz-zaal imi 'ahluhaa waaj'al-lanaa mil lladunka wal iyya waaj'al-lanaa mil lladunka naseera
Ail zeena 'aamanu yuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena kafaru yuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ait-taaghooti faqaatil ooaa 'awleeaa'a aash-shaytaani 'inna kayda aash-shaytaani kaana da'eefa

Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena qeela lahum kuffooaa 'aydeeakum waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata fal ammaa kutiba 'al ayhimu aul qitaal u 'izaa fareeq mminhum yakhshawna aan-naasa kakhashyati ail laahi 'awa aashadda khashyat waqaal u rabbanaa lima katabta 'al aynaa aal qitaal a lawlaa 'akhkhartanaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb qul mataa'u aud-dunya qal eel waal aakhiratu khayr llimani aittaqaa wal aa tuzlamoona fateela

Aynamaa takoonu yudrikkkumu aul mawtu wal aw kuntum fi burooj mmushayyadat wain tusibhum hasanat yaqoolu haazihi min 'indi ail laahi wain tusibhum sayyeeat yaqoolu haazihi min 'indika qul kul l mmin 'indi ail laahi famaal i haa'ul aa'i ail qawmi laa yakaadoona yafqahoona hadeeth
Mmaa 'asaabaka min hasanat famina aal laahi wamaa 'asaabaka min sayyeeat famin nnafsika waarsal naaka lin-naasi rasoola wakafaa bial laahi shaheed
Mmany yyuti'i air-rasoola faqada aataa'a aal laaha waman tawal laa famaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim hafeez
Wayaqooloona taa'at faizaa barazu min 'indika bayyata taa'ifat mminhum ghayra aal zi taqoolu waal laahu yaktubu maa yubayyitoona faa'rid 'anhum watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi wakeela
Aafal aa yatadabbaroona aal qur'aana wal aw kaana min 'indi ghayri ail laahi lawajadu feehi aikhtil aafa katheer

Waizaa jaa'ahumuaa 'amr mmina aal aamni 'awi ail khawfi 'azaa'u bihi wal aw raddoohu 'il aa aar-rasooli wail aa 'ooli ail aamri minhum la'al imahu aul zeena yastanbitoonahu minhum wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu laattaba'tumu aush-shaytaana 'il laa qal eel
Faqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi laa tukal lafu 'il laa nafsaka waharridi ail moomineena 'asaa aal laahu 'any yyakuffa basa aal zeena kafaru waal laahu 'ashaddu basa waashaddu tankeel
Mmany yyashfa' shafaa'atan hasanat yakul llaahu naseeb mminhaa wamany yyashfa' shafaa'at sayyeeat yakul llaahu kifl mminhaa wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' mmuqeeh
Waizaa huyyeetum bitahiyyat fahayyu biahsana minhaa 'aw ruddoohaa 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li sha'in haseeba
Ail laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa layajma'annakumuaa 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laa rayba feehi wamana aasdaqu mina aal laahi hadeeth
Famaa lakum fi ail munaafiqeena feeatayni waal laahu 'arkasahum bimaa kasabooaa 'atureedoona 'an tahdu mana aadal la aal laahu wamany yyudlil i ail laahu fal an tajida lahu sabeel

Waddu law takfuroona kamaa kafaru fatakoonoona sawaa' fal aa tattakhizu minhumuaa 'awleeaa'a hattaa yuhaajiru fi sabeeli ail laahi fain tawal lawa fakhuzoohum waaqtul oohum haythu wajadttumoohum wal aa tattakhizu minhum wal iyya wal aa naseera

Ail laa aal zeena yasil oona 'il aa qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaqun aaw jaa'ookum hasirat sudooruhumuaa 'any yyuqaatil ookumuaa 'aw yuqaatil u qawmahum wal aw shaa'a aal laahu lasal latahum 'al aykum fal aqaatal ookum faini ai'tazal ookum fal am yuqaatil ookum waal qawia ail aykumu aus-sal ama famaa ja'al a aal laahu lakum 'al ayhim sabeel

Wamany yyaqtul moomina mmuta'ammida fajazaa'uhu jahannamu khaal ida feehaa waghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhi wal a'anahu waa'adda lahu 'azaabaan 'azeem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa darabtum fi sabeeli ail laahi fatabayyanu wal aa taqoolu limana aal qaa 'il aykumu aus-sal ama lasta moomina tabtaghoona 'arada aal hayawaati aid-dunya fa'inda aal laahi maghaanimu katheerat kazaal ika kuntum mmin qablu famanna aal laahu 'al aykum fatabayyanooaa 'inna aal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Llaa yastawi ail qaa'idoona mina aal moomineena ghayra 'ooli aid-darari waal mujaahidoona fi sabeeli ail laahi biamwaal ihim waanfusihim faddal a aal laahu aul mujaahideena biamwaal ihim waanfusihim 'al aa aal qaa'ideena darajat wakul la wa'ada aal laahu aul husnaa wafaddal a aal laahu aul mujaahideena 'al aa aal qaa'ideena 'ajraan 'azeem
Darajaat mminhu wamaghfirat warahmat wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheema

Ainna aal zeena tawaffyaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu zaal imiaa 'anfusihim qaal u feema kuntum qaal u kunnaa mustad'afeena fi ail aardi qaal ooaa 'al am takuna aardu aul laahi waasi'at fatuhaajiru feehaa faul aa'ika mawyaahum jahannamu wasaa'at maseera
Ail laa aal mustad'afeena mina aar-rijaal i waan-nisaa'i waal wil daani laa yastatee'oona heelat wal aa yahtadoona sabeel

Waizaa darabtum fi ail aardi fal aysa 'al aykum junaahun aan taqsuru mina aas-sal awaati 'in khiftumuaa 'any yyaftinakumu aul zeena kafarooaa 'inna aal kaafireena kaanu lakum 'adoowa mmubeen

Waizaa kunta feehim faaqamta lahumu aus-sal awaata fal taqum taa'ifat mminhum mma'aka wal yaakhuzooaa 'aslihatahum faizaa sajadu fal yakoonu minw wwaraa'ikum wal taati taa'ifatun akhraa lam yusal lu fal yusal lu ma'aka wal yaakhuzu hizrahum waaslihatahum wadda aal zeena kafaru law taghful oona 'ana aaslihatikum waamti'atikum fayameeloona 'al aykum mmaylat waahidat wal aa junaaha 'al aykumuaa 'in kaana bikumuaa 'aza mmim mmatarin aaw kuntum mmardaa 'an tada'ooaa 'aslihatakum wakhuzu hizrakumuaa 'inna aal laaha 'a'adda lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Faizaa qadaytumu aus-sal awaata faazkuru aul laaha qeeaama waqu'ooda wa'al aa junoobikum faizaa aatmanantum faaqeemu aus-sal awaata 'inna aas-sal awaata kaanat 'al aa aal moomineena kitaaba mmawqooh
Wal aa tahinu fi aibtighaa'i ail qawmi 'in takoonu taal amoona fainnahum yaal amoona kamaa taal amoona watarjoona mina aal laahi maa laa yarjoona wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeema
Ainnaa 'anzal naa 'il ayka aal kitaaba bial haqqi litahkuma bayna aan-naasi bimaa 'aryaaka aal laahu wal aa takul llil khaa'ineena khaseem
Waastaghfiri ail laaha 'inna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Wal aa tujaadil 'ani ail zeena yakhtaanoona 'anfusahumuaa 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu man kaana khawwaanaan aatheem
Yastakhfoona mina aan-naasi wal aa yastakhfoona mina aal laahi wahooa ma'ahumuaa 'iz yubayyitoona maa laa yardaa mina aal qawli wakaana aal laahu bimaa ya'mal oona muheeta
Haantum haa'ul aa'i jaadal tum 'anhum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya famany yyujaadil u aul laaha 'anhum yawma aal qeeaamati 'am mmany yyakoonu 'al ayhim wakeel
Wamany yya'mal sooaa'aan aaw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri ail laaha yajidi ail laaha ghafoora rraheem
Wamany yyaksibi aithma fainnamaa yaksibuhu 'al aa nafsihi wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem
Wamany yyaksib khateeaatan aawi aithma thumma yarmi bihi bareeaa faqadi aihtamal a buhtaana waithma mmubeen

Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al ayka warahmatuhu lahammat ttaa'ifat mminhumuaa 'any yyudil looka wamaa yudil loona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yadurroonaka min sha' waanzal a aal laahu 'al ayka aal kitaaba waal hikmata wa'al lamaka maa lam takun ta'lamu wakaana fadlu aul laahi 'al ayka 'azeem

Llaa khayra fi katheer mmin nnajwyaahumuaa 'il laa mana aamara bisadaqatin aaw ma'roofin aawi aislaahi bayna aan-naasi wamany yyaf'al zaal ika aabtighaa'a mardaati ail laahi fasawfa nooteehi 'ajraan 'azeem
Wamany yyushaaqiqi air-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahu aul hudaa wayattabi' ghayra sabeeli ail moomineena nooal lihi maa tawal laa wanuslihi jahannama wasaa'at maseera
Ainna aal laaha laa yaghfiru 'any yyushraka bihi wayaghfiru maa doona zaal ika limany yyashaa'u wamany yyushrik bial laahi faqad ddal la dal aal aa ba'eeda
Ainy yyad'oona min doonihiaa 'il laa 'inaatha wainy yyad'oona 'il laa shaytaana mmareed
Lla'anahu aul laahu waqaal a laattakhizanna min 'ibaadika naseeba mmafrood

Yureedoona 'any yyakhruju mina aan-nari wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minhaa wal ahum 'azaab mmuqeem
Waas-saariqu waas-saariqatu faaqta'ooaa 'aydeeahumaa jazaa'a bimaa kasabaa nakaal a mmina aal laahi waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Faman taaba mim ba'di zul mihi waaslaha fainna aal laaha yatoobu 'al ayhi 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Aal am ta'lama aanna aal laaha lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi yu'azzibu many yyashaa'u wayaghfiru limany yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Yayyuhaa aar-rasoolu laa yuhzinka aal zeena yusaari'oona fi ail kufri mina aal zeena qaal ooaa 'aamannaa biafwaahihim wal am toomin qul oobuhum wamina aal zeena haadu sammaa'oona lil kazibi sammaa'oona liqawmin aakhareena lam yaatooka yuharrifoona aal kal ima mim ba'di mawaadi'ihi yaqooloona 'inu aooteetum haazaa fakhuzoohu wail llam tootawhu faahzaru wamany yyuridi ail laahu fitnatahu fal an tamlika lahu mina aal laahi shayaan awlaa'ika aal zeena lam yuridi ail laahu 'any yyutahhira qul oobahum lahum fi aid-dunya khizy wal ahum fi ail aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem

Sammaa'oona lil kazibi 'akkaal oona lis-suhti fain jaa'ooka faahkum baynahumuaa 'awa aa'rid 'anhum wain tu'rid 'anhum fal any yyadurrooka shaya wain hakamta faahkum baynahum bial qisti 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muqsiteen
Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa'indahumu aut-tawryaatu feehaa hukmu aul laahi thumma yatawal lawna mim ba'di zaal ika wamaa 'ul aa'ika bial moomineen

'innaa 'anzal naa aat-tawryaata feehaa huda wanoor yahkumu bihaa aan-nabeeaaoona aal zeena 'aslamu lil zeena haadu waar-rabbaaneeyoona waal aahbaaru bimaa aastuhfizu min kitaabi ail laahi wakaanu 'al ayhi shuhadaa'a fal aa takhshawua aun-naasa waakhshawni wal aa tashtaru biayaati thamana qal eela wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu faul aa'ika humu aul kaafiroon

Wakatabnaa 'al ayhim feehaa 'anna aan-nafsa bian-nafsi waal'ayna bial'ayni waal aanfa bial aanfi waal uazna bial uazni waas-sinna bias-sinni waal jurooha qisaas faman tasaddaqa bihi fahooa kaffaarat llaahu wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Waqaffaynaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim bi'eesaa aabni maryama musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi mina aat-tawryaati wa'aataynaahu aul ianjeela feehi huda wanoor wamusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi mina aat-tawryaati wahuda wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Wal yahkuma aahlu aul ianjeeli bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu feehi wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu faul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon

Waanzal naa 'il ayka aal kitaaba bial haqqi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi mina aal kitaabi wamuhayminaan 'al ayhi faahkum baynahum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu wal aa tattabi'a aahwaa'ahum 'ammaa jaa'aka mina aal haqqi likul l ja'al naa minkum shir'at waminhaaja wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laja'al akumuaa 'ummat waahidat wal aakil lleeablooakum fi maa 'aatyaakum faastabiqu aul khayraati 'il aa aal laahi marji'ukum jamee'a fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon

Waanu auhkum baynahum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu wal aa tattabi'a aahwaa'ahum waahzarhumuaa 'any yyaftinooka 'am ba'di maa 'anzal a aal laahu 'il ayka fain tawal lawa faa'lama aannamaa yureedu aul laahu 'any yyuseebahum biba'di zunoobihim wainna katheera mmina aan-naasi lafaasiqoon
'afahukma aal jaahil iyyati yabghoona wamana aahsanu mina aal laahi hukma lliqawm yooqinoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu aul yahooda waan-nasaaraa 'awleeaa'a ba'duhumuaa 'awleeaa'u ba'd wamany yyatawal laahum mminkum fainnahu minhumuaa 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen

Fataraa aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad yusaari'oona feehim yaqooloona nakhshaa 'an tuseebanaa daa'irat fa'asaa aal laahu 'any yyaateea bial fathi 'awa aamr mmin 'indihi fayusbihu 'al aa maa 'asarru fiaa 'anfusihim naadimeen
Yaqoolu aul zeena 'aamanooaa 'ahaa'ul aa'i ail zeena 'aqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihimuaa 'innahum lama'akum habitata aa'maal uhum faasbahu khaasireen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu many yyartadid minkum 'an deenihi fasawfa yaati ail laahu biqawm yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahuaa 'azil latin 'al aa aal moomineena 'a'izzatin 'al aa aal kaafireena yujaahidoona fi sabeeli ail laahi wal aa yakhaafoona lawmata laa'im zaal ika fadlu aul laahi yooteehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Ainnamaa wal eeyukumu aul laahu warasooluhu waal zeena 'aamanu aul zeena yuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wayootoona aaz-zakawaata wahum raaki'oon
Wamany yyatawal la aal laaha warasoolahu waal zeena 'aamanu fainna hizba aal laahi humu aul ghaal iboon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu aul zeena aattakhazu deenakum huzu'a wal a'iba mmina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablikum waal kuffaara 'awleeaa'a waattaqu aul laaha 'in kuntum mmoomineen
Waizaa naadaytumuaa 'il aa aas-sal awaati aittakhazoohaa huzu'a wal a'iba zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'qil oon
Qul yaahla aal kitaabi hal tanqimoona minnaa 'il laa 'ana aamannaa bial laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa wamaa 'unzil a min qablu waanna 'aktharakum faasiqoon

Qul hal u anabbeeukum bisharr mmin zaal ika mathoobatan 'inda aal laahi mal lla'anahu aul laahu waghadiba 'al ayhi waja'al a minhumu aul qiradata waal khanaazeera wa'abada aat-taaghoota 'ul aa'ika sharr mmakaana waadal lu 'an sawaa'i ais-sabeel
Waizaa jaa'ookum qaal ooaa 'aamannaa waqad ddakhal u bial kufri wahum qad kharaju bihi waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa kaanu yaktumoon
Wataraa katheera mminhum yusaari'oona fi ail iathmi waal'udwaani waaklihimu aus-suhta labeesa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Lawlaa yanhyaahumu aur-rabbaaneeyoona waal aahbaaru 'an qawlihimu aul iathma waaklihimu aus-suhta labeesa maa kaanu yasna'oon

Waqaal ati ail yahoodu yadu aul laahi maghloolatun ghul lata aydeehim wal u'inu bimaa qaal u bal yadaahu mabsootataani yunfiqu kayfa yashaa'u wal ayazeedanna katheera mminhum mmaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika tughyaana wakufra waal qaynaa baynahumu aul'adaawata waal baghdaa'a al aa yawmi ail qeeaamati kul lamaa 'awqadu naara llil harbi 'atfaahaa aal laahu wayas'awna fi ail aardi fasaada waal laahu laa yuhibbu aul mufsideen
Wal awa aanna 'ahla aal kitaabi 'aamanu waattaqawa lakaffarnaa 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal aadkhal naahum jannaati ain-na'eem

Wal awa aannahumuaa 'aqaamu aut-tawryaata waal ianjeela wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhim mmir rrabbihim laakal u min fawqihim wamin tahti 'arjul ihim mminhumuaa 'ummat mmuqtasidat wakatheer mminhum saa'a maa ya'mal oon
Yayyuhaa aar-rasoolu bal ligh maa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika wail llam taf'al famaa bal laghta risaal aatihi waal laahu ya'simuka mina aan-naasi 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen

Qul yaahla aal kitaabi lastum 'al aa sha'in hattaa tuqeemu aut-tawryaata waal ianjeela wamaa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum wal ayazeedanna katheera mminhum mmaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika tughyaana wakufra fal aa taasa 'al aa aal qawmi ail kaafireen
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu waal zeena haadu waas-saaboona waan-nasaaraa mana aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wa'amil a saal iha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Laqada aakhaznaa meethaaqa baniaa 'israa'eela waarsal naa 'il ayhim rusul a kul lamaa jaa'ahum rasoolu bimaa laa tahwaa 'anfusuhum fareeqa kazzabu wafareeqa yaqtul oon
Wahasibooaa 'al laa takoona fitnat fa'amu wasammu thumma taaba aal laahu 'al ayhim thumma 'amu wasammu katheer mminhum waal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon

Laqad kafara aal zeena qaal ooaa 'inna aal laaha hooa aal maseehu aubnu maryama waqaal a aal maseehu yaabaniaa 'israa'eela aa'budu aul laaha rabbi warabbakumuaa 'innahu many yyushrik bial laahi faqad harrama aal laahu 'al ayhi ail jannata wamawyaahu aun-naaru wamaa liz-zaal imeena mina aansar

Llaqad kafara aal zeena qaal ooaa 'inna aal laaha thaal ithu thal aathat wamaa mini ail aahin ail laa 'il aah waahid wail llam yantahu 'ammaa yaqooloona layamassanna aal zeena kafaru minhum 'azaabun aal eem
Aafal aa yatooboona 'il aa aal laahi wayastaghfiroonahu waal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Mmaa aal maseehu aubnu maryama 'il laa rasool qad khal at min qablihi air-rusul u waummuhu siddeeqat kaanaa yaakul aani ait-ta'aama aanzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu aul ayaati thumma aanzura aannaa yoofakoon
Qul a aata'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yamliku lakum darra wal aa naf'a waal laahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Qul yaahla aal kitaabi laa taghlu fi deenikum ghayra aal haqqi wal aa tattabi'ooaa 'ahwaa'a qawm qad ddal lu min qablu waadal lu katheera wadal lu 'an sawaa'i ais-sabeel
Lu'ina aal zeena kafaru mim baniaa 'israa'eela 'al aa lisaani daawuda wa'eesaa aabni maryama zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon
Kaanu laa yatanaahawna 'am mmunkar fa'al oohu labeesa maa kaanu yaf'al oon
Taraa katheera mminhum yatawal lawna aal zeena kafaru labeesa maa qaddamat lahumuaa 'anfusuhumuaa 'an sakhita aal laahu 'al ayhim wafi ail'azaabi hum khaal idoon
Wal aw kaanu yoominoona bial laahi waan-nabiaa'i wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi maa aattakhazoohumuaa 'awleeaa'a wal aakinna katheera mminhum faasiqoon

Latajidanna 'ashadda aan-naasi 'adaawat llil zeena 'aamanu aul yahooda waal zeena 'ashraku wal atajidanna 'aqrabahum mmawaddat llil zeena 'aamanu aul zeena qaal ooaa 'innaa nasaaraa zaal ika bianna minhum qisseeseena waruhbaana waannahum laa yastakbiroon
Waizaa sami'u maa 'unzil a 'il aa aar-rasooli taraa 'a'yunahum tafeedu mina aad-dam'i mimmaa 'arafu mina aal haqqi yaqooloona rabbanaa 'aamannaa faaktubnaa ma'a aash-shaahideen
Wamaa lanaa laa noominu bial laahi wamaa jaa'anaa mina aal haqqi wanatma'u 'any yyudkhil anaa rabbunaa ma'a aal qawmi ais-saal iheen
Faathaabahumu aul laahu bimaa qaal u jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wazaal ika jazaa'u aul muhsineen
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jaheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tuharrimu tayyibaati maa 'ahal la aal laahu lakum wal aa ta'tadooaa 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul mu'tadeen
Wakul u mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu hal aal a tayyiba waattaqu aul laaha aal ziaa 'antum bihi moominoon

Laa yooaakhizukumu aul laahu bial laghwi fiaa 'aymaanikum wal aakiny yyooaakhizukum bimaa 'aqqadttumu aul aymaana fakaffaaratuhuaa 'it'aamu 'asharati masaakeena mina aawsati maa tut'imoona 'ahleekumuaa 'aw kiswatuhumuaa 'aw tahreeru raqabat famal llam yajid faseeaamu thal aathati 'ayyaam zaal ika kaffaaratu 'aymaanikumuaa 'izaa hal aftum waahfazooaa 'aymaanakum kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumuaa 'ayaatihi la'al lakum tashkuroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'innamaa aal khamru waal maysiru waal aansaabu waal aazlaamu rijs mmin 'amal i aish-shaytaani faajtaniboohu la'al lakum tuflihoon
'innamaa yureedu aush-shaytaanu 'any yyooqi'a baynakumu aul'adaawata waal baghdaa'a fi ail khamri waal maysiri wayasuddakum 'an zikri ail laahi wa'ani ais-sal awaati fahal a aantum mmuntahoon
Waatee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola waahzaru fain tawal laytum faa'lamooaa 'annamaa 'al aa rasoolinaa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen

Laysa 'al aa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati junaah feemaa ta'imooaa 'izaa maa aattaqa wwa'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati thumma aattaqa wwa'aamanu thumma aattaqa wwaahsanu waal laahu yuhibbu aul muhsineen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu layablooannakumu aul laahu bisha' mmina aas-saydi tanaal uhuaa 'aydeekum warimaahukum leea'lama aal laahu many yyakhaafuhu bial ghaybi famani ai'tadaa ba'da zaal ika fal ahu 'azaabun aal eem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa taqtul u aus-sayda waantum hurum waman qatal ahu minkum mmuta'ammida fajazaa'u mithli maa qatal a mina aan-na'ami yahkumu bihi zawaa 'adl mminkum hadyaa baal igha aal ka'bati 'aw kaffaaratu ta'aami masaakeena 'aw 'adlu zaal ika seeaama lleeazooqa wabaal a 'amrihi 'afaa aal laahu 'ammaa sal afa waman 'aada fayantaqimu aul laahu minhu waal laahu 'azeez zoo auntiqaam
Ahil la lakum saydu aul bahri wata'aamuhu mataa'a llakum wal is-sayyaarati wahurrima 'al aykum saydu aul barri maa dumtum huruma waattaqu aul laaha aal ziaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon

Ja'al a aal laahu aul ka'bata aal bayta aal haraama qeeaama llin-naasi waash-shahra aal haraama waal hadya waal qal aa'ida zaal ika lita'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi waanna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Ai'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaabi waanna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Mmaa 'al aa aar-rasooli 'il laa aal bal aaghu waal laahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul-laa yastawi ail khabeethu waat-tayyibu wal awa aa'jabaka kathratu aul khabeethi faattaqu aul laaha yaaooli ail aal baabi la'al lakum tuflihoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tasal u 'ana aashyaa'a an tubda lakum tasu'kum wain tasal u 'anhaa heena yunazzal u aul qur'aanu tubda lakum 'afaa aal laahu 'anhaa waal laahu ghafoorun hal eem
Qad saal ahaa qawm mmin qablikum thumma 'asbahu bihaa kaafireen
Maa ja'al a aal laahu mim baheerat wal aa saa'ibat wal aa waseelat wal aa haam wal aakinna aal zeena kafaru yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba waaktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awia ail aa maa 'anzal a aal laahu wail aa aar-rasooli qaal u hasbunaa maa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana 'aabaa'uhum laa ya'lamoona shaya wal aa yahtadoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'al aykumuaa 'anfusakum laa yadurrukum mman dal la 'izaa aahtadaytumuaa 'il aa aal laahi marji'ukum jamee'a fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu shahaadatu baynikumuaa 'izaa hadara 'ahadakumu aul mawtu heena aal wasiyyati aithnaani zawaa 'adl mminkumuaa 'awa aakharaani min ghayrikumuaa 'ina aantum darabtum fi ail aardi faasaabatkum mmuseebatu aul mawti tahbisoonahumaa mim ba'di ais-sal awaati fayuqsimaani bial laahi 'ini airtabtum laa nashtari bihi thamana wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa wal aa naktumu shahaadata aal laahi 'innaa 'iza llamina aal aathimeen

Fain 'uthira 'al aa 'annahumaa aastahaqqaa 'ithma faakharaani yaqoomaani maqaamahumaa mina aal zeena aastuhiqqa 'al ayhimu aul aawlayaani fayuqsimaani bial laahi lashahaadatunaa 'ahaqqu min shahaadatihimaa wamaa aa'tadaynaa 'innaa 'iza llamina aaz-zaal imeen
Zaal ika 'adnaa 'any yyaatu biash-shahaadati 'al aa wajhihaa 'aw yakhaafooaa 'an turadda 'aymaanu ba'da 'aymaanihim waattaqu aul laaha waasma'u waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen
Yawma yajma'u aul laahu aur-rusul a fayaqoolu maazaa 'ujibtum qaal u laa 'il ma lanaa 'innaka 'anta 'al laamu aul ghuyoob

'iz qaal a aal laahu yaa'eesaa aabna maryama aazkur ni'mati 'al ayka wa'al aa waal idatika 'iza ayyadttuka biroohi ail qudusi tukal limu aun-naasa fi ail mahdi wakahla waiz 'al lamtuka aal kitaaba waal hikmata waat-tawryaata waal ianjeela waiz takhluqu mina aat-teeni kahayati ait-tayri biizni fatanfukhu feehaa fatakoonu taa'iraa biizni watubriu aul aakmaha waal aabrasa biizni waiz tukhriju aul mawtaa biizni waiz kafaftu baniaa 'israa'eela 'anka 'iz jeetahum bial bayyinaati faqaal a aal zeena kafaru minhumuaa 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Waiza aawhaytu 'il aa aal hawaareeyina 'ana aaminu bi wabirasooli qaal ooaa 'aamannaa waashhad biannanaa muslimoon
'iz qaal a aal hawaareeyoona yaa'eesaa aabna maryama hal yastatee'u rabbuka 'any yyunazzil a 'al aynaa maa'idat mmina aas-samaa'i qaal a aattaqu aul laaha 'in kuntum mmoomineen
Qaal u nureedu 'an nnaakul a minhaa watatma'inna qul oobunaa wana'lama 'an qad sadaqtanaa wanakoona 'al ayhaa mina aash-shaahideen
Qaal a 'eesaa aabnu maryama aal laahumma rabbanaa 'anzil 'al aynaa maa'idat mmina aas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eeda lliawwal inaa wa'aakhirinaa wa'ayat mminka waarzuqnaa waanta khayru aur-raaziqeen
Qaal a aal laahu 'inni munazzil uhaa 'al aykum famany yyakfur ba'du minkum fainneea 'u'azzibuhu 'azaaba llaa 'u'azzibuhuaa 'ahada mmina aal'aal ameen

Waiz qaal a aal laahu yaa'eesaa aabna maryama 'aanta qul ta lin-naasi aittakhizooni waummeea 'il aahayni min dooni ail laahi qaal a subhaanaka maa yakoonu leea 'ana aaqoola maa laysa li bihaqqin ain kuntu qul tuhu faqad 'al imtahu ta'lamu maa fi nafsi wal aa 'a'lamu maa fi nafsika 'innaka 'anta 'al laamu aul ghuyoob

Maa qul tu lahumuaa 'il laa maa 'amartani bihiaa 'anu au'budu aul laaha rabbi warabbakum wakuntu 'al ayhim shaheeda mmaa dumtu feehim fal ammaa tawaffaytani kunta 'anta aar-raqeeba 'al ayhim waanta 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed
Ain tu'azzibhum fainnahum 'ibaaduka wain taghfir lahum fainnaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Qaal a aal laahu haazaa yawma yanfa'u aus-saadiqeena sidquhum lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada rradeea aal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Lil hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa feehinna wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda waja'al a aaz-zul umaati waan-noor
Thumma aal zeena kafaru birabbihim ya'dil oon
Hooa aal zi khal aqakum mmin teen thumma qadaa 'ajal a waajal mmusammaan 'indahu thumma 'antum tamtaroon
Wahooa aal laahu fi ais-samaawaati wafi ail aardi ya'lamu sirrakum wajahrakum waya'lamu maa taksiboon
Wamaa taateehim mmina ayat mmina ayaati rabbihimuaa 'il laa kaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Faqad kazzabu bial haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fasawfa yaateehimuaa 'anbaa'ua maa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon

'al am yarawa kama aahlaknaa min qablihim mmin qarn mmakkannaahum fi ail aardi maa lam numakkil llakum waarsal naa aas-samaa'a 'al ayhim mmidraara waja'al naa aal aanhaara tajri min tahtihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim waanshanaa mim ba'dihim qarnaan aakhareen
Wal aw nazzal naa 'al ayka kitaaba fi qirtaas fal amasoohu biaydeehim laqaal a aal zeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Waqaal u lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi mal ak wal awa aanzal naa mal aka llaqudeea aal aamru thumma laa yunzaroon
Wal aw ja'al naahu mal aka llaja'al naahu rajul a wal al abasnaa 'al ayhim mmaa yal bisoon
Wal aqadu austuhzia birusul mmin qablika fahaaqa bial zeena sakhiru minhum mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul seeru fi ail aardi thumma aanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen

Qul-limam mmaa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi qul-lil hi kataba 'al aa nafsihi air-rahmata layajma'annakumuaa 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laa rayba feehi ail zeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum fahum laa yoominoon
Wal ahu maa sakana fi ail yli waan-nahari wahooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem

Qul a aaghayra aal laahi 'attakhizu wal iyya faatiri ais-samaawaati waal aardi wahooa yut'imu wal aa yut'amu qul i ainneea 'umirtu 'ana aakoona 'awwal a mana aaslama wal aa takoonanna mina aal mushrikeen
Qul i ainneea 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbi 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Mmany yyusraf 'anhu yawma'iz faqad rahimahu wazaal ika aal fawzu aul mubeen
Wainy yyamsaska aal laahu bidurr fal aa kaashifa lahuaa 'il laa hooa wainy yyamsaska bikhayr fahooa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wahooa aal qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihi wahooa aal hakeemu aul khabeer

Qul a ayyu sha'in aakbaru shahaadat qul i ail laahu shaheedu bayni wabaynakum waooheea 'il ayya haazaa aal qur'aanu liunzirakum bihi wamam bal agha 'a'innakum latashhadoona 'anna ma'a aal laahi 'aal ihatan akhraa qul-laa 'ashhadu qul i ainnamaa hooa 'il aah waahid wainnani bariaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
Aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona 'abnaa'ahumu aul zeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum fahum laa yoominoon
Wamana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan aaw kazzaba biayaatihiaa 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil zeena 'ashrakooaa 'ayna shurakaa'ukumu aul zeena kuntum taz'umoon
Thumma lam takun fitnatahumuaa 'il laa 'an qaal u waal laahi rabbinaa maa kunnaa mushrikeen
Aanzur kayfa kazabu 'al aa 'anfusihim wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

Waminhum mmany yyastami'u 'il ayka waja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihimuaa 'akinnatan aany yyafqahoohu wafiaa 'aazaanihim waqra wainy yyarawa kul la 'ayat llaa yoominu bihaa hattaa 'izaa jaa'ooka yujaadil oonaka yaqoolu aul zeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul aawwal een
Wahum yanhawna 'anhu wayanawna 'anhu wainy yyuhlikoona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Wal aw taraa 'iz wuqifu 'al aa aan-nari faqaal u yaal aytanaa nuraddu wal aa nukazzibu biayaati rabbinaa wanakoonu mina aal moomineen
Bal badaa lahum mmaa kaanu yukhfoona min qablu wal aw ruddu la'aadu limaa nuhu 'anhu wainnahum lakaaziboon
Waqaal ooaa 'in heea 'il laa hayaatunaa aad-dunya wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
Wal aw taraa 'iz wuqifu 'al aa rabbihim qaal a 'al aysa haazaa bial haqqi qaal u bal aa warabbinaa qaal a fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Qad khasira aal zeena kazzabu bil iqaa'i ail laahi hattaa 'izaa jaa'athumu aus-saa'atu baghtat qaal u yaahasratanaa 'al aa maa farratnaa feehaa wahum yahmil oona 'awzaarahum 'al aa zuhoorihimuaa 'al aa saa'a maa yaziroon
Wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa la'ib wal ahw wal ad-daaru aul aakhiratu khayr llil zeena yattaqoona 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Qad na'lamu 'innahu layuhzinuka aal zi yaqooloona fainnahum laa yukziboonaka wal aakinna aaz-zaal imeena biayaati ail laahi yajhadoon
Wal aqad kuzzibat rusul mmin qablika fasabaru 'al aa maa kuzzibu waoozu hattaa 'atyaahum nasrunaa wal aa mubaddil a likal imaati ail laahi wal aqad jaa'aka min nnabai ail mursal een

Wain kaana kabura 'al ayka 'i'raaduhum faini aistata'ta 'an tabtagheea nafaqa fi ail aardi 'aw sul lama fi ais-samaa'i fataateeahum biayat wal aw shaa'a aal laahu lajama'ahum 'al aa aal hudaa fal aa takoonanna mina aal jaahil een
'innamaa yastajeebu aul zeena yasma'oona waal mawtaa yab'athuhumu aul laahu thumma 'il ayhi yurja'oon
Waqaal u lawlaa nuzzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi qul i ainna aal laaha qaadirun 'al aa 'any yyunazzil a 'ayat wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa min daabbat fi ail aardi wal aa taa'ir yateeru bijanaahayhi 'il laa 'umamun aamthaal ukum mmaa farratnaa fi ail kitaabi min sha' thumma 'il aa rabbihim yuhsharoon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa summ wabukm fi aiz-zul umaati many yyashai ail laahu yudlil hu wamany yyasha yaj'al hu 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Qul a aaraytakumuaa 'ina aatyaakum 'azaabu aul laahi 'awa aatatkumu aus-saa'atu 'aghayra aal laahi tad'oona 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal i aiyyaahu tad'oona fayakshifu maa tad'oona 'il ayhi 'in shaa'a watansawna maa tushrikoon
Wal aqada aarsal naa 'il aa 'umam mmin qablika faakhaznaahum bial basaa'i waad-darraa'i la'al laahum yatadarra'oon
Fal awlaa 'iz jaa'ahum basunaa tadarra'u wal aakin qasat qul oobuhum wazayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fal ammaa nasu maa zukkiru bihi fatahnaa 'al ayhimuaa 'abwaaba kul li sha'in hattaa 'izaa farihu bimaa 'ootooaa 'akhaznaahum baghtat faizaa hum mmublisoon
Faquti'a daabiru aul qawmi ail zeena zal amu waal hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Qul a aaraytumuaa 'ina aakhaza aal laahu sam'akum waabsaarakum wakhatama 'al aa qul oobikum mmani ail aahun ghayru aul laahi yaateekum bihi ainzur kayfa nusarrifu aul ayaati thumma hum yasdifoon
Qul a aaraytakumuaa 'ina aatyaakum 'azaabu aul laahi baghtatan aaw jahratan hal yuhlaku 'il laa aal qawmu auz-zaal imoon
Wamaa nursil u aul mursal eena 'il laa mubashshireena wamunzireena famana aamana waaslaha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa yamassuhumu aul'azaabu bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon

Qul-laa 'aqoolu lakum 'indi khazaa'inu aul laahi wal aa 'a'lamu aul ghayba wal aa 'aqoolu lakumuaa 'inni mal akun aina aattabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya qul hal yastawi ail aa'maa waal baseeru 'afal aa tatafakkaroon
Waanzir bihi ail zeena yakhaafoona 'any yyuhsharooaa 'il aa rabbihim laysa lahum mmin doonihi wal eey wal aa shafee' lla'al laahum yattaqoon

Wal aa tatrudi ail zeena yad'oona rabbahum bial ghadawaati waal'asheeyi yureedoona wajhahu maa 'al ayka min hisaabihim mmin sha' wamaa min hisaabika 'al ayhim mmin sha' fatatrudahum fatakoona mina aaz-zaal imeen
Wakazaal ika fatannaa ba'dahum biba'd lleeaqoolooaa 'ahaa'ul aa'i manna aal laahu 'al ayhim mmim bayninaa 'al aysa aal laahu bia'lama biash-shaakireen

Waizaa jaa'aka aal zeena yoominoona biayaatinaa faqul sal aamun 'al aykum kataba rabbukum 'al aa nafsihi air-rahmata 'annahu man 'amil a minkum sooaa'aa bijahaal at thumma taaba mim ba'dihi waaslaha fainnahu ghafoor rraheem
Wakazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati wal itastabeena sabeela aal mujrimeen
Qul i ainni nuheetu 'ana aa'buda aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi qul-laa 'attabi'u 'ahwaa'akum qad ddal al tu 'iza wamaa 'anaa mina aal muhtadeen
Qul i ainni 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi wakazzabtum bihi maa 'indi maa tasta'jil oona bihiaa 'ini ail hukmu 'il laa lil hi yaqussu aul haqqa wahooa khayru aul faasil een
Qul-lawa aanna 'indi maa tasta'jil oona bihi laqudeea aal aamru bayni wabaynakum waal laahu 'a'lamu biaz-zaal imeen

Wa'indahu mafaatihu aul ghaybi laa ya'lamuhaa 'il laa hooa waya'lamu maa fi ail barri waal bahri wamaa tasqutu minw wwaraqatin ail laa ya'lamuhaa wal aa habbat fi zul umaati ail aardi wal aa ratb wal aa yaabisin ail laa fi kitaab mmubeen
Wahooa aal zi yatawaffyaakum bial yli waya'lamu maa jarahtum bian-nahari thumma yab'athukum feehi leeuqdaa 'ajal mmusamma thumma 'il ayhi marji'ukum thumma yunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wahooa aal qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihi wayursil u 'al aykum hafazatan hattaa 'izaa jaa'a ahadakumu aul mawtu tawaffathu rusul unaa wahum laa yufarritoon
Thumma ruddooaa 'il aa aal laahi mawlyaahumu aul haqqi 'al aa lahu aul hukmu wahooa 'asra'u aul haasibeen
Qul many yyunajjeekum mmin zul umaati ail barri waal bahri tad'oonahu tadarru'a wakhufyat lla'ina aanjaytanaa min haazihi lanakoonanna mina aash-shaakireen
Qul i ail laahu yunjeekum mminhaa wamin kul li karb thumma 'antum tushrikoon

Qul hooa aal qaadiru 'al aa 'any yyab'atha 'al aykum 'azaaba mmin fawqikumuaa 'aw min tahti 'arjul ikumuaa 'aw yal bisakum sheea'a wayuzeeqa ba'dakum basa ba'din aunzur kayfa nusarrifu aul ayaati la'al laahum yafqahoon
Wakazzaba bihi qawmuka wahooa aal haqqu qul-lastu 'al aykum biwakeel llikul li naba mmustaqarr wasawfa ta'lamoon

Waizaa rayta aal zeena yakhoodoona fiaa 'ayaatinaa faa'rid 'anhum hattaa yakhoodu fi hadeethin ghayrihi waimmaa yunseeannaka aash-shaytaanu fal aa taq'ud ba'da aaz-zikraa ma'a aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wamaa 'al aa aal zeena yattaqoona min hisaabihim mmin sha' wal aakin zikraa la'al laahum yattaqoon

Wazari ail zeena aattakhazu deenahum la'iba wal ahwa wagharrathumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunya wazakkir bihiaa 'an tubsal a nafsu bimaa kasabat laysa lahaa min dooni ail laahi wal eey wal aa shafee' wain ta'dil kul la 'adl llaa yookhaz minhaa 'ul aa'ika aal zeena 'ubsil u bimaa kasabu lahum sharaab mmin hameem wa'azaabun aal eemu bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Qul a aanad'u min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'unaa wal aa yadurrunaa wanuraddu 'al aa 'a'qaabinaa ba'da 'iz hadyaanaa aal laahu kaal zi aistahwathu aush-shayaateenu fi ail aardi hayraana lahuaa 'ashaab yad'oonahuaa 'il aa aal hudaa aytinaa qul i ainna hudaa aal laahi hooa aal hudaa waumirnaa linuslima lirabbi ail'aal ameen
Waana aaqeemu aus-sal awaata waattaqoohu wahooa aal ziaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Wahooa aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda bial haqqi wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoon
Qawluhu aul haqqu wal ahu aul mul ku yawma yunfakhu fi ais-soori 'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati wahooa aal hakeemu aul khabeer
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu liabeehi 'aazara 'atattakhizu 'asnaamaan aal ihatan ainneea 'aryaaka waqawmaka fi dal aal mmubeen
Wakazaal ika nuriaa 'ibraaheema mal akoota aas-samaawaati waal aardi wal eeakoona mina aal mooqineen
Fal ammaa janna 'al ayhi ail ylu r'a kawkaba qaal a haazaa rabbi fal ammaa 'afal a qaal a laa 'uhibbu aul aafil een
Fal ammaa ra'aa aal qamara baazigha qaal a haazaa rabbi fal ammaa 'afal a qaal a la'il llam yahdini rabbi laakoonanna mina aal qawmi aid-daal leen
Fal ammaa ra'aa aash-shamsa baazighat qaal a haazaa rabbi haazaa 'akbaru fal ammaa 'afal at qaal a yaaqawmi 'inni bariaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
'inni wajjahtu wajheea lil zi fatara aas-samaawaati waal aarda haneefa wamaa 'anaa mina aal mushrikeen

Wahaajjahu qawmuhu qaal a 'atuhaajjooni fi ail laahi waqad hadyaani wal aa 'akhaafu maa tushrikoona bihiaa 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a rabbi shaya wasi'a rabbi kul la sha'in 'il maan aafal aa tatazakkaroon
Wakayfa 'akhaafu maa 'ashraktum wal aa takhaafoona 'annakumuaa 'ashraktum bial laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi 'al aykum sul taana fayyu aul fareeqayni 'ahaqqu bial aamni 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Aal zeena 'aamanu wal am yal bisooaa 'eemaanahum bizul min awlaa'ika lahumu aul aamnu wahum mmuhtadoon
Watil ka hujjatunaa 'aataynaahaa 'ibraaheema 'al aa qawmihi narfa'u darajaati man nnashaa'u ainna rabbaka hakeemun 'al eem
Wawahabnaa lahuaa 'ishaaqa waya'qooba kul laan hadaynaa wanoohaan hadaynaa min qablu wamin zurriyyatihi daawuda wasul aymaana wayyooba wayoosufa wamoosaa wahaaroona wakazaal ika najzi ail muhsineen
Wazakariyyaa'a wayahyaa wa'eesaa wail yaasa kul l mmina aas-saal iheen
Waismaa'eela waal yasa'a wayoonusa wal oota wakul la faddal naa 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Wamina aabaa'ihim wazurriyyaatihim waikhwaanihim waajtabaynaahum wahadaynaahumuaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Zaal ika hudaa aal laahi yahdi bihi many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wal awa aashraku lahabita 'anhum mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba waal hukma waan-nubooaa'ata fainy yyakfur bihaa haa'ul aa'i faqad wakkal naa bihaa qawma llaysu bihaa bikaafireen
'ul aa'ika aal zeena hadaa aal laahu fabihudyaahumu auqtadih qul-laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajraan ain hooa 'il laa zikraa lil'aal ameen

Wamaa qadaru aul laaha haqqa qadrihiaa 'iz qaal u maa 'anzal a aal laahu 'al aa bashar mmin sha' qul mana aanzal a aal kitaaba aal zi jaa'a bihi moosaa noora wahuda llin-naasi taj'al oonahu qaraateesa tubdoonahaa watukhfoona katheera wa'ul limtum mmaa lam ta'lamooaa 'antum wal aa 'aabaa'ukum qul i ail laahu thumma zarhum fi khawdihim yal'aboon

Wahaazaa kitaabun aanzal naahu mubaarak mmusaddiqu aul zi bayna yadayhi wal itunzira 'umma aal quraa waman hawlahaa waal zeena yoominoona bial aakhirati yoominoona bihi wahum 'al aa sal aatihim yuhaafizoon

Wamana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan aaw qaal a 'ooheea 'il ayya wal am yooha 'il ayhi sha' waman qaal a saunzil u mithla maa 'anzal a aal laahu wal aw taraa 'izi aiz-zaal imoona fi ghamaraati ail mawti waal mal aa'ikatu baasitooaa 'aydeehimuaa 'akhrijooaa 'anfusakumu aul yawma tujzawna 'azaaba aal hooni bimaa kuntum taqooloona 'al aa aal laahi ghayra aal haqqi wakuntum 'ana ayaatihi tastakbiroon

Wal aqad jeetumoonaa furaadaa kamaa khal aqnaakumuaa 'awwal a marrat wataraktum mmaa khawwal naakum waraa'a zuhoorikum wamaa naraa ma'akum shufa'aa'akumu aul zeena za'amtumuaa 'annahum feekum shurakaa'ua laqad ttaqatta'a baynakum wadal la 'ankum mmaa kuntum taz'umoon
'inna aal laaha faal iqu aul habbi waan-nawaa yukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti wamukhriju aul mayyiti mina aal hayyi zaal ikumu aul laahu faannaa toofakoon
Faal iqu aul iasbaahi wajaa'il u aul yli sakana waash-shamsa waal qamara husbaana zaal ika taqdeeru aul'azeezi ail'al eem
Wahooa aal zi ja'al a lakumu aun-nujooma litahtadu bihaa fi zul umaati ail barri waal bahri qad fassal naa aal ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
Wahooa aal ziaa 'anshaakum mmin nnafs waahidat famustaqarr wamustawda' qad fassal naa aal ayaati liqawm yafqahoon

Wahooa aal ziaa 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faakhrajnaa bihi nabaata kul li sha' faakhrajnaa minhu khadira nnukhriju minhu habba mmutaraakiba wamina aan-nakhli min tal'ihaa qinwaan daaneeat wajannaat mmina aa'naab waaz-zaytoona waar-rummaana mushtabiha waghayra mutashaabihin aunzurooaa 'il aa thamarihiaa 'izaa 'athmara wayan'ihiaa 'inna fi zaal ikum layaat lliqawm yoominoon
Waja'al u lil hi shurakaa'a aal jinna wakhal aqahum wakharraqu lahu baneena wabanaati bighayri 'il m subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yasifoon
Badee'u aus-samaawaati waal aardi 'annaa yakoonu lahu wal ad wal am takul llaahu saahibat wakhal aqa kul la sha' wahooa bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa khaal iqu kul li sha' faa'budoohu wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' wakeel
Llaa tudrikuhu aul aabsaaru wahooa yudriku aul aabsaara wahooa aal lateefu aul khabeer
Qad jaa'akum basaa'iru mir rrabbikum famana aabsara fal inafsihi waman 'ameea fa'al ayhaa wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum bihafeez
Wakazaal ika nusarrifu aul ayaati wal eeaqoolu darasta wal inubayyinahu liqawm ya'lamoon
Aattabi' maa 'ooheea 'il ayka mir rrabbika laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa waa'rid 'ani ail mushrikeen
Wal aw shaa'a aal laahu maa 'ashraku wamaa ja'al naaka 'al ayhim hafeeza wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel

Wal aa tasubbu aul zeena yad'oona min dooni ail laahi fayasubbu aul laaha 'adwaa bighayri 'il m kazaal ika zayyannaa likul li 'ummatin 'amal ahum thumma 'il aa rabbihim mmarji'uhum fayunabbeeuhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in jaa'athumuaa 'ayat llayoominunna bihaa qul i ainnamaa aal ayaatu 'inda aal laahi wamaa yush'irukumuaa 'annahaa 'izaa jaa'at laa yoominoon
Wanuqal libu 'afidatahum waabsaarahum kamaa lam yoominu bihiaa 'awwal a marrat wanazaruhum fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Wal awa aannanaa nazzal naa 'il ayhimu aul mal aa'ikata wakal lamahumu aul mawtaa wahasharnaa 'al ayhim kul la sha' qibal a mmaa kaanu leeoominooaa 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu wal aakinna 'aktharahum yajhal oon

Wakazaal ika ja'al naa likul li nabiaa'in 'adoowa shayaateena aal iansi waal jinni yoohi ba'duhumuaa 'il aa ba'd zukhrufa aal qawli ghuroora wal aw shaa'a rabbuka maa fa'al oohu fazarhum wamaa yaftaroon
Wal itasghaa 'il ayhi 'afidatu aul zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati wal eeardawhu wal eeaqtarifu maa hum mmuqtarifoon

'afaghayra aal laahi 'abtaghi hakama wahooa aal ziaa 'anzal a 'il aykumu aul kitaaba mufassal a waal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba ya'lamoona 'annahu munzal mmir rrabbika bial haqqi fal aa takoonanna mina aal mumtareen
Watammat kal imaatu rabbika sidqa wa'adla llaa mubaddil a likal imaatihi wahooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wain tuti'a aakthara man fi ail aardi yudil looka 'an sabeeli ail laahi 'iny yyattabi'oona 'il laa aaz-zanna wain humuaa 'il laa yakhrusoon
'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu many yyadil lu 'an sabeelihi wahooa 'a'lamu bial muhtadeen
Fakul u mimmaa zukira aasmu aul laahi 'al ayhi 'in kuntum biayaatihi moomineen

Wamaa lakumuaa 'al laa taakul u mimmaa zukira aasmu aul laahi 'al ayhi waqad fassal a lakum mmaa harrama 'al aykumuaa 'il laa maa aadturirtumuaa 'il ayhi wainna katheera llayadil loona biahwaa'ihim bighayri 'il min ainna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu bial mu'tadeen
Wazaru zaahira aal iathmi wabaatinahuaa 'inna aal zeena yaksiboona aal iathma sayujzawna bimaa kaanu yaqtarifoon
Wal aa taakul u mimmaa lam yuzkari aismu aul laahi 'al ayhi wainnahu lafisq wainna aash-shayaateena layoohoona 'il aa 'awleeaa'ihim leeujaadil ookum waina aata'tumoohumuaa 'innakum lamushrikoon
'awaman kaana mayyita faahyaynaahu waja'al naa lahu noora yamshi bihi fi ain-naasi kamam mmathal uhu fi aiz-zul umaati laysa bikhaarij mminhaa kazaal ika zuyyina lil kaafireena maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa fi kul li qaryatin aakaabira mujrimeehaa leeamkuru feehaa wamaa yamkuroona 'il laa bianfusihim wamaa yash'uroon

Waizaa jaa'athumuaa 'ayat qaal u lan nnoomina hattaa nootaa mithla maa 'ooteea rusul u aul laahi ail laahu 'a'lamu haythu yaj'al u risaal aatihi sayuseebu aul zeena 'ajramu saghaarun 'inda aal laahi wa'azaab shadeedu bimaa kaanu yamkuroon

Famany yyuridi ail laahu 'any yyahdeeahu yashrah sadrahu lil iaslaami wamany yyurida aany yyudil laahu yaj'al sadrahu dayyiqaan harija kaannamaa yassa'adu fi ais-samaa'i kazaal ika yaj'al u aul laahu aur-rijsa 'al aa aal zeena laa yoominoon
Wahaazaa siraatu rabbika mustaqeema qad fassal naa aal ayaati liqawm yazzakkaroon
Lahum daaru aus-sal aami 'inda rabbihim wahooa wal eeyuhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon

Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a yaama'shara aal jinni qadi aistakthartum mmina aal iansi waqaal a 'awleeaa'uhum mmina aal iansi rabbanaa aastamta'a ba'dunaa biba'd wabal aghnaa 'ajal anaa aal ziaa 'ajjal ta lanaa qaal a aan-naaru mathwyaakum khaal ideena feehaa 'il laa maa shaa'a aal laahu 'inna rabbaka hakeemun 'al eem
Wakazaal ika nooal li ba'da aaz-zaal imeena ba'daa bimaa kaanu yaksiboon

Yaama'shara aal jinni waal iansi 'al am yaatikum rusul mminkum yaqussoona 'al aykumuaa 'ayaati wayunziroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa qaal u shahidnaa 'al aa 'anfusinaa wagharrathumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunya washahidu 'al aa 'anfusihimuaa 'annahum kaanu kaafireen
Zaal ika 'al llam yakur rrabbuka muhlika aal quraa bizul m waahluhaa ghaafil oon
Wal ikul l darajaat mmimmaa 'amil u wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ya'mal oon
Warabbuka aal ghaneeyu zoo aur-rahmati 'iny yyasha yuzhibkum wayastakhlif mim ba'dikum mmaa yashaa'u kamaa 'anshaakum mmin zurriyyati qawmin aakhareen
'inna maa too'adoona laat wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Qul yaaqawmi ai'mal u 'al aa makaanatikumuaa 'inni 'aamil fasawfa ta'lamoona man takoonu lahu 'aaqibatu aud-dari 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon

Waja'al u lil hi mimmaa zaraa mina aal harthi waal aan'aami naseeba faqaal u haazaa lil hi biza'mihim wahaazaa lishurakaa'inaa famaa kaana lishurakaa'ihim fal aa yasil u 'il aa aal laahi wamaa kaana lil hi fahooa yasil u 'il aa shurakaa'ihim saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakazaal ika zayyana likatheer mmina aal mushrikeena qatla 'awlaadihim shurakaa'uhum leeurdoohum wal eeal bisu 'al ayhim deenahum wal aw shaa'a aal laahu maa fa'al oohu fazarhum wamaa yaftaroon

Waqaal u haazihiaa 'an'aam waharthun hijr llaa yat'amuhaa 'il laa man nnashaa'u biza'mihim waan'aamun hurrimat zzuhooruhaa waan'aam llaa yazkuroona aasma aal laahi 'al ayhaa aaftiraa'an 'al ayhi sayajzeehim bimaa kaanu yaftaroon
Waqaal u maa fi butooni haazihi ail aan'aami khaal isat llizukoorinaa wamuharramun 'al aa 'azwaajinaa wainy yyakum mmaytat fahum feehi shurakaa'u sayajzeehim wasfahumuaa 'innahu hakeemun 'al eem
Qad khasira aal zeena qatal ooaa 'awlaadahum safahaa bighayri 'il m waharramu maa razaqahumu aul laahu auftiraa'an 'al aa aal laahi qad ddal lu wamaa kaanu muhtadeen

Wahooa aal ziaa 'anshaa jannaat mma'rooshaat waghayra ma'rooshaat waan-nakhla waaz-zar'a mukhtal ifaan akluhu waaz-zaytoona waar-rummaana mutashaabiha waghayra mutashaabih kul u min thamarihiaa 'izaa 'athmara wa'aatu haqqahu yawma hisaadihi wal aa tusrifooaa 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul musrifeen
Wamina aal aan'aami hamoolat wafarsha kul u mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu wal aa tattabi'u khutwaati aish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen

Thamaaneeata 'azwaaj mmina aad-dani aithnayni wamina aal ma'zi aithnayni qul a aaz-zakarayni harrama 'ami ail uanthayayni 'ammaa aashtamal at 'al ayhi 'arhaamu aul uanthayayni nabbiooni bi'il min ain kuntum saadiqeen

Wamina aal iabil i aithnayni wamina aal baqari aithnayni qul a aaz-zakarayni harrama 'ami ail uanthayayni 'ammaa aashtamal at 'al ayhi 'arhaamu aul uanthayayni 'am kuntum shuhadaa'a az wassyaakumu aul laahu bihaazaa famana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kaziba lleeudil la aan-naasa bighayri 'il min ainna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen

Qul-laa 'ajidu fi maa 'ooheea 'il ayya muharramaan 'al aa taa'im yat'amuhuaa 'il laa 'any yyakoona maytatan aaw dama mmasfoohaan aaw lahma khinzeer fainnahu rijsun aaw fisqaan ahil la lighayri ail laahi bihi famanu audturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fainna rabbaka ghafoor rraheem

Wa'al aa aal zeena haadu harramnaa kul la zi zufur wamina aal baqari waal ghanami harramnaa 'al ayhim shuhoomahumaa 'il laa maa hamal at zzuhooruhumaa 'awi ail hawayaa 'aw maa aakhtal ata bi'azm zaal ika jazaynaahum bibaghyihim wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Fain kazzabooka faqur-rabbukum zoo rahmat waasi'at wal aa yuraddu basuhu 'ani ail qawmi ail mujrimeen

Sayaqoolu aul zeena 'ashraku law shaa'a aal laahu maa 'ashraknaa wal aa 'aabaa'unaa wal aa harramnaa min sha' kazaal ika kazzaba aal zeena min qablihim hattaa zaaqu basanaa qul hal 'indakum mmin 'il m fatukhrijoohu lanaa 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa aaz-zanna waina aantumuaa 'il laa takhrusoon
Qul fal il hi ail hujjatu aul baal ighatu fal aw shaa'a lahadyaakumuaa 'ajma'een

Qul hal umma shuhadaa'akumu aul zeena yashhadoona 'anna aal laaha harrama haazaa fain shahidu fal aa tashhad ma'ahum wal aa tattabi'a aahwaa'a aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waal zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati wahum birabbihim ya'dil oon

Qul ta'aal awaa aatlu maa harrama rabbukum 'al aykumuaa 'al laa tushriku bihi shaya wabial waal idayni 'ihsaana wal aa taqtul ooaa 'awlaadakum mmini aimlaaq nnahnu narzuqukum waiyyaahum wal aa taqrabu aul fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana wal aa taqtul u aun-nafsa aal ti harrama aal laahu 'il laa bial haqqi zaal ikum wassyaakum bihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

Wal aa taqrabu maal a aal yateemi 'il laa bial ti heea 'ahsanu hattaa yablugha 'ashuddahu waawfu aul kayla waal meezaana bial qisti laa nukal lifu nafsaan ail laa wus'ahaa waizaa qul tum faa'dil u wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa wabi'ahdi ail laahi 'awfu zaal ikum wassyaakum bihi la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Waanna haazaa siraati mustaqeema faattabi'oohu wal aa tattabi'u aus-subul a fatafarraqa bikum 'an sabeelihi zaal ikum wassyaakum bihi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Thumma 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba tamaamaan 'al aa aal ziaa 'ahsana watafseela llikul li sha' wahuda warahmat lla'al laahum bil iqaa'i rabbihim yoominoon
Wahaazaa kitaabun aanzal naahu mubaarak faattabi'oohu waattaqu la'al lakum turhamoon
'an taqoolooaa 'innamaa 'unzil a aal kitaabu 'al aa taa'ifatayni min qablinaa wain kunnaa 'an diraasatihim laghaafil een

'aw taqoolu lawa aannaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa aal kitaabu lakunnaa 'ahdaa minhum faqad jaa'akum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum wahuda warahmat famana aazlamu mimman kazzaba biayaati ail laahi wasadafa 'anhaa sanajzi ail zeena yasdifoona 'ana ayaatinaa sooaa'a aal'azaabi bimaa kaanu yasdifoon

Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'an taateeahumu aul mal aa'ikatu 'aw yaateea rabbuka 'aw yaateea ba'du 'ayaati rabbika yawma yaati ba'du 'ayaati rabbika laa yanfa'u nafsaan aeemaanuhaa lam takuna aamanat min qablu 'aw kasabat fiaa 'eemaanihaa khayra qul i aintazirooaa 'innaa muntaziroon
'inna aal zeena farraqu deenahum wakaanu sheea'a llasta minhum fi sha'in ainnamaa 'amruhumuaa 'il aa aal laahi thumma yunabbeeuhum bimaa kaanu yaf'al oon
Man jaa'a bial hasanati fal ahu 'ashru 'amthaal ihaa waman jaa'a bias-sayyeeati fal aa yujzaa 'il laa mithlahaa wahum laa yuzlamoon
Qul i ainnani hadyaani rabbeea 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Deena qayyima mmil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen
Qul i ainna sal aati wanusuki wamahyaa wamamaateea lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Laa shareeka lahu wabizaal ika 'umirtu waanaa 'awwal u aul muslimeen

Qul a aaghayra aal laahi 'abghi rabba wahooa rabbu kul li sha' wal aa taksibu kul lu nafsin ail laa 'al ayhaa wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa thumma 'il aa rabbikum mmarji'ukum fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Wahooa aal zi ja'al akum khal aa'ifa aal aardi warafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'd darajaat lleeablooakum fi maa 'aatyaakumuaa 'inna rabbaka saree'u aul'iqaabi wainnahu laghafoor rraheem
Aal aammiaasaa kitaabun aunzil a 'il ayka fal aa yakun fi sadrika haraj mminhu litunzira bihi wazikraa lil moomineen
Aattabi'u maa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum wal aa tattabi'u min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a qal eela mmaa tazzakkaroon
Wakam mmin qaryatin aahlaknaahaa fajaa'ahaa basunaa bayaataan aaw hum qaa'il oon
Famaa kaana da'wyaahumuaa 'iz jaa'ahum basunaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Fal anasal anna aal zeena 'ursil a 'il ayhim wal anasal anna aal mursal een
Fal anaqussanna 'al ayhim bi'il m wamaa kunnaa ghaa'ibeen
Waal waznu yawma'izin ail haqqu faman thaqul at mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika aal zeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum bimaa kaanu biayaatinaa yazlimoon
Wal aqad makkannaakum fi ail aardi waja'al naa lakum feehaa ma'ayisha qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Wal aqad khal aqnaakum thumma sawwarnaakum thumma qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa lam yakum mmina aas-saajideen
Qaal a maa mana'aka 'al laa tasjuda 'iza aamartuka qaal a 'anaa khayr mminhu khal aqtani min nnar wakhal aqtahu min teen
Qaal a faahbit minhaa famaa yakoonu laka 'an tatakabbara feehaa faakhruji ainnaka mina aas-saaghireen
Qaal a 'anzirniaa 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a 'innaka mina aal munzareen
Qaal a fabimaa 'aghwaytani laaq'udanna lahum siraataka aal mustaqeem
Thumma laateeannahum mmim bayni 'aydeehim wamin khal fihim wa'ana aymaanihim wa'an shamaa'il ihim wal aa tajidu 'aktharahum shaakireen
Qaal a aakhruj minhaa maz'ooma mmadhoora llaman tabi'aka minhum laamlaanna jahannama minkumuaa 'ajma'een
Wayaadamu auskuna aanta wazawjuka aal jannata fakul aa min haythu sheetumaa wal aa taqrabaa haazihi aish-shajarata fatakoonaa mina aaz-zaal imeen

Fawaswasa lahumaa aash-shaytaanu leeubdeea lahumaa maa wureea 'anhumaa min saw'aatihimaa waqaal a maa nahyaakumaa rabbukumaa 'an haazihi aish-shajarati 'il laa 'an takoonaa mal akayni 'aw takoonaa mina aal khaal ideen
Waqaasamahumaa 'inni lakumaa lamina aan-naasiheen

Fadal lyaahumaa bighuroor fal ammaa zaaqaa aash-shajarata badat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa watafiqaa yakhsifaani 'al ayhimaa minw wwaraqi ail jannati wanaadyaahumaa rabbuhumaa 'al ama aanhakumaa 'an til kumaa aash-shajarati waaqul-lakumaa 'inna aash-shaytaana lakumaa 'adoow mmubeen
Qaal aa rabbanaa zal amnaa 'anfusanaa wail llam taghfir lanaa watarhamnaa lanakoonanna mina aal khaasireen
Qaal a aahbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'adoow wal akum fi ail aardi mustaqarr wamataa'un ail aa heen
Qaal a feehaa tahyawna wafeehaa tamootoona waminhaa tukhrajoon
Yaabaniaa 'aadama qada aanzal naa 'al aykum libaasa yooaari saw'aatikum wareesha wal ibaasa aat-taqwaa zaal ika khayr zaal ika mina ayaati ail laahi la'al laahum yazzakkaroon

Yaabaniaa 'aadama laa yaftinannakumu aush-shaytaanu kamaa 'akhraja 'abawaykum mmina aal jannati yanzi'u 'anhumaa libaasahumaa leeureeahumaa saw'aatihimaa 'innahu yaryaakum hooa waqabeeluhu min haythu laa tarawnahumuaa 'innaa ja'al naa aash-shayaateena 'awleeaa'a lil zeena laa yoominoon
Waizaa fa'al u faahishat qaal u wajadnaa 'al ayhaa 'aabaa'anaa waal laahu 'amaranaa bihaa qul i ainna aal laaha laa yaamuru bial fahshaa'i aataqooloona 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon

Qul a aamara rabbi bial qisti waaqeemu wujoohakum 'inda kul li masjid waad'oohu mukhliseena lahu aud-deena kamaa badaakum ta'oodoona fareeqaan hadaa wafareeqaan haqqa 'al ayhimu aud-dal aal atu 'innahumu auttakhazu aush-shayaateena 'awleeaa'a min dooni ail laahi wayahsiboona 'annahum mmuhtadoon
Yaabaniaa 'aadama khuzu zeenatakum 'inda kul li masjid wakul u waashrabu wal aa tusrifooaa 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul musrifeen

Qul man harrama zeenata aal laahi ail tiaa 'akhraja li'ibaadihi waat-tayyibaati mina aar-rizqi qul heea lil zeena 'aamanu fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya khaal isat yawma aal qeeaamati kazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon

Qul i ainnamaa harrama rabbeea aal fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana waal iathma waal baghya bighayri ail haqqi waan tushriku bial laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana waan taqoolu 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Wal ikul li 'ummatin aajal faizaa jaa'a ajal uhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Yaabaniaa 'aadama 'immaa yaateeannakum rusul mminkum yaqussoona 'al aykumuaa 'ayaati famani aittaqaa waaslaha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waastakbaru 'anhaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-nari hum feehaa khaal idoon

Famana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan aaw kazzaba biayaatihiaa 'ul aa'ika yanaal uhum naseebuhum mmina aal kitaabi hattaa 'izaa jaa'athum rusul unaa yatawaffawnahum qaal ooaa 'ayna maa kuntum tad'oona min dooni ail laahi qaal u dal lu 'annaa washahidu 'al aa 'anfusihimuaa 'annahum kaanu kaafireen

Qaal a aadkhul u fiaa 'umam qad khal at min qablikum mmina aal jinni waal iansi fi ain-nari kul lamaa dakhal atu ammat lla'anatu akhtahaa hattaa 'izaa aaddaaraku feehaa jamee'a qaal atu akhryaahum lioolyaahum rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i aadal loonaa faatihim 'azaaba di'fa mmina aan-nar
Qaal a likul l di'f wal aakil llaa ta'lamoon
Waqaal atu awlyaahum liukhryaahum famaa kaana lakum 'al aynaa min fadl fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum taksiboon

'inna aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waastakbaru 'anhaa laa tufattahu lahumuaa 'abwaabu aus-samaa'i wal aa yadkhul oona aal jannata hattaa yal ija aal jamal u fi sammi ail kheeaati wakazaal ika najzi ail mujrimeen
Lahum mmin jahannama mihaad wamin fawqihim ghawaash wakazaal ika najzi aiz-zaal imeen
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati laa nukal lifu nafsaan ail laa wus'ahaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Wanaza'naa maa fi sudoorihim mmin ghil l tajri min tahtihimu aul aanhaaru waqaal u aul hamdu lil hi ail zi hadyaanaa lihaazaa wamaa kunnaa linahtadeea lawlaa 'an hadyaanaa aal laahu laqad jaa'at rusul u rabbinaa bial haqqi wanoodooaa 'an til kumu aul jannatu 'oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

Wanaadaa 'ashaabu aul jannati 'ashaaba aan-nari 'an qad wajadnaa maa wa'adanaa rabbunaa haqqa fahal wajadttum mmaa wa'ada rabbukum haqqa qaal u na'am faazzana mooazzinu baynahumuaa 'al lla'natu aul laahi 'al aa aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena yasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwaja wahum bial aakhirati kaafiroon
Wabaynahumaa hijaab wa'al aa aal aa'raafi rijaal ya'rifoona kul laa biseemyaahum wanaadawaa aashaaba aal jannati 'an sal aamun 'al aykum lam yadkhul oohaa wahum yatma'oon
Waizaa surifata aabsaaruhum til qaa'a ashaabi ain-nari qaal u rabbanaa laa taj'al naa ma'a aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wanaadaa 'ashaabu aul aa'raafi rijaal a ya'rifoonahum biseemyaahum qaal u maa 'aghnaa 'ankum jam'ukum wamaa kuntum tastakbiroon
'ahaa'ul aa'i ail zeena 'aqsamtum laa yanaal uhumu aul laahu birahmatin audkhul u aul jannata laa khawfun 'al aykum wal aa 'antum tahzanoon
Wanaadaa 'ashaabu aun-nari 'ashaaba aal jannati 'ana aafeedu 'al aynaa mina aal maa'i aaw mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu qaal ooaa 'inna aal laaha harramahumaa 'al aa aal kaafireen
Aal zeena aattakhazu deenahum lahwa wal a'iba wagharrathumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunya faal yawma nansyaahum kamaa nasu liqaa'a yawmihim haazaa wamaa kaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Wal aqad jeenaahum bikitaab fassal naahu 'al aa 'il min huda warahmat lliqawm yoominoon

Hal yanzuroona 'il laa taaweelahu yawma yaati taaweeluhu yaqoolu aul zeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusul u rabbinaa bial haqqi fahal-lanaa min shufa'aa'a fayashfa'u lanaa 'aw nuraddu fana'mal a ghayra aal zi kunnaa na'mal u qad khasirooaa 'anfusahum wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

'inna rabbakumu aul laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi yughshi ail yla aan-nahaara yatlubuhu hatheetha waash-shamsa waal qamara waan-nujooma musakhkharaati biamrihiaa 'al aa lahu aul khal qu waal aamru tabaaraka aal laahu rabbu aul'aal ameen
Aad'u rabbakum tadarru'a wakhufyatan ainnahu laa yuhibbu aul mu'tadeen
Wal aa tufsidu fi ail aardi ba'da 'islaahihaa waad'oohu khawfa watama'aan ainna rahmata aal laahi qareeb mmina aal muhsineen

Wahooa aal zi yursil u aur-reeaaha nushuraa bayna yada rahmatihi hattaa 'izaa 'aqal lat sahaaba thiqaal a suqnaahu libal ad mmayyit faanzal naa bihi ail maa'a faakhrajnaa bihi min kul li aith-thamaraati kazaal ika nukhriju aul mawtaa la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Waal bal adu aut-tayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhu biizni rabbihi waal zi khabutha laa yakhruju 'il laa nakida kazaal ika nusarrifu aul ayaati liqawm yashkuroon
Laqada aarsal naa noohaan ail aa qawmihi faqaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhuaa 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qaal a aal mal au min qawmihiaa 'innaa lanaryaaka fi dal aal mmubeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi laysa bi dal aal at wal aakinni rasool mmir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'ubal lighukum risaal aati rabbi waansahu lakum waa'lamu mina aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
'awa'ajibtumuaa 'an jaa'akum zikr mmir rrabbikum 'al aa rajul mminkum leeunzirakum wal itattaqu wal a'al lakum turhamoon
Fakazzaboohu faanjaynaahu waal zeena ma'ahu fi ail ful ki waaghraqnaa aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa 'innahum kaanu qawmaan 'ameen
Wail aa 'aadin aakhaahum hooda qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhuaa 'afal aa tattaqoon
Qaal a aal mal au aul zeena kafaru min qawmihiaa 'innaa lanaryaaka fi safaahat wainnaa lanazunnuka mina aal kaazibeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi laysa bi safaahat wal aakinni rasool mmir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'ubal lighukum risaal aati rabbi waanaa lakum naasihun aameen

Aawa'ajibtumuaa 'an jaa'akum zikr mmir rrabbikum 'al aa rajul mminkum leeunzirakum waazkurooaa 'iz ja'al akum khul afaa'a mim ba'di qawmi nooh wazaadakum fi ail khal qi bastat faazkurooaa 'aal aa'a aal laahi la'al lakum tuflihoon
Qaal ooaa 'ajeetanaa lina'buda aal laaha wahdahu wanazara maa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen

Qaal a qad waqa'a 'al aykum mmir rrabbikum rijs waghadabun aatujaadil oonani fiaa 'asmaa' sammaytumoohaa 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum mmaa nazzal a aal laahu bihaa min sul taan faantazirooaa 'inni ma'akum mmina aal muntazireen
Faanjaynaahu waal zeena ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa waqata'naa daabira aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wamaa kaanu moomineen

Wail aa thamooda 'akhaahum saal iha qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum haazihi naaqatu aul laahi lakumuaa 'ayat fazaroohaa taakul fiaa 'ardi ail laahi wal aa tamassoohaa bisooaa' fayaakhuzakum 'azaabun aal eem

Waazkurooaa 'iz ja'al akum khul afaa'a mim ba'di 'aad wabawwaakum fi ail aardi tattakhizoona min suhoolihaa qusoora watanhitoona aal jibaal a buyoota faazkurooaa 'aal aa'a aal laahi wal aa ta'thawa fi ail aardi mufsideen
Qaal a aal mal au aul zeena aastakbaru min qawmihi lil zeena aastud'ifu limana aamana minhumuaa 'ata'lamoona 'anna saal iha mmursal mmir rrabbihi qaal ooaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil a bihi moominoon
Qaal a aal zeena aastakbarooaa 'innaa bial ziaa 'aamantum bihi kaafiroon
Fa'aqaru aun-naaqata wa'atawa 'ana aamri rabbihim waqaal u yaasaal ihu auytinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aal mursal een
Faakhazathumu aur-rajfatu faasbahu fi darihim jaathimeen
