Fatawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaaqawmi laqada aablaghtukum risaal ata rabbi wanasahtu lakum wal aakil llaa tuhibboona aan-naasiheen
Wal ootaan aiz qaal a liqawmihiaa 'ataatoona aal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa mina aahad mmina aal'aal ameen
'innakum lataatoona aar-rijaal a shahwat mmin dooni ain-nisaa'i bal a aantum qawm mmusrifoon
Wamaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'akhrijoohum mmin qaryatikumuaa 'innahumuaa 'unaas yatatahharoon
Faanjaynaahu waahlahuaa 'il laa aamraatahu kaanat mina aal ghaabireen
Waamtarnaa 'al ayhim mmatara faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mujrimeen

Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum faawfu aul kayla waal meezaana wal aa tabkhasu aun-naasa 'ashyaa'ahum wal aa tufsidu fi ail aardi ba'da 'islaahihaa zaal ikum khayr llakumuaa 'in kuntum mmoomineen

Wal aa taq'udu bikul li siraat too'idoona watasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi mana aamana bihi watabghoonahaa 'iwaja waazkurooaa 'iz kuntum qal eela fakaththarakum waanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mufsideen
Wain kaana taa'ifat mminkumuaa 'aamanu bial ziaa 'ursil tu bihi wataa'ifat llam yoominu faasbiru hattaa yahkuma aal laahu baynanaa wahooa khayru aul haakimeen
Qaal a aal mal au aul zeena aastakbaru min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka yaashu'aybu waal zeena 'aamanu ma'aka min qaryatinaa 'aw lata'oodunna fi mil latinaa qaal a 'awal aw kunnaa kaariheen

Qadi aiftaraynaa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan ain 'udnaa fi mil latikum ba'da 'iz najjyaanaa aal laahu minhaa wamaa yakoonu lanaa 'an nna'ooda feehaa 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu rabbunaa wasi'a rabbunaa kul la sha'in 'il maan 'al aa aal laahi tawakkal naa rabbanaa aaftah baynanaa wabayna qawminaa bial haqqi waanta khayru aul faatiheen
Waqaal a aal mal au aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi la'ini aittaba'tum shu'aybaan ainnakumuaa 'iza llakhaasiroon
Faakhazathumu aur-rajfatu faasbahu fi darihim jaathimeen
Aal zeena kazzabu shu'ayba kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa aal zeena kazzabu shu'ayba kaanu humu aul khaasireen
Fatawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaaqawmi laqada aablaghtukum risaal aati rabbi wanasahtu lakum fakayfa 'aasaa 'al aa qawm kaafireen
Wamaa 'arsal naa fi qaryat mmin nnabiaa'in ail laa 'akhaznaa 'ahlahaa bial basaa'i waad-darraa'i la'al laahum yaddarra'oon
Thumma baddal naa makaana aas-sayyeeati ail hasanata hattaa 'afa wwaqaal u qad massa 'aabaa'anaa aad-darraa'u waas-sarraa'u faakhaznaahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Wal awa aanna 'ahla aal quraa 'aamanu waattaqawa lafatahnaa 'al ayhim barakaat mmina aas-samaa'i waal aardi wal aakin kazzabu faakhaznaahum bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
'afaamina 'ahlu aul quraa 'any yyaateeahum basunaa bayaata wahum naa'imoon
'awaamina 'ahlu aul quraa 'any yyaateeahum basunaa duha wahum yal'aboon
'afaaminu makra aal laahi fal aa yaamanu makra aal laahi 'il laa aal qawmu aul khaasiroon
'awal am yahdi lil zeena yarithoona aal aarda mim ba'di 'ahlihaa 'al llaw nashaa'u aasabnaahum bizunoobihim wanatba'u 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yasma'oon

Til ka aal quraa naqussu 'al ayka mina aanbaa'ihaa wal aqad jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati famaa kaanu leeoominu bimaa kazzabu min qablu kazaal ika yatba'u aul laahu 'al aa qul oobi ail kaafireen
Wamaa wajadnaa liaktharihim mmin 'ahd wainw wwajadnaa 'aktharahum lafaasiqeen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim mmoosaa biayaatinaa 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi fazal amu bihaa faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mufsideen
Waqaal a moosaa yaafir'awnu 'inni rasool mmir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
Haqeequn 'al ayya 'al llaa 'aqoola 'al aa aal laahi 'il laa aal haqqa qad jeetukum bibayyinat mmir rrabbikum faarsil ma'i baniaa 'israa'eel
Qaal a 'in kunta jeeta biayat faati bihaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Faal qaa 'asaahu faizaa heea thu'baam mmubeen
Wanaza'a yadahu faizaa heea baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaal a aal mal au min qawmi fir'awna 'inna haazaa lasaahirun 'al eem
Yureedu 'any yyukhrijakum mmina aardikum famaazaa taamuroon
Qaal ooaa 'arjihi waakhaahu waarsil fi ail madaa'ini haashireen
Yaatooka bikul li saahirin 'al eem
Wajaa'a aas-saharatu fir'awna qaal ooaa 'inna lanaa laajraan ain kunnaa nahnu aul ghaal ibeen
Qaal a na'am wainnakum lamina aal muqarrabeen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'immaa 'an tul qeea waimmaa 'an nnakoona nahnu aul mul qeen
Qaal a 'al qu fal ammaa 'al qawa saharooaa 'a'yuna aan-naasi waastarhaboohum wajaa'oo bisihrin 'azeem
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'ana aal qi 'asaaka faizaa heea tal aqqafu maa yaafikoon
Fawaqa'a aal haqqu wabatal a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faghul ibu hunaal ika waanqal abu saaghireen
Waul qeea aas-saharatu saajideen
Qaal ooaa 'aamannaa birabbi ail'aal ameen
Rabbi moosaa wahaaroon
Qaal a fir'awnu 'aamantum bihi qabla 'ana aazana lakumuaa 'inna haazaa lamakr mmakartumoohu fi ail madeenati litukhriju minhaa 'ahlahaa fasawfa ta'lamoon
Lauqatti'anna 'aydeeakum waarjul akum mmin khil aaf thumma lausal libannakumuaa 'ajma'een
Qaal ooaa 'innaa 'il aa rabbinaa munqal iboon
Wamaa tanqimu minnaa 'il laa 'ana aamannaa biayaati rabbinaa lammaa jaa'atnaa rabbanaa 'afrigh 'al aynaa sabra watawaffanaa muslimeen
Waqaal a aal mal au min qawmi fir'awna 'atazaru moosaa waqawmahu leeufsidu fi ail aardi wayazaraka wa'aal ihataka qaal a sanaqtul u 'abnaa'ahum wanastahyi nisaa'ahum wainnaa fawqahum qaahiroon
Qaal a moosaa liqawmihi aista'eenu bial laahi waasbirooaa 'inna aal aarda lil hi yoorithuhaa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi waal'aaqibatu lil muttaqeen
Qaal ooaa 'oozeenaa min qabli 'an taateeanaa wamim ba'di maa jeetanaa qaal a 'asaa rabbukumuaa 'any yyuhlika 'adoowakum wayastakhlifakum fi ail aardi fayanzura kayfa ta'mal oon
Wal aqada aakhaznaa 'aal a fir'awna bias-sineena wanaqs mmina aath-thamaraati la'al laahum yazzakkaroon
Faizaa jaa'athumu aul hasanatu qaal u lanaa haazihi wain tusibhum sayyeeat yattayyaru bimoosaa wamam mma'ahuaa 'al aa 'innamaa taa'iruhum 'inda aal laahi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Waqaal u mahmaa taatinaa bihi mina ayat llitasharanaa bihaa famaa nahnu laka bimoomineen
Faarsal naa 'al ayhimu aut-toofaana waal jaraada waal qummal a waad-dafaadi'a waad-dama 'ayaat mmufassal aat faastakbaru wakaanu qawma mmujrimeen
Wal ammaa waqa'a 'al ayhimu aur-rijzu qaal u yaamoosaa aad'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka la'in kashafta 'annaa aar-rijza lanoominanna laka wal anursil anna ma'aka baniaa 'israa'eel
Fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhumu aur-rijza 'il aa 'ajal in hum baal ighoohu 'izaa hum yankuthoon
Faantaqamnaa minhum faaghraqnaahum fi ail yammi biannahum kazzabu biayaatinaa wakaanu 'anhaa ghaafil een
Waawrathnaa aal qawma aal zeena kaanu yustad'afoona mashaariqa aal aardi wamaghaaribahaa aal ti baaraknaa feehaa watammat kal imatu rabbika aal husnaa 'al aa baniaa 'israa'eel
Bimaa sabaru wadammarnaa maa kaana yasna'u fir'awnu waqawmuhu wamaa kaanu ya'rishoon
Wajaawaznaa bibaniaa 'israa'eela aal bahra faatawa 'al aa qawm ya'kufoona 'al aa 'asnaam llaahum qaal u yaamoosaa aaj'al-lanaa 'il aaha kamaa lahumuaa 'aal ihat qaal a 'innakum qawm tajhal oon
'inna haa'ul aa'i mutabbar mmaa hum feehi wabaatil mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Qaal a 'aghayra aal laahi 'abgheekumuaa 'il aaha wahooa faddal akum 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Waiza aanjaynaakum mmina aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'a aal'azaabi yaqtul oona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafi zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem

Wawaa'adnaa moosaa thal aatheena laylat waatmamnaahaa bi'ashr fatamma meeqaatu rabbihiaa 'arba'eena laylat waqaal a moosaa liakheehi haaroona aakhlufni fi qawmi waaslih wal aa tattabi' sabeela aal mufsideen

Wal ammaa jaa'a moosaa limeeqaatinaa wakal lamahu rabbuhu qaal a rabbi 'ariniaa 'anzuri ail ayka qaal a lan taryaani wal aakinu aunzuri ail aa aal jabal i faini aistaqarra makaanahu fasawfa taryaani fal ammaa tajal laa rabbuhu lil jabal i ja'al ahu dakka wakharra moosaa sa'iqa fal ammaa 'afaaqa qaal a subhaanaka tubtu 'il ayka waanaa 'awwal u aul moomineen
Qaal a yaamoosaa 'inni aistafaytuka 'al aa aan-naasi birisaal ati wabikal aami fakhuz maa 'aataytuka wakum mmina aash-shaakireen
Wakatabnaa lahu fi ail aal waahi min kul li sha' mmaw'izat watafseela llikul li sha' fakhuzhaa biqoowat waamur qawmaka yaakhuzu biahsanihaa saooreekum daara aal faasiqeen

Saasrifu 'ana ayaateea aal zeena yatakabbaroona fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi wainy yyarawa kul la 'ayat llaa yoominu bihaa wainy yyarawa sabeela aar-rushdi laa yattakhizoohu sabeela wainy yyarawa sabeela aal ghayyi yattakhizoohu sabeela zaal ika biannahum kazzabu biayaatinaa wakaanu 'anhaa ghaafil een
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wal iqaa'i ail aakhirati habitata aa'maal uhum hal yujzawna 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waattakhaza qawmu moosaa mim ba'dihi min hul eeyihim 'ijla jasada llaahu khooaarun aal am yarawaa aannahu laa yukal limuhum wal aa yahdeehim sabeelaan aittakhazoohu wakaanu zaal imeen
Wal ammaa suqita fiaa 'aydeehim waraawaa aannahum qad ddal lu qaal u la'il llam yarhamnaa rabbunaa wayaghfir lanaa lanakoonanna mina aal khaasireen

Wal ammaa raja'a moosaa 'il aa qawmihi ghadbaana 'asifa qaal a beesamaa khal aftumooni mim ba'deea 'a'ajil tumuaa 'amra rabbikum waal qaa aal aal waaha waakhaza birasi 'akheehi yajurruhuaa 'il ayhi qaal a aabna 'umma 'inna aal qawma aastad'afooni wakaadu yaqtul oonani fal aa tushmit beea aal aa'daa'a wal aa taj'al ni ma'a aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Qaal a rabbi aighfir li wal iakhi waadkhil naa fi rahmatika waanta 'arhamu aur-raahimeen
'inna aal zeena aattakhazu aul'ijla sayanaal uhum ghadab mmir rrabbihim wazil lat fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wakazaal ika najzi ail muftareen
Waal zeena 'amil u aus-sayyiaati thumma taabu mim ba'dihaa wa'aamanooaa 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Wal ammaa sakata 'am mmoosaa aal ghadabu 'akhaza aal aal waaha wafi nuskhatihaa huda warahmat llil zeena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon

Waakhtaara moosaa qawmahu sab'eena rajul a llimeeqaatinaa fal ammaa 'akhazathumu aur-rajfatu qaal a rabbi law sheeta 'ahlaktahum mmin qablu waiyyaya 'atuhlikunaa bimaa fa'al a aas-sufahaa'u minnaa 'in heea 'il laa fitnatuka tudil lu bihaa man tashaa'u watahdi man tashaa'u aanta wal eeyunaa faaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa waanta khayru aul ghaafireen

Waaktub lanaa fi haazihi aid-dunya hasanat wafi ail aakhirati 'innaa hudnaa 'il ayka qaal a 'azaabeea 'useebu bihi mana aashaa'u warahmati wasi'at kul la sha' fasaaktubuhaa lil zeena yattaqoona wayootoona aaz-zakawaata waal zeena hum biayaatinaa yoominoon

Aal zeena yattabi'oona aar-rasoola aan-nabiaa'a aal uammiyya aal zi yajidoonahu maktoobaan 'indahum fi ait-tawryaati waal ianjeeli yaamuruhum bial ma'roofi wayanhyaahum 'ani ail munkari wayuhil lu lahumu aut-tayyibaati wayuharrimu 'al ayhimu aul khabaa'itha wayada'u 'anhumuaa 'israhum waal aaghlaal a aal ti kaanat 'al ayhim faal zeena 'aamanu bihi wa'azzaroohu wanasaroohu waattaba'u aun-noora aal ziaa 'unzil a ma'ahuaa 'ul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon

Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'inni rasoolu aul laahi 'il aykum jamee'aan ail zi lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa yuhyi wayumeetu faaminu bial laahi warasoolihi ain-nabiaa'i ail uammeeyi ail zi yoominu bial laahi wakal imaatihi waattabi'oohu la'al lakum tahtadoon
Wamin qawmi moosaa 'ummat yahdoona bial haqqi wabihi ya'dil oon

Waqatta'naahumu authnata 'ashrata 'asbaataan amama waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'izi aistasqyaahu qawmuhuaa 'ani aidrib bbi'asaaka aal hajara faanbajasat minhu authnataa 'ashrata 'ayna qad 'al ima kul lu 'unaas mmashrabahum wazal lal naa 'al ayhimu aul ghamaama waanzal naa 'al ayhimu aul manna waas-sal waa kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wamaa zal amoonaa wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Waiz qeela lahumu auskunu haazihi ail qaryata wakul u minhaa haythu sheetum waqoolu hittat waadkhul u aul baaba sujjada tughfar lakum khateeaatukum sanazeedu aul muhsineen
Fabaddal a aal zeena zal amu minhum qawlaan ghayra aal zi qeela lahum faarsal naa 'al ayhim rijza mmina aas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yazlimoon

Wasal hum 'ani ail qaryati ail ti kaanat haadirata aal bahri 'iz ya'doona fi ais-sabti 'iz taateehim heetaanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra'a wayawma laa yasbitoona laa taateehim kazaal ika nabloohum bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Waiz qaal atu ammat mminhum lima ta'izoona qawmaan ail laahu muhlikuhumuaa 'aw mu'azzibuhum 'azaaba shadeeda qaal u ma'ziratun ail aa rabbikum wal a'al laahum yattaqoon
Fal ammaa nasu maa zukkiru bihiaa 'anjaynaa aal zeena yanhawna 'ani ais-sooaa'i waakhaznaa aal zeena zal amu bi'azaabi beesi bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Fal ammaa 'atawa 'am mmaa nuhu 'anhu qul naa lahum koonu qiradatan khaasieen
Waiz taazzana rabbuka layab'athanna 'al ayhimuaa 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati many yyasoomuhum sooaa'a aal'azaabi 'inna rabbaka lasaree'u aul'iqaabi wainnahu laghafoor rraheem
Waqatta'naahum fi ail aardi 'umama mminhumu aus-saal ihoona waminhum doona zaal ika wabal awnaahum bial hasanaati waas-sayyiaati la'al laahum yarji'oon

Fakhal afa mim ba'dihim khal f warithu aul kitaaba yaakhuzoona 'arada haazaa aal aadnaa wayaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa wainy yyaatihim 'arad mmithluhu yaakhuzoohu 'al am yookhaz 'al ayhim mmeethaaqu aul kitaabi 'al llaa yaqoolu 'al aa aal laahi 'il laa aal haqqa wadarasu maa feehi waad-daaru aul aakhiratu khayr llil zeena yattaqoona 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Waal zeena yumassikoona bial kitaabi waaqaamu aus-sal awaata 'innaa laa nudee'u 'ajra aal musliheen
Waiz nataqnaa aal jabal a fawqahum kaannahu zul lat wazannooaa 'annahu waaqi'u bihim khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat waazkuru maa feehi la'al lakum tattaqoon

Waiza aakhaza rabbuka mim baniaa 'aadama min zuhoorihim zurriyyaatihim waashhadahum 'al aa 'anfusihimuaa 'al astu birabbikum qaal u bal aa shahidnaa 'an taqoolu yawma aal qeeaamati 'innaa kunnaa 'an haazaa ghaafil een
'aw taqoolooaa 'innamaa 'ashraka 'aabaa'unaa min qablu wakunnaa zurriyyat mmim ba'dihimuaa 'afatuhlikunaa bimaa fa'al a aal mubtil oon
Wakazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati wal a'al laahum yarji'oon
Waatlu 'al ayhim nabaa aal ziaa 'aataynaahu 'ayaatinaa faansal akha minhaa faatba'ahu aush-shaytaanu fakaana mina aal ghaaween

Wal aw sheenaa larafa'naahu bihaa wal aakinnahuaa 'akhlada 'il aa aal aardi waattaba'a hawyaahu famathal uhu kamathal i ail kal bi 'in tahmil 'al ayhi yal hatha aaw tatrukhu yal hath zaal ika mathal u aul qawmi ail zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa faaqsusi ail qasasa la'al laahum yatafakkaroon
Saa'a mathal aan ail qawmu aul zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waanfusahum kaanu yazlimoon
Many yyahdi ail laahu fahooa aal muhtadi wamany yyudlil faul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon

Wal aqad zaranaa lijahannama katheera mmina aal jinni waal iansi lahum qul oob llaa yafqahoona bihaa wal ahumuaa 'a'yul llaa yubsiroona bihaa wal ahumuaa 'aazaal llaa yasma'oona bihaa 'ul aa'ika kaal aan'aami bal humuaa 'adal lu 'ul aa'ika humu aul ghaafil oon
Wal il hi ail aasmaa'u aul husnaa faad'oohu bihaa wazaru aul zeena yul hidoona fiaa 'asmaa'ihi sayujzawna maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamimman khal aqnaa 'ummat yahdoona bial haqqi wabihi ya'dil oon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum mmin haythu laa ya'lamoon
Waumli lahumuaa 'inna kaydi mateen
Aawal am yatafakkaru maa bisaahibihim mmin jinnatin ain hooa 'il laa nazeer mmubeen
Aawal am yanzuru fi mal akooti ais-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa khal aqa aal laahu min sha' waan 'asaa 'any yyakoona qadi aiqtaraba 'ajal uhum fabiayyi hadeethi ba'dahu yoominoon
Many yyudlil i ail laahu fal aa haadeea lahu wanazaruhum fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Yasal oonaka 'ani ais-saa'ati 'ayyaana mursyaahaa qul i ainnamaa 'il muhaa 'inda rabbi laa yujal leehaa liwaqtihaa 'il laa hooa thaqul at fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi laa taateekumuaa 'il laa baghtat yasal oonaka kaannaka hafeeyun 'anhaa qul i ainnamaa 'il muhaa 'inda aal laahi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon

Qul-laa 'amliku linafsi naf'a wal aa darraan ail laa maa shaa'a aal laahu wal aw kuntu 'a'lamu aul ghayba laastakthartu mina aal khayri wamaa massaneea aas-sooaa'u aina aanaa 'il laa nazeer wabasheer lliqawm yoominoon

Hooa aal zi khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat waja'al a minhaa zawjahaa leeaskuna 'il ayhaa fal ammaa taghashshyaahaa hamal at hamlaan khafeefa famarrat bihi fal ammaa 'athqal at dda'awaa aal laaha rabbahumaa la'ina aataytanaa saal iha llanakoonanna mina aash-shaakireen
Fal ammaa 'aatyaahumaa saal iha ja'al aa lahu shirka feemaa 'aatyaahumaa fata'aal aa aal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
'ayushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shaya wahum yukhlaqoon
Wal aa yastatee'oona lahum nasra wal aa 'anfusahum yansuroon
Wain tad'oohumuaa 'il aa aal hudaa laa yatba'ookum sawaa'un 'al aykumuaa 'ada'awtumoohumuaa 'ama aantum saamitoon
'inna aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'ibaadun aamthaal ukum faad'oohum fal yastajeebu lakumuaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen

'al ahumuaa 'arjul yamshoona bihaa 'am lahumuaa 'ayd yabtishoona bihaa 'am lahumuaa 'a'yuny yubsiroona bihaa 'am lahumuaa 'aazaany yasma'oona bihaa qul u aud'u shurakaa'akum thumma keedooni fal aa tunziroon
'inna wal eeyeea aal laahu aul zi nazzal a aal kitaaba wahooa yatawal laa aas-saal iheen
Waal zeena tad'oona min doonihi laa yastatee'oona nasrakum wal aa 'anfusahum yansuroon
Wain tad'oohumuaa 'il aa aal hudaa laa yasma'u wataryaahum yanzuroona 'il ayka wahum laa yubsiroon
Khuzi ail'afwa waamur bial'urfi waa'rid 'ani ail jaahil een
Waimmaa yanzaghannaka mina aash-shaytaani nazgh faasta'iz bial laahi 'innahu samee'un 'al eem
Ainna aal zeena aattaqawia aizaa massahum taa'if mmina aash-shaytaani tazakkaru faizaa hum mmubsiroon
Waikhwaanuhum yumiddoonahum fi ail ghayyi thumma laa yuqsiroon
Waizaa lam taatihim biayat qaal u lawlaa aajtabaytahaa qul i ainnamaa 'attabi'u maa yoohaa 'il ayya mir rrabbi haazaa basaa'iru mir rrabbikum wahuda warahmat lliqawm yoominoon
Waizaa quria aal qur'aanu faastami'u lahu waansitu la'al lakum turhamoon
Waazkur rrabbaka fi nafsika tadarru'a wakheefat wadoona aal jahri mina aal qawli bial ghudoowi waal aasaal i wal aa takum mmina aal ghaafil een
'inna aal zeena 'inda rabbika laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihi wayusabbihoonahu wal ahu yasjudoon
Yasal oonaka 'ani ail aanfaal i qul i ail aanfaal u lil hi waar-rasooli faattaqu aul laaha waaslihu zaata baynikum waatee'u aul laaha warasoolahuaa 'in kuntum mmoomineen
'innamaa aal moominoona aal zeena 'izaa zukira aal laahu wajil at qul oobuhum waizaa tul eeat 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatuhu zaadathumuaa 'eemaana wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Aal zeena yuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
'ul aa'ika humu aul moominoona haqqa llaahum darajaatun 'inda rabbihim wamaghfirat warizq kareem
Kamaa 'akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bial haqqi wainna fareeqa mmina aal moomineena lakaarihoon
Yujaadil oonaka fi ail haqqi ba'da maa tabayyana kaannamaa yusaaqoona 'il aa aal mawti wahum yanzuroon

Waiz ya'idukumu aul laahu 'ihdaa aat-taa'ifatayni 'annahaa lakum watawaddoona 'anna ghayra zaati aish-shawkati takoonu lakum wayureedu aul laahu 'any yyuhiqqa aal haqqa bikal imaatihi wayaqta'a daabira aal kaafireen
Leeuhiqqa aal haqqa wayubtil a aal baatil a wal aw kariha aal mujrimoon
'iz tastagheethoona rabbakum faastajaaba lakumuaa 'anni mumiddukum bial f mmina aal mal aa'ikati murdafeen
Wamaa ja'al ahu aul laahu 'il laa bushraa wal itatma'inna bihi qul oobukum wamaa aan-nasru 'il laa min 'indi ail laahi 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Aiz yughsheekumu aun-nu'aasa 'amanat mminhu wayunazzil u 'al aykum mmina aas-samaa'i maa' lleeutahhirakum bihi wayuzhiba 'ankum rijza aash-shaytaani wal eearbita 'al aa qul oobikum wayuthabbita bihi ail aaqdaam
'iz yoohi rabbuka 'il aa aal mal aa'ikati 'anni ma'akum fathabbitu aul zeena 'aamanu saul qi fi qul oobi ail zeena kafaru aur-ru'ba faadribu fawqa aal aa'naaqi waadribu minhum kul la bana
Zaal ika biannahum shaaqqu aul laaha warasoolahu wamany yyushaaqiqi ail laaha warasoolahu fainna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Zaal ikum fazooqoohu waanna lil kaafireena 'azaaba aan-nar
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa laqeetumu aul zeena kafaru zahfa fal aa tooal loohumu aul aadbaar
Wamany yyooal lihim yawma'iz duburahuaa 'il laa mutaharrifa lliqitaal in aaw mutahayyizaan ail aa feeat faqad baa'a bighadab mmina aal laahi wamawyaahu jahannamu wabeesa aal maseer
Fal am taqtul oohum wal aakinna aal laaha qatal ahum wamaa ramayta 'iz ramayta wal aakinna aal laaha ramaa wal eeubleea aal moomineena minhu bal aa'an hasanaan ainna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Zaal ikum waanna aal laaha mooahhin kayda aal kaafireen
'in tastaftihu faqad jaa'akumu aul fathu wain tantahu fahooa khayr llakum wain ta'oodu na'ud wal an tughneea 'ankum feeatukum shaya wal aw kathurat waanna aal laaha ma'a aal moomineen
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'atee'u aul laaha warasoolahu wal aa tawal lawa 'anhu waantum tasma'oon
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena qaal u sami'naa wahum laa yasma'oon
'inna sharra aad-dawaabbi 'inda aal laahi ais-summu aul bukmu aul zeena laa ya'qil oon
Wal aw 'al ima aal laahu feehim khayra llaasma'ahum wal awa aasma'ahum latawal la wwahum mmu'ridoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu austajeebu lil hi wal ir-rasooli 'izaa da'aakum limaa yuhyeekum waa'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha yahoolu bayna aal mar'i waqal bihi waannahuaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Waattaqu fitnat llaa tuseebanna aal zeena zal amu minkum khaassat waa'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Waazkurooaa 'iza aantum qal eel mmustad'afoona fi ail aardi takhaafoona 'any yyatakhattafakumu aun-naasu faawyaakum wayyadakum binasrihi warazaqakum mmina aat-tayyibaati la'al lakum tashkuroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa takhoonu aul laaha waar-rasoola watakhoonooaa 'amaanaatikum waantum ta'lamoon
Waa'lamooaa 'annamaa 'amwaal ukum waawlaadukum fitnat waanna aal laaha 'indahuaa 'ajrun 'azeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'in tattaqu aul laaha yaj'al-lakum furqaana wayukaffir 'ankum sayyiaatikum wayaghfir lakum waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem
Waiz yamkuru bika aal zeena kafaru leeuthbitooka 'aw yaqtul ooka 'aw yukhrijooka wayamkuroona wayamkuru aul laahu waal laahu khayru aul maakireen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatunaa qaal u qad sami'naa law nashaa'u laqul naa mithla haazaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul aawwal een
Waiz qaal u aul laahumma 'in kaana haazaa hooa aal haqqa min 'indika faamtir 'al aynaa hijaarat mmina aas-samaa'i aawi aeetinaa bi'azaabin aal eem
Wamaa kaana aal laahu leeu'azzibahum waanta feehim wamaa kaana aal laahu mu'azzibahum wahum yastaghfiroon

Wamaa lahumuaa 'al laa yu'azzibahumu aul laahu wahum yasuddoona 'ani ail masjidi ail haraami wamaa kaanooaa 'awleeaa'ahuaa 'ina aawleeaa'uhuaa 'il laa aal muttaqoona wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa kaana sal aatuhum 'inda aal bayti 'il laa mukaa' watasdeeat fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
'inna aal zeena kafaru yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum leeasuddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi fasayunfiqoonahaa thumma takoonu 'al ayhim hasrat thumma yughlaboona waal zeena kafarooaa 'il aa jahannama yuhsharoon
Leeameeza aal laahu aul khabeetha mina aat-tayyibi wayaj'al a aal khabeetha ba'dahu 'al aa ba'd fayarkumahu jamee'a fayaj'al ahu fi jahannama 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Qul-lil zeena kafarooaa 'iny yyantahu yughfar lahum mmaa qad sal afa wainy yya'oodu faqad madat sunnatu aul aawwal een
Waqaatil oohum hattaa laa takoona fitnat wayakoona aad-deenu kul luhu lil hi faini aintahawa fainna aal laaha bimaa ya'mal oona baseer
Wain tawal lawa faa'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha mawlyaakum ni'ma aal mawlaa wani'ma aan-naseer

Waa'lamooaa 'annamaa ghanimtum mmin sha' faanna lil hi khumusahu wal ir-rasooli wal izi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waabni ais-sabeeli 'in kuntumuaa 'aamantum bial laahi wamaa 'anzal naa 'al aa 'abdinaa yawma aal furqaani yawma aal taqaa aal jam'aani waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Aiza aantum bial'udwati aid-dunya wahum bial'udwati ail quswaa waar-rakbu 'asfal a minkum wal aw tawaa'adttum laakhtal aftum fi ail mee'aadi wal aakil lleeaqdeea aal laahu 'amra kaana maf'ool
Lleeahlika man hal aka 'am bayyinat wayahyaa man hayeea 'am bayyinat wainna aal laaha lasamee'un 'al eem
Aiz yureekahumu aul laahu fi manaamika qal eela wal awa aaryaakahum katheera llafashil tum wal atanaaza'tum fi ail aamri wal aakinna aal laaha sal lama 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Waiz yureekumoohumuaa 'izi ail taqaytum fiaa 'a'yunikum qal eela wayuqal lil ukum fiaa 'a'yunihim leeaqdeea aal laahu 'amra kaana maf'oola wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul uamoor
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa laqeetum feeat faathbutu waazkuru aul laaha katheera lla'al lakum tuflihoon
Waatee'u aul laaha warasoolahu wal aa tanaaza'u fatafshal u watazhaba reehukum waasbirooaa 'inna aal laaha ma'a aas-saabireen
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena kharaju min deeaarihim batara wareeaa'a aan-naasi wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi waal laahu bimaa ya'mal oona muheeh

Waiz zayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum waqaal a laa ghaal iba lakumu aul yawma mina aan-naasi wainni jaar llakum fal ammaa taraa'ati ail feeataani nakasa 'al aa 'aqibayhi waqaal a 'inni bariaa' mminkumuaa 'inneea 'araa maa laa tarawna 'inneea 'akhaafu aul laaha waal laahu shadeedu aul'iqaab
'iz yaqoolu aul munaafiqoona waal zeena fi qul oobihim mmaradun gharra haa'ul aa'i deenuhum wamany yyatawakkal 'al aa aal laahi fainna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Wal aw taraa 'iz yatawaffaa aal zeena kafaru aul mal aa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbaarahum wazooqu 'azaaba aal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamata aydeekum waanna aal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna waal zeena min qablihim kafaru biayaati ail laahi faakhazahumu aul laahu bizunoobihimuaa 'inna aal laaha qaweey shadeedu aul'iqaab
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha lam yaku mughayyira nni'matan aan'amahaa 'al aa qawmin hattaa yughayyiru maa bianfusihim waanna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna waal zeena min qablihim kazzabu biayaati rabbihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim waaghraqnaa 'aal a fir'awna wakul l kaanu zaal imeen
'inna sharra aad-dawaabbi 'inda aal laahi ail zeena kafaru fahum laa yoominoon
Aal zeena 'aahadtta minhum thumma yanqudoona 'ahdahum fi kul li marrat wahum laa yattaqoon
Faimmaa tathqafannahum fi ail harbi fasharrid bihim mman khal fahum la'al laahum yazzakkaroon
Waimmaa takhaafanna min qawmin kheeaanat faanbizi ail ayhim 'al aa sawaa'in ainna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul khaa'ineen
Wal aa tahsibanna aal zeena kafaru sabaqooaa 'innahum laa yu'jizoon

Waa'iddu lahum mmaa aastata'tum mmin qoowat wamir rribaati ail khayli turhiboona bihi 'adoowa aal laahi wa'adoowakum wa'aakhareena min doonihim laa ta'lamoonahumu aul laahu ya'lamuhum wamaa tunfiqu min sha' fi sabeeli ail laahi yooaffa 'il aykum waantum laa tuzlamoon
Wain janahu lis-sal mi faajnah lahaa watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wainy yyureedooaa 'any yyakhda'ooka fainna hasbaka aal laahu hooa aal ziaa 'ayyadaka binasrihi wabial moomineen
Waal lafa bayna qul oobihim lawa aanfaqta maa fi ail aardi jamee'a mmaa 'al lafta bayna qul oobihim wal aakinna aal laaha 'al lafa baynahumuaa 'innahu 'azeezun hakeem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u hasbuka aal laahu wamani aittaba'aka mina aal moomineen

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u harridi ail moomineena 'al aa aal qitaal i 'iny yyakum mminkum 'ishroona saabiroona yaghlibu miayatayni wain takum mminkum mmiayat yaghlibooaa 'al fa mmina aal zeena kafaru biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon

Aal aana khaffafa aal laahu 'ankum wa'al ima 'anna feekum du'fa fain takum mminkum mmiayat saabirat yaghlibu miayatayni wainy yyakum mminkumuaa 'al f yaghlibooaa 'al fayni biizni ail laahi waal laahu ma'a aas-saabireen
Maa kaana linabiaa'in aany yyakoona lahuaa 'asraa hattaa yuthkhina fi ail aardi tureedoona 'arada aad-dunya waal laahu yureedu aul aakhirata waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Llawlaa kitaab mmina aal laahi sabaqa lamassakum feemaa 'akhazttum 'azaabun 'azeem
Fakul u mimmaa ghanimtum hal aal a tayyiba waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u qul-liman fiaa 'aydeekum mmina aal aasraa 'iny yya'lami ail laahu fi qul oobikum khayra yootikum khayra mmimmaa 'ukhiza minkum wayaghfir lakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Wainy yyureedu kheeaanataka faqad khaanu aul laaha min qablu faamkana minhum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Ainna aal zeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fi sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena 'aawa wwanasarooaa 'ul aa'ika ba'duhumuaa 'awleeaa'u ba'd waal zeena 'aamanu wal am yuhaajiru maa lakum mminw wwal ayatihim mmin sha'in hattaa yuhaajiru waini aistansarookum fi aid-deeni fa'al aykumu aun-nasru 'il laa 'al aa qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaq waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Waal zeena kafaru ba'duhumuaa 'awleeaa'u ba'din ail laa taf'al oohu takun fitnat fi ail aardi wafasaad kabeer
Waal zeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu fi sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena 'aawa wwanasarooaa 'ul aa'ika humu aul moominoona haqqa llaahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Waal zeena 'aamanu mim ba'du wahaajaru wajaahadu ma'akum faul aa'ika minkum waoolu aul aarhaami ba'duhumuaa 'awlaa biba'd fi kitaabi ail laahi 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Baraa'at mmina aal laahi warasoolihiaa 'il aa aal zeena 'aahadttum mmina aal mushrikeen
Faseehu fi ail aardi 'arba'ata 'ashhur waa'lamooaa 'annakum ghayru mu'jizi ail laahi waanna aal laaha mukhzi ail kaafireen

Waazaam mmina aal laahi warasoolihiaa 'il aa aan-naasi yawma aal hajji ail aakbari 'anna aal laaha bariaa' mmina aal mushrikeena warasooluhu fain tubtum fahooa khayr llakum wain tawal laytum faa'lamooaa 'annakum ghayru mu'jizi ail laahi wabashshiri ail zeena kafaru bi'azaabin aal eem

Ail laa aal zeena 'aahadttum mmina aal mushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shaya wal am yuzaahiru 'al aykumuaa 'ahada faatimmooaa 'il ayhim 'ahdahumuaa 'il aa muddatihimuaa 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muttaqeen

Faizaa aansal akha aal aashhuru aul hurumu faaqtul u aul mushrikeena haythu wajadttumoohum wakhuzoohum waahsuroohum waaq'udu lahum kul la marsad fain taabu waaqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata fakhal lu sabeelahumuaa 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Waina aahad mmina aal mushrikeena aastajaaraka faajirhu hattaa yasma'a kal aama aal laahi thumma 'ablighhu maamanahu zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'lamoon

Kayfa yakoonu lil mushrikeena 'ahdun 'inda aal laahi wa'inda rasoolihiaa 'il laa aal zeena 'aahadttum 'inda aal masjidi ail haraami famaa aastaqaamu lakum faastaqeemu lahumuaa 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muttaqeen
Kayfa wainy yyazharu 'al aykum laa yarqubu feekumuaa 'il la wal aa zimmat yurdoonakum biafwaahihim wataabaa qul oobuhum waaktharuhum faasiqoon
Aashtarawa biayaati ail laahi thamana qal eela fasaddu 'an sabeelihiaa 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Laa yarquboona fi moominin ail la wal aa zimmat waul aa'ika humu aul mu'tadoon
Fain taabu waaqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata faikhwaanukum fi aid-deeni wanufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
Wain nnakathooaa 'aymaanahum mmim ba'di 'ahdihim wata'anu fi deenikum faqaatil ooaa 'aymmata aal kufri 'innahum laa 'aymaana lahum la'al laahum yantahoon
'al aa tuqaatil oona qawma nnakathooaa 'aymaanahum wahammu biikhraaji air-rasooli wahum bada'ookumuaa 'awwal a marratin aatakhshawnahum faal laahu 'ahaqqu 'an takhshawhu 'in kuntum mmoomineen
Qaatil oohum yu'azzibhumu aul laahu biaydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum 'al ayhim wayashfi sudoora qawm mmoomineen
Wayuzhib ghayza qul oobihim wayatoobu aul laahu 'al aa many yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Aam hasibtumuaa 'an tutraku wal ammaa ya'lami ail laahu aul zeena jaahadu minkum wal am yattakhizu min dooni ail laahi wal aa rasoolihi wal aa aal moomineena wal eejat waal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Maa kaana lil mushrikeena 'any yya'muru masaajida aal laahi shaahideena 'al aa 'anfusihim bial kufri 'ul aa'ika habitata aa'maal uhum wafi ain-nari hum khaal idoon

'innamaa ya'muru masaajida aal laahi mana aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waaqaama aas-sal awaata wa'aataa aaz-zakawaata wal am yakhsha 'il laa aal laaha fa'asaa 'ul aa'ika 'any yyakoonu mina aal muhtadeen

'aja'al tum siqayata aal haajji wa'imaarata aal masjidi ail haraami kamana aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wajaahada fi sabeeli ail laahi laa yastawuna 'inda aal laahi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu fi sabeeli ail laahi biamwaal ihim waanfusihimuaa 'a'zamu darajatan 'inda aal laahi waul aa'ika humu aul faa'izoon
Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmat mminhu waridwaanw wajannaat llaahum feehaa na'eem mmuqeem
Khaal ideena feehaa 'abadaan ainna aal laaha 'indahuaa 'ajrun 'azeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizooaa 'aabaa'akum waikhwaanakumuaa 'awleeaa'a ani aistahabbu aul kufra 'al aa aal iaymaani wamany yyatawal laahum mminkum faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Qul i ain kaana 'aabaa'ukum waabnaa'ukum waikhwaanukum waazwaajukum wa'asheeratukum waamwaal un aiqtaraftumoohaa watijaarat takhshawna kasaadahaa wamasaakinu tardawnahaa 'ahabba 'il aykum mmina aal laahi warasoolihi wajihaad fi sabeelihi fatarabbasu hattaa yaateea aal laahu biamrihi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen
Laqad nasarakumu aul laahu fi mawaatina katheerat wayawma hunaynin aiza aa'jabatkum kathratukum fal am tughni 'ankum shaya wadaaqat 'al aykumu aul aardu bimaa rahubat thumma wal laytum mmudbireen
Thumma 'anzal a aal laahu sakeenatahu 'al aa rasoolihi wa'al aa aal moomineena waanzal a junooda llam tarawhaa wa'azzaba aal zeena kafaru wazaal ika jazaa'u aul kaafireen
Thumma yatoobu aul laahu mim ba'di zaal ika 'al aa many yyashaa'u waal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'innamaa aal mushrikoona najas fal aa yaqrabu aul masjida aal haraama ba'da 'aamihim haazaa wain khiftum 'aylat fasawfa yughneekumu aul laahu min fadlihiaa 'in shaa'a anna aal laaha 'al eemun hakeem

Qaatil u aul zeena laa yoominoona bial laahi wal aa bial yawmi ail aakhiri wal aa yuharrimoona maa harrama aal laahu warasooluhu wal aa yadeenoona deena aal haqqi mina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba hattaa yu'tu aul jizyata 'any yyad wahum saaghiroon

Waqaal ati ail yahoodu 'uzayru aubnu aul laahi waqaal ati ain-nasaaraa aal maseehu aubnu aul laahi zaal ika qawluhum biafwaahihim yudaahoona qawla aal zeena kafaru min qablu qaatal ahumu aul laahu 'annaa yoofakoon

Aattakhazooaa 'ahbaarahum waruhbaanahumuaa 'arbaaba mmin dooni ail laahi waal maseeha aabna maryama wamaa 'umirooaa 'il laa leea'budooaa 'il aaha waahida llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa subhaanahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
Yureedoona 'any yyutfiu noora aal laahi biafwaahihim wayaabaa aal laahu 'il laa 'any yyutimma noorahu wal aw kariha aal kaafiroon
Hooa aal ziaa 'arsal a rasoolahu bial hudaa wadeeni ail haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aa aad-deeni kul lihi wal aw kariha aal mushrikoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'inna katheera mmina aal aahbari waar-ruhbaani layaakul oona 'amwaal a aan-naasi bial baatil i wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena yaknizoona aaz-zahaba waal fiddata wal aa yunfiqoonahaa fi sabeeli ail laahi fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aal eem
Yawma yuhmaa 'al ayhaa fi nari jahannama fatukwaa bihaa jibaahuhum wajunoobuhum wazuhooruhum haazaa maa kanaztum lianfusikum fazooqu maa kuntum taknizoon

'inna 'iddata aash-shuhoori 'inda aal laahi aithnaa 'ashara shahra fi kitaabi ail laahi yawma khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda minhaa 'arba'atun hurum zaal ika aad-deenu aul qayyimu fal aa tazlimu feehinna 'anfusakum waqaatil u aul mushrikeena kaaffat kamaa yuqaatil oonakum kaaffat waa'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha ma'a aal muttaqeen

'innamaa aan-naseeyu zeeaadat fi ail kufri yadil lu bihi ail zeena kafaru yuhil loonahu 'aama wayuharrimoonahu 'aama lleeooaatiu 'iddata maa harrama aal laahu fayuhil lu maa harrama aal laahu zuyyina lahum sooaa'u aa'maal ihim waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu maa lakumuaa 'izaa qeela lakumu aunfiru fi sabeeli ail laahi aiththaaqal tumuaa 'il aa aal aardi 'aradeetum bial hayawaati aid-dunya mina aal aakhirati famaa mataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunya fi ail aakhirati 'il laa qal eel
Ail laa tanfiru yu'azzibkum 'azaabaan aal eema wayastabdil qawmaan ghayrakum wal aa tadurroohu shaya waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Ail laa tansuroohu faqad nasarahu aul laahu 'iza aakhrajahu aul zeena kafaru thaaneea aathnayni 'iz humaa fi ail ghari 'iz yaqoolu lisaahibihi laa tahzani ainna aal laaha ma'anaa faanzal a aal laahu sakeenatahu 'al ayhi wayyadahu bijunood llam tarawhaa waja'al a kal imata aal zeena kafaru aus-suflaa wakal imatu aul laahi heea aal'ul ya waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Ainfiru khifaafa wathiqaal a wajaahidu biamwaal ikum waanfusikum fi sabeeli ail laahi zaal ikum khayr llakumuaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

Law kaana 'arada qareeba wasafara qaasida llaattaba'ooka wal aakim ba'udat 'al ayhimu aush-shuqqatu wasayahlifoona bial laahi lawi aistata'naa lakharajnaa ma'akum yuhlikoona 'anfusahum waal laahu ya'lamu 'innahum lakaaziboon
'afaa aal laahu 'anka lima 'azinta lahum hattaa yatabayyana laka aal zeena sadaqu wata'lama aal kaazibeen
Laa yastaazinuka aal zeena yoominoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri 'any yyujaahidu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim waal laahu 'al eemu bial muttaqeen
'innamaa yastaazinuka aal zeena laa yoominoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waartaabat qul oobuhum fahum fi raybihim yataraddadoon
Wal awa aaraadu aul khurooja laa'addu lahu 'uddat wal aakin kariha aal laahu aunbi'aathahum fathabbatahum waqeela aaq'udu ma'a aal qaa'ideen
Law kharaju feekum mmaa zaadookumuaa 'il laa khabaal a wal aawda'u khil aal akum yabghoonakumu aul fitnata wafeekum sammaa'oona lahum waal laahu 'al eemu biaz-zaal imeen
Laqadi aibtaghawua aul fitnata min qablu waqal labu laka aal uamoora hattaa jaa'a aal haqqu wazahara 'amru aul laahi wahum kaarihoon
Waminhum mmany yyaqoolu auyzal lli wal aa taftinniaa 'al aa fi ail fitnati saqatu wainna jahannama lamuheetatu bial kaafireen
'in tusibka hasanat tasu'hum wain tusibka museebat yaqoolu qada aakhaznaa 'amranaa min qablu wayatawal la wwahum farihoon
Qul-lany yyuseebanaa 'il laa maa kataba aal laahu lanaa hooa mawlyaanaa wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail moominoon
Qul hal tarabbasoona binaa 'il laa 'ihdaa aal husnayayni wanahnu natarabbasu bikumuaa 'any yyuseebakumu aul laahu bi'azaab mmin 'indihiaa 'aw biaydeenaa fatarabbasooaa 'innaa ma'akum mmutarabbisoon
Qul a aanfiqu taw'aan aaw karha llany yyutaqabbal a minkumuaa 'innakum kuntum qawma faasiqeen

Wamaa mana'ahumuaa 'an tuqbal a minhum nafaqaatuhumuaa 'il laa 'annahum kafaru bial laahi wabirasoolihi wal aa yaatoona aas-sal awaata 'il laa wahum kusaal aa wal aa yunfiqoona 'il laa wahum kaarihoon
Fal aa tu'jibka 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhumuaa 'innamaa yureedu aul laahu leeu'azzibahum bihaa fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya watazhaqa 'anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Wayahlifoona bial laahi 'innahum laminkum wamaa hum mminkum wal aakinnahum qawm yafraqoon
Law yajidoona mal jaan aaw maghaaraatin aaw muddakhal a llawal lawia ail ayhi wahum yajmahoon
Waminhum mmany yyal mizuka fi ais-sadaqaati fainu a'tu minhaa radu wail llam yu'tawa minhaa 'izaa hum yaskhatoon
Wal awa aannahum radu maa 'aatyaahumu aul laahu warasooluhu waqaal u hasbunaa aal laahu sayooteenaa aal laahu min fadlihi warasooluhuaa 'innaa 'il aa aal laahi raaghiboon

'innamaa aas-sadaqaatu lil fuqaraa'i waal masaakeeni waal'aamil eena 'al ayhaa waal mooal lafati qul oobuhum wafi air-riqaabi waal ghaarimeena wafi sabeeli ail laahi waabni ais-sabeeli fareedat mmina aal laahi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Waminhumu aul zeena yoozoona aan-nabiaa'a wayaqooloona hooa 'uzn qul u aznu khayr llakum yoominu bial laahi wayoominu lil moomineena warahmat llil zeena 'aamanu minkum waal zeena yoozoona rasoola aal laahi lahum 'azaabun aal eem
Yahlifoona bial laahi lakum leeurdookum waal laahu warasooluhuaa 'ahaqqu 'any yyurdoohu 'in kaanu moomineen
'al am ya'lamooaa 'annahu many yyuhaadidi ail laaha warasoolahu faanna lahu naara jahannama khaal ida feehaa zaal ika aal khizyu aul'azeem
Yahzaru aul munaafiqoona 'an tunazzal a 'al ayhim soorat tunabbeeuhum bimaa fi qul oobihim qul i aistahzi'ooaa 'inna aal laaha mukhrij mmaa tahzaroon
Wal a'in saal tahum layaqoolunna 'innamaa kunnaa nakhoodu wanal'abu qul a aabial laahi wa'ayaatihi warasoolihi kuntum tastahzi'oon
Laa ta'taziru qad kafartum ba'da 'eemaanikumuaa 'iny yyu'fa 'an taa'ifat mminkum tu'azzab taa'ifatu biannahum kaanu mujrimeen

Aal munaafiqoona waal munaafiqaatu ba'duhum mmim ba'd yaamuroona bial munkari wayanhawna 'ani ail ma'roofi wayaqbidoona 'aydeeahum nasu aul laaha fanaseeahumuaa 'inna aal munaafiqeena humu aul faasiqoon
Wa'ada aal laahu aul munaafiqeena waal munaafiqaati waal kuffaara naara jahannama khaal ideena feehaa heea hasbuhum wal a'anahumu aul laahu wal ahum 'azaab mmuqeem

Kaal zeena min qablikum kaanooaa 'ashadda minkum qoowat waakthara 'amwaal a waawlaada faastamta'u bikhal aaqihim faastamta'tum bikhal aaqikum kamaa aastamta'a aal zeena min qablikum bikhal aaqihim wakhudtum kaal zi khaadooaa 'ul aa'ika habitata aa'maal uhum fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati waul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
'al am yaatihim nabau aul zeena min qablihim qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamood
Waqawmi 'ibraaheema waashaabi madyana waal mootafikaati 'atathum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati famaa kaana aal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon

Waal moominoona waal moominaatu ba'duhumuaa 'awleeaa'u ba'd yaamuroona bial ma'roofi wayanhawna 'ani ail munkari wayuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wayootoona aaz-zakawaata wayutee'oona aal laaha warasoolahuaa 'ul aa'ika sayarhamuhumu aul laahu 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Wa'ada aal laahu aul moomineena waal moominaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wamasaakina tayyibat fi jannaati 'adn waridwaam mmina aal laahi 'akbaru zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u jaahidi ail kuffaara waal munaafiqeena waaghluz 'al ayhim wamawyaahum jahannamu wabeesa aal maseer

Yahlifoona bial laahi maa qaal u wal aqad qaal u kal imata aal kufri wakafaru ba'da 'islaamihim wahammu bimaa lam yanaal u wamaa naqamooaa 'il laa 'ana aaghnyaahumu aul laahu warasooluhu min fadlihi fainy yyatoobu yaku khayra llaahum wainy yyatawal lawa yu'azzibhumu aul laahu 'azaabaan aal eema fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati wamaa lahum fi ail aardi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Waminhum mman 'aahada aal laaha la'ina aatyaanaa min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna wal anakoonanna mina aas-saal iheen
Fal ammaa 'aatyaahum mmin fadlihi bakhil u bihi watawal la wwahum mmu'ridoon
Faa'qabahum nifaaqa fi qul oobihimuaa 'il aa yawmi yal qawnahu bimaa 'akhlafu aul laaha maa wa'adoohu wabimaa kaanu yakziboon
'al am ya'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu sirrahum wanajwyaahum waanna aal laaha 'al laamu aul ghuyoob
Ail zeena yal mizoona aal muttawwi'eena mina aal moomineena fi ais-sadaqaati waal zeena laa yajidoona 'il laa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum sakhira aal laahu minhum wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem

Aistaghfir lahumuaa 'aw laa tastaghfir lahumuaa 'in tastaghfir lahum sab'eena marrat fal any yyaghfira aal laahu lahum zaal ika biannahum kafaru bial laahi warasoolihi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen

Fariha aal mukhal lafoona bimaq'adihim khil aafa rasooli ail laahi wakarihooaa 'any yyujaahidu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fi sabeeli ail laahi waqaal u laa tanfiru fi ail harri qul naaru jahannama 'ashaddu harra llaw kaanu yafqahoon
Fal yadhaku qal eela wal yabku katheera jazaa'a bimaa kaanu yaksiboon

Fair rraja'aka aal laahu 'il aa taa'ifat mminhum faastaazanooka lil khurooji faqul-lan takhruju ma'eea 'abada wal an tuqaatil u ma'i 'adoowaan ainnakum radeetum bial qu'oodi 'awwal a marrat faaq'udu ma'a aal khaal ifeen
Wal aa tusal li 'al aa 'ahad mminhum mmaata 'abada wal aa taqum 'al aa qabrihiaa 'innahum kafaru bial laahi warasoolihi wamaatu wahum faasiqoon
Wal aa tu'jibka 'amwaal uhum waawlaaduhumuaa 'innamaa yureedu aul laahu 'any yyu'azzibahum bihaa fi aid-dunya watazhaqa 'anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Waizaa 'unzil at sooratun aana aaminu bial laahi wajaahidu ma'a rasoolihi aistaazanaka 'oolu aut-tawli minhum waqaal u zarnaa nakum mma'a aal qaa'ideen
Radu biany yyakoonu ma'a aal khawaal ifi watubi'a 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Laakini air-rasoolu waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu jaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim waul aa'ika lahumu aul khayraatu waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
'a'adda aal laahu lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Wajaa'a aal mu'azziroona mina aal aa'raabi leeoozana lahum waqa'ada aal zeena kazabu aul laaha warasoolahu sayuseebu aul zeena kafaru minhum 'azaabun aal eem

Llaysa 'al aa aad-du'afaa'i wal aa 'al aa aal mardaa wal aa 'al aa aal zeena laa yajidoona maa yunfiqoona harajun aizaa nasahu lil hi warasoolihi maa 'al aa aal muhsineena min sabeel waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Wal aa 'al aa aal zeena 'izaa maa 'atawka litahmil ahum qul ta laa 'ajidu maa 'ahmil ukum 'al ayhi tawal la wwaa'yunuhum tafeedu mina aad-dam'i hazanaan aal laa yajidu maa yunfiqoon
'innamaa aas-sabeelu 'al aa aal zeena yastaazinoonaka wahumuaa 'aghneeaa'u radu biany yyakoonu ma'a aal khawaal ifi wataba'a aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa ya'lamoon

Ya'taziroona 'il aykumuaa 'izaa raja'tumuaa 'il ayhim qul-laa ta'taziru lan nnoomina lakum qad nabbaanaa aal laahu mina aakhbarikum wasayaraa aal laahu 'amal akum warasooluhu thumma turaddoona 'il aa 'aal imi ail ghaybi waash-shahaadati fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Sayahlifoona bial laahi lakumuaa 'izaa aanqal abtumuaa 'il ayhim litu'ridu 'anhum faa'ridu 'anhumuaa 'innahum rijs wamawyaahum jahannamu jazaa'a bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Yahlifoona lakum litardawa 'anhum fain tardawa 'anhum fainna aal laaha laa yardaa 'ani ail qawmi ail faasiqeen
Aal aa'raabu 'ashaddu kufra wanifaaqa waajdaru 'al laa ya'lamu hudooda maa 'anzal a aal laahu 'al aa rasoolihi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Wamina aal aa'raabi many yyattakhizu maa yunfiqu maghrama wayatarabbasu bikumu aud-dawaa'ira 'al ayhim daa'iratu aus-saw'i waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Wamina aal aa'raabi many yyoominu bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wayattakhizu maa yunfiqu qurubaatin 'inda aal laahi wasal awaati air-rasooli 'al aa 'innahaa qurubat llaahum sayudkhil uhumu aul laahu fi rahmatihiaa 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Waas-saabiqoona aal aawwal oona mina aal muhaajireena waal aansari waal zeena aattaba'oohum biihsaar rradeea aal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu waa'adda lahum jannaat tajri tahtahaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem

Wamimman hawlakum mmina aal aa'raabi munaafiqoona wamina aahli ail madeenati maradu 'al aa aan-nifaaqi laa ta'lamuhum nahnu na'lamuhum sanu'azzibuhum mmarratayni thumma yuraddoona 'il aa 'azaabin 'azeem
Wa'aakharoona aa'tarafu bizunoobihim khal atu 'amal a saal iha wa'aakhara sayyeeaan 'asaa aal laahu 'any yyatooba 'al ayhimuaa 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Khuz mina aamwaal ihim sadaqat tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim bihaa wasal li 'al ayhimuaa 'inna sal awaatika sakal llaahum waal laahu samee'un 'al eem
Aal am ya'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha hooa yaqbal u aut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihi wayaakhuzu aus-sadaqaati waanna aal laaha hooa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Waqul i ai'mal u fasayaraa aal laahu 'amal akum warasooluhu waal moominoona wasaturaddoona 'il aa 'aal imi ail ghaybi waash-shahaadati fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wa'aakharoona murjawna liamri ail laahi 'immaa yu'azzibuhum waimmaa yatoobu 'al ayhim waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Ail zeena aattakhazu masjida diraara wakufra watafreeqaa bayna aal moomineena wairsaada lliman haaraba aal laaha warasoolahu min qablu wal ayahlifunna 'ina aaradnaa 'il laa aal husnaa waal laahu yashhadu 'innahum lakaaziboon
Laa taqum feehi 'abada llamasjidun assisa 'al aa aat-taqwaa mina aawwal i yawmin aahaqqu 'an taqooma feehi feehi rijaal yuhibboona 'any yyatatahharu waal laahu yuhibbu aul muttahhireen

'afamanu assisa bunyaanuhu 'al aa taqwaa mina aal laahi waridwaanin khayrun aam mmanu assisa bunyaanuhu 'al aa shafaa jurufin har faanhaara bihi fi nari jahannama waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Laa yazaal u bunyaanuhumu aul zi banawa reebat fi qul oobihimuaa 'il laa 'an tuqatta'a qul oobuhum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Ainna aal laaha aashtaraa mina aal moomineena 'anfusahum waamwaal ahum bianna lahumu aul jannata yuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ail laahi fayaqtul oona wayuqtal oona wa'daan 'al ayhi haqqa fi ait-tawryaati waal ianjeeli waal qur'aani wamana aawfaa bi'ahdihi mina aal laahi faastabshiru bibay'ikumu aul zi baya'tum bihi wazaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem

Aut-taa'iboona aal'aabidoona aal haamidoona aas-saa'ihoona aar-raaki'oona aas-saajidoona aal aamiroona bial ma'roofi waan-naahoona 'ani ail munkari waal haafizoona lihudoodi ail laahi wabashshiri ail moomineen
Maa kaana lin-nabiaa'i waal zeena 'aamanooaa 'any yyastaghfiru lil mushrikeena wal aw kaanooaa 'ooli qurbaa mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumuaa 'annahumuaa 'ashaabu aul jaheem
Wamaa kaana aastighfaaru 'ibraaheema liabeehi 'il laa 'am mmaw'idat wa'adahaa 'iyyaahu fal ammaa tabayyana lahuaa 'annahu 'adoow llil hi tabarraa minhu 'inna 'ibraaheema laawwaahun hal eem
Wamaa kaana aal laahu leeudil la qawmaa ba'da 'iz hadyaahum hattaa yubayyina lahum mmaa yattaqoona 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Ainna aal laaha lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi yuhyi wayumeetu wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer

Llaqad ttaaba aal laahu 'al aa aan-nabiaa'i waal muhaajireena waal aansari ail zeena aattaba'oohu fi saa'ati ail'usrati mim ba'di maa kaada tazeeghu qul oobu fareeq mminhum thumma taaba 'al ayhimuaa 'innahu bihim ra'oof rraheem

Wa'al aa aath-thal aathati ail zeena khul lifu hattaa 'izaa daaqat 'al ayhimu aul aardu bimaa rahubat wadaaqat 'al ayhimuaa 'anfusuhum wazannooaa 'al llaa mal jaa mina aal laahi 'il laa 'il ayhi thumma taaba 'al ayhim leeatoobooaa 'inna aal laaha hooa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha wakoonu ma'a aas-saadiqeen

Maa kaana liahli ail madeenati waman hawlahum mmina aal aa'raabi 'any yyatakhal lafu 'ar rrasooli ail laahi wal aa yarghabu bianfusihim 'an nnafsihi zaal ika biannahum laa yuseebuhum zama wal aa nasab wal aa makhmasat fi sabeeli ail laahi wal aa yataoona mawteea yagheezu aul kuffaara wal aa yanaal oona min 'adoow nnaylaan ail laa kutiba lahum bihi 'amal saal ihun ainna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen
Wal aa yunfiqoona nafaqat sagheerat wal aa kabeerat wal aa yaqta'oona waadeeaan ail laa kutiba lahum leeajzeeahumu aul laahu 'ahsana maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamaa kaana aal moominoona leeanfiru kaaffat fal awlaa nafara min kul li firqat mminhum taa'ifat lleeatafaqqahu fi aid-deeni wal eeunziru qawmahumuaa 'izaa raja'ooaa 'il ayhim la'al laahum yahzaroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu qaatil u aul zeena yal oonakum mmina aal kuffari wal yajidu feekum ghil zat waa'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha ma'a aal muttaqeen
Waizaa maa 'unzil at soorat faminhum mmany yyaqoolu 'ayyukum zaadathu haazihiaa 'eemaana faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu fazaadathumuaa 'eemaana wahum yastabshiroon
Waammaa aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad fazaadathum rijsaan ail aa rijsihim wamaatu wahum kaafiroon
'awal aa yarawna 'annahum yuftanoona fi kul li 'aam mmarratan aaw marratayni thumma laa yatooboona wal aa hum yazzakkaroon
Waizaa maa 'unzil at soorat nnazara ba'duhumuaa 'il aa ba'din hal yaryaakum mmina aahad thumma aansarafu sarafa aal laahu qul oobahum biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon
Laqad jaa'akum rasool mmina aanfusikum 'azeezun 'al ayhi maa 'anittum hareesun 'al aykum bial moomineena ra'oof rraheem
Fain tawal lawa faqul hasbeea aal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wahooa rabbu aul'arshi ail'azeem
'al aar til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail hakeem

'akaana lin-naasi 'ajabaan aana aawhaynaa 'il aa rajul mminhumuaa 'ana aanziri ain-naasa wabashshiri ail zeena 'aamanooaa 'anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim qaal a aal kaafiroona 'inna haazaa lasihr mmubeen

Ainna rabbakumu aul laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi yudabbiru aul aamra maa min shafee'in ail laa mim ba'di 'iznihi zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum faa'budoohu 'afal aa tazzakkaroon

'il ayhi marji'ukum jamee'a wa'da aal laahi haqqaan ainnahu yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu leeajzeea aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati bial qisti waal zeena kafaru lahum sharaab mmin hameem wa'azaabun aal eemu bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Hooa aal zi ja'al a aash-shamsa deeaa' waal qamara noora waqaddarahu manaazil a lita'lamu 'adada aas-sineena waal hisaaba maa khal aqa aal laahu zaal ika 'il laa bial haqqi nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
'inna fi aikhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahari wamaa khal aqa aal laahu fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi layaat lliqawm yattaqoon
'inna aal zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa waradu bial hayawaati aid-dunya waatmaannu bihaa waal zeena hum 'ana ayaatinaa ghaafil oon
'ul aa'ika mawyaahumu aun-naaru bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati yahdeehim rabbuhum bieemaanihim tajri min tahtihimu aul aanhaaru fi jannaati ain-na'eem
Da'wyaahum feehaa subhaanaka aal laahumma watahiyyatuhum feehaa sal aam wa'aakhiru da'wyaahumuaa 'ani ail hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Wal aw yu'ajjil u aul laahu lin-naasi aish-sharra aasti'jaal ahum bial khayri laqudeea 'il ayhimuaa 'ajal uhum fanazaru aul zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Waizaa massa aal iansaana aad-durru da'aanaa lijanbihiaa 'aw qaa'idaan aaw qaa'ima fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhu durrahu marra kaal llam yad'unaa 'il aa durr mmassahu kazaal ika zuyyina lil musrifeena maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wal aqada aahlaknaa aal quroona min qablikum lammaa zal amu wajaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati wamaa kaanu leeoominu kazaal ika najzi ail qawma aal mujrimeen
Thumma ja'al naakum khal aa'ifa fi ail aardi mim ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'mal oon

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal a aal zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa ayti biqur'aanin ghayri haazaa 'aw baddil hu qul maa yakoonu leea 'anu abaddil ahu min til qaa'i nafseea 'ina aattabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya 'inneea 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbi 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qul-law shaa'a aal laahu maa tal awtuhu 'al aykum wal aa 'adryaakum bihi faqad labithtu feekum 'umura mmin qablihiaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Famana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan aaw kazzaba biayaatihiaa 'innahu laa yuflihu aul mujrimoon

Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yadurruhum wal aa yanfa'uhum wayaqooloona haa'ul aa'i shufa'aa'unaa 'inda aal laahi qul a aatunabbioona aal laaha bimaa laa ya'lamu fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail aardi subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Wamaa kaana aan-naasu 'il laa 'ummat waahidat faakhtal afu wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum feemaa feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wayaqooloona lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi faqul i ainnamaa aal ghaybu lil hi faantazirooaa 'inni ma'akum mmina aal muntazireen
Waizaa 'azaqnaa aan-naasa rahmat mmim ba'di darraa'a massathumuaa 'izaa lahum mmakr fiaa 'ayaatinaa qul i ail laahu 'asra'u makraan ainna rusul anaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon

Hooa aal zi yusayyirukum fi ail barri waal bahri hattaa 'izaa kuntum fi ail ful ki wajarayna bihim bireeh tayyibat wafarihu bihaa jaa'athaa reehun 'aasif wajaa'ahumu aul mawju min kul li makaanw wazannooaa 'annahumuaa 'uheeta bihim da'awua aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena la'ina aanjaytanaa min haazihi lanakoonanna mina aash-shaakireen

Fal ammaa 'anjyaahumuaa 'izaa hum yabghoona fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'innamaa baghyukum 'al aa 'anfusikum mmataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunya thumma 'il aynaa marji'ukum fanunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

'innamaa mathal u aul hayawaati aid-dunya kamaa'in aanzal naahu mina aas-samaa'i faakhtal ata bihi nabaatu aul aardi mimmaa yaakul u aun-naasu waal aan'aamu hattaa 'izaa 'akhazati ail aardu zukhrufahaa waazzayyanat wazanna 'ahluhaa 'annahum qaadiroona 'al ayhaa 'atyaahaa 'amrunaa laylaan aaw nahaara faja'al naahaa haseeda kaal llam taghna bial aamsi kazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm yatafakkaroon
Waal laahu yad'ooaa 'il aa dari ais-sal aami wayahdi many yyashaa'u ail aa siraat mmustaqeem
Llil zeena 'ahsanu aul husnaa wazeeaadat wal aa yarhaqu wujoohahum qatar wal aa zil latun awlaa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Waal zeena kasabu aus-sayyiaati jazaa'u sayyeeati bimithlihaa watarhaquhum zil lat mmaa lahum mmina aal laahi min 'aasim kaannamaa 'ughsheeat wujoohuhum qita'a mmina aal yli muzlimaan awlaa'ika 'ashaabu aun-nari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil zeena 'ashraku makaanakumuaa 'antum washurakaa'ukum fazayyal naa baynahum waqaal a shurakaa'uhum mmaa kuntumuaa 'iyyaanaa ta'budoon
Fakafaa bial laahi shaheedaa baynanaa wabaynakumuaa 'in kunnaa 'an 'ibaadatikum laghaafil een
Hunaal ika tablu kul lu nafs mmaa 'aslafat waruddooaa 'il aa aal laahi mawlyaahumu aul haqqi wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

Qul many yyarzuqukum mmina aas-samaa'i waal aardi 'ammany yyamliku aus-sam'a waal aabsaara wamany yyukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti wayukhriju aul mayyita mina aal hayyi wamany yyudabbiru aul aamra fasayaqooloona aal laahu faqul a aafal aa tattaqoon
Fazaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukumu aul haqqu famaazaa ba'da aal haqqi 'il laa aad-dal aal u faannaa tusrafoon
Kazaal ika haqqat kal imaatu rabbika 'al aa aal zeena fasaqooaa 'annahum laa yoominoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yyabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu qul i ail laahu yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu faannaa toofakoon

Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yyahdiaa 'il aa aal haqqi qul i ail laahu yahdi lil haqqi 'afamany yyahdiaa 'il aa aal haqqi 'ahaqqu 'any yyuttaba'a 'ammal llaa yahaddiaa 'il laa 'any yyuhdaa famaa lakum kayfa tahkumoon
Wamaa yattabi'u 'aktharuhumuaa 'il laa zannaan ainna aaz-zanna laa yughni mina aal haqqi shayaan ainna aal laaha 'al eemu bimaa yaf'al oon
Wamaa kaana haazaa aal qur'aanu 'any yyuftaraa min dooni ail laahi wal aakin tasdeeqa aal zi bayna yadayhi watafseela aal kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'am yaqooloona aaftaryaahu qul faatu bisoorat mmithlihi waad'u mani aistata'tum mmin dooni ail laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal kazzabu bimaa lam yuheetu bi'il mihi wal ammaa yaatihim taaweeluhu kazaal ika kazzaba aal zeena min qablihim faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu auz-zaal imeen
Waminhum mmany yyoominu bihi waminhum mmal llaa yoominu bihi warabbuka 'a'lamu bial mufsideen
Wain kazzabooka faqul-li 'amal i wal akum 'amal ukumuaa 'antum bareeaaoona mimmaa 'a'mal u waanaa bariaa' mmimmaa ta'mal oon
Waminhum mmany yyastami'oona 'il ayka 'afaanta tusmi'u aus-summa wal aw kaanu laa ya'qil oon
Waminhum mmany yyanzuru 'il ayka 'afaanta tahdi ail'umya wal aw kaanu laa yubsiroon
'inna aal laaha laa yazlimu aun-naasa shaya wal aakinna aan-naasa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum kaal llam yal bathooaa 'il laa saa'at mmina aan-nahari yata'aarafoona baynahum qad khasira aal zeena kazzabu bil iqaa'i ail laahi wamaa kaanu muhtadeen
Waimmaa nureeannaka ba'da aal zi na'iduhumuaa 'aw natawaffayannaka fail aynaa marji'uhum thumma aal laahu shaheedun 'al aa maa yaf'al oon
Wal ikul li 'ummat rrasool faizaa jaa'a rasooluhum qudeea baynahum bial qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-laa 'amliku linafsi darra wal aa naf'aan ail laa maa shaa'a aal laahu likul li 'ummatin aajal un aizaa jaa'a ajal uhum fal aa yastaakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Qul a aaraytumuaa 'ina aatyaakum 'azaabuhu bayaataan aaw nahaara mmaazaa yasta'jil u minhu aul mujrimoon
'athumma 'izaa maa waqa'a 'aamantum bihiaa 'aal aana waqad kuntum bihi tasta'jil oon
Thumma qeela lil zeena zal amu zooqu 'azaaba aal khul di hal tujzawna 'il laa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
Wayastanbioonaka 'ahaqqun hooa qul i ai warabbeea 'innahu lahaqq wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Wal awa aanna likul li nafs zal amat maa fi ail aardi laaftadat bihi waasarru aun-nadaamata lammaa raawua aul'azaaba waqudeea baynahum bial qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
'al aa 'inna lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi 'al aa 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Hooa yuhyi wayumeetu wail ayhi turja'oon
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu qad jaa'atkum mmaw'izat mmir rrabbikum washifaa' llimaa fi ais-sudoori wahuda warahmat llil moomineen
Qul bifadli ail laahi wabirahmatihi fabizaal ika fal yafrahu hooa khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Qul a aaraytum mmaa 'anzal a aal laahu lakum mmir rrizq faja'al tum mminhu haraama wahal aal a qul a aal laahu 'azina lakumuaa 'am 'al aa aal laahi taftaroon
Wamaa zannu aul zeena yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba yawma aal qeeaamati 'inna aal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa yashkuroon

Wamaa takoonu fi shanw wamaa tatlu minhu min qur'aanw wal aa ta'mal oona min 'amal in ail laa kunnaa 'al aykum shuhoodaan aiz tufeedoona feehi wamaa ya'zubu 'ar rrabbika mim mmithqaal i zarrat fi ail aardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'i wal aa 'asghara min zaal ika wal aa 'akbara 'il laa fi kitaab mmubeen
Aal aa 'inna 'awleeaa'a aal laahi laa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Aal zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Lahumu aul bushraa fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wafi ail aakhirati laa tabdeela likal imaati ail laahi zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
Wal aa yuhzinka qawluhumuaa 'inna aal'izzata lil hi jamee'aan hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
'al aa 'inna lil hi man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail aardi wamaa yattabi'u aul zeena yad'oona min dooni ail laahi shurakaa'a any yyattabi'oona 'il laa aaz-zanna wain humuaa 'il laa yakhrusoon
Hooa aal zi ja'al a lakumu aul yla litaskunu feehi waan-nahaara mubsiraan ainna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yasma'oon
Qaal u auttakhaza aal laahu wal ada subhaanahu hooa aal ghaneeyu lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi 'in 'indakum mmin sul taani bihaazaa 'ataqooloona 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qul i ainna aal zeena yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba laa yuflihoon
Mataa' fi aid-dunya thumma 'il aynaa marji'uhum thumma nuzeequhumu aul'azaaba aash-shadeeda bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Waatlu 'al ayhim nabaa noohin aiz qaal a liqawmihi yaaqawmi 'in kaana kabura 'al aykum mmaqaami watazkeeri biayaati ail laahi fa'al aa aal laahi tawakkal tu faajmi'ooaa 'amrakum washurakaa'akum thumma laa yakuna aamrukum 'al aykum ghummat thumma aaqdooaa 'il ayya wal aa tunziroon
Fain tawal laytum famaa saal tukum mmina aajrin aina aajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi waumirtu 'ana aakoona mina aal muslimeen
Fakazzaboohu fanajjaynaahu wamam mma'ahu fi ail ful ki waja'al naahum khal aa'ifa waaghraqnaa aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul munzareen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihi rusul aan ail aa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bial bayyinaati famaa kaanu leeoominu bimaa kazzabu bihi min qablu kazaal ika natba'u 'al aa qul oobi ail mu'tadeen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim mmoosaa wahaaroona 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi biayaatinaa faastakbaru wakaanu qawma mmujrimeen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu min 'indinaa qaal ooaa 'inna haazaa lasihr mmubeen
Qaal a moosaa 'ataqooloona lil haqqi lammaa jaa'akumuaa 'asihrun haazaa wal aa yuflihu aus-saahiroon
Qaal ooaa 'ajeetanaa lital fitanaa 'ammaa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa watakoona lakumaa aal kibreeaa'u fi ail aardi wamaa nahnu lakumaa bimoomineen
Waqaal a fir'awnu auytooni bikul li saahirin 'al eem
Fal ammaa jaa'a aas-saharatu qaal a lahum mmoosaa 'al qu maa 'antum mmul qoon
Fal ammaa 'al qawa qaal a moosaa maa jeetum bihi ais-sihru 'inna aal laaha sayubtil uhuaa 'inna aal laaha laa yuslihu 'amal a aal mufsideen
Wayuhiqqu aul laahu aul haqqa bikal imaatihi wal aw kariha aal mujrimoon
Famaa 'aamana limoosaa 'il laa zurriyyat mmin qawmihi 'al aa khawf mmin fir'awna wamal aeehimuaa 'any yyaftinahum wainna fir'awna la'aal fi ail aardi wainnahu lamina aal musrifeen
Waqaal a moosaa yaaqawmi 'in kuntumuaa 'aamantum bial laahi fa'al ayhi tawakkal ooaa 'in kuntum mmuslimeen
Faqaal u 'al aa aal laahi tawakkal naa rabbanaa laa taj'al naa fitnat llil qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wanajjinaa birahmatika mina aal qawmi ail kaafireen
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa waakheehi 'an tabawwa'aa liqawmikumaa bimisra buyoota waaj'al u buyootakum qiblat waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wabashshiri ail moomineen

Waqaal a moosaa rabbanaa 'innaka 'aatayta fir'awna wamal aahu zeenat waamwaal a fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya rabbanaa leeadil lu 'an sabeelika rabbanaa aatmis 'al aa 'amwaal ihim waashdud 'al aa qul oobihim fal aa yoominu hattaa yarawua aul'azaaba aal aal eem
Qaal a qadu ajeebat dda'watukumaa faastaqeemaa wal aa tattabi'aanni sabeela aal zeena laa ya'lamoon

Wajaawaznaa bibaniaa 'israa'eela aal bahra faatba'ahum fir'awnu wajunooduhu baghya wa'adwaan hattaa 'izaa 'adrakahu aul gharaqu qaal a 'aamantu 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa aal ziaa 'aamanat bihi banooaa 'israa'eela waanaa mina aal muslimeen
'aal aana waqad 'asayta qablu wakunta mina aal mufsideen
Faal yawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khal faka 'ayat wainna katheera mmina aan-naasi 'ana ayaatinaa laghaafil oon

Wal aqad bawwanaa baniaa 'israa'eela mubawwaa sidq warazaqnaahum mmina aat-tayyibaati famaa aakhtal afu hattaa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu 'inna rabbaka yaqdi baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Fain kunta fi shakk mmimmaa 'anzal naa 'il ayka fasal i ail zeena yaqra'oona aal kitaaba min qablika laqad jaa'aka aal haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna mina aal mumtareen
Wal aa takoonanna mina aal zeena kazzabu biayaati ail laahi fatakoona mina aal khaasireen
'inna aal zeena haqqat 'al ayhim kal imaatu rabbika laa yoominoon
Wal aw jaa'athum kul lu 'ayatin hattaa yarawua aul'azaaba aal aal eem
Fal awlaa kaanat qaryatun aamanat fanafa'ahaa 'eemaanuhaa 'il laa qawma yoonusa lammaa 'aamanu kashafnaa 'anhum 'azaaba aal khizyi fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wamatta'naahumuaa 'il aa heen
Wal aw shaa'a rabbuka laamana man fi ail aardi kul luhum jamee'aan aafaanta tukrihu aun-naasa hattaa yakoonu moomineen
Wamaa kaana linafsin aan toomina 'il laa biizni ail laahi wayaj'al u aur-rijsa 'al aa aal zeena laa ya'qil oon
Qul u aunzuru maazaa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa tughni ail ayaatu waan-nuzuru 'an qawm llaa yoominoon
Fahal yantaziroona 'il laa mithla 'ayyaami ail zeena khal awa min qablihim qul faantazirooaa 'inni ma'akum mmina aal muntazireen
Thumma nunajji rusul anaa waal zeena 'aamanu kazaal ika haqqaan 'al aynaa nunajji ail moomineen

Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'in kuntum fi shakk mmin deeni fal aa 'a'budu aul zeena ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi wal aakina aa'budu aul laaha aal zi yatawaffyaakum waumirtu 'ana aakoona mina aal moomineen
Waana aaqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefa wal aa takoonanna mina aal mushrikeen
Wal aa tad'u min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'uka wal aa yadurruka fain fa'al ta fainnaka 'iza mmina aaz-zaal imeen
Wainy yyamsaska aal laahu bidurr fal aa kaashifa lahuaa 'il laa hooa wainy yyuridka bikhayr fal aa raadda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wahooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu qad jaa'akumu aul haqqu mir rrabbikum famani aihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadi linafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum biwakeel
Waattabi' maa yoohaa 'il ayka waasbir hattaa yahkuma aal laahu wahooa khayru aul haakimeen
'al aar kitaabun ahkimata ayaatuhu thumma fussil at mil lladun hakeemin khabeer
Aal laa ta'budooaa 'il laa aal laaha 'innani lakum mminhu nazeer wabasheer

Waani aistaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi yumatti'kum mmataa'aan hasanaan ail aa 'ajal mmusamma wayooti kul la zi fadl fadlahu wain tawal lawa fainneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawm kabeer
Ail aa aal laahi marji'ukum wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Aal aa 'innahum yathnoona sudoorahum leeastakhfu minhu 'al aa heena yastaghshoona theeaabahum ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Wamaa min daabbat fi ail aardi 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi rizquhaa waya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda'ahaa kul l fi kitaab mmubeen

Wahooa aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda fi sittati 'ayyaam wakaana 'arshuhu 'al aa aal maa'i leeablooakumuaa 'ayyukumuaa 'ahsanu 'amal a wal a'in qul ta 'innakum mmab'oothoona mim ba'di ail mawti layaqoolanna aal zeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Wal a'ina aakhkharnaa 'anhumu aul'azaaba 'il aa 'ummat mma'doodat llayaqoolunna maa yahbisuhuaa 'al aa yawma yaateehim laysa masroofaan 'anhum wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Wal a'ina aazaqnaa aal iansaana minnaa rahmat thumma naza'naahaa minhu 'innahu layaoos kafoor
Wal a'ina aazaqnaahu na'maa'a ba'da darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna zahaba aas-sayyiaatu 'anneea 'innahu lafarih fakhoor
Ail laa aal zeena sabaru wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer

Fal a'al laka taariku ba'da maa yoohaa 'il ayka wadaa'iqu bihi sadruka 'any yyaqoolu lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi kanzun aaw jaa'a ma'ahu mal akun ainnamaa 'anta nazeer waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' wakeel
Aam yaqooloona aaftaryaahu qul faatu bi'ashri sooar mmithlihi muftarayaat waad'u mani aistata'tum mmin dooni ail laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail lam yastajeebu lakum faa'lamooaa 'annamaa 'unzil a bi'il mi ail laahi waal llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa fahal a aantum mmuslimoon
Man kaana yureedu aul hayawaata aad-dunya wazeenatahaa nooaffi 'il ayhimuaa 'a'maal ahum feehaa wahum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena laysa lahum fi ail aakhirati 'il laa aan-naaru wahabita maa sana'u feehaa wabaatil mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon

'afaman kaana 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbihi wayatloohu shaahid mminhu wamin qablihi kitaabu moosaa 'imaama warahmatan awlaa'ika yoominoona bihi wamany yyakfur bihi mina aal aahzaabi faan-naaru maw'iduhu fal aa taku fi miryat mminhu 'innahu aul haqqu mir rrabbika wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yoominoon

Wamana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan awlaa'ika yu'radoona 'al aa rabbihim wayaqoolu aul aashhaadu haa'ul aa'i ail zeena kazabu 'al aa rabbihimuaa 'al aa la'natu aul laahi 'al aa aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena yasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwaja wahum bial aakhirati hum kaafiroon
'ul aa'ika lam yakoonu mu'jizeena fi ail aardi wamaa kaana lahum mmin dooni ail laahi mina aawleeaa'a yudaa'afu lahumu aul'azaabu maa kaanu yastatee'oona aas-sam'a wamaa kaanu yubsiroon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Laa jarama 'annahum fi ail aakhirati humu aul aakhsaroon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati waakhbatooaa 'il aa rabbihimuaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon
Mathal u aul fareeqayni kaal aa'maa waal aasammi waal baseeri waas-samee'i hal yastaweeaani mathal aan aafal aa tazzakkaroon
Wal aqada aarsal naa noohaan ail aa qawmihiaa 'inni lakum nazeer mmubeen
Aal llaa ta'budooaa 'il laa aal laaha 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin aal eem

Faqaal a aal mal au aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi maa naryaaka 'il laa bashara mmithlanaa wamaa naryaaka aattaba'aka 'il laa aal zeena humuaa 'araazil unaa baadeea aar-rayi wamaa naraa lakum 'al aynaa min fadli bal nazunnukum kaazibeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'araytumuaa 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi wa'aatyaani rahmat mmin 'indihi fa'ameeat 'al aykumuaa 'anul zimukumoohaa waantum lahaa kaarihoon
Wayaaqawmi laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi maal aan aina aajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi wamaa 'anaa bitaaridi ail zeena 'aamanooaa 'innahum mmul aaqu rabbihim wal aakinneea 'aryaakum qawma tajhal oon
Wayaaqawmi many yyansuruni mina aal laahi 'in taradttuhumuaa 'afal aa tazzakkaroon

Wal aa 'aqoolu lakum 'indi khazaa'inu aul laahi wal aa 'a'lamu aul ghayba wal aa 'aqoolu 'inni mal ak wal aa 'aqoolu lil zeena tazdariaa 'a'yunukum lany yyooteeahumu aul laahu khayraan ail laahu 'a'lamu bimaa fiaa 'anfusihimuaa 'inneea 'iza llamina aaz-zaal imeen
Qaal u yaanoohu qad jaadal tanaa faaktharta jidaal anaa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Qaal a 'innamaa yaateekum bihi ail laahu 'in shaa'a wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Wal aa yanfa'ukum nusheea 'ina aaradttu 'ana aansaha lakumuaa 'in kaana aal laahu yureedu 'any yyughweeakum hooa rabbukum wail ayhi turja'oon
'am yaqooloona aaftaryaahu qul i aini aiftaraytuhu fa'al ayya 'ijraami waanaa bariaa' mmimmaa tujrimoon
Waooheea 'il aa noohin aannahu lany yyoomina min qawmika 'il laa man qada aamana fal aa tabta'is bimaa kaanu yaf'al oon
Waasna'i ail ful ka bia'yuninaa wawahyinaa wal aa tukhaatibni fi ail zeena zal amooaa 'innahum mmughraqoon
Wayasna'u aul ful ka wakul lamaa marra 'al ayhi mal a mmin qawmihi sakhiru minhu qaal a 'in taskharu minnaa fainnaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
Fasawfa ta'lamoona many yyaateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi wayahil lu 'al ayhi 'azaab mmuqeem
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'a amrunaa wafaara aat-tannooru qul naa aahmil feehaa min kul li zawjayni aithnayni waahlaka 'il laa man sabaqa 'al ayhi ail qawlu wamana aamana wamaa 'aamana ma'ahuaa 'il laa qal eel
Waqaal a aarkabu feehaa bismi ail laahi mujryaahaa wamursyaahaa 'inna rabbi laghafoor rraheem
Waheea tajri bihim fi mawj kaal jibaal i wanaadaa noohun aibnahu wakaana fi ma'zil yaabunayyi airkab ma'anaa wal aa takum mma'a aal kaafireen
Qaal a saawiaa 'il aa jabal ya'simuni mina aal maa'i qaal a laa 'aasima aal yawma mina aamri ail laahi 'il laa mar rrahima wahaal a baynahumaa aal mawju fakaana mina aal mughraqeen
Waqeela yaardu aubla'i maa'aki wayaasamaa'u aaqli'i wagheeda aal maa'u waqudeea aal aamru waastawat 'al aa aal joodeeyi waqeela bu'da llil qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wanaadaa nooh rrabbahu faqaal a rabbi 'inna aabni mina aahli wainna wa'daka aal haqqu waanta 'ahkamu aul haakimeen
Qaal a yaanoohu 'innahu laysa mina aahlika 'innahu 'amal un ghayru saal ih fal aa tasal anni maa laysa laka bihi 'il mun ainneea 'a'izuka 'an takoona mina aal jaahil een
Qaal a rabbi 'inneea 'a'oozu bika 'ana aasal aka maa laysa li bihi 'il m wail laa taghfir li watarhamniaa 'akum mmina aal khaasireen
Qeela yaanoohu auhbit bisal aam mminnaa wabarakaatin 'al ayka wa'al aa 'umam mmimmam mma'aka waumam sanumatti'uhum thumma yamassuhum mminnaa 'azaabun aal eem
Til ka mina aanbaa'i ail ghaybi nooheehaa 'il ayka maa kunta ta'lamuhaa 'anta wal aa qawmuka min qabli haazaa faasbiri ainna aal'aaqibata lil muttaqeen
Wail aa 'aadin aakhaahum hooda qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhuaa 'ina aantumuaa 'il laa muftaroon
Yaaqawmi laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajraan aina aajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal zi fataraneea 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wayaaqawmi aistaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi yursil i ais-samaa'a 'al aykum mmidraara wayazidkum qoowatan ail aa qoowatikum wal aa tatawal lawa mujrimeen
Qaal u yaahoodu maa jeetanaa bibayyinat wamaa nahnu bitaarikiaa 'aal ihatinaa 'an qawlika wamaa nahnu laka bimoomineen
'in nnaqoolu 'il laa aa'taryaaka ba'du 'aal ihatinaa bisooaa' qaal a 'inneea 'ushhidu aul laaha waashhadooaa 'anni bariaa' mmimmaa tushrikoona min doonihi fakeedooni jamee'a thumma laa tunziroon
'inni tawakkal tu 'al aa aal laahi rabbi warabbikum mmaa min daabbatin ail laa hooa 'aakhizu binaaseeatihaa 'inna rabbi 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Fain tawal lawa faqada aablaghtukum mmaa 'ursil tu bihiaa 'il aykum wayastakhlifu rabbi qawmaan ghayrakum wal aa tadurroonahu shayaan ainna rabbi 'al aa kul li sha'in hafeez
Wal ammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa hooda waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa wanajjaynaahum mmin 'azaabin ghal eez
Watil ka 'aad jahadu biayaati rabbihim wa'asawa rusul ahu waattaba'ooaa 'amra kul li jabbarin 'aneed
Wautbi'u fi haazihi aid-dunya la'nat wayawma aal qeeaamati 'al aa 'inna 'aada kafaru rabbahumuaa 'al aa bu'da lli'aad qawmi hood

Wail aa thamooda 'akhaahum saal iha qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhu hooa 'anshaakum mmina aal aardi waasta'marakum feehaa faastaghfiroohu thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi 'inna rabbi qareeb mmujeeb
Qaal u yaasaal ihu qad kunta feenaa marjoowa qabla haazaa 'atanhyaanaa 'an nna'buda maa ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa wainnanaa lafi shakk mmimmaa tad'oonaa 'il ayhi mureeb
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'araytumuaa 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi wa'aatyaani minhu rahmat famany yyansuruni mina aal laahi 'in 'asaytuhu famaa tazeedoonani ghayra takhseer
Wayaaqawmi haazihi naaqatu aul laahi lakumuaa 'ayat fazaroohaa taakul fiaa 'ardi ail laahi wal aa tamassoohaa bisooaa' fayaakhuzakum 'azaab qareeb
Fa'aqaroohaa faqaal a tamatta'u fi darikum thal aathata 'ayyaam zaal ika wa'dun ghayru makzoob
Fal ammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa saal iha waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa wamin khizyi yawma'izin ainna rabbaka hooa aal qaweeyu aul'azeez
Waakhaza aal zeena zal amu aus-sayhatu faasbahu fi deeaarihim jaathimeen
Kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa 'al aa 'inna thamooda kafaru rabbahumuaa 'al aa bu'da llithamood
Wal aqad jaa'at rusul unaa 'ibraaheema bial bushraa qaal u sal aama qaal a sal aam famaa labitha 'an jaa'a bi'ijlin haneez
Fal ammaa r'aa 'aydeeahum laa tasil u 'il ayhi nakirahum waawjasa minhum kheefat qaal u laa takhafi ainnaa 'ursil naa 'il aa qawmi looh
Waamraatuhu qaa'imat fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa biishaaqa waminw wwaraa'i ashaaqa ya'qoob
Qaal at yaawaylataa 'aal idu waanaa 'ajooz wahaazaa ba'li shaykhaan ainna haazaa lasha'un 'ajeeb
Qaal ooaa 'ata'jabeena mina aamri ail laahi rahmatu aul laahi wabarakaatuhu 'al aykumuaa 'ahla aal bayti 'innahu hameed mmajeed
Fal ammaa zahaba 'ani aibraaheema aar-raw'u wajaa'athu aul bushraa yujaadil unaa fi qawmi looh
Ainna 'ibraaheema lahal eemun aawwaah mmuneeb
Yaaibraaheemu 'a'rid 'an haazaa 'innahu qad jaa'a amru rabbika wainnahumuaa 'aateehim 'azaabun ghayru mardood
Wal ammaa jaa'at rusul unaa loota saa'a bihim wadaaqa bihim zar'a waqaal a haazaa yawmun 'aseeb

Wajaa'ahu qawmuhu yuhra'oona 'il ayhi wamin qablu kaanu ya'mal oona aas-sayyiaati qaal a yaaqawmi haa'ul aa'i banaati hunna 'atharu lakum faattaqu aul laaha wal aa tukhzooni fi dayfeea 'al aysa minkum rajur-rasheed
Qaal u laqad 'al imta maa lanaa fi banaatika min haqq wainnaka lata'lamu maa nureed
Qaal a lawa aanna li bikum qoowatan aawa aawiaa 'il aa rukn shadeed

Qaal u yaal ootu 'innaa rusul u rabbika lany yyasil ooaa 'il ayka faasri biahlika biqit' mmina aal yli wal aa yal tafit minkumuaa 'ahadun ail laa aamraataka 'innahu museebuhaa maa 'asaabahumuaa 'inna maw'idahumu aus-subhu 'al aysa aas-subhu biqareeb
Fal ammaa jaa'a amrunaa ja'al naa 'aal eeahaa saafil ahaa waamtarnaa 'al ayhaa hijaarat mmin sijjeel
Mmandood mmusawwamatan 'inda rabbika wamaa heea mina aaz-zaal imeena biba'eed

Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhu wal aa tanqusu aul mikyaal a waal meezaana 'inneea 'aryaakum bikhayr wainneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawm mmuheeh
Wayaaqawmi 'awfu aul mikyaal a waal meezaana bial qisti wal aa tabkhasu aun-naasa 'ashyaa'ahum wal aa ta'thawa fi ail aardi mufsideen
Baqiyyatu aul laahi khayr llakumuaa 'in kuntum mmoomineen
Wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum bihafeez
Qaal u yaashu'aybu 'asal awaatuka taamuruka 'an nnatruka maa ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa 'awa aan nnaf'al a fiaa 'amwaal inaa maa nashaa'ua ainnaka laanta aal hal eemu aur-rasheed

Qaal a yaaqawmi 'araytumuaa 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi warazaqani minhu rizqaan hasana wamaa 'ureedu 'anu akhaal ifakumuaa 'il aa maa 'anhyaakum 'anhu 'inu areedu 'il laa aal iaslaaha maa aastata'tu wamaa tawfeeqeea 'il laa bial laahi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi 'uneeb
Wayaaqawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqeea 'any yyuseebakum mmithlu maa 'asaaba qawma noohin aaw qawma hoodin aaw qawma saal ih wamaa qawmu loot mminkum biba'eed
Waastaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi 'inna rabbi raheem wadood
Qaal u yaashu'aybu maa nafqahu katheera mmimmaa taqoolu wainnaa lanaryaaka feenaa da'eefa wal awlaa rahtuka larajamnaaka wamaa 'anta 'al aynaa bi'azeez
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'arahteea 'a'azzu 'al aykum mmina aal laahi waattakhazttumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyaan ainna rabbi bimaa ta'mal oona muheeh
Wayaaqawmi ai'mal u 'al aa makaanatikumuaa 'inni 'aamil sawfa ta'lamoona many yyaateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi waman hooa kaazib waartaqibooaa 'inni ma'akum raqeeb
Wal ammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa shu'ayba waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa waakhazati ail zeena zal amu aus-sayhatu faasbahu fi deeaarihim jaathimeen
Kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa 'al aa bu'da llimadyana kamaa ba'idat thamood
Wal aqada aarsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
