Ail aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faattaba'ooaa 'amra fir'awna wamaa 'amru fir'awna birasheed
Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma aal qeeaamati faawradahumu aun-naara wabeesa aal wirdu aul mawrood
Wautbi'u fi haazihi la'nat wayawma aal qeeaamati beesa aar-rifdu aul marfood
Zaal ika mina aanbaa'i ail quraa naqussuhu 'al ayka minhaa qaa'im wahaseed
Wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin zal amooaa 'anfusahum famaa 'aghnat 'anhumuaa 'aal ihatuhumu aul ti yad'oona min dooni ail laahi min sha' llammaa jaa'a amru rabbika wamaa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
Wakazaal ika 'akhzu rabbika 'izaa 'akhaza aal quraa waheea zaal imatun ainna 'akhzahuaa 'al eem shadeed
Ainna fi zaal ika layat lliman khaafa 'azaaba aal aakhirati zaal ika yawm mmajmoo' llaahu aun-naasu wazaal ika yawm mmashhood
Wamaa nooakhkhiruhuaa 'il laa liajal mma'dood
Yawma yaati laa takal lamu nafsun ail laa biiznihi faminhum shaqeey wasa'eed
Faammaa aal zeena shaqu fafi ain-nari lahum feehaa zafeer washaheeq
Khaal ideena feehaa maa daamati ais-samaawaatu waal aardu 'il laa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'inna rabbaka fa'aal-limaa yureed
Waammaa aal zeena sa'idu fafi ail jannati khaal ideena feehaa maa daamati ais-samaawaatu waal aardu 'il laa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'ataa'an ghayra majzooz
Fal aa taku fi miryat mmimmaa ya'budu haa'ul aa'i maa ya'budoona 'il laa kamaa ya'budu 'aabaa'uhum mmin qablu wainnaa lamooaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba faakhtul ifa feehi wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum wainnahum lafi shakk mminhu mureeb
Wain kul la llamaa layooaffeeannahum rabbuka 'a'maal ahumuaa 'innahu bimaa ya'mal oona khabeer
Faastaqim kamaa 'umirta waman taaba ma'aka wal aa tatghawia ainnahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Wal aa tarkanooaa 'il aa aal zeena zal amu fatamassakumu aun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi mina aawleeaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
Waaqimi ais-sal awaata tarafayi ain-nahari wazul afa mmina aal yli 'inna aal hasanaati yuzhibna aas-sayyiaati zaal ika zikraa liz-zaakireen
Waasbir fainna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen

Fal awlaa kaana mina aal qurooni min qablikumuaa 'oolu baqiyyat yanhawna 'ani ail fasaadi fi ail aardi 'il laa qal eela mmimmana aanjaynaa minhum waattaba'a aal zeena zal amu maa 'utrifu feehi wakaanu mujrimeen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka leeuhlika aal quraa bizul m waahluhaa muslihoon

Wal aw shaa'a rabbuka laja'al a aan-naasa 'ummat waahidat wal aa yazaal oona mukhtal ifeena 'il laa mar rrahima rabbuka wal izaal ika khal aqahum watammat kal imatu rabbika laamlaanna jahannama mina aal jinnati waan-naasi 'ajma'een
Wakul la nnaqussu 'al ayka mina aanbaa'i air-rusul i maa nuthabbitu bihi fu'aadaka wajaa'aka fi haazihi ail haqqu wamaw'izat wazikraa lil moomineen
Waqul-lil zeena laa yoominoona aa'mal u 'al aa makaanatikumuaa 'innaa 'aamil oona waantazirooaa 'innaa muntaziroon
Wal il hi ghaybu aus-samaawaati waal aardi wail ayhi yurja'u aul aamru kul luhu faa'budhu watawakkal 'al ayhi wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
'al aar til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail mubeen
'innaa 'anzal naahu qur'aanaan 'arabiyya lla'al lakum ta'qil oon
Nahnu naqussu 'al ayka 'ahsana aal qasasi bimaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka haazaa aal qur'aana wain kunta min qablihi lamina aal ghaafil een
'iz qaal a yoosufu liabeehi yaabati 'inni raytu 'ahada 'ashara kawkaba waash-shamsa waal qamara raytuhum li saajideen
Qaal a yaabunayyi laa taqsus ru'yaka 'al aa 'ikhwatika fayakeedu laka kaydaan ainna aash-shaytaana lil iansaani 'adoow mmubeen

Wakazaal ika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayu'al limuka min taaweeli ail aahaadeethi wayutimmu ni'matahu 'al ayka wa'al aa 'aal i ya'qooba kamaa 'atammahaa 'al aa 'abawayka min qablu 'ibraaheema waishaaqa 'inna rabbaka 'al eemun hakeem
Llaqad kaana fi yoosufa waikhwatihiaa 'ayaat llis-saa'il een
'iz qaal u layoosufu waakhoohu 'ahabbu 'il aa 'abeenaa minnaa wanahnu 'usbatun ainna 'abaanaa lafi dal aal mmubeen
Auqtul u yoosufa 'awi aitrahoohu 'arda yakhlu lakum wajhu 'abeekum watakoonu mim ba'dihi qawma saal iheen
Qaal a qaa'il mminhum laa taqtul u yoosufa waal qoohu fi ghayaabaati ail jubbi yal taqithu ba'du aus-sayyaarati 'in kuntum faa'il een
Qaal u yaabaanaa maa laka laa taamannaa 'al aa yoosufa wainnaa lahu lanaasihoon
'arsil hu ma'anaa ghada yarta'i wayal'ab wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaal a 'inni layuhzinuneea 'an tazhabu bihi waakhaafu 'any yyaakul ahu auz-zeebu waantum 'anhu ghaafil oon
Qaal u la'ina aakal ahu auz-zeebu wanahnu 'usbatun ainnaa 'iza llakhaasiroon
Fal ammaa zahabu bihi waajma'ooaa 'any yyaj'al oohu fi ghayaabaati ail jubbi waawhaynaa 'il ayhi latunabbeeannahum biamrihim haazaa wahum laa yash'uroon
Wajaa'ooaa 'abaahum 'ishaa' yabkoon
Qaal u yaabaanaa 'innaa zahabnaa nastabiqu wataraknaa yoosufa 'inda mataa'inaa faakal ahu auz-zeebu wamaa 'anta bimoomil llanaa wal aw kunnaa saadiqeen
Wajaa'oo 'al aa qameesihi bidam kazib qaal a bal sawwal at lakumuaa 'anfusukumuaa 'amra fasabr jameel waal laahu aul musta'aanu 'al aa maa tasifoon
Wajaa'at sayyaarat faarsal u waaridahum faadlaa dal wahu qaal a yaabushraya haazaa ghul aam waasarroohu bidaa'at waal laahu 'al eemu bimaa ya'mal oon
Washarawhu bithamani bakhs daraahima ma'doodat wakaanu feehi mina aaz-zaahideen

Waqaal a aal zi aishtaryaahu mim mmisra liamraatihiaa 'akrimi mathwyaahu 'asaa 'any yyanfa'anaa 'aw nattakhizahu wal ada wakazaal ika makkannaa leeoosufa fi ail aardi wal inu'al limahu min taaweeli ail aahaadeethi waal laahu ghaal ibun 'al aa 'amrihi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa bal agha 'ashuddahuaa 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wakazaal ika najzi ail muhsineen
Waraawadathu aul ti hooa fi baytihaa 'an nnafsihi waghal laqati ail aabwaaba waqaal at heeta laka qaal a ma'aaza aal laahi 'innahu rabbeea 'ahsana mathwaya 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon
Wal aqad hammat bihi wahamma bihaa lawlaa 'ar rr'a burhaana rabbihi kazaal ika linasrifa 'anhu aus-sooaa'a waal fahshaa'a annahu min 'ibaadinaa aal mukhlaseen
Waastabaqaa aal baaba waqaddat qameesahu min dubur waal fayaa sayyidahaa ladaa aal baabi qaal at maa jazaa'u mana aaraada biahlika sooaa'aan ail laa 'any yyusjana 'aw 'azaabun aal eem
Qaal a heea raawadatni 'an nnafsi washahida shaahid mmina aahlihaa 'in kaana qameesuhu qudda min qubul fasadaqat wahooa mina aal kaazibeen
Wain kaana qameesuhu qudda min dubur fakazabat wahooa mina aas-saadiqeen
Fal ammaa r'a qameesahu qudda min dubur qaal a 'innahu min kaydikunna 'inna kaydakunna 'azeem
Yoosufu 'a'rid 'an haazaa waastaghfiri lizanbiki 'innaki kunti mina aal khaatieen
Waqaal a niswat fi ail madeenati aimraatu aul'azeezi turaawidu fatyaahaa 'an nnafsihi qad shaghafahaa hubbaan ainnaa lanaryaahaa fi dal aal mmubeen

Fal ammaa sami'at bimakrihinna 'arsal ati ail ayhinna waa'tadat lahunna muttakaa wa'aatat kul la waahidat mminhunna sikkeena waqaal atu aukhruj 'al ayhinna fal ammaa raynahuaa 'akbarnahu waqatta'na 'aydeeahunna waqul na haasha lil hi maa haazaa basharaan ain haazaa 'il laa mal ak kareem
Qaal at fazaal ikunna aal zi lumtunnani feehi wal aqad raawadttuhu 'an nnafsihi faasta'sama wal a'il llam yaf'al maa 'aamuruhu layusjananna wal ayakoona mmina aas-saaghireen
Qaal a rabbi ais-sijnu 'ahabbu 'il ayya mimmaa yad'oonaniaa 'il ayhi wail laa tasrif 'anni kaydahunna 'asbu 'il ayhinna waakum mmina aal jaahil een
Faastajaaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunna 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Thumma badaa lahum mmim ba'di maa raawua aul ayaati layasjununnahu hattaa heen

Wadakhal a ma'ahu aus-sijna fatayaani qaal a 'ahaduhumaa 'inneea 'aryaaneea 'a'siru khamra waqaal a aal aakharu 'inneea 'aryaaneea 'ahmil u fawqa rasi khubza taakul u aut-tayru minhu nabbeenaa bitaaweelihiaa 'innaa naryaaka mina aal muhsineen

Qaal a laa yaateekumaa ta'aam turzaqaanihiaa 'il laa nabbatukumaa bitaaweelihi qabla 'any yyaateeakumaa zaal ikumaa mimmaa 'al lamani rabbeea 'inni taraktu mil lata qawm llaa yoominoona bial laahi wahum bial aakhirati hum kaafiroon

Waattaba'tu mil lata 'aabaa'eea 'ibraaheema waishaaqa waya'qooba maa kaana lanaa 'an nnushrika bial laahi min sha' zaal ika min fadli ail laahi 'al aynaa wa'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Yaasaahibayi ais-sijni 'aarbaab mmutafarriqoona khayrun aami ail laahu aul waahidu aul qahhaar

Maa ta'budoona min doonihiaa 'il laa 'asmaa' sammaytumoohaa 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum mmaa 'anzal a aal laahu bihaa min sul taanin aini ail hukmu 'il laa lil hi 'amara 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laa 'iyyaahu zaal ika aad-deenu aul qayyimu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Yaasaahibayi ais-sijni 'ammaa 'ahadukumaa fayasqi rabbahu khamra waammaa aal aakharu fayuslabu fataakul u aut-tayru mir rrasihi qudeea aal aamru aul zi feehi tastafteeaan
Waqaal a lil zi zanna 'annahu naaj mminhumaa aazkurni 'inda rabbika faansyaahu aush-shaytaanu zikra rabbihi fal abitha fi ais-sijni bid'a sineen

Waqaal a aal mal iku 'inneea 'araa sab'a baqaraat simaany yaakul uhunna sab'un 'ijaaf wasab'a sunbul aatin khudr waukhara yaabisaat yayyuhaa aal mal au aaftooni fi ru'yaya 'in kuntum lir-ru'ya ta'buroon
Qaal ooaa 'adghaathu 'ahlaam wamaa nahnu bitaaweeli ail aahlaami bi'aal imeen
Waqaal a aal zi najaa minhumaa waaddakara ba'da 'ummatin aanaa 'unabbeeukum bitaaweelihi faarsil oon
Yoosufu 'ayyuhaa aas-siddeequ 'aftinaa fi sab'i baqaraat simaany yaakul uhunna sab'un 'ijaaf wasab'i sunbul aatin khudr waukhara yaabisaat lla'al leea 'arji'u 'il aa aan-naasi la'al laahum ya'lamoon
Qaal a tazra'oona sab'a sineena daba famaa hasadttum fazaroohu fi sunbul ihiaa 'il laa qal eela mmimmaa taakul oon
Thumma yaati mim ba'di zaal ika sab' shidaad yaakul na maa qaddamtum lahunna 'il laa qal eela mmimmaa tuhsinoon
Thumma yaati mim ba'di zaal ika 'aam feehi yughaathu aun-naasu wafeehi ya'siroon
Waqaal a aal mal iku auytooni bihi fal ammaa jaa'ahu aur-rasoolu qaal a aarji'i ail aa rabbika fasal hu maa baal u aun-niswati ail ti qatta'na 'aydeeahunna 'inna rabbi bikaydihinna 'al eem

Qaal a maa khatbukunna 'iz raawadttunna yoosufa 'an nnafsihi qul na haasha lil hi maa 'al imnaa 'al ayhi min sooaa' qaal ati aimraatu aul'azeezi ail aana hashasa aal haqqu 'anaa raawadttuhu 'an nnafsihi wainnahu lamina aas-saadiqeen
Zaal ika leea'lama 'anni lama aakhunhu bial ghaybi waanna aal laaha laa yahdi kayda aal khaa'ineen
Wamaa 'ubarriu nafseea 'inna aan-nafsa laammaaratu bias-sooaa'i al laa maa rahima rabbeea 'inna rabbi ghafoor rraheem
Waqaal a aal mal iku auytooni bihiaa 'astakhlishu linafsi fal ammaa kal lamahu qaal a 'innaka aal yawma ladaynaa makeenun aameen
Qaal a aaj'al ni 'al aa khazaa'ini ail aardi 'inni hafeezun 'al eem
Wakazaal ika makkannaa leeoosufa fi ail aardi yatabawwau minhaa haythu yashaa'u nuseebu birahmatinaa man nnashaa'u wal aa nudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen
Wal aajru aul aakhirati khayr llil zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wajaa'a akhwatu yoosufa fadakhal u 'al ayhi fa'arafahum wahum lahu munkiroon
Wal ammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaal a aytooni biakh llakum mmina aabeekumuaa 'al aa tarawna 'anneea 'oofi ail kayla waanaa khayru aul munzil een
Fail llam taatooni bihi fal aa kayla lakum 'indi wal aa taqraboon
Qaal u sanuraawidu 'anhu 'abaahu wainnaa lafaa'il oon
Waqaal a lifityatihi aij'al u bidaa'atahum fi rihaal ihim la'al laahum ya'rifoonahaa 'izaa aanqal abooaa 'il aa 'ahlihim la'al laahum yarji'oon
Fal ammaa raja'ooaa 'il aa 'abeehim qaal u yaabaanaa muni'a minnaa aal kaylu faarsil ma'anaa 'akhaanaa naktal wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaal a hal a aamanukum 'al ayhi 'il laa kamaa 'amintukum 'al aa 'akheehi min qablu faal laahu khayrun hifza wahooa 'arhamu aur-raahimeen

Wal ammaa fatahu mataa'ahum wajadu bidaa'atahum ruddati ail ayhim qaal u yaabaanaa maa nabghi haazihi bidaa'atunaa ruddati ail aynaa wanameeru 'ahlanaa wanahfazu 'akhaanaa wanazdaadu kayla ba'eer zaal ika kayl yaseer
Qaal a lanu arsil ahu ma'akum hattaa tootooni mawthiqa mmina aal laahi lataatunnani bihiaa 'il laa 'any yyuhaata bikum fal ammaa 'aatawhu mawthiqahum qaal a aal laahu 'al aa maa naqoolu wakeel

Waqaal a yaabaniyya laa tadkhul u mim baab waahid waadkhul u mina aabwaab mmutafarriqat wamaa 'ughni 'ankum mmina aal laahi min sha'in aini ail hukmu 'il laa lil hi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wa'al ayhi fal yatawakkal i ail mutawakkil oon

Wal ammaa dakhal u min haythu 'amarahumuaa 'aboohum mmaa kaana yughni 'anhum mmina aal laahi min sha'in ail laa haajat fi nafsi ya'qooba qadyaahaa wainnahu lazoo 'il m llimaa 'al lamnaahu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa dakhal u 'al aa yoosufa 'aawaa 'il ayhi 'akhaahu qaal a 'inneea 'anaa 'akhooka fal aa tabta'is bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fal ammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja'al a aas-siqayata fi rahli 'akheehi thumma 'azzana mooazzinun ayyatuhaa aal'eeru 'innakum lasaariqoon
Qaal u waaqbal u 'al ayhim mmaazaa tafqidoon
Qaal u nafqidu sooaa'a aal mal iki wal iman jaa'a bihi himlu ba'eer waanaa bihi za'eem
Qaal u taal laahi laqad 'al imtum mmaa jeenaa linufsida fi ail aardi wamaa kunnaa saariqeen
Qaal u famaa jazaa'uhuaa 'in kuntum kaazibeen
Qaal u jazaa'uhu manw wwujida fi rahlihi fahooa jazaa'uhu kazaal ika najzi aiz-zaal imeen

Fabadaa biaw'eeatihim qabla wi'aa'i aakheehi thumma aastakhrajahaa minw wwi'aa'i aakheehi kazaal ika kidnaa leeoosufa maa kaana leeaakhuza 'akhaahu fi deeni ail mal iki 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu narfa'u darajaati man nnashaa'u wafawqa kul li zi 'il min 'al eem
Qaal ooaa 'iny yyasriq faqad saraqa 'akh llaahu min qablu faasarrahaa yoosufu fi nafsihi wal am yubdihaa lahum qaal a 'antum sharr mmakaana waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa tasifoon
Qaal u yayyuhaa aal'azeezu 'inna lahuaa 'aba shaykha kabeera fakhuza aahadanaa makaanahuaa 'innaa naryaaka mina aal muhsineen
Qaal a ma'aaza aal laahi 'an nnaakhuza 'il laa manw wwajadnaa mataa'anaa 'indahuaa 'innaa 'iza llazaal imoon

Fal ammaa aastayasu minhu khal asu najiyya qaal a kabeeruhumuaa 'al am ta'lamooaa 'anna 'abaakum qada aakhaza 'al aykum mmawthiqa mmina aal laahi wamin qablu maa farratttum fi yoosufa fal ana aabraha aal aarda hattaa yaazana leea 'abeea 'aw yahkuma aal laahu li wahooa khayru aul haakimeen
Aarji'ooaa 'il aa 'abeekum faqoolu yaabaanaa 'inna aabnaka saraqa wamaa shahidnaa 'il laa bimaa 'al imnaa wamaa kunnaa lil ghaybi haafizeen
Wasal i ail qaryata aal ti kunnaa feehaa waal'eera aal tiaa 'aqbal naa feehaa wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Qaal a bal sawwal at lakumuaa 'anfusukumuaa 'amra fasabr jameelun 'asaa aal laahu 'any yyaateeani bihim jamee'aan ainnahu hooa aal'al eemu aul hakeem
Watawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaasafaa 'al aa yoosufa waabyaddat 'aynaahu mina aal huzni fahooa kazeem
Qaal u taal laahi tafta'ua tazkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradaan aaw takoona mina aal haal ikeen
Qaal a 'innamaa 'ashku baththi wahuzneea 'il aa aal laahi waa'lamu mina aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Yaabaniyya aazhabu fatahassasu miny yyoosufa waakheehi wal aa tayasu mir rrawhi ail laahi 'innahu laa yayasu mir rrawhi ail laahi 'il laa aal qawmu aul kaafiroon
Fal ammaa dakhal u 'al ayhi qaal u yayyuhaa aal'azeezu massanaa waahlanaa aad-durru wajeenaa bibidaa'at mmuzjyaat faawfi lanaa aal kayla watasaddaq 'al aynaa 'inna aal laaha yajzi ail mutasaddiqeen
Qaal a hal 'al imtum mmaa fa'al tum beeoosufa waakheehi 'iza aantum jaahil oon
Qaal ooaa 'annaka laanta yoosufu qaal a 'anaa yoosufu wahaazaa 'akhi qad manna aal laahu 'al aynaa 'innahu many yyattaqi wayasbir fainna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen
Qaal u taal laahi laqada aatharaka aal laahu 'al aynaa wain kunnaa lakhaatieen
Qaal a laa tathreeba 'al aykumu aul yawma yaghfiru aul laahu lakum wahooa 'arhamu aur-raahimeen
Aazhabu biqameesi haazaa faal qoohu 'al aa wajhi 'abi yaati baseera waatooni biahlikumuaa 'ajma'een
Wal ammaa fasal ati ail'eeru qaal a 'aboohumuaa 'inni laajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa 'an tufannidoon
Qaal u taal laahi 'innaka lafi dal aal ika aal qadeem
Fal ammaa 'an jaa'a aal basheeru 'al qyaahu 'al aa wajhihi faartadda baseera qaal a 'al ama aaqul-lakumuaa 'inneea 'a'lamu mina aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qaal u yaabaanaa aastaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa 'innaa kunnaa khaatieen
Qaal a sawfa 'astaghfiru lakum rabbeea 'innahu hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Fal ammaa dakhal u 'al aa yoosufa 'aawaa 'il ayhi 'abawayhi waqaal a aadkhul u misra 'in shaa'a aal laahu 'aamineen

Warafa'a 'abawayhi 'al aa aal'arshi wakharru lahu sujjada waqaal a yaabati haazaa taaweelu ru'yaya min qablu qad ja'al ahaa rabbi haqqa waqada aahsana beea 'iza aakhrajani mina aas-sijni wajaa'a bikum mmina aal badwi mim ba'di 'an nnazagha aash-shaytaanu bayni wabayna 'ikhwateea 'inna rabbi lateef llimaa yashaa'u ainnahu hooa aal'al eemu aul hakeem

Rabbi qada aataytani mina aal mul ki wa'al lamtani min taaweeli ail aahaadeethi faatira aas-samaawaati waal aardi 'anta wal eeyi fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati tawaffani muslima waal hiqni bias-saal iheen
Zaal ika mina aanbaa'i ail ghaybi nooheehi 'il ayka wamaa kunta ladayhimuaa 'iza aajma'ooaa 'amrahum wahum yamkuroon
Wamaa 'aktharu aun-naasi wal aw harasta bimoomineen
Wamaa tasal uhum 'al ayhi mina aajrin ain hooa 'il laa zikr llil'aal ameen
Wakayyim mmina ayat fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi yamurroona 'al ayhaa wahum 'anhaa mu'ridoon
Wamaa yoominu 'aktharuhum bial laahi 'il laa wahum mmushrikoon
'afaaminooaa 'an taateeahum ghaasheeat mmin 'azaabi ail laahi 'aw taateeahumu aus-saa'atu baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Qul haazihi sabeeleea 'ad'ooaa 'il aa aal laahi 'al aa baseeratin aanaa wamani aittaba'ani wasubhaana aal laahi wamaa 'anaa mina aal mushrikeen

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika 'il laa rijaal a yoohaa 'il ayhim mmina aahli ail quraa 'afal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim wal adaaru aul aakhirati khayr llil zeena aattaqawaa aafal aa ta'qil oon
Hattaa 'izaa aastayasa aar-rusul u wazannooaa 'annahum qad kuzzibu jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanuji man nnashaa'u wal aa yuraddu basunaa 'ani ail qawmi ail mujrimeen
Laqad kaana fi qasasihim 'ibrat lliooli ail aal baabi maa kaana hadeetha yuftaraa wal aakin tasdeeqa aal zi bayna yadayhi watafseela kul li sha' wahuda warahmat lliqawm yoominoon
'al aammiaar til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi waal ziaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika aal haqqu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yoominoon

Aal laahu aul zi rafa'a aas-samaawaati bighayri 'amad tarawnahaa thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara kul l yajri liajal mmusamma yudabbiru aul aamra yufassil u aul ayaati la'al lakum bil iqaa'i rabbikum tooqinoon

Wahooa aal zi madda aal aarda waja'al a feehaa rawaaseea waanhaara wamin kul li aith-thamaraati ja'al a feehaa zawjayni aithnayni yughshi ail yla aan-nahaara 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon

Wafi ail aardi qita' mmutajaawiraat wajannaat mmina aa'naab wazar' wanakheel sinwaanw waghayri sinwaan tusqaa bimaa' waahid wanufaddil u ba'dahaa 'al aa ba'd fi ail uakli 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wain ta'jab fa'ajab qawluhumuaa 'azaa kunnaa turaabaan ainnaa lafi khal q jadeed
Awlaa'ika aal zeena kafaru birabbihim waul aa'ika aal aaghlaal u fiaa 'a'naaqihim waul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-nari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wayasta'jil oonaka bias-sayyeeati qabla aal hasanati waqad khal at min qablihimu aul mathul aatu wainna rabbaka lazoo maghfirat llin-naasi 'al aa zul mihim wainna rabbaka lashadeedu aul'iqaab
Wayaqoolu aul zeena kafaru lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihiaa 'innamaa 'anta munzir wal ikul li qawmin haad
Ail laahu ya'lamu maa tahmil u kul lu 'unthaa wamaa tagheedu aul aarhaamu wamaa tazdaadu wakul lu sha'in 'indahu bimiqdar
'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati ail kabeeru aul muta'aal
Sawaa' mminkum mmana aasarra aal qawla waman jahara bihi waman hooa mustakhfi bial yli wasaaribu bian-nahar

Lahu mu'aqqibaat mmim bayni yadayhi wamin khal fihi yahfazoonahu mina aamri ail laahi 'inna aal laaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiru maa bianfusihim waizaa 'araada aal laahu biqawm sooaa'a fal aa maradda lahu wamaa lahum mmin doonihi minw wwaal
Hooa aal zi yureekumu aul barqa khawfa watama'a wayunshiu aus-sahaaba aath-thiqaal
Wayusabbihu aur-ra'du bihamdihi waal mal aa'ikatu min kheefatihi wayursil u aus-sawaa'iqa fayuseebu bihaa many yyashaa'u wahum yujaadil oona fi ail laahi wahooa shadeedu aul mihaal

Lahu da'watu aul haqqi waal zeena yad'oona min doonihi laa yastajeeboona lahum bisha'in ail laa kabaasiti kaffayhi 'il aa aal maa'i leeablugha faahu wamaa hooa bibaal ighihi wamaa du'aa'u aul kaafireena 'il laa fi dal aal
Wal il hi yasjudu man fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi taw'a wakarha wazil aal uhum bial ghudoowi waal aasaal

Qul mar rrabbu aus-samaawaati waal aardi qul i ail laahu qul a aafaattakhazttum mmin doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a laa yamlikoona lianfusihim naf'a wal aa darra qul hal yastawi ail aa'maa waal baseeru 'am hal tastawi aiz-zul umaatu waan-noor
'am ja'al u lil hi shurakaa'a khal aqu kakhal qihi fatashaabaha aal khal qu 'al ayhim qul i ail laahu khaal iqu kul li sha' wahooa aal waahidu aul qahhaar

'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' fasaal ata aawdeeatu biqadarihaa faahtamal a aas-saylu zabada rraabeea wamimmaa tooqidoona 'al ayhi fi ain-nari aibtighaa'a hil yatin aaw mataa' zabad mmithluhu kazaal ika yadribu aul laahu aul haqqa waal baatil a faammaa aaz-zabadu fayazhabu jufaa' waammaa maa yanfa'u aun-naasa fayamkuthu fi ail aardi kazaal ika yadribu aul laahu aul aamthaal

Lil zeena aastajaabu lirabbihimu aul husnaa waal zeena lam yastajeebu lahu lawa aanna lahum mmaa fi ail aardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu laaftadawa bihiaa 'ul aa'ika lahum sooaa'u aul hisaabi wamawyaahum jahannamu wabeesa aal mihaad
'afamany yya'lamu 'annamaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika aal haqqu kaman hooa 'a'maa 'innamaa yatazakkaru 'oolu aul aal baab
Ail zeena yoofoona bi'ahdi ail laahi wal aa yanqudoona aal meethaaq
Waal zeena yasil oona maa 'amara aal laahu bihiaa 'any yyoosal a wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhaafoona sooaa'a aal hisaab
Waal zeena sabaru aubtighaa'a wajhi rabbihim waaqaamu aus-sal awaata waanfaqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat wayadra'oona bial hasanati ais-sayyeeata 'ul aa'ika lahum 'uqbaa aad-dar

Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa waman sal aha mina aabaa'ihim waazwaajihim wazurriyyaatihim waal mal aa'ikatu yadkhul oona 'al ayhim mmin kul li baab sal aamun 'al aykum bimaa sabartum fani'ma 'uqbaa aad-dar
Waal zeena yanqudoona 'ahda aal laahi mim ba'di meethaaqihi wayaqta'oona maa 'amara aal laahu bihiaa 'any yyoosal a wayufsidoona fi ail aardi 'ul aa'ika lahumu aul la'natu wal ahum sooaa'u aud-dar
Ail laahu yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru wafarihu bial hayawaati aid-dunya wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunya fi ail aakhirati 'il laa mataa'
Wayaqoolu aul zeena kafaru lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi qul i ainna aal laaha yudil lu many yyashaa'u wayahdiaa 'il ayhi mana aanaab
Aal zeena 'aamanu watatma'innu qul oobuhum bizikri ail laahi 'al aa bizikri ail laahi tatma'innu aul qul oob
Aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati toobaa lahum wahusnu maab

Kazaal ika 'arsal naaka fiaa 'ummat qad khal at min qablihaa 'umam llitatlooaa 'al ayhimu aul ziaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka wahum yakfuroona biar-rahmaani qul hooa rabbi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi mataab

Wal awa aanna qur'aana suyyirat bihi ail jibaal u 'aw qutti'at bihi ail aardu 'aw kul lima bihi ail mawtaa bal-lil hi ail aamru jamee'aan aafal am yayasi ail zeena 'aamanooaa 'al llaw yashaa'u aul laahu lahadaa aan-naasa jamee'a wal aa yazaal u aul zeena kafaru tuseebuhum bimaa sana'u qaari'atun aaw tahul lu qareeba mmin darihim hattaa yaateea wa'du aul laahi 'inna aal laaha laa yukhlifu aul mee'aad
Wal aqadu austuhzia birusul mmin qablika faamlaytu lil zeena kafaru thumma 'akhazttuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab

'afaman hooa qaa'imun 'al aa kul li nafsi bimaa kasabat waja'al u lil hi shurakaa'a qul sammoohumuaa 'am tunabbioonahu bimaa laa ya'lamu fi ail aardi 'am bizaahir mmina aal qawli bal zuyyina lil zeena kafaru makruhum wasaddu 'ani ais-sabeeli wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad
Llaahum 'azaab fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wal a'azaabu aul aakhirati 'ashaqqu wamaa lahum mmina aal laahi minw wwaaq
Mmathal u aul jannati ail ti wu'ida aal muttaqoona tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru 'ukluhaa daa'im wazil luhaa til ka 'uqbaa aal zeena aattaqa wwa'uqbaa aal kaafireena aan-naar

Waal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba yafrahoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamina aal aahzaabi many yyunkiru ba'dahu qul i ainnamaa 'umirtu 'ana aa'buda aal laaha wal aa 'ushrika bihiaa 'il ayhi 'ad'u wail ayhi maab
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naahu hukmaan 'arabiyya wal a'ini aittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum ba'da maa jaa'aka mina aal'il mi maa laka mina aal laahi minw wwal eey wal aa waaq
Wal aqada aarsal naa rusul a mmin qablika waja'al naa lahumuaa 'azwaaja wazurriyyat wamaa kaana lirasoolin aany yyaateea biayatin ail laa biizni ail laahi likul li 'ajal kitaab
Yamhu aul laahu maa yashaa'u wayuthabbitu wa'indahuaa 'ummu aul kitaab
Waim mmaa nureeannaka ba'da aal zi na'iduhumuaa 'aw natawaffayannaka fainnamaa 'al ayka aal bal aaghu wa'al aynaa aal hisaab
'awal am yarawaa aannaa naati ail aarda nanqusuhaa mina aatraafihaa waal laahu yahkumu laa mu'aqqiba lihukmihi wahooa saree'u aul hisaab
Waqad makara aal zeena min qablihim fal il hi ail makru jamee'a ya'lamu maa taksibu kul lu nafs wasaya'lamu aul kaafiru liman 'uqbaa aad-dar
Wayaqoolu aul zeena kafaru lasta mursal a qul kafaa bial laahi shaheedaa bayni wabaynakum waman 'indahu 'il mu aul kitaab
'al aar kitaabun aanzal naahu 'il ayka litukhrija aan-naasa mina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noor
Biizni rabbihimuaa 'il aa siraati ail'azeezi ail hameed
Ail laahu aul zi lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi wawayl llil kaafireena min 'azaab shadeed
Ail zeena yastahibboona aal hayawaata aad-dunya 'al aa aal aakhirati wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwajaan awlaa'ika fi dal aal i ba'eed
Wamaa 'arsal naa mir rrasoolin ail laa bil isaani qawmihi leeubayyina lahum fayudil lu aul laahu many yyashaa'u wayahdi many yyashaa'u wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Wal aqada aarsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa 'ana aakhrij qawmaka mina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noor
Wazakkirhum biayyyaami ail laahi 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbar shakoor

Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi aizkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykumuaa 'iza aanjyaakum mmina aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'a aal'azaabi wayuzabbihoona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafi zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem
Waiz taazzana rabbukum la'in shakartum laazeedannakum wal a'in kafartumuaa 'inna 'azaabi lashadeed
Waqaal a moosaa 'in takfurooaa 'antum waman fi ail aardi jamee'a fainna aal laaha laghaneeyun hameed
Aal am yaatikum naba'ua aul zeena min qablikum qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamood

Waal zeena mim ba'dihim laa ya'lamuhumuaa 'il laa aal laahu jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati faraddooaa 'aydeeahum fiaa 'afwaahihim waqaal ooaa 'innaa kafarnaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi wainnaa lafi shakk mmimmaa tad'oonanaa 'il ayhi mureeb

Qaal at rusul uhumuaa 'afi ail laahi shakk faatiri ais-samaawaati waal aardi yad'ookum leeaghfira lakum mmin zunoobikum wayooakhkhirakumuaa 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma qaal ooaa 'ina aantumuaa 'il laa bashar mmithlunaa tureedoona 'an tasuddoonaa 'ammaa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa faatoonaa bisul taam mmubeen

Qaal at lahum rusul uhumuaa 'in nnahnu 'il laa bashar mmithlukum wal aakinna aal laaha yamunnu 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wamaa kaana lanaa 'an nnaateeakum bisul taanin ail laa biizni ail laahi wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail moominoon
Wamaa lanaa 'al laa natawakkal a 'al aa aal laahi waqad hadyaanaa subul anaa wal anasbiranna 'al aa maa 'aazaytumoonaa wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mutawakkil oon
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lirusul ihim lanukhrijannakum mmina aardinaa 'aw lata'oodunna fi mil latinaa faawhaa 'il ayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna aaz-zaal imeen
Wal anuskinannakumu aul aarda mim ba'dihim zaal ika liman khaafa maqaami wakhaafa wa'eed
Waastaftahu wakhaaba kul lu jabbarin 'aneed
Mminw wwaraa'ihi jahannamu wayusqaa mim mmaa' sadeed
Yatajarra'uhu wal aa yakaadu yuseeghuhu wayaateehi ail mawtu min kul li makaanw wamaa hooa bimayyit waminw wwaraa'ihi 'azaabun ghal eez
Mmathal u aul zeena kafaru birabbihimuaa 'a'maal uhum karamaadin aishtaddat bihi air-reeaahu fi yawmin 'aasif llaa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasabu 'al aa sha' zaal ika hooa aad-dal aal u aul ba'eed
'al am tara 'anna aal laaha khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda bial haqqi 'iny yyasha yuzhibkum wayaati bikhal q jadeed wamaa zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi bi'azeez

Wabarazu lil hi jamee'a faqaal a aad-du'afaa'ua lil zeena aastakbarooaa 'innaa kunnaa lakum taba'a fahal a aantum mmughnoona 'annaa min 'azaabi ail laahi min sha' qaal u law hadyaanaa aal laahu lahadaynaakum sawaa'un 'al aynaa 'ajazi'naa 'am sabarnaa maa lanaa mim mmahees

Waqaal a aash-shaytaanu lammaa qudeea aal aamru 'inna aal laaha wa'adakum wa'da aal haqqi wawa'adttukum faakhlaftukum wamaa kaana li 'al aykum mmin sul taanin ail laa 'an da'awtukum faastajabtum li fal aa tal oomooni wal oomooaa 'anfusakum mmaa 'anaa bimusrikhikum wamaa 'antum bimusrikhiyya 'inni kafartu bimaa 'ashraktumooni min qablu 'inna aaz-zaal imeena lahum 'azaabun aal eem
Waudkhil a aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa biizni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feehaa sal aam
Aal am tara kayfa daraba aal laahu mathal a kal imat tayyibat kashajarat tayyibatin aasluhaa thaabit wafar'uhaa fi ais-samaa'
Tootiaa 'uklahaa kul la heeni biizni rabbihaa wayadribu aul laahu aul aamthaal a lin-naasi la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wamathal u kal imatin khabeethat kashajaratin khabeethatin aujtuththat min fawqi ail aardi maa lahaa min qarar
Yuthabbitu aul laahu aul zeena 'aamanu bial qawli aith-thaabiti fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wafi ail aakhirati wayudil lu aul laahu auz-zaal imeena wayaf'al u aul laahu maa yashaa'
Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena baddal u ni'mata aal laahi kufra waahal lu qawmahum daara aal bawar
Jahannama yaslawnahaa wabeesa aal qaraar
Waja'al u lil hi 'andaada lleeudil lu 'an sabeelihi qul tamatta'u fainna maseerakumuaa 'il aa aan-nar
Qul-li'ibaadeea aal zeena 'aamanu yuqeemu aus-sal awaata wayunfiqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat mmin qabli 'any yyaateea yawm llaa bay' feehi wal aa khil aal

Ail laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda waanzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faakhraja bihi mina aath-thamaraati rizqa llakum wasakhkhara lakumu aul ful ka litajreea fi ail bahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu aul aanhaar
Wasakhkhara lakumu aush-shamsa waal qamara daa'ibayni wasakhkhara lakumu aul yla waan-nahaar
Wa'aatyaakum mmin kul li maa saal tumoohu wain ta'uddu ni'mata aal laahi laa tuhsoohaa 'inna aal iansaana lazal oom kaffaar
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu rabbi aij'al haazaa aal bal ada 'aamina waajnubni wabaniyya 'an nna'buda aal aasnaam
Rabbi 'innahunna 'adlal na katheera mmina aan-naasi faman tabi'ani fainnahu minni waman 'asani fainnaka ghafoor rraheem

Rrabbanaa 'inneea 'askantu min zurriyyati biwaadin ghayri zi zar'in 'inda baytika aal muharrami rabbanaa leeuqeemu aus-sal awaata faaj'al a aafidat mmina aan-naasi tahwiaa 'il ayhim waarzuqhum mmina aath-thamaraati la'al laahum yashkuroon
Rabbanaa 'innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfi wamaa nu'linu wamaa yakhfaa 'al aa aal laahi min sha' fi ail aardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi wahaba li 'al aa aal kibari 'ismaa'eela waishaaqa 'inna rabbi lasamee'u aud-du'aa'
Rabbi aij'al ni muqeema aas-sal awaati wamin zurriyyati rabbanaa wataqabbal du'aa'
Rabbanaa aaghfir li wal iwaal idayya wal il moomineena yawma yaqoomu aul hisaab
Wal aa tahsibanna aal laaha ghaafil aan 'ammaa ya'mal u auz-zaal imoona 'innamaa yooakhkhiruhum leeawm tashkhasu feehi ail aabsaar
Muhti'eena muqni'i ru'oosihim laa yartaddu 'il ayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaa'

Waanziri ain-naasa yawma yaateehimu aul'azaabu fayaqoolu aul zeena zal amu rabbanaa 'akhkhirnaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb nnujib da'wataka wanattabi'i air-rusul a 'awal am takoonooaa 'aqsamtum mmin qablu maa lakum mmin zawaal
Wasakantum fi masaakini ail zeena zal amooaa 'anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa fa'al naa bihim wadarabnaa lakumu aul aamthaal
Waqad makaru makrahum wa'inda aal laahi makruhum wain kaana makruhum litazoola minhu aul jibaal
Fal aa tahsibanna aal laaha mukhlifa wa'dihi rusul ahuaa 'inna aal laaha 'azeez zoo auntiqaam
Yawma tubaddal u aul aardu ghayra aal aardi waas-samaawaatu wabarazu lil hi ail waahidi ail qahhar
Wataraa aal mujrimeena yawma'iz mmuqarraneena fi ail aasfaad
Saraabeeluhum mmin qatiraanw wataghshaa wujoohahumu aun-naar
Leeajzeea aal laahu kul la nafs mmaa kasabati ainna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab
Haazaa bal aagh llin-naasi wal eeunzaru bihi wal eea'lamooaa 'annamaa hooa 'il aah waahid wal eeazzakkara 'oolu aul aal baab
'al aar til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi waqur'aam mmubeen
Rrubamaa yawaddu aul zeena kafaru law kaanu muslimeen
Zarhum yaakul u wayatamatta'u wayul hihimu aul aamal u fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wamaa 'ahlaknaa min qaryatin ail laa wal ahaa kitaab mma'loom
Mmaa tasbiqu minu ammatin aajal ahaa wamaa yastaakhiroon
Waqaal u yayyuhaa aal zi nuzzil a 'al ayhi aiz-zikru 'innaka lamajnoon
Llawmaa taateenaa bial mal aa'ikati 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Maa tanazzal u aul mal aa'ikatu 'il laa bial haqqi wamaa kaanooaa 'iza mmunzareen
'innaa nahnu nazzal naa aaz-zikra wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Wal aqada aarsal naa min qablika fi sheea'i ail aawwal een
Wamaa yaateehim mmir rrasoolin ail laa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Kazaal ika naslukuhu fi qul oobi ail mujrimeen
Laa yoominoona bihi waqad khal at sunnatu aul aawwal een
Wal aw fatahnaa 'al ayhim baaba mmina aas-samaa'i fazal lu feehi ya'rujoon
Laqaal ooaa 'innamaa sukkirata aabsaarunaa bal nahnu qawm mmashooroon
Wal aqad ja'al naa fi ais-samaa'i burooja wazayyannaahaa lin-naazireen
Wahafiznaahaa min kul li shaytaar rrajeem
Ail laa mani aistaraqa aas-sam'a faatba'ahu shihaab mmubeen
Waal aarda madadnaahaa waal qaynaa feehaa rawaaseea waanbatnaa feehaa min kul li sha' mmawzoon
Waja'al naa lakum feehaa ma'ayisha wamal llastum lahu biraaziqeen
Waim mmin sha'in ail laa 'indanaa khazaa'inuhu wamaa nunazzil uhuaa 'il laa biqadar mma'loom
Waarsal naa aar-reeaaha lawaaqiha faanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' faasqaynaakumoohu wamaa 'antum lahu bikhaazineen
Wainnaa lanahnu nuhyi wanumeetu wanahnu aul waarithoon
Wal aqad 'al imnaa aal mustaqdimeena minkum wal aqad 'al imnaa aal mustaakhireen
Wainna rabbaka hooa yahshuruhumuaa 'innahu hakeemun 'al eem
Wal aqad khal aqnaa aal iansaana min sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Waal jaanna khal aqnaahu min qablu min nnari ais-samoom
Waiz qaal a rabbuka lil mal aa'ikati 'inni khaal iqu bashara mmin sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Faizaa sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi mir rroohi faqa'u lahu saajideen
Fasajada aal mal aa'ikatu kul luhumuaa 'ajma'oon
'il laa 'ibleesa 'abaa 'any yyakoona ma'a aas-saajideen
Qaal a yaaibleesu maa laka 'al laa takoona ma'a aas-saajideen
Qaal a lama aakul lliasjuda libasharin khal aqtahu min sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Qaal a faakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem
Wainna 'al ayka aal la'nata 'il aa yawmi aid-deen
Qaal a rabbi faanzirniaa 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a fainnaka mina aal munzareen
'il aa yawmi ail waqti ail ma'loom
Qaal a rabbi bimaa 'aghwaytani lauzayyinanna lahum fi ail aardi wal aughweeannahumuaa 'ajma'een
'il laa 'ibaadaka minhumu aul mukhlaseen
Qaal a haazaa siraatun 'al ayya mustaqeem
Ainna 'ibaadi laysa laka 'al ayhim sul taanun ail laa mani aittaba'aka mina aal ghaaween
Wainna jahannama lamaw'iduhumuaa 'ajma'een
Lahaa sab'atu 'abwaab llikul li baab mminhum juz' mmaqsoom
Ainna aal muttaqeena fi jannaat wa'uyoon
Audkhul oohaa bisal aamin aamineen
Wanaza'naa maa fi sudoorihim mmin ghil lin aikhwaanaan 'al aa surur mmutaqaabil een
Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasab wamaa hum mminhaa bimukhrajeen
Nabbi 'ibaadeea 'anneea 'anaa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Waanna 'azaabi hooa aal'azaabu aul aal eem
Wanabbeehum 'an dayfi 'ibraaheem
'iz dakhal u 'al ayhi faqaal u sal aama qaal a 'innaa minkum wajil oon
Qaal u laa tawjal i ainnaa nubashshiruka bighul aamin 'al eem
Qaal a 'abashshartumooni 'al aa 'am mmassaneea aal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
Qaal u bashsharnaaka bial haqqi fal aa takum mmina aal qaaniteen
Qaal a wamany yyaqnatu mir rrahmati rabbihiaa 'il laa aad-daal loon
Qaal a famaa khatbukumuaa 'ayyuhaa aal mursal oon
Qaal ooaa 'innaa 'ursil naa 'il aa qawm mmujrimeen
'il laa 'aal a lootin ainnaa lamunajjoohumuaa 'ajma'een
'il laa aamraatahu qaddarnaa 'innahaa lamina aal ghaabireen
Fal ammaa jaa'a al a lootin ail mursal oon
Qaal a 'innakum qawm mmunkaroon
Qaal u bal jeenaaka bimaa kaanu feehi yamtaroon
Waataynaaka bial haqqi wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Faasri biahlika biqit' mmina aal yli waattabi'a aadbaarahum wal aa yal tafit minkumuaa 'ahad waamdu haythu toomaroon
Waqadaynaa 'il ayhi zaal ika aal aamra 'anna daabira haa'ul aa'i maqtoo' mmusbiheen
Wajaa'a ahlu aul madeenati yastabshiroon
Qaal a 'inna haa'ul aa'i dayfi fal aa tafdahoon
Waattaqu aul laaha wal aa tukhzoon
Qaal ooaa 'awal am nanhaka 'ani ail'aal ameen
Qaal a haa'ul aa'i banaateea 'in kuntum faa'il een
La'amruka 'innahum lafi sakratihim ya'mahoon
Faakhazathumu aus-sayhatu mushriqeen
Faja'al naa 'aal eeahaa saafil ahaa waamtarnaa 'al ayhim hijaarat mmin sijjeel
Ainna fi zaal ika layaat llil mutawassimeen
Wainnahaa labisabeel mmuqeem
Ainna fi zaal ika layat llil moomineen
Wain kaana 'ashaabu aul aykati lazaal imeen
Faantaqamnaa minhum wainnahumaa labiimaam mmubeen
Wal aqad kazzaba 'ashaabu aul hijri ail mursal een
Wa'aataynaahumuaa 'ayaatinaa fakaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Wakaanu yanhitoona mina aal jibaal i buyootaan aamineen
Faakhazathumu aus-sayhatu musbiheen
Famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wamaa khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi wainna aas-saa'ata laateeat faasfahi ais-safha aal jameel
'inna rabbaka hooa aal khal laaqu aul'al eem
Wal aqada aataynaaka sab'a mmina aal mathaani waal qur'aana aal'azeem
Laa tamuddanna 'aynayka 'il aa maa matta'naa bihiaa 'azwaaja mminhum wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim waakhfid janaahaka lil moomineen
Waqul i ainneea 'anaa aan-nazeeru aul mubeen
Kamaa 'anzal naa 'al aa aal muqtasimeen
Aal zeena ja'al u aul qur'aana 'ideen
Fawarabbika lanasal annahumuaa 'ajma'een
'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faasda' bimaa toomaru waa'rid 'ani ail mushrikeen
'innaa kafaynaaka aal mustahzi'een
Aal zeena yaj'al oona ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wal aqad na'lamu 'annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakum mmina aas-saajideen
Waa'bud rabbaka hattaa yaateeaka aal yaqeen
'ataa 'amru aul laahi fal aa tasta'jil oohu subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Yunazzil u aul mal aa'ikata biar-roohi mina aamrihi 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihiaa 'ana aanzirooaa 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa 'anaa faattaqoon
Khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda bial haqqi ta'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Khal aqa aal iansaana min nnutfat faizaa hooa khaseem mmubeen
Waal aan'aama khal aqahaa lakum feehaa dif' wamanaafi'u waminhaa taakul oon
Wal akum feehaa jamaal un heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
Watahmil u 'athqaal akumuaa 'il aa bal ad llam takoonu baal igheehi 'il laa bishiqqi ail aanfusi 'inna rabbakum lara'oof rraheem
Waal khayla waal bighaal a waal hameera litarkaboohaa wazeenat wayakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa'al aa aal laahi qasdu aus-sabeeli waminhaa jaa'ir wal aw shaa'a lahadyaakumuaa 'ajma'een
Hooa aal ziaa 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' llakum mminhu sharaab waminhu shajar feehi tuseemoon
Yunbitu lakum bihi aiz-zar'a waaz-zaytoona waan-nakheela waal aa'naaba wamin kul li aith-thamaraati 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wasakhkhara lakumu aul yla waan-nahaara waash-shamsa waal qamara waan-nujooma musakhkharaati biamrihiaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wamaa zaraa lakum fi ail aardi mukhtal ifaan aal waanuhuaa 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yazzakkaroon
Wahooa aal zi sakhkhara aal bahra litaakul u minhu lahma tariyya watastakhriju minhu hil yat tal basoonahaa wataraa aal ful ka mawaakhira feehi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Waal qaa fi ail aardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bikum waanhaara wasubul a lla'al lakum tahtadoon
Wa'al aamaat wabian-najmi hum yahtadoon
'afamany yyakhluqu kamal llaa yakhluqu 'afal aa tazzakkaroon
Wain ta'uddu ni'mata aal laahi laa tuhsoohaa 'inna aal laaha laghafoor rraheem
Waal laahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoon
Waal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi laa yakhluqoona shaya wahum yukhlaqoon
'amwaatun ghayru 'ahyaa' wamaa yash'uroona 'ayyaana yub'athoon
'il aahukumuaa 'il aah waahid faal zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati qul oobuhum mmunkirat wahum mmustakbiroon
Laa jarama 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul mustakbireen
Waizaa qeela lahum mmaazaa 'anzal a rabbukum qaal ooaa 'asaateeru aul aawwal een
Leeahmil ooaa 'awzaarahum kaamil at yawma aal qeeaamati wamina aawzari ail zeena yudil loonahum bighayri 'il min aal aa saa'a maa yaziroon
Qad makara aal zeena min qablihim faataa aal laahu bunyaanahum mmina aal qawaa'idi fakharra 'al ayhimu aus-saqfu min fawqihim waatyaahumu aul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Thumma yawma aal qeeaamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eea aal zeena kuntum tushaaqqooni feehim qaal a aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma 'inna aal khizya aal yawma waas-sooaa'a 'al aa aal kaafireen
Aal zeena tatawaffyaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu zaal imiaa 'anfusihim faal qawua aus-sal ama maa kunnaa na'mal u min sooaa'i bal aa 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Faadkhul ooaa 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fal abeesa mathwaa aal mutakabbireen
Waqeela lil zeena aattaqawa maazaa 'anzal a rabbukum qaal u khayra llil zeena 'ahsanu fi haazihi aid-dunya hasanat wal adaaru aul aakhirati khayr wal ani'ma daaru aul muttaqeen
Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona kazaal ika yajzi ail laahu aul muttaqeen
Aal zeena tatawaffyaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona sal aamun 'al aykumu audkhul u aul jannata bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'an taateeahumu aul mal aa'ikatu 'aw yaateea 'amru rabbika kazaal ika fa'al a aal zeena min qablihim wamaa zal amahumu aul laahu wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Faasaabahum sayyiaatu maa 'amil u wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon

Waqaal a aal zeena 'ashraku law shaa'a aal laahu maa 'abadnaa min doonihi min sha' nnahnu wal aa 'aabaa'unaa wal aa harramnaa min doonihi min sha' kazaal ika fa'al a aal zeena min qablihim fahal 'al aa aar-rusul i 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen

Wal aqad ba'athnaa fi kul li 'ummat rrasoolaan aanu au'budu aul laaha waajtanibu aut-taaghoota faminhum mman hadaa aal laahu waminhum mman haqqat 'al ayhi aid-dal aal atu faseeru fi ail aardi faanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen
'in tahris 'al aa hudyaahum fainna aal laaha laa yuhdaa many yyudil lu wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim laa yab'athu aul laahu many yyamootu bal aa wa'daan 'al ayhi haqqa wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Leeubayyina lahumu aul zi yakhtal ifoona feehi wal eea'lama aal zeena kafarooaa 'annahum kaanu kaazibeen
'innamaa qawlunaa lisha'in aizaa 'aradnaahu 'an nnaqoola lahu kun fayakoon
Waal zeena haajaru fi ail laahi mim ba'di maa zul imu lanubawweeannahum fi aid-dunya hasanat wal aajru aul aakhirati 'akbaru law kaanu ya'lamoon
Aal zeena sabaru wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika 'il laa rijaal a yoohaa 'il ayhim fasal ooaa 'ahla aaz-zikri 'in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Bial bayyinaati waaz-zuburi waanzal naa 'il ayka aaz-zikra litubayyina lin-naasi maa nuzzil a 'il ayhim wal a'al laahum yatafakkaroon
'afaamina aal zeena makaru aus-sayyiaati 'any yyakhsifa aal laahu bihimu aul aarda 'aw yaateeahumu aul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
'aw yaakhuzahum fi taqal lubihim famaa hum bimu'jizeen
'aw yaakhuzahum 'al aa takhawwuf fainna rabbakum lara'oof rraheem
Aawal am yarawia ail aa maa khal aqa aal laahu min sha' yatafayya'ua zil aal uhu 'ani ail yameeni waash-shamaa'il i sujjada llil hi wahum daakhiroon
Wal il hi yasjudu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi min daabbat waal mal aa'ikatu wahum laa yastakbiroon
Yakhaafoona rabbahum mmin fawqihim wayaf'al oona maa yoomaroon
Waqaal a aal laahu laa tattakhizooaa 'il aahayni aithnayni 'innamaa hooa 'il aah waahid faiyyaya faarhaboon
Wal ahu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wal ahu aud-deenu waasibaan aafaghayra aal laahi tattaqoon
Wamaa bikum mmin nni'mat famina aal laahi thumma 'izaa massakumu aud-durru fail ayhi tajaroon
Thumma 'izaa kashafa aad-durra 'ankumuaa 'izaa fareeq mminkum birabbihim yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum fatamatta'u fasawfa ta'lamoon
Wayaj'al oona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseeba mmimmaa razaqnaahum taal laahi latusal unna 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon
Wayaj'al oona lil hi ail banaati subhaanahu wal ahum mmaa yashtahoon
Waizaa bushshira 'ahaduhum bial uanthaa zal la wajhuhu muswadda wahooa kazeem
Yatawaaraa mina aal qawmi min sooaa'i maa bushshira bihiaa 'ayumsikuhu 'al aa hoonin aam yadussuhu fi ait-turaabi 'al aa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Lil zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati mathal u aus-saw'i wal il hi ail mathal u aul aa'laa wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Wal aw yooaakhizu aul laahu aun-naasa bizul mihim mmaa taraka 'al ayhaa min daabbat wal aakiny yyooakhkhiruhumuaa 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faizaa jaa'a ajal uhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Wayaj'al oona lil hi maa yakrahoona watasifu 'al sinatuhumu aul kaziba 'anna lahumu aul husnaa laa jarama 'anna lahumu aun-naara waannahum mmufritoon
Taal laahi laqada aarsal naa 'il aa 'umam mmin qablika fazayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum fahooa wal eeyuhumu aul yawma wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem
Wamaa 'anzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba 'il laa litubayyina lahumu aul zi aikhtal afu feehi wahuda warahmat lliqawm yoominoon
Waal laahu 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faahya bihi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yasma'oon
Wainna lakum fi ail aan'aami la'ibrat nnasqeekum mmimmaa fi butoonihi mim bayni farth wadam llabanaan khaal isa saa'igha llish-shaaribeen
Wamin thamaraati ain-nakheeli waal aa'naabi tattakhizoona minhu sakara warizqaan hasanaan ainna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Waawhaa rabbuka 'il aa aan-nahli 'ani aittakhizi mina aal jibaal i buyoota wamina aash-shajari wamimmaa ya'rishoon

Thumma kul i min kul li aith-thamaraati faasluki subul a rabbiki zul ul a yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaab mmukhtal ifun aal waanuhu feehi shifaa' llin-naasi 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Waal laahu khal aqakum thumma yatawaffyaakum waminkum mmany yyuraddu 'il aa 'arzal i ail'umuri lika laa ya'lama ba'da 'il m shayaan ainna aal laaha 'al eem qadeer
Waal laahu faddal a ba'dakum 'al aa ba'd fi air-rizqi famaa aal zeena fuddil u biraaddi rizqihim 'al aa maa mal akata aymaanuhum fahum feehi sawaa'un aafabini'mati ail laahi yajhadoon

Waal laahu ja'al a lakum mmina aanfusikumuaa 'azwaaja waja'al a lakum mmina aazwaajikum baneena wahafadat warazaqakum mmina aat-tayyibaati 'afabial baatil i yoominoona wabini'mati ail laahi hum yakfuroon
Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqa mmina aas-samaawaati waal aardi shaya wal aa yastatee'oon
Fal aa tadribu lil hi ail aamthaal a 'inna aal laaha ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Daraba aal laahu mathal aan 'abda mmamlooka llaa yaqdiru 'al aa sha' wamar rrazaqnaahu minnaa rizqaan hasana fahooa yunfiqu minhu sirra wajahraan hal yastawuna aal hamdu lil hi bal a aaktharuhum laa ya'lamoon

Wadaraba aal laahu mathal a rrajul ayni 'ahaduhumaa 'abkamu laa yaqdiru 'al aa sha' wahooa kal lun 'al aa mawlyaahu 'aynamaa yooajjihhhu laa yaati bikhayrin hal yastawi hooa wamany yyaamuru bial'adli wahooa 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal il hi ghaybu aus-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa 'amru aus-saa'ati 'il laa kal amhi ail basari 'aw hooa 'aqrabu 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Waal laahu 'akhrajakum mmim butooni 'ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shaya waja'al a lakumu aus-sam'a waal aabsaara waal aafidata la'al lakum tashkuroon
'al am yarawia ail aa aat-tayri musakhkharaat fi jawwi ais-samaa'i maa yumsikuhunna 'il laa aal laahu 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yoominoon

Waal laahu ja'al a lakum mmim buyootikum sakana waja'al a lakum mmin jul oodi ail aan'aami buyoota tastakhiffoonahaa yawma za'anikum wayawma 'iqaamatikum wamina aaswaafihaa waawbarihaa waash'arihaa 'athaatha wamataa'aan ail aa heen

Waal laahu ja'al a lakum mmimmaa khal aqa zil aal a waja'al a lakum mmina aal jibaal i 'aknaana waja'al a lakum saraabeela taqeekumu aul harra wasaraabeela taqeekum basakum kazaal ika yutimmu ni'matahu 'al aykum la'al lakum tuslimoon
Fain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al ayka aal bal aaghu aul mubeen
Ya'rifoona ni'mata aal laahi thumma yunkiroonahaa waaktharuhumu aul kaafiroon
Wayawma nab'athu min kul li 'ummat shaheeda thumma laa yoozanu lil zeena kafaru wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Waizaa ra'aa aal zeena zal amu aul'azaaba fal aa yukhaffafu 'anhum wal aa hum yunzaroon
Waizaa ra'aa aal zeena 'ashraku shurakaa'ahum qaal u rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i shurakaa'unaa aal zeena kunnaa nad'u min doonika faal qawia ail ayhimu aul qawla 'innakum lakaaziboon
Waal qawia ail aa aal laahi yawma'izin ais-sal ama wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi zidnaahum 'azaaba fawqa aal'azaabi bimaa kaanu yufsidoon

Wayawma nab'athu fi kul li 'ummat shaheedaan 'al ayhim mmina aanfusihim wajeenaa bika shaheedaan 'al aa haa'ul aa'i wanazzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba tibyaana llikul li sha' wahuda warahmat wabushraa lil muslimeen
'inna aal laaha yaamuru bial'adli waal iahsaani waeetaa'i zi ail qurbaa wayanhaa 'ani ail fahshaa'i waal munkari waal baghyi ya'izukum la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Waawfu bi'ahdi ail laahi 'izaa 'aahadttum wal aa tanqudu aul aymaana ba'da tawkeedihaa waqad ja'al tumu aul laaha 'al aykum kafeelaan ainna aal laaha ya'lamu maa taf'al oon

Wal aa takoonu kaal ti naqadat ghazlahaa mim ba'di qoowatin aankaatha tattakhizoona 'aymaanakum dakhal aa baynakumuaa 'an takoona 'ummatun heea 'arbaa minu ammatin ainnamaa yablookumu aul laahu bihi wal ayubayyinanna lakum yawma aal qeeaamati maa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laja'al akumuaa 'ummat waahidat wal aakiny yyudil lu many yyashaa'u wayahdi many yyashaa'u wal atusal unna 'ammaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wal aa tattakhizooaa 'aymaanakum dakhal aa baynakum fatazil la qadamu ba'da thubootihaa watazooqu aus-sooaa'a bimaa sadadttum 'an sabeeli ail laahi wal akum 'azaabun 'azeem
Wal aa tashtaru bi'ahdi ail laahi thamana qal eelaan ainnamaa 'inda aal laahi hooa khayr llakumuaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Maa 'indakum yanfadu wamaa 'inda aal laahi baaq wal ayajzeeanna aal zeena sabarooaa 'ajrahum biahsani maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Man 'amil a saal iha mmin zakarin aawu anthaa wahooa moomin fal anuhyeeannahu hayawaat tayyibat wal anajzeeannahumuaa 'ajrahum biahsani maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faizaa qarata aal qur'aana faasta'iz bial laahi mina aash-shaytaani air-rajeem
'innahu laysa lahu sul taanun 'al aa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
'innamaa sul taanuhu 'al aa aal zeena yatawal lawnahu waal zeena hum bihi mushrikoon
Waizaa baddal naa 'ayat mmakaana 'ayat waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa yunazzil u qaal ooaa 'innamaa 'anta muftari bal a aaktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Qul nazzal ahu roohu aul qudusi mir rrabbika bial haqqi leeuthabbita aal zeena 'aamanu wahuda wabushraa lil muslimeen
Wal aqad na'lamu 'annahum yaqooloona 'innamaa yu'al limuhu bashar llisaanu aul zi yul hidoona 'il ayhi 'a'jameey wahaazaa lisaanun 'arabeey mmubeen
Ainna aal zeena laa yoominoona biayaati ail laahi laa yahdeehimu aul laahu wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem
Ainnamaa yaftari ail kaziba aal zeena laa yoominoona biayaati ail laahi waul aa'ika humu aul kaaziboon

Man kafara bial laahi mim ba'di 'eemaanihiaa 'il laa manu akriha waqal buhu mutma'innu bial iaymaani wal aakim mman sharaha bial kufri sadra fa'al ayhim ghadab mmina aal laahi wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Zaal ika biannahumu austahabbu aul hayawaata aad-dunya 'al aa aal aakhirati waanna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen
'ul aa'ika aal zeena taba'a aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim wasam'ihim waabsaarihim waul aa'ika humu aul ghaafil oon
Laa jarama 'annahum fi ail aakhirati humu aul khaasiroon
Thumma 'inna rabbaka lil zeena haajaru mim ba'di maa futinu thumma jaahadu wasabarooaa 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Yawma taati kul lu nafs tujaadil u 'an nnafsihaa watooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at wahum laa yuzlamoon

Wadaraba aal laahu mathal a qaryat kaanata aaminat mmutma'innat yaateehaa rizquhaa raghada mmin kul li makaan fakafarat bian'umi ail laahi faazaaqahaa aal laahu libaasa aal joo'i waal khawfi bimaa kaanu yasna'oon
Wal aqad jaa'ahum rasool mminhum fakazzaboohu faakhazahumu aul'azaabu wahum zaal imoon
Fakul u mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu hal aal a tayyiba waashkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'in kuntumuaa 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
'innamaa harrama 'al aykumu aul maytata waad-dama wal ahma aal khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la lighayri ail laahi bihi famanu audturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wal aa taqoolu limaa tasifu 'al sinatukumu aul kaziba haazaa hal aal wahaazaa haraam llitaftaru 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba 'inna aal zeena yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba laa yuflihoon
Mataa' qal eel wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem
Wa'al aa aal zeena haadu harramnaa maa qasasnaa 'al ayka min qablu wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma 'inna rabbaka lil zeena 'amil u aus-sooaa'a bijahaal at thumma taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahooaa 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Ainna 'ibraaheema kaana 'ummat qaanita llil hi haneefa wal am yaku mina aal mushrikeen
Shaakira llian'umihi aijtabyaahu wahadyaahu 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wa'aataynaahu fi aid-dunya hasanat wainnahu fi ail aakhirati lamina aas-saal iheen
Thumma 'awhaynaa 'il ayka 'ani aittabi' mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen
'innamaa ju'il a aas-sabtu 'al aa aal zeena aakhtal afu feehi wainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Aad'u 'il aa sabeeli rabbika bial hikmati waal maw'izati ail hasanati wajaadil hum bial ti heea 'ahsanu 'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu biman dal la 'an sabeelihi wahooa 'a'lamu bial muhtadeen
Wain 'aaqabtum fa'aaqibu bimithli maa 'ooqibtum bihi wal a'in sabartum lahooa khayr llis-saabireen
Waasbir wamaa sabruka 'il laa bial laahi wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim wal aa taku fi dayq mmimmaa yamkuroon
'inna aal laaha ma'a aal zeena aattaqa wwaal zeena hum mmuhsinoon
Subhaana aal ziaa 'asraa bi'abdihi layla mmina aal masjidi ail haraami 'il aa aal masjidi ail aaqsaa aal zi baaraknaa hawlahu linureeahu mina ayaatinaa 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul baseer
Wa'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba waja'al naahu huda llibaniaa 'israa'eela 'al laa tattakhizu min dooni wakeel
Zurriyyata man hamal naa ma'a noohin ainnahu kaana 'abda shakoor
Waqadaynaa 'il aa baniaa 'israa'eela fi ail kitaabi latufsidunna fi ail aardi marratayni wal ata'lunna 'ul oowa kabeer
Faizaa jaa'a wa'du 'oolyaahumaa ba'athnaa 'al aykum 'ibaada llanaa 'ooli bas shadeed fajaasu khil aal a aad-deeari wakaana wa'da mmaf'ool
Thumma radadnaa lakumu aul karrata 'al ayhim waamdadnaakum biamwaal wabaneena waja'al naakumuaa 'akthara nafeera

Aina aahsantumuaa 'ahsantum lianfusikum waina aasatum fal ahaa faizaa jaa'a wa'du aul aakhirati leeasuu wujoohakum wal eeadkhul u aul masjida kamaa dakhal oohu 'awwal a marrat wal eeutabbiru maa 'al awa tatbeera
'asaa rabbukumuaa 'any yyarhamakum wain 'udttum 'udnaa waja'al naa jahannama lil kaafireena haseera
Ainna haazaa aal qur'aana yahdi lil ti heea 'aqwamu wayubashshiru aul moomineena aal zeena ya'mal oona aas-saal ihaati 'anna lahumuaa 'ajra kabeer
Waanna aal zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati 'a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabaan aal eem
Wayad'u aul iansaanu biash-sharri du'aa'ahu bial khayri wakaana aal iansaanu 'ajool

Waja'al naa aal yla waan-nahaara 'ayatayni famahawnaa 'ayata aal yli waja'al naa 'ayata aan-nahari mubsirat llitabtaghu fadla mmir rrabbikum wal ita'lamu 'adada aas-sineena waal hisaaba wakul la sha' fassal naahu tafseel
Wakul la 'insaanin aal zamnaahu taa'irahu fi 'unuqihi wanukhriju lahu yawma aal qeeaamati kitaaba yal qyaahu manshoora
Aiqra kitaabaka kafaa binafsika aal yawma 'al ayka haseeb
Mmani aihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadi linafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa wamaa kunnaa mu'azzibeena hattaa nab'atha rasool
Waizaa 'aradnaa 'an nnuhlika qaryatan aamarnaa mutrafeehaa fafasaqu feehaa fahaqqa 'al ayhaa aal qawlu fadammarnaahaa tadmeer
Wakama aahlaknaa mina aal qurooni mim ba'di nooh wakafaa birabbika bizunoobi 'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer
Mman kaana yureedu aul'aajil ata 'ajjal naa lahu feehaa maa nashaa'u liman nnureedu thumma ja'al naa lahu jahannama yaslayaahaa mazmooma mmadhoor
Wamana aaraada aal aakhirata wasa'aa lahaa sa'yahaa wahooa moomin faul aa'ika kaana sa'yuhum mmashkoor
Kul la nnumiddu haa'ul aa'i wahaa'ul aa'i min 'ataa'i rabbika wamaa kaana 'ataa'u rabbika mahzoora
Aunzur kayfa faddal naa ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd wal al aakhiratu 'akbaru darajaat waakbaru tafdeel
Llaa taj'al ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara fataq'uda mazmooma mmakhzool

Waqadaa rabbuka 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laa 'iyyaahu wabial waal idayni 'ihsaanaan aimmaa yablughanna 'indaka aal kibara 'ahaduhumaa 'aw kil aahumaa fal aa taqul-laahumaa 'uff wal aa tanharhumaa waqul-laahumaa qawla kareem
Waakhfid lahumaa janaaha aaz-zul li mina aar-rahmati waqur-rabbi airhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaani sagheer
Rrabbukumuaa 'a'lamu bimaa fi nufoosikumuaa 'in takoonu saal iheena fainnahu kaana lil aawwaabeena ghafoor
Wa'aati zaa aal qurbaa haqqahu waal miskeena waabna aas-sabeeli wal aa tubazzir tabzeera
Ainna aal mubazzireena kaanooaa 'ikhwaana aash-shayaateeni wakaana aash-shaytaanu lirabbihi kafoor
Waimmaa tu'ridanna 'anhumu aubtighaa'a rahmat mmir rrabbika tarjoohaa faqul-laahum qawla mmaysoor
Wal aa taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ail aa 'unuqika wal aa tabsuthaa kul la aal basti fataq'uda mal ooma mmahsoora
Ainna rabbaka yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'innahu kaana bi'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer
Wal aa taqtul ooaa 'awlaadakum khashyata 'imlaaq nnahnu narzuquhum waiyyaakumuaa 'inna qatlahum kaana khita kabeer
Wal aa taqrabu auz-zinaa 'innahu kaana faahishat wasaa'a sabeel
Wal aa taqtul u aun-nafsa aal ti harrama aal laahu 'il laa bial haqqi waman qutil a mazlooma faqad ja'al naa liwal eeyihi sul taana fal aa yusrif ffi ail qatli 'innahu kaana mansoor
Wal aa taqrabu maal a aal yateemi 'il laa bial ti heea 'ahsanu hattaa yablugha 'ashuddahu waawfu bial'ahdi 'inna aal'ahda kaana masool
Waawfu aul kayla 'izaa kil tum wazinu bial qustaasi ail mustaqeemi zaal ika khayr waahsanu taaweel
Wal aa taqfu maa laysa laka bihi 'il mun ainna aas-sam'a waal basara waal fu'aada kul lu 'ul aa'ika kaana 'anhu masool
Wal aa tamshi fi ail aardi marahaan ainnaka lan takhriqa aal aarda wal an tablugha aal jibaal a tool
Kul lu zaal ika kaana sayyeeatan 'inda rabbika makrooh
Zaal ika mimmaa 'awhaa 'il ayka rabbuka mina aal hikmati wal aa taj'al ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara fatul qaa fi jahannama mal ooma mmadhoora
Aafaasfyaakum rabbukum bial baneena waattakhaza mina aal mal aa'ikati 'inaathaan ainnakum lataqooloona qawlaan 'azeem
Wal aqad sarrafnaa fi haazaa aal qur'aani leeazzakkaru wamaa yazeeduhumuaa 'il laa nufoor
Qul-law kaana ma'ahuaa 'aal ihat kamaa taqooloona 'iza llaabtaghawia ail aa zi ail'arshi sabeel
Subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yaqooloona 'ul oowa kabeer
Yusabbihu lahu aus-samaawaatu aus-sab'u waal aardu waman feehinna waim mmin sha'in ail laa yusabbihu bihamdihi wal aakil llaa tafqahoona tasbeehahumuaa 'innahu kaana hal eemaan ghafoor
Waizaa qarata aal qur'aana ja'al naa baynaka wabayna aal zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati hijaaba mmastoor
Waja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihimuaa 'akinnatan aany yyafqahoohu wafiaa 'aazaanihim waqra waizaa zakarta rabbaka fi ail qur'aani wahdahu wal lawa 'al aa 'adbaarihim nufoor
Nnahnu 'a'lamu bimaa yastami'oona bihiaa 'iz yastami'oona 'il ayka waiz hum najwaa 'iz yaqoolu auz-zaal imoona 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa rajul a mmashoora
Aunzur kayfa darabu laka aal aamthaal a fadal lu fal aa yastatee'oona sabeel
Waqaal ooaa 'azaa kunnaa 'izaama warufaataan ainnaa lamab'oothoona khal qa jadeed
Qul koonu hijaaratan aaw hadeeda

Aaw khal qa mmimmaa yakburu fi sudoorikum fasayaqooloona many yyu'eedunaa qul i ail zi fatarakumuaa 'awwal a marrat fasayunghidoona 'il ayka ru'oosahum wayaqooloona mataa hooa qul 'asaa 'any yyakoona qareeb
Yawma yad'ookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi watazunnoona 'il llabithtumuaa 'il laa qal eel
Waqul-li'ibaadi yaqoolu aul ti heea 'ahsanu 'inna aash-shaytaana yanzaghu baynahumuaa 'inna aash-shaytaana kaana lil iansaani 'adoowa mmubeen
Rrabbukumuaa 'a'lamu bikumuaa 'iny yyasha yarhamkumuaa 'awi ainy yyasha yu'azzibkum wamaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim wakeel
Warabbuka 'a'lamu biman fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wal aqad faddal naa ba'da aan-nabeeaaina 'al aa ba'd wa'aataynaa daawuda zaboor
Qul u aud'u aul zeena za'amtum mmin doonihi fal aa yamlikoona kashfa aad-durri 'ankum wal aa tahweela
Awlaa'ika aal zeena yad'oona yabtaghoona 'il aa rabbihimu aul waseelata 'ayyuhumuaa 'aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahu wayakhaafoona 'azaabahuaa 'inna 'azaaba rabbika kaana mahzoor
Waim mmin qaryatin ail laa nahnu muhlikoohaa qabla yawmi ail qeeaamati 'aw mu'azziboohaa 'azaaba shadeeda kaana zaal ika fi ail kitaabi mastoor
Wamaa mana'anaa 'an nnursil a bial ayaati 'il laa 'an kazzaba bihaa aal aawwal oona wa'aataynaa thamooda aan-naaqata mubsirat fazal amu bihaa wamaa nursil u bial ayaati 'il laa takhweef

Waiz qul naa laka 'inna rabbaka 'ahaata bian-naasi wamaa ja'al naa aar-ru'yaa aal tiaa 'araynaaka 'il laa fitnat llin-naasi waash-shajarata aal mal'oonata fi ail qur'aani wanukhawwifuhum famaa yazeeduhumuaa 'il laa tughyaana kabeer
Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa qaal a 'aasjudu liman khal aqta teen
Qaal a 'araytaka haazaa aal zi karramta 'al ayya la'ina aakhkhartaniaa 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laahtanikanna zurriyyatahuaa 'il laa qal eel
Qaal a aazhab faman tabi'aka minhum fainna jahannama jazaa'ukum jazaa' mmawfoor
Waastafziz mani aistata'ta minhum bisawtika waajlib 'al ayhim bikhaylika warajlika washaarikhum fi ail aamwaal i waal aawlaadi wa'idhum wamaa ya'iduhumu aush-shaytaanu 'il laa ghuroora
Ainna 'ibaadi laysa laka 'al ayhim sul taanw wakafaa birabbika wakeel
Rrabbukumu aul zi yuzji lakumu aul ful ka fi ail bahri litabtaghu min fadlihiaa 'innahu kaana bikum raheem
Waizaa massakumu aud-durru fi ail bahri dal la man tad'oona 'il laa 'iyyaahu fal ammaa najjyaakumuaa 'il aa aal barri 'a'radtum wakaana aal iansaanu kafoora
Aafaamintumuaa 'any yyakhsifa bikum jaaniba aal barri 'aw yursil a 'al aykum haasiba thumma laa tajidu lakum wakeela
Aama aamintumuaa 'any yyu'eedakum feehi taaratan akhraa fayursil a 'al aykum qaasifa mmina aar-reehi fayughriqakum bimaa kafartum thumma laa tajidu lakum 'al aynaa bihi tabee'
Wal aqad karramnaa baniaa 'aadama wahamal naahum fi ail barri waal bahri warazaqnaahum mmina aat-tayyibaati wafaddal naahum 'al aa katheer mmimman khal aqnaa tafdeel
Yawma nad'u kul la 'unaasi biimaamihim famanu awteea kitaabahu beeameenihi faul aa'ika yaqra'oona kitaabahum wal aa yuzlamoona fateel
Waman kaana fi haazihiaa 'a'maa fahooa fi ail aakhirati 'a'maa waadal lu sabeel
Wain kaadu layaftinoonaka 'ani ail ziaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka litaftareea 'al aynaa ghayrahu waiza llaattakhazooka khal eel
Wal awlaa 'an thabbatnaaka laqad kidtta tarkanu 'il ayhim shaya qal eela
Aiza llaazaqnaaka di'fa aal hayawaati wadi'fa aal mamaati thumma laa tajidu laka 'al aynaa naseer
Wain kaadu layastafizzoonaka mina aal aardi leeukhrijooka minhaa waiza llaa yal bathoona khal faka 'il laa qal eel
Sunnata man qada aarsal naa qablaka mir rrusul inaa wal aa tajidu lisunnatinaa tahweela
Aaqimi ais-sal awaata lidul ooki aish-shamsi 'il aa ghasaqi ail yli waqur'aana aal fajri 'inna qur'aana aal fajri kaana mashhood
Wamina aal yli fatahajjad bihi naafil at llaka 'asaa 'any yyab'athaka rabbuka maqaama mmahmood
Waqur-rabbi 'adkhil ni mudkhal a sidq waakhrijni mukhraja sidq waaj'al-li mil lladunka sul taana nnaseer
Waqul jaa'a aal haqqu wazahaqa aal baatil u 'inna aal baatil a kaana zahooq
Wanunazzil u mina aal qur'aani maa hooa shifaa' warahmat llil moomineena wal aa yazeedu auz-zaal imeena 'il laa khasaar
Waizaa 'an'amnaa 'al aa aal iansaani 'a'rada wanaa bijaanibihi waizaa massahu aush-sharru kaana yaoos
Qul kul l ya'mal u 'al aa shaakil atihi farabbukumuaa 'a'lamu biman hooa 'ahdaa sabeel
Wayasal oonaka 'ani air-roohi qul i air-roohu mina aamri rabbi wamaa 'ooteetum mmina aal'il mi 'il laa qal eel
Wal a'in sheenaa lanazhabanna bial ziaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihi 'al aynaa wakeela
Ail laa rahmat mmir rrabbika 'inna fadlahu kaana 'al ayka kabeer
Qul-la'ini aijtama'ati ail iansu waal jinnu 'al aa 'any yyaatu bimithli haazaa aal qur'aani laa yaatoona bimithlihi wal aw kaana ba'duhum liba'd zaheer
Wal aqad sarrafnaa lin-naasi fi haazaa aal qur'aani min kul li mathal faabaa 'aktharu aun-naasi 'il laa kufoor
Waqaal u lan nnoomina laka hattaa tufajjira lanaa mina aal aardi yanboo'a
Aaw takoona laka jannat mmin nnakheel wa'inab fatufajjira aal aanhaara khil aal ahaa tafjeera
Aaw tusqita aas-samaa'a kamaa za'amta 'al aynaa kisafaan aaw taateea bial laahi waal mal aa'ikati qabeela
Aaw yakoona laka bayt mmin zukhrufin aaw tarqaa fi ais-samaa'i wal an nnoomina liruqeeyika hattaa tunazzil a 'al aynaa kitaaba nnaqra'uhu qul subhaana rabbi hal kuntu 'il laa bashara rrasool
Wamaa mana'a aan-naasa 'any yyoominooaa 'iz jaa'ahumu aul hudaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'aba'atha aal laahu bashara rrasool
Qul-law kaana fi ail aardi mal aa'ikat yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzal naa 'al ayhim mmina aas-samaa'i mal aka rrasool
Qul kafaa bial laahi shaheedaa bayni wabaynakumuaa 'innahu kaana bi'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer

Wamany yyahdi ail laahu fahooa aal muhtadi wamany yyudlil fal an tajida lahumuaa 'awleeaa'a min doonihi wanahshuruhum yawma aal qeeaamati 'al aa wujoohihim 'umya wabukma wasumma mmawyaahum jahannamu kul lamaa khabat zidnaahum sa'eer
Zaal ika jazaa'uhum biannahum kafaru biayaatinaa waqaal ooaa 'azaa kunnaa 'izaama warufaataan ainnaa lamab'oothoona khal qa jadeeda
Aawal am yarawaa aanna aal laaha aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda qaadirun 'al aa 'any yyakhluqa mithlahum waja'al a lahumuaa 'ajal a llaa rayba feehi faabaa aaz-zaal imoona 'il laa kufoor
Qul-lawa aantum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbeea 'iza llaamsaktum khashyata aal ianfaaqi wakaana aal iansaanu qatoor
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa tis'a 'ayaati bayyinaat fasal baniaa 'israa'eela 'iz jaa'ahum faqaal a lahu fir'awnu 'inni laazunnuka yaamoosaa mashoor
Qaal a laqad 'al imta maa 'anzal a haa'ul aa'i al laa rabbu aus-samaawaati waal aardi basaa'ira wainni laazunnuka yaafir'awnu mathboor
Faaraada 'any yyastafizzahum mmina aal aardi faaghraqnaahu wamam mma'ahu jamee'
Waqul naa mim ba'dihi libaniaa 'israa'eela aaskunu aul aarda faizaa jaa'a wa'du aul aakhirati jeenaa bikum lafeef
Wabial haqqi 'anzal naahu wabial haqqi nazal a wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa mubashshira wanazeer
Waqur'aana faraqnaahu litaqraahu 'al aa aan-naasi 'al aa mukth wanazzal naahu tanzeel

Qul a aaminu bihiaa 'aw laa toominooaa 'inna aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma min qablihiaa 'izaa yutlaa 'al ayhim yakhirroona lil aazqaani sujjada wayaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa 'in kaana wa'du rabbinaa lamaf'ool
Wayakhirroona lil aazqaani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushoo'
Qul u aud'u aul laaha 'awu aud'u aur-rahmaana 'ayya mmaa tad'u fal ahu aul aasmaa'u aul husnaa wal aa tajhar bisal aatika wal aa tukhaafit bihaa waabtaghi bayna zaal ika sabeel
Waqul i ail hamdu lil hi ail zi lam yattakhiz wal ada wal am yakul llaahu shareek fi ail mul ki wal am yakul llaahu wal eey mmina aaz-zul li wakabbirhu takbeera
Ail hamdu lil hi ail ziaa 'anzal a 'al aa 'abdihi ail kitaaba wal am yaj'al-laahu 'iwaj
Qayyima lleeunzira basa shadeeda mmil lladunhu wayubashshira aal moomineena aal zeena ya'mal oona aas-saal ihaati 'anna lahumuaa 'ajraan hasan
Mmaakitheena feehi 'abad
Wayunzira aal zeena qaal u auttakhaza aal laahu wal ad
Mmaa lahum bihi min 'il m wal aa liaabaa'ihim kaburat kal imat takhruju mina aafwaahihimuaa 'iny yyaqooloona 'il laa kazib
Fal a'al laka baakhi' nnafsaka 'al aa 'aathaarihimuaa 'il llam yoominu bihaazaa aal hadeethi 'asafa
Ainnaa ja'al naa maa 'al aa aal aardi zeenat llaahaa linablooahumuaa 'ayyuhumuaa 'ahsanu 'amal
Wainnaa lajaa'il oona maa 'al ayhaa sa'eeda juruza
Aam hasibta 'anna 'ashaaba aal kahfi waar-raqeemi kaanu mina ayaatinaa 'ajaba
Aiza aawaa aal fityatu 'il aa aal kahfi faqaal u rabbanaa 'aatinaa mil lladunka rahmat wahayyi lanaa mina aamrinaa rashad
Fadarabnaa 'al aa 'aazaanihim fi ail kahfi sineena 'adad
Thumma ba'athnaahum lina'lama 'ayyu aul hizbayni 'ahsaa limaa labithooaa 'amad
Nnahnu naqussu 'al ayka nabaahum bial haqqi 'innahum fityatun aamanu birabbihim wazidnaahum hud
Warabatnaa 'al aa qul oobihimuaa 'iz qaamu faqaal u rabbunaa rabbu aus-samaawaati waal aardi lan nnad'ooaa min doonihiaa 'il aaha llaqad qul naa 'iza shatata
Haa'ul aa'i qawmunaa aattakhazu min doonihiaa 'aal ihat llawlaa yaatoona 'al ayhim bisul taani bayyin famana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazib
Waizi ai'tazal tumoohum wamaa ya'budoona 'il laa aal laaha fawuaa 'il aa aal kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum mmir rrahmatihi wayuhayyi lakum mmina aamrikum mmarfiq

Wataraa aash-shamsa 'izaa tal a'at ttazzaawaru 'an kahfihim zaata aal yameeni waizaa gharabat ttaqriduhum zaata aash-shimaal i wahum fi fajwat mminhu zaal ika mina ayaati ail laahi many yyahdi ail laahu fahooa aal muhtadi wamany yyudlil fal an tajida lahu wal iyya mmurshid

Watahsibuhumuaa 'ayqaaza wahum ruqood wanuqal libuhum zaata aal yameeni wazaata aash-shimaal i wakal buhum baasit ziraa'ayhi bial waseedi lawi aittal a'ta 'al ayhim lawal layta minhum firaara wal amul leeta minhum ru'b

Wakazaal ika ba'athnaahum leeatasaa'al u baynahum qaal a qaa'il mminhum kam labithtum qaal u labithnaa yawmaan aaw ba'da yawm qaal u rabbukumuaa 'a'lamu bimaa labithtum faab'athooaa 'ahadakum biwariqikum haazihiaa 'il aa aal madeenati fal yanzura ayyuhaa 'azkaa ta'aama fal yaatikum birizq mminhu wal yatal attaf wal aa yush'iranna bikumuaa 'ahada
Ainnahumuaa 'iny yyazharu 'al aykum yarjumookumuaa 'aw yu'eedookum fi mil latihim wal an tuflihooaa 'izaan aabad

Wakazaal ika 'a'tharnaa 'al ayhim leea'lamooaa 'anna wa'da aal laahi haqq waanna aas-saa'ata laa rayba feehaa 'iz yatanaaza'oona baynahumuaa 'amrahum faqaal u aubnu 'al ayhim bunyaana rrabbuhumuaa 'a'lamu bihim qaal a aal zeena ghal abu 'al aa 'amrihim lanattakhizanna 'al ayhim mmasjid

Sayaqooloona thal aathat rraabi'uhum kal buhum wayaqooloona khamsat saadisuhum kal buhum rajmaa bial ghaybi wayaqooloona sab'at wathaaminuhum kal buhum qur-rabbeea 'a'lamu bi'iddatihim mmaa ya'lamuhumuaa 'il laa qal eel
Fal aa tumaari feehimuaa 'il laa miraa' zaahira wal aa tastafti feehim mminhumuaa 'ahad
Wal aa taqoolanna lishaa'in ainni faa'il zaal ika ghadaan ail laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu waazkur rrabbaka 'izaa naseeta waqul 'asaa 'any yyahdeeani rabbi liaqraba min haazaa rashad
Wal abithu fi kahfihim thal aatha miayat sineena waazdaadu tis'
Qul i ail laahu 'a'lamu bimaa labithu lahu ghaybu aus-samaawaati waal aardi 'absir bihi waasmi' maa lahum mmin doonihi minw wwal eey wal aa yushriku fi hukmihiaa 'ahad
Waatlu maa 'ooheea 'il ayka min kitaabi rabbika laa mubaddil a likal imaatihi wal an tajida min doonihi mul tahad

Waasbir nafsaka ma'a aal zeena yad'oona rabbahum bial ghadawaati waal'asheeyi yureedoona wajhahu wal aa ta'du 'aynaaka 'anhum tureedu zeenata aal hayawaati aid-dunya wal aa tuti' mana aaghfal naa qal bahu 'an zikrinaa waattaba'a hawyaahu wakaana 'amruhu furuh

Waqul i ail haqqu mir rrabbikum faman shaa'a fal yoominw wwaman shaa'a fal yakfuri ainnaa 'a'tadnaa liz-zaal imeena naaraan aahaata bihim suraadiquhaa wainy yyastagheethu yughaathu bimaa' kaal muhli yashwi ail wujooha beesa aash-sharaabu wasaa'at murtafaqa
Ainna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'innaa laa nudee'u 'ajra mana aahsana 'amal a

Awlaa'ika lahum jannaatu 'adn tajri min tahtihimu aul aanhaaru yuhal lawna feehaa mina aasaawira min zahab wayal basoona theeaabaan khudra mmin sundus waistabraq mmuttakieena feehaa 'al aa aal aaraa'iki ni'ma aath-thawaabu wahasunat murtafaq
Waadrib lahum mmathal a rrajul ayni ja'al naa liahadihimaa jannatayni mina aa'naab wahafafnaahumaa binakhl waja'al naa baynahumaa zar'
Kil taa aal jannatayni 'aatatu aklahaa wal am tazlim mminhu shaya wafajjarnaa khil aal ahumaa nahar
Wakaana lahu thumur faqaal a lisaahibihi wahooa yuhaawiruhuaa 'anaa 'aktharu minka maal a waa'azzu nafar
Wadakhal a jannatahu wahooa zaal im llinafsihi qaal a maa 'azunnu 'an tabeeda haazihiaa 'abada wamaa 'azunnu aus-saa'ata qaa'imat wal a'ir rrudidttu 'il aa rabbi laajidanna khayra mminhumaa munqal ab
Qaal a lahu saahibuhu wahooa yuhaawiruhuaa 'akafarta bial zi khal aqaka min turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma sawwyaaka rajul
Llaakinnaa hooa aal laahu rabbi wal aa 'ushriku birabbeea 'ahad
Wal awlaa 'iz dakhal ta jannataka qul ta maa shaa'a aal laahu laa qoowata 'il laa bial laahi 'in tarani 'anaa 'aqal la minka maal a wawal ad
Fa'asaa rabbeea 'any yyooteeani khayra mmin jannatika wayursil a 'al ayhaa husbaana mmina aas-samaa'i fatusbiha sa'eeda zal aqa
Aaw yusbiha maa'uhaa ghawra fal an tastatee'a lahu tal ab
Wauheeta bithumurihi faasbaha yuqal libu kaffayhi 'al aa maa 'anfaqa feehaa waheea khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa wayaqoolu yaal aytani lamu ashrik birabbeea 'ahad
Wal am takul llaahu feeat yansuroonahu min dooni ail laahi wamaa kaana muntasira
Hunaal ika aal wal ayatu lil hi ail haqqi hooa khayr thawaaba wakhayrun 'uqub

Waadrib lahum mmathal a aal hayawaati aid-dunya kamaa'in aanzal naahu mina aas-samaa'i faakhtal ata bihi nabaatu aul aardi faasbaha hasheema tazroohu aur-reeaahu wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' mmuqtadira
Ail maal u waal banoona zeenatu aul hayawaati aid-dunya waal baaqeeaatu aus-saal ihaatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaaba wakhayrun aamal
Wayawma nusayyiru aul jibaal a wataraa aal aarda baarizat wahasharnaahum fal am nughaadir minhumuaa 'ahad
Wa'uridu 'al aa rabbika saffa llaqad jeetumoonaa kamaa khal aqnaakumuaa 'awwal a marrati bal za'amtumuaa 'al lan nnaj'al a lakum mmaw'id

Wawudi'a aal kitaabu fataraa aal mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wayaqooloona yaawaylatanaa maal i haazaa aal kitaabi laa yughaadiru sagheerat wal aa kabeeratan ail laa 'ahsyaahaa wawajadu maa 'amil u haadira wal aa yazlimu rabbuka 'ahad

Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa kaana mina aal jinni fafasaqa 'ana aamri rabbihiaa 'afatattakhizoonahu wazurriyyatahuaa 'awleeaa'a min dooni wahum lakum 'adoowu beesa liz-zaal imeena badal
Mmaa 'ashhadttuhum khal qa aas-samaawaati waal aardi wal aa khal qa 'anfusihim wamaa kuntu muttakhiza aal mudil leena 'adud
Wayawma yaqoolu naadu shurakaa'eea aal zeena za'amtum fada'awhum fal am yastajeebu lahum waja'al naa baynahum mmawbiq
Wara'aa aal mujrimoona aan-naara fazannooaa 'annahum mmooaaqi'oohaa wal am yajidu 'anhaa masrif
Wal aqad sarrafnaa fi haazaa aal qur'aani lin-naasi min kul li mathal wakaana aal iansaanu 'akthara sha' jadal
Wamaa mana'a aan-naasa 'any yyoominooaa 'iz jaa'ahumu aul hudaa wayastaghfiru rabbahumuaa 'il laa 'an taateeahum sunnatu aul aawwal eena 'aw yaateeahumu aul'azaabu qibal
Wamaa nursil u aul mursal eena 'il laa mubashshireena wamunzireena wayujaadil u aul zeena kafaru bial baatil i leeudhidu bihi ail haqqa waattakhazooaa 'ayaati wamaa 'unziru huzu'

Wamana aazlamu mimman zukkira biayaati rabbihi faa'rada 'anhaa wanaseea maa qaddamat yadaahu 'innaa ja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihimuaa 'akinnatan aany yyafqahoohu wafiaa 'aazaanihim waqra wain tad'uhumuaa 'il aa aal hudaa fal any yyahtadooaa 'izaan aabad
Warabbuka aal ghafooru zoo aur-rahmati law yooaakhizuhum bimaa kasabu la'ajjal a lahumu aul'azaaba bal-laahum mmaw'id llany yyajidu min doonihi maw'il
Watil ka aal quraa 'ahlaknaahum lammaa zal amu waja'al naa limuhlakihim mmaw'id
Waiz qaal a moosaa lifatyaahu laa 'abrahu hattaa 'ablugha majma'a aal bahrayni 'awa aamdeea huqub
Fal ammaa bal aghaa majma'a baynihimaa naseeaa hootahumaa faattakhaza sabeelahu fi ail bahri sarab
Fal ammaa jaawazaa qaal a lifatyaahu 'aatinaa ghadaa'anaa laqad laqeenaa min safarinaa haazaa nasab
Qaal a 'arayta 'iza aawaynaa 'il aa aas-sakhrati fainni naseetu aul hoota wamaa 'ansyaaneehi 'il laa aash-shaytaanu 'ana aazkurahu waattakhaza sabeelahu fi ail bahri 'ajab
Qaal a zaal ika maa kunnaa nabghi faartaddaa 'al aa 'aatharihimaa qasas
Fawajadaa 'abda mmin 'ibaadinaa 'aataynaahu rahmat mmin 'indinaa wa'al lamnaahu mil lladunnaa 'il m
Qaal a lahu moosaa hal a aattabi'uka 'al aa 'an tu'al limani mimmaa 'ul limta rushd
Qaal a 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'i sabr
Wakayfa tasbiru 'al aa maa lam tuhit bihi khubr
Qaal a satajiduneea 'in shaa'a aal laahu saabira wal aa 'a'si laka 'amr
Qaal a faini aittaba'tani fal aa tasal anni 'an sha'in hattaa 'uhditha laka minhu zikr
Faantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa rakibaa fi ais-safeenati kharaqahaa qaal a 'akharaqtahaa litughriqa 'ahlahaa laqad jeeta shayaan aimr
Qaal a 'al ama aaqul i ainnaka lan tastatee'a ma'i sabr
Qaal a laa tooaakhizni bimaa naseetu wal aa turhiqni mina aamri 'usr
Faantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa laqeeaa ghul aama faqatal ahu qaal a 'aqatal ta nafsa zaakeeata bighayri nafs llaqad jeeta shaya nnukur
Qaal a 'al ama aaqul-laka 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'i sabr
Qaal a 'in saal tuka 'an sha'i ba'dahaa fal aa tusaahibni qad bal aghta mil lladuni 'uzr

Faantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa 'atayaa 'ahla qaryatin aistat'amaa 'ahlahaa faabawaa aany yyudayyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaara yureedu 'any yyanqadda faaqaamahu qaal a law sheeta lattakhaztta 'al ayhi 'ajr
Qaal a haazaa firaaqu bayni wabaynika saunabbeeuka bitaaweeli maa lam tastati' 'al ayhi sabra
Aammaa aas-safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'mal oona fi ail bahri faaradttu 'ana aa'eebahaa wakaana waraa'ahum mmal ik yaakhuzu kul la safeenatin ghasb
Waammaa aal ghul aamu fakaana 'abawaahu moominayni fakhasheenaa 'any yyurhiqahumaa tughyaana wakufr
Faaradnaa 'any yyubaddil ahumaa rabbuhumaa khayra mminhu zakawaat waaqraba ruhm

Waammaa aal jidaaru fakaana lighul aamayni yateemayni fi ail madeenati wakaana tahtahu kanz llaahumaa wakaana 'aboohumaa saal iha faaraada rabbuka 'any yyablughaa 'ashuddahumaa wayastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmat mmir rrabbika wamaa fa'al tuhu 'ana aamri zaal ika taaweelu maa lam tasti' 'al ayhi sabr
Wayasal oonaka 'an zi ail qarnayni qul saatlu 'al aykum mminhu zikra
Ainnaa makkannaa lahu fi ail aardi wa'aataynaahu min kul li sha' sabab

Faattaba'a sababaan hattaa 'izaa bal agha maghriba aash-shamsi wajadahaa taghrubu fi 'aynin hameeat wawajada 'indahaa qawma qul naa yaazaa aal qarnayni 'immaa 'an tu'azziba waimmaa 'an tattakhiza feehim husn
Qaal a 'ammaa man zal ama fasawfa nu'azzibuhu thumma yuraddu 'il aa rabbihi fayu'azzibuhu 'azaaba nnukur
Waammaa mana aamana wa'amil a saal iha fal ahu jazaa'u aul husnaa wasanaqoolu lahu mina aamrinaa yusr

Ail laa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a saal iha faul aa'ika yadkhul oona aal jannata wal aa yuzlamoona shay

Llaa yasma'oona feehaa laghwaan ail laa sal aama wal ahum rizquhum feehaa bukrat wa'ashiyy

Wamaa natanazzal u 'il laa biamri rabbika lahu maa bayna 'aydeenaa wamaa khal fanaa wamaa bayna zaal ika wamaa kaana rabbuka nasiyy
