'inna aal zeena kafaru wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi waal masjidi ail haraami ail zi ja'al naahu lin-naasi sawaa'un ail'aakifu feehi waal baadi wamany yyurid feehi biil haadi bizul m nnuziqhu min 'azaabin aal eem
Waiz bawwanaa liibraaheema makaana aal bayti 'al llaa tushrik bi shaya watahhir bayteea lit-taa'ifeena waal qaa'imeena waar-rukka'i ais-sujood
Waazzin fi ain-naasi bial hajji yaatooka rijaal a wa'al aa kul li daamir yaateena min kul li fajjin 'ameeq
Lleeashhadu manaafi'a lahum wayazkuru ausma aal laahi fiaa 'ayyaam mma'loomaatin 'al aa maa razaqahum mmim baheemati ail aan'aami fakul u minhaa waat'imu aul baa'isa aal faqeer
Thumma leeaqdu tafathahum wal yoofu nuzoorahum wal yattawwafu bial bayti ail'ateeq

Zaal ika wamany yyu'azzim hurumaati ail laahi fahooa khayr llaahu 'inda rabbihi wauhil lat lakumu aul aan'aamu 'il laa maa yutlaa 'al aykum faajtanibu aur-rijsa mina aal aawthaani waajtanibu qawla aaz-zoor
Hunafaa'a lil hi ghayra mushrikeena bihi wamany yyushrik bial laahi fakaannamaa kharra mina aas-samaa'i fatakhattafuhu aut-tayru 'aw tahwi bihi air-reehu fi makaan saheeq
Zaal ika wamany yyu'azzim sha'aa'ira aal laahi fainnahaa min taqwaa aal qul oob
Lakum feehaa manaafi'u 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma thumma mahil luhaa 'il aa aal bayti ail'ateeq
Wal ikul li 'ummat ja'al naa mansaka lleeazkuru ausma aal laahi 'al aa maa razaqahum mmim baheemati ail aan'aami fail aahukumuaa 'il aah waahid fal ahuaa 'aslimu wabashshiri ail mukhbiteen
Aal zeena 'izaa zukira aal laahu wajil at qul oobuhum waas-saabireena 'al aa maa 'asaabahum waal muqeemi ais-sal awaati wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon

Waal budna ja'al naahaa lakum mmin sha'aa'iri ail laahi lakum feehaa khayr faazkuru ausma aal laahi 'al ayhaa sawaaffa faizaa wajabat junoobuhaa fakul u minhaa waat'imu aul qaani'a waal mu'tarra kazaal ika sakhkharnaahaa lakum la'al lakum tashkuroon
Lany yyanaal a aal laaha luhoomuhaa wal aa dimaa'uhaa wal aakiny yyanaal uhu aut-taqwaa minkum kazaal ika sakhkharahaa lakum litukabbiru aul laaha 'al aa maa hadyaakum wabashshiri ail muhsineen
'inna aal laaha yudaafi'u 'ani ail zeena 'aamanooaa 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu kul la khawwaan kafoor
Azina lil zeena yuqaatal oona biannahum zul imu wainna aal laaha 'al aa nasrihim laqadeer

Ail zeena 'ukhriju min deeaarihim bighayri haqqin ail laa 'any yyaqoolu rabbunaa aal laahu wal awlaa difaa'u aul laahi ain-naasa ba'dahum biba'd llaahudimat sawaami'u wabeea' wasal awaat wamasaajidu yuzkaru feehaa aasmu aul laahi katheera wal ayansuranna aal laahu many yyansuruhuaa 'inna aal laaha laqaweeyun 'azeez
Ail zeena 'im mmakkannaahum fi ail aardi 'aqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata waamaru bial ma'roofi wanahawa 'ani ail munkari wal il hi 'aaqibatu aul uamoor
Wainy yyukazzibooka faqad kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh wa'aad wathamood
Waqawmu 'ibraaheema waqawmu looh
Waashaabu madyana wakuzziba moosaa faamlaytu lil kaafireena thumma 'akhazttuhum fakayfa kaana nakeer
Fakayyim mmin qaryatin aahlaknaahaa waheea zaal imat faheea khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa wabeer mmu'attal at waqasr mmasheed
Aafal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fatakoona lahum qul oob ya'qil oona bihaa 'awa aazaany yasma'oona bihaa fainnahaa laa ta'maa aal aabsaaru wal aakin ta'maa aal qul oobu aul ti fi ais-sudoor
Wayasta'jil oonaka bial'azaabi wal any yyukhlifa aal laahu wa'dahu wainna yawmaan 'inda rabbika kaal fi sanat mmimmaa ta'uddoon
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin aamlaytu lahaa waheea zaal imat thumma 'akhazttuhaa wail ayya aal maseer
Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'innamaa 'anaa lakum nazeer mmubeen
Faal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Waal zeena sa'awa fiaa 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jaheem

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika mir rrasool wal aa nabiaa'in ail laa 'izaa tamannaa 'al qaa aash-shaytaanu fiaa 'umniyyatihi fayansakhu aul laahu maa yul qi aish-shaytaanu thumma yuhkimu aul laahu 'ayaatihi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Lleeaj'al a maa yul qi aish-shaytaanu fitnat llil zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad waal qaaseeati qul oobuhum wainna aaz-zaal imeena lafi shiqaaqi ba'eed
Wal eea'lama aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma 'annahu aul haqqu mir rrabbika fayoominu bihi fatukhbita lahu qul oobuhum wainna aal laaha lahaadi ail zeena 'aamanooaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aa yazaal u aul zeena kafaru fi miryat mminhu hattaa taateeahumu aus-saa'atu baghtatan aaw yaateeahum 'azaabu yawmin 'aqeem
Ail mul ku yawma'iz llil hi yahkumu baynahum faal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fi jannaati ain-na'eem
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa faul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Waal zeena haajaru fi sabeeli ail laahi thumma qutil ooaa 'aw maatu layarzuqannahumu aul laahu rizqaan hasana wainna aal laaha lahooa khayru aur-raaziqeen
Layudkhil annahum mmadkhal a yardawnahu wainna aal laaha la'al eemun hal eem
Zaal ika waman 'aaqaba bimithli maa 'ooqiba bihi thumma bugheea 'al ayhi layansurannahu aul laahu 'inna aal laaha la'afoowun ghafoor
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha yooliju aul yla fi ain-nahari wayooliju aun-nahaara fi ail yli waanna aal laaha samee'u baseer
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu waanna maa tad'oona min doonihi hooa aal baatil u waanna aal laaha hooa aal'al eeyu aul kabeer
'al am tara 'anna aal laaha 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' fatusbihu aul aardu mukhdarratan ainna aal laaha lateefun khabeer
Llaahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi wainna aal laaha lahooa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha sakhkhara lakum mmaa fi ail aardi waal ful ka tajri fi ail bahri biamrihi wayumsiku aus-samaa'a an taqa'a 'al aa aal aardi 'il laa biiznihiaa 'inna aal laaha bian-naasi lara'oof rraheem
Wahooa aal ziaa 'ahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekumuaa 'inna aal iansaana lakafoor
Llikul li 'ummat ja'al naa mansakaan hum naasikoohu fal aa yunaazi'unnaka fi ail aamri waad'u 'il aa rabbika 'innaka la'al aa huda mmustaqeem
Wain jaadal ooka faqul i ail laahu 'a'lamu bimaa ta'mal oon
Aal laahu yahkumu baynakum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
'al am ta'lama aanna aal laaha ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaa'i waal aardi 'inna zaal ika fi kitaabin ainna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana wamaa laysa lahum bihi 'il m wamaa liz-zaal imeena min nnaseer

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat ta'rifu fi wujoohi ail zeena kafaru aul munkara yakaadoona yastoona bial zeena yatloona 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatinaa qul a aafaunabbeeukum bisharr mmin zaal ikumu aun-naaru wa'adahaa aal laahu aul zeena kafaru wabeesa aal maseer

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu duriba mathal faastami'u lahuaa 'inna aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi lany yyakhluqu zubaaba wal awi aijtama'u lahu wainy yyaslubhumu auz-zubaabu shaya llaa yastanqizoohu minhu da'ufa aat-taal ibu waal matloob
Maa qadaru aul laaha haqqa qadrihiaa 'inna aal laaha laqaweeyun 'azeez
Ail laahu yastafi mina aal mal aa'ikati rusul a wamina aan-naasi 'inna aal laaha samee'u baseer
Ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul uamoor
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu aurka'u waasjudu waa'budu rabbakum waaf'al u aul khayra la'al lakum tuflihoon

Wajaahidu fi ail laahi haqqa jihaadihi hooa aajtabyaakum wamaa ja'al a 'al aykum fi aid-deeni min haraj mmil lata 'abeekumuaa 'ibraaheema hooa sammyaakumu aul muslimeena min qablu wafi haazaa leeakoona aar-rasoolu shaheedaan 'al aykum watakoonu shuhadaa'a 'al aa aan-naasi faaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waa'tasimu bial laahi hooa mawlyaakum fani'ma aal mawlaa wani'ma aan-naseer
Qada aaflaha aal moominoon
Aal zeena hum fi sal aatihim khaashi'oon
Waal zeena hum 'ani ail laghwi mu'ridoon
Waal zeena hum liz-zakawaati faa'il oon
Waal zeena hum lifuroojihim haafizoon
'il laa 'al aa 'azwaajihimuaa 'aw maa mal akata aymaanuhum fainnahum ghayru mal oomeen
Famani aibtaghaa waraa'a zaal ika faul aa'ika humu aul'aadoon
Waal zeena hum liamaanaatihim wa'ahdihim raa'oon
Waal zeena hum 'al aa sal awaatihim yuhaafizoon
'ul aa'ika humu aul waarithoon
Aal zeena yarithoona aal firdawsa hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wal aqad khal aqnaa aal iansaana min sul aal at mmin teen
Thumma ja'al naahu nutfat fi qarar mmakeen

Thumma khal aqnaa aan-nutfata 'al aqat fakhal aqnaa aal'al aqata mudghat fakhal aqnaa aal mudghata 'izaama fakasawnaa aal'izaama lahma thumma 'anshanaahu khal qaan aakhara fatabaaraka aal laahu 'ahsanu aul khaal iqeen
Thumma 'innakum ba'da zaal ika lamayyitoon
Thumma 'innakum yawma aal qeeaamati tub'athoon
Wal aqad khal aqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraa'iqa wamaa kunnaa 'ani ail khal qi ghaafil een
Waanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa'a biqadar faaskannaahu fi ail aardi wainnaa 'al aa zahaabi bihi laqaadiroon
Faanshanaa lakum bihi jannaat mmin nnakheel waa'naab llakum feehaa fawaakihu katheerat waminhaa taakul oon
Washajarat takhruju min toori seenaa'a tanbutu biad-duhni wasibgh llil aakil een
Wainna lakum fi ail aan'aami la'ibrat nnasqeekum mmimmaa fi butoonihaa wal akum feehaa manaafi'u katheerat waminhaa taakul oon
Wa'al ayhaa wa'al aa aal ful ki tuhmal oon
Wal aqada aarsal naa noohaan ail aa qawmihi faqaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhuaa 'afal aa tattaqoon

Faqaal a aal mal a'ua aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi maa haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum yureedu 'any yyatafaddal a 'al aykum wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laanzal a mal aa'ikat mmaa sami'naa bihaazaa fiaa 'aabaa'inaa aal aawwal een
'in hooa 'il laa rajul u bihi jinnat fatarabbasu bihi hattaa heen
Qaal a rabbi ainsurni bimaa kazzaboon

Faawhaynaa 'il ayhi 'ani aisna'i ail ful ka bia'yuninaa wawahyinaa faizaa jaa'a amrunaa wafaara aat-tannooru faasluk feehaa min kul li zawjayni aithnayni waahlaka 'il laa man sabaqa 'al ayhi ail qawlu minhum wal aa tukhaatibni fi ail zeena zal amooaa 'innahum mmughraqoon
Faizaa aastawayta 'anta wamam mma'aka 'al aa aal ful ki faqul i ail hamdu lil hi ail zi najjyaanaa mina aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Waqur-rabbi 'anzil ni munzal a mmubaaraka waanta khayru aul munzil een
'inna fi zaal ika layaat wain kunnaa lamubtal een
Thumma 'anshanaa mim ba'dihim qarnaan aakhareen
Faarsal naa feehim rasoola mminhumuaa 'anu au'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmini ail aahin ghayruhuaa 'afal aa tattaqoon

Waqaal a aal mal au min qawmihi ail zeena kafaru wakazzabu bil iqaa'i ail aakhirati waatrafnaahum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya maa haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum yaakul u mimmaa taakul oona minhu wayashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
Wal a'ina aata'tum bashara mmithlakumuaa 'innakumuaa 'iza llakhaasiroon
'aya'idukumuaa 'annakumuaa 'izaa mittum wakuntum turaaba wa'izaamaan aannakum mmukhrajoon
Hayhaata hayhaata limaa too'adoon
'in heea 'il laa hayaatunaa aad-dunya namootu wanahya wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
'in hooa 'il laa rajul un aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kaziba wamaa nahnu lahu bimoomineen
Qaal a rabbi ainsurni bimaa kazzaboon
Qaal a 'ammaa qal eel llayusbihunna naadimeen
Faakhazathumu aus-sayhatu bial haqqi faja'al naahum ghuthaa' fabu'da llil qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Thumma 'anshanaa mim ba'dihim quroonaan aakhareen
Maa tasbiqu minu ammatin aajal ahaa wamaa yastaakhiroon
Thumma 'arsal naa rusul anaa tatra kul la maa jaa'a aummat rrasooluhaa kazzaboohu faatba'naa ba'dahum ba'da waja'al naahumuaa 'ahaadeetha fabu'da lliqawm llaa yoominoon
Thumma 'arsal naa moosaa waakhaahu haaroon
Biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
Ail aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faastakbaru wakaanu qawmaan 'aal een
Faqaal ooaa 'anoominu libasharayni mithlinaa waqawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon
Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanu mina aal muhlakeen
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba la'al laahum yahtadoon
Waja'al naa aabna maryama waummahuaa 'ayat wa'aawaynaahumaa 'il aa rubwat zaati qarar wama'een
Yayyuhaa aar-rusul u kul u mina aat-tayyibaati waa'mal u saal ihaan ainni bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem
Waanna haazihiaa 'ummatukumuaa 'ummat waahidat waanaa rabbukum faattaqoon
Fataqatta'ooaa 'amrahum baynahum zubura kul lu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Fazarhum fi ghamratihim hattaa heen
Ayahsiboona 'annamaa numidduhum bihi mim mmaal wabaneen
Nusaari'u lahum fi ail khayraati bal-laa yash'uroon
'inna aal zeena hum mmin khashyati rabbihim mmushfiqoon
Waal zeena hum biayaati rabbihim yoominoon
Waal zeena hum birabbihim laa yushrikoon
Waal zeena yootoona maa 'aata wwaqul oobuhum wajil atun aannahumuaa 'il aa rabbihim raaji'oon
'ul aa'ika yusaari'oona fi ail khayraati wahum lahaa saabiqoon
Wal aa nukal lifu nafsaan ail laa wus'ahaa wal adaynaa kitaab yantiqu bial haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Bal qul oobuhum fi ghamrat mmin haazaa wal ahumuaa 'a'maal mmin dooni zaal ika hum lahaa 'aamil oon
Hattaa 'izaa 'akhaznaa mutrafeehim bial'azaabi 'izaa hum yajaroon
Laa tajaru aul yawma 'innakum mminnaa laa tunsaroon
Qad kaanata ayaati tutlaa 'al aykum fakuntum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum tankisoon
Mustakbireena bihi saamira tuhjiroon
'afal am yaddabbaru aul qawla 'am jaa'ahum mmaa lam yaati 'aabaa'ahumu aul aawwal een
'am lam ya'rifu rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroon
'am yaqooloona bihi jinnatu bal jaa'ahum bial haqqi waaktharuhum lil haqqi kaarihoon
Wal awi aittaba'a aal haqqu 'ahwaa'ahum lafasadati ais-samaawaatu waal aardu waman feehinna bal a aataynaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mmu'ridoon
'am tasal uhum kharja fakharaaju rabbika khayr wahooa khayru aur-raaziqeen
Wainnaka latad'oohumuaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wainna aal zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati 'ani ais-siraati lanaakiboon
Wal aw rahimnaahum wakashafnaa maa bihim mmin durr llal ajju fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
Wal aqada aakhaznaahum bial'azaabi famaa aastakaanu lirabbihim wamaa yatadarra'oon
Hattaa 'izaa fatahnaa 'al ayhim baaba zaa 'azaab shadeedin aizaa hum feehi mublisoon
Wahooa aal ziaa 'anshaa lakumu aus-sam'a waal aabsaara waal aafidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Wahooa aal zi zaraakum fi ail aardi wail ayhi tuhsharoon
Wahooa aal zi yuhyi wayumeetu wal ahu aukhtil aafu aul yli waan-nahari 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Bal qaal u mithla maa qaal a aal aawwal oon
Qaal ooaa 'azaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaaba wa'izaamaan ainnaa lamab'oothoon
Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa'aabaa'unaa haazaa min qablu 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul aawwal een
Qul-limani ail aardu waman feehaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona lil hi qul a aafal aa tazzakkaroon
Qul mar rrabbu aus-samaawaati ais-sab'i warabbu aul'arshi ail'azeem
Sayaqooloona lil hi qul a aafal aa tattaqoon
Qul mam beeadihi mal akootu kul li sha' wahooa yujeeru wal aa yujaaru 'al ayhi 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona lil hi qul faannaa tusharoon
Bal a aataynaahum bial haqqi wainnahum lakaaziboon
Maa aattakhaza aal laahu minw wwal ad wamaa kaana ma'ahu mini ail aahin aiza llazahaba kul lu 'il aahi bimaa khal aqa wal a'al aa ba'duhum 'al aa ba'd subhaana aal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon
'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati fata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Qur-rabbi 'immaa tureeanni maa yoo'adoon
Rabbi fal aa taj'al ni fi ail qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wainnaa 'al aa 'an nnureeaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
Aadfa' bial ti heea 'ahsanu aus-sayyeeata nahnu 'a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
Waqur-rabbi 'a'oozu bika min hamazaati aish-shayaateen
Waa'oozu bika rabbi 'any yyahduroon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'a ahadahumu aul mawtu qaal a rabbi airji'oon
La'al leea 'a'mal u saal iha feemaa taraktu kal laa 'innahaa kal imatun hooa qaa'il uhaa waminw wwaraa'ihim barzakhun ail aa yawmi yub'athoon
Faizaa nufikha fi ais-soori fal aa 'ansaaba baynahum yawma'iz wal aa yatasaa'al oon
Faman thaqul at mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika aal zeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum fi jahannama khaal idoon
Tal fahu wujoohahumu aun-naaru wahum feehaa kaal ihoon
'al am takuna ayaati tutlaa 'al aykum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon
Qaal u rabbanaa ghal abat 'al aynaa shiqwatunaa wakunnaa qawma daal leen
Rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa minhaa fain 'udnaa fainnaa zaal imoon
Qaal a aakhsau feehaa wal aa tukal limoon
'innahu kaana fareeq mmin 'ibaadi yaqooloona rabbanaa 'aamannaa faaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa waanta khayru aur-raahimeen
Faattakhazttumoohum sukhriyyaan hattaa 'ansawkum zikri wakuntum mminhum tadhakoon
'inni jazaytuhumu aul yawma bimaa sabarooaa 'annahum humu aul faa'izoon
Qaal a kam labithtum fi ail aardi 'adada sineen
Qaal u labithnaa yawmaan aaw ba'da yawm fasal i ail'aaddeen
Qaal a 'il llabithtumuaa 'il laa qal eela llawa aannakum kuntum ta'lamoon
'afahasibtumuaa 'annamaa khal aqnaakum 'abatha waannakumuaa 'il aynaa laa turja'oon
Fata'aal aa aal laahu aul mal iku aul haqqu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa rabbu aul'arshi ail kareem
Wamany yyad'u ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara laa burhaana lahu bihi fainnamaa hisaabuhu 'inda rabbihiaa 'innahu laa yuflihu aul kaafiroon
Waqur-rabbi aighfir waarham waanta khayru aur-raahimeen
Sooratun aanzal naahaa wafaradnaahaa waanzal naa feehaa 'ayaati bayyinaat lla'al lakum tazzakkaroon

Aaz-zaaneeatu waaz-zaani faajlidu kul la waahid mminhumaa miayata jal dat wal aa taakhuzkum bihimaa rafat fi deeni ail laahi 'in kuntum toominoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wal yashhad 'azaabahumaa taa'ifat mmina aal moomineen
Aaz-zaani laa yankihu 'il laa zaaneeatan aaw mushrikat waaz-zaaneeatu laa yankihuhaa 'il laa zaanin aaw mushrik wahurrima zaal ika 'al aa aal moomineen
Waal zeena yarmoona aal muhsanaati thumma lam yaatu biarba'ati shuhadaa'a faajlidoohum thamaaneena jal dat wal aa taqbal u lahum shahaadatan aabada waul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
'il laa aal zeena taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahu fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Waal zeena yarmoona 'azwaajahum wal am yakul llaahum shuhadaa'u ail laa 'anfusuhum fashahaadatu 'ahadihimuaa 'arba'a shahaadaati bial laahi 'innahu lamina aas-saadiqeen
Waal khaamisatu 'al lla'natu aul laahi 'al ayhi 'in kaana mina aal kaazibeen
Wayadra'ua 'anhaa aal'azaaba 'an tashhada 'arba'a shahaadaati bial laahi 'innahu lamina aal kaazibeen
Waal khaamisatu 'an ghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhaa 'in kaana mina aas-saadiqeen
Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu waanna aal laaha tawwaabun hakeem

Ainna aal zeena jaa'oo bial iafki 'usbat mminkum laa tahsiboohu sharra llakum bal hooa khayr llakum likul li aimri mminhum mmaa aaktasaba mina aal iathmi waal zi tawal laa kibrahu minhum lahu 'azaabun 'azeem
Llawlaa 'iz sami'tumoohu zanna aal moominoona waal moominaatu bianfusihim khayra waqaal u haazaa 'ifk mmubeen
Llawlaa jaa'oo 'al ayhi biarba'ati shuhadaa'a faiz lam yaatu biash-shuhadaa'i faul aa'ika 'inda aal laahi humu aul kaaziboon
Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati lamassakum fi maa 'afadtum feehi 'azaabun 'azeem
Aiz tal aqqawnahu bial sinatikum wataqooloona biafwaahikum mmaa laysa lakum bihi 'il m watahsiboonahu hayyina wahooa 'inda aal laahi 'azeem
Wal awlaa 'iz sami'tumoohu qul tum mmaa yakoonu lanaa 'an nnatakal lama bihaazaa subhaanaka haazaa buhtaanun 'azeem
Ya'izukumu aul laahu 'an ta'oodu limithlihiaa 'abadaan ain kuntum mmoomineen
Wayubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Ainna aal zeena yuhibboona 'an tashee'a aal faahishatu fi ail zeena 'aamanu lahum 'azaabun aal eem fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati waal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon
Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu waanna aal laaha ra'oof rraheem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattabi'u khutwaati aish-shaytaani wamany yyattabi' khutwaati aish-shaytaani fainnahu yaamuru bial fahshaa'i waal munkari wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu maa zakaa minkum mmina aahadin aabada wal aakinna aal laaha yuzakki many yyashaa'u waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Wal aa yaatal i 'oolu aul fadli minkum waas-sa'ati 'any yyootooaa 'ooli ail qurbaa waal masaakeena waal muhaajireena fi sabeeli ail laahi wal ya'fu wal yasfahooaa 'al aa tuhibboona 'any yyaghfira aal laahu lakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Ainna aal zeena yarmoona aal muhsanaati ail ghaafil aati ail moominaati lu'inu fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Yawma tashhadu 'al ayhimuaa 'al sinatuhum waydeehim waarjul uhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Yawma'iz yooaffeehimu aul laahu deenahumu aul haqqa waya'lamoona 'anna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu aul mubeen

Aul khabeethaatu lil khabeetheena waal khabeethoona lil khabeethaati waat-tayyibaatu lit-tayyibeena waat-tayyiboona lit-tayyibaati 'ul aa'ika mubarra'oona mimmaa yaqooloona lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tadkhul u buyootaan ghayra buyootikum hattaa tastaanisu watusal limu 'al aa 'ahlihaa zaal ikum khayr llakum la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Fail llam tajidu feehaa 'ahada fal aa tadkhul oohaa hattaa yoozana lakum wain qeela lakumu aurji'u faarji'u hooa 'azkaa lakum waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem
Llaysa 'al aykum junaahun aan tadkhul u buyootaan ghayra maskoonat feehaa mataa' llakum waal laahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul-lil moomineena yaghuddu mina aabsaarihim wayahfazu furoojahum zaal ika 'azkaa lahumuaa 'inna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa yasna'oon

Waqul-lil moominaati yaghdudna mina aabsaarihinna wayahfazna furoojahunna wal aa yubdeena zeenatahunna 'il laa maa zahara minhaa wal yadribna bikhumurihinna 'al aa juyoobihinna wal aa yubdeena zeenatahunna 'il laa libu'oolatihinna 'awa aabaa'ihinna 'awa aabaa'i bu'oolatihinna 'awa aabnaa'ihinna 'awa aabnaa'i bu'oolatihinna 'awi aikhwaanihinna 'aw baniaa 'ikhwaanihinna 'aw baniaa 'akhawaatihinna 'aw nisaa'ihinna 'aw maa mal akata aymaanuhunna 'awi ait-taabi'eena ghayri 'ooli ail iarbati mina aar-rijaal i 'awi ait-tifli ail zeena lam yazharu 'al aa 'awraati ain-nisaa'i wal aa yadribna biarjul ihinna leeu'lama maa yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watoobooaa 'il aa aal laahi jamee'aan ayyuha aal moominoona la'al lakum tuflihoon
Waankihu aul ayaamaa minkum waas-saal iheena min 'ibaadikum waimaa'ikumuaa 'iny yyakoonu fuqaraa'a yughnihimu aul laahu min fadlihi waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem

Wal yasta'fifi ail zeena laa yajidoona nikaahaan hattaa yughneeahumu aul laahu min fadlihi waal zeena yabtaghoona aal kitaaba mimmaa mal akata aymaanukum fakaatiboohumuaa 'in 'al imtum feehim khayra wa'aatoohum mmim mmaal i ail laahi ail ziaa 'aatyaakum wal aa tukrihu fatayaatikum 'al aa aal bighaa'i ana aaradna tahassuna llitabtaghu 'arada aal hayawaati aid-dunya wamany yyukrihhhunna fainna aal laaha mim ba'di 'ikraahihinna ghafoor rraheem
Wal aqada aanzal naa 'il aykumuaa 'ayaat mmubayyanaat wamathal a mmina aal zeena khal awa min qablikum wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen

Aal laahu nooru aus-samaawaati waal aardi mathal u noorihi kamishkawaat feehaa misbaahun ail misbaahu fi zujaajatin aiz-zujaajatu kaannahaa kawkab durreey yooqadu min shajarat mmubaarakat zaytoonat llaa sharqiyyat wal aa gharbiyyat yakaadu zaytuhaa yudiaa'u wal aw lam tamsashu naar nnoorun 'al aa noor yahdi ail laahu linoorihi many yyashaa'u wayadribu aul laahu aul aamthaal a lin-naasi waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Fi buyootin aazina aal laahu 'an turfa'a wayuzkara feehaa aasmuhu yusabbihu lahu feehaa bial ghudoowi waal aasaal i  rijaal-laa tul heehim tijaarat wal aa bay'un 'an zikri ail laahi waiqaami ais-sal awaati waeetaa'i aiz-zakawaati yakhaafoona yawma tataqal labu feehi ail qul oobu waal aabsaar
Leeajzeeahumu aul laahu 'ahsana maa 'amil u wayazeedahum mmin fadlihi waal laahu yarzuqu many yyashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Waal zeena kafarooaa 'a'maal uhum kasaraabi biqee'at yahsibuhu auz-zamaanu maa'an hattaa 'izaa jaa'ahu lam yajidhu shaya wawajada aal laaha 'indahu fawaffyaahu hisaabahu waal laahu saree'u aul hisaab

'aw kazul umaat fi bahr llujjeey yaghshyaahu mawj mmin fawqihi mawj mmin fawqihi sahaab zul umaatu ba'duhaa fawqa ba'din aizaa 'akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaryaahaa wamal llam yaj'al i ail laahu lahu noora famaa lahu min nnoor
Aal am tara 'anna aal laaha yusabbihu lahu man fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi waat-tayru saaffaat kul l qad 'al ima sal aatahu watasbeehahu waal laahu 'al eemu bimaa yaf'al oon
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi wail aa aal laahi ail maseer

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha yuzji sahaaba thumma yooal lifu baynahu thumma yaj'al uhu rukaama fataraa aal wadqa yakhruju min khil aal ihi wayunazzil u mina aas-samaa'i min jibaal feehaa mim barad fayuseebu bihi many yyashaa'u wayasrifuhu 'am mmany yyashaa'u yakaadu sanaa barqihi yazhabu bial aabsaari  yuqal libu aul laahu aul yla waan-nahaara 'inna fi zaal ika la'ibrat lliooli ail aabsaar

Waal laahu khal aqa kul la daabbat mmim mmaa' faminhum mmany yyamshi 'al aa batnihi waminhum mmany yyamshi 'al aa rijlayni waminhum mmany yyamshi 'al aa 'arba' yakhluqu aul laahu maa yashaa'u ainna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Llaqada aanzal naa 'ayaat mmubayyanaat waal laahu yahdi many yyashaa'u ail aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wayaqooloona 'aamannaa bial laahi wabiar-rasooli waata'naa thumma yatawal laa fareeq mminhum mmim ba'di zaal ika wamaa 'ul aa'ika bial moomineen
Waizaa du'ooaa 'il aa aal laahi warasoolihi leeahkuma baynahumuaa 'izaa fareeq mminhum mmu'ridoon
Wainy yyakul llaahumu aul haqqu yaatooaa 'il ayhi muz'ineen
'afi qul oobihim mmaradun aami airtaabooaa 'am yakhaafoona 'any yyaheefa aal laahu 'al ayhim warasooluhu bal u awlaa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon
'innamaa kaana qawla aal moomineena 'izaa du'ooaa 'il aa aal laahi warasoolihi leeahkuma baynahumuaa 'any yyaqoolu sami'naa waata'naa waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu wayakhsha aal laaha wayattaqihi faul aa'ika humu aul faa'izoon
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'ina aamartahum layakhrujunna qul-laa tuqsimu taa'at mma'roofatun ainna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon

Qul a aatee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola fain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al ayhi maa hummil a wa'al aykum mmaa hummil tum wain tutee'oohu tahtadu wamaa 'al aa aar-rasooli 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen

Wa'ada aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu minkum wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati layastakhlifannahum fi ail aardi kamaa aastakhlafa aal zeena min qablihim wal ayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu aul zi airtadaa lahum wal ayubaddil annahum mmim ba'di khawfihimuaa 'amna ya'budoonani laa yushrikoona bi shaya waman kafara ba'da zaal ika faul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
Waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waatee'u aur-rasoola la'al lakum turhamoon
Laa tahsibanna aal zeena kafaru mu'jizeena fi ail aardi wamawyaahumu aun-naaru wal abeesa aal maseer

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu leeastaazinkumu aul zeena mal akata aymaanukum waal zeena lam yablughu aul hul uma minkum thal aatha marraat mmin qabli sal awaati ail fajri waheena tada'oona theeaabakum mmina aaz-zaheerati wamim ba'di sal awaati ail'ishaa'i thal aathu 'awraat llakum laysa 'al aykum wal aa 'al ayhim junaahu ba'dahunna tawwaafoona 'al aykum ba'dukum 'al aa ba'd kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Waizaa bal agha aal aatfaal u minkumu aul hul uma fal yastaazinu kamaa aastaazana aal zeena min qablihim kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumuaa 'ayaatihi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Waal qawaa'idu mina aan-nisaa'i ail ti laa yarjoona nikaaha fal aysa 'al ayhinna junaahun aany yyada'na theeaabahunna ghayra mutabarrijaati bizeenat waany yyasta'fifna khayr llaahunna waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Llaysa 'al aa aal aa'maa haraj wal aa 'al aa aal aa'raji haraj wal aa 'al aa aal mareedi haraj wal aa 'al aa 'anfusikumuaa 'an taakul u mim buyootikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'aabaa'ikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'ummahaatikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'ikhwaanikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'akhawaatikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'a'maamikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'ammaatikumuaa 'aw buyooti 'akhwaal ikumuaa 'aw buyooti khaal aatikumuaa 'aw maa mal aktum mmafaatihahuaa 'aw sadeeqikum laysa 'al aykum junaahun aan taakul u jamee'aan aawa aashtaata faizaa dakhal tum buyoota fasal limu 'al aa 'anfusikum tahiyyat mmin 'indi ail laahi mubaarakat tayyibat kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati la'al lakum ta'qil oon

'innamaa aal moominoona aal zeena 'aamanu bial laahi warasoolihi waizaa kaanu ma'ahu 'al aa 'amr jaami' llam yazhabu hattaa yastaazinoohu 'inna aal zeena yastaazinoonaka 'ul aa'ika aal zeena yoominoona bial laahi warasoolihi faizaa aastaazanooka liba'di shanihim faazal lliman sheeta minhum waastaghfir lahumu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Llaa taj'al u du'aa'a aar-rasooli baynakum kadu'aa'i ba'dikum ba'da qad ya'lamu aul laahu aul zeena yatasal lal oona minkum liwaaza fal yahzari ail zeena yukhaal ifoona 'ana aamrihiaa 'an tuseebahum fitnatun aaw yuseebahum 'azaabun aal eem
Aal aa 'inna lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi qad ya'lamu maa 'antum 'al ayhi wayawma yurja'oona 'il ayhi fayunabbeeuhum bimaa 'amil u waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Tabaaraka aal zi nazzal a aal furqaana 'al aa 'abdihi leeakoona lil'aal ameena nazeera
Ail zi lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi wal am yattakhiz wal ada wal am yakul llaahu shareek fi ail mul ki wakhal aqa kul la sha' faqaddarahu taqdeer
Waattakhazu min doonihiaa 'aal ihat llaa yakhluqoona shaya wahum yukhlaqoona wal aa yamlikoona lianfusihim darra wal aa naf'a wal aa yamlikoona mawta wal aa hayawaat wal aa nushoor
Waqaal a aal zeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'ifkun aiftaryaahu waa'aanahu 'al ayhi qawmun aakharoona faqad jaa'oo zul ma wazoor
Waqaal ooaa 'asaateeru aul aawwal eena aaktatabahaa faheea tumlaa 'al ayhi bukrat waaseel
Qul a aanzal ahu aul zi ya'lamu aus-sirra fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi 'innahu kaana ghafoora rraheem
Waqaal u maal i haazaa aar-rasooli yaakul u aut-ta'aama wayamshi fi ail aaswaaqi lawlaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi mal ak fayakoona ma'ahu nazeera
Aaw yul qaa 'il ayhi kanzun aaw takoonu lahu jannat yaakul u minhaa waqaal a aaz-zaal imoona 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa rajul a mmashoora
Aunzur kayfa darabu laka aal aamthaal a fadal lu fal aa yastatee'oona sabeel
Tabaaraka aal ziaa 'in shaa'a ja'al a laka khayra mmin zaal ika jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru wayaj'al-laka qusoora
Bal kazzabu bias-saa'ati waa'tadnaa liman kazzaba bias-saa'ati sa'eera
Aizaa raathum mmim mmakaani ba'eed sami'u lahaa taghayyuza wazafeer
Waizaa 'ul qu minhaa makaana dayyiqa mmuqarraneena da'awa hunaal ika thuboor
Llaa tad'u aul yawma thuboora waahida waad'u thuboora katheer
Qul a aazaal ika khayrun aam jannatu aul khul di ail ti wu'ida aal muttaqoona kaanat lahum jazaa' wamaseer
Llaahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaal ideena kaana 'al aa rabbika wa'da mmasool
Wayawma nahshuruhum wamaa ya'budoona min dooni ail laahi fayaqoolu 'aantumuaa 'adlal tum 'ibaadi haa'ul aa'i aam hum dal lu aus-sabeel
Qaal u subhaanaka maa kaana yanbaghi lanaa 'an nnattakhiza min doonika mina aawleeaa'a wal aakim mmatta'tahum wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa nasu auz-zikra wakaanu qawmaa boor
Faqad kazzabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa yastatee'oona sarfa wal aa nasra wamany yyazlim mminkum nuziqhu 'azaaba kabeer
Wamaa 'arsal naa qablaka mina aal mursal eena 'il laa 'innahum layaakul oona aat-ta'aama wayamshoona fi ail aaswaaqi waja'al naa ba'dakum liba'd fitnatan aatasbiroona wakaana rabbuka baseer
Waqaal a aal zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa aal mal aa'ikatu 'aw naraa rabbanaa laqadi aistakbaru fiaa 'anfusihim wa'ataw 'utoowa kabeer
Yawma yarawna aal mal aa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'iz llil mujrimeena wayaqooloona hijra mmahjoor
Waqadimnaa 'il aa maa 'amil u min 'amal faja'al naahu habaa' mmanthoora
Aashaabu aul jannati yawma'izin khayr mmustaqarra waahsanu maqeel
Wayawma tashshaqqaqu aus-samaa'u bial ghamaami wanuzzil a aal mal aa'ikatu tanzeela
Ail mul ku yawma'izin ail haqqu lir-rahmaani wakaana yawmaan 'al aa aal kaafireena 'aseer
Wayawma ya'addu auz-zaal imu 'al aa yadayhi yaqoolu yaal aytani aittakhazttu ma'a aar-rasooli sabeel
Yaawaylataa laytani lama aattakhiz ful aanaan khal eel
Llaqada aadal lani 'ani aiz-zikri ba'da 'iz jaa'ani wakaana aash-shaytaanu lil iansaani khazool
Waqaal a aar-rasoolu yaarabbi 'inna qawmeea aattakhazu haazaa aal qur'aana mahjoor
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa likul li nabiaa'in 'adoowa mmina aal mujrimeena wakafaa birabbika haadeea wanaseer
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lawlaa nuzzil a 'al ayhi ail qur'aanu jumlat waahidat kazaal ika linuthabbita bihi fu'aadaka warattal naahu tarteel
Wal aa yaatoonaka bimathal in ail laa jeenaaka bial haqqi waahsana tafseera
Ail zeena yuhsharoona 'al aa wujoohihimuaa 'il aa jahannama 'ul aa'ika sharr mmakaana waadal lu sabeel
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba waja'al naa ma'ahuaa 'akhaahu haaroona wazeer
Faqul naa aazhabaa 'il aa aal qawmi ail zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeer
Waqawma nooh llammaa kazzabu aur-rusul a 'aghraqnaahum waja'al naahum lin-naasi 'ayat waa'tadnaa liz-zaal imeena 'azaabaan aal eem
Wa'aada wathamooda waashaaba aar-rassi waquroonaa bayna zaal ika katheer
Wakul la darabnaa lahu aul aamthaal a wakul la tabbarnaa tatbeer
Wal aqada aatawa 'al aa aal qaryati ail tiaa 'umtirat matara aas-saw'i aafal am yakoonu yarawnahaa bal kaanu laa yarjoona nushoor
Waizaa raawka 'iny yyattakhizoonaka 'il laa huzu'aan aahaazaa aal zi ba'atha aal laahu rasoola
Ain kaada layudil lunaa 'ana aal ihatinaa lawlaa 'an sabarnaa 'al ayhaa wasawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawna aal'azaaba mana aadal lu sabeela
Aarayta mani aittakhaza 'il aahahu hawyaahu 'afaanta takoonu 'al ayhi wakeela
Aam tahsibu 'anna 'aktharahum yasma'oona 'aw ya'qil oona 'in humuaa 'il laa kaal aan'aami bal humuaa 'adal lu sabeela
Aal am tara 'il aa rabbika kayfa madda aaz-zil la wal aw shaa'a laja'al ahu saakina thumma ja'al naa aash-shamsa 'al ayhi dal eel
Thumma qabadnaahu 'il aynaa qabda yaseer
Wahooa aal zi ja'al a lakumu aul yla libaasa waan-nawma subaata waja'al a aan-nahaara nushoor
Wahooa aal ziaa 'arsal a aar-reeaaha nushuraa bayna yada rahmatihi waanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' tahoor
Llinuheea bihi bal dat mmayta wanusqeeahu mimmaa khal aqnaa 'an'aama waanaasiyya katheer
Wal aqad sarrafnaahu baynahum leeazzakkaru faabaa 'aktharu aun-naasi 'il laa kufoor
Wal aw sheenaa laba'athnaa fi kul li qaryat nnazeer
Fal aa tuti'i ail kaafireena wajaahidhum bihi jihaada kabeer
Wahooa aal zi maraja aal bahrayni haazaa 'azb furaat wahaazaa mil hun ajaaj waja'al a baynahumaa barzakha wahijra mmahjoor
Wahooa aal zi khal aqa mina aal maa'i bashara faja'al ahu nasaba wasihra wakaana rabbuka qadeer
Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'uhum wal aa yadurruhum wakaana aal kaafiru 'al aa rabbihi zaheer
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa mubashshira wanazeer
Qul maa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi mina aajrin ail laa man shaa'a any yyattakhiza 'il aa rabbihi sabeel
Watawakkal 'al aa aal hayyi ail zi laa yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafaa bihi bizunoobi 'ibaadihi khabeera
Ail zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi air-rahmaanu fasal bihi khabeer
Waizaa qeela lahumu ausjudu lir-rahmaani qaal u wamaa aar-rahmaanu 'anasjudu limaa taamurunaa wazaadahum nufoor
Tabaaraka aal zi ja'al a fi ais-samaa'i burooja waja'al a feehaa siraaja waqamara mmuneer
Wahooa aal zi ja'al a aal yla waan-nahaara khil fat llimana aaraada 'any yyazzakkara 'awa aaraada shukoor
Wa'ibaadu aur-rahmaani ail zeena yamshoona 'al aa aal aardi hawna waizaa khaatabahumu aul jaahil oona qaal u sal aam
Waal zeena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjada waqeeaam
Waal zeena yaqooloona rabbanaa aasrif 'annaa 'azaaba jahannama 'inna 'azaabahaa kaana gharaama
Ainnahaa saa'at mustaqarra wamuqaam
Waal zeena 'izaa 'anfaqu lam yusrifu wal am yuqtiru wakaana bayna zaal ika qawaam
Waal zeena laa yad'oona ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara wal aa yaqtul oona aan-nafsa aal ti harrama aal laahu 'il laa bial haqqi wal aa yaznoona wamany yyaf'al zaal ika yal qa 'athaam
Yudaa'af lahu aul'azaabu yawma aal qeeaamati wayakhlud feehi muhaana
Ail laa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a 'amal a saal iha faul aa'ika yubaddil u aul laahu sayyiaatihim hasanaat wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Waman taaba wa'amil a saal iha fainnahu yatoobu 'il aa aal laahi mataab
Waal zeena laa yashhadoona aaz-zoora waizaa marru bial laghwi marru kiraam

Faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu makrihimuaa 'innaa dammarnaahum waqawmahumuaa 'ajma'een
Fatil ka buyootuhum khaaweeata bimaa zal amooaa 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm ya'lamoon
Waanjaynaa aal zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wal ootaan aiz qaal a liqawmihiaa 'ataatoona aal faahishata waantum tubsiroon
'a'innakum lataatoona aar-rijaal a shahwat mmin dooni ain-nisaa'i bal a aantum qawm tajhal oon
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'akhrijooaa 'aal a loot mmin qaryatikumuaa 'innahumuaa 'unaas yatatahharoon
Faanjaynaahu waahlahuaa 'il laa aamraatahu qaddarnaahaa mina aal ghaabireen
Waamtarnaa 'al ayhim mmatara fasaa'a mataru aul munzareen
Qul i ail hamdu lil hi wasal aamun 'al aa 'ibaadihi ail zeena aastafaa 'aal laahu khayrun aammaa tushrikoon

'amman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda waanzal a lakum mmina aas-samaa'i maa' faanbatnaa bihi hadaa'iqa zaata bahjat mmaa kaana lakumuaa 'an tunbitu shajarahaa 'al aah mma'a aal laahi bal hum qawm ya'dil oon
'amman ja'al a aal aarda qaraara waja'al a khil aal ahaa 'anhaara waja'al a lahaa rawaaseea waja'al a bayna aal bahrayni haajizaan aal aah mma'a aal laahi bal a aaktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
'ammany yyujeebu aul mudtarra 'izaa da'aahu wayakshifu aus-sooaa'a wayaj'al ukum khul afaa'a aal aardi 'al aah mma'a aal laahi qal eela mmaa tazzakkaroon
'ammany yyahdeekum fi zul umaati ail barri waal bahri wamany yyursil u aur-reeaaha nushuraa bayna yada rahmatihiaa 'al aah mma'a aal laahi ta'aal aa aal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
'ammany yyabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu wamany yyarzuqukum mmina aas-samaa'i waal aardi 'al aah mma'a aal laahi qul haatu burhaanakumuaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-laa ya'lamu man fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi ail ghayba 'il laa aal laahu wamaa yash'uroona 'ayyaana yub'athoon
Bal i aiddaaraka 'il muhum fi ail aakhirati bal hum fi shakk mminhaa bal hum mminhaa 'amoon
Waqaal a aal zeena kafarooaa 'izaa kunnaa turaaba wa'aabaa'unaa 'a'innaa lamukhrajoon
Laqad wu'idnaa haazaa nahnu wa'aabaa'unaa min qablu 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul aawwal een
Qul seeru fi ail aardi faanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mujrimeen
Wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim wal aa takun fi dayq mmimmaa yamkuroon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul 'asaa 'any yyakoona radifa lakum ba'du aul zi tasta'jil oon
Wainna rabbaka lazoo fadlin 'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa yashkuroon
Wainna rabbaka laya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu'linoon
Wamaa min ghaa'ibat fi ais-samaa'i waal aardi 'il laa fi kitaab mmubeen
Ainna haazaa aal qur'aana yaqussu 'al aa baniaa 'israa'eela 'akthara aal zi hum feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wainnahu lahuda warahmat llil moomineen
'inna rabbaka yaqdi baynahum bihukmihi wahooa aal'azeezu aul'al eem
Fatawakkal 'al aa aal laahi 'innaka 'al aa aal haqqi ail mubeen
'innaka laa tusmi'u aul mawtaa wal aa tusmi'u aus-summa aad-du'aa'a azaa wal lawa mudbireen
Wamaa 'anta bihaadi ail'umyi 'an dal aal atihimuaa 'in tusmi'u 'il laa many yyoominu biayaatinaa fahum mmuslimoon
Waizaa waqa'a aal qawlu 'al ayhimuaa 'akhrajnaa lahum daabbat mmina aal aardi tukal limuhumuaa 'inna aan-naasa kaanu biayaatinaa laa yooqinoon
Wayawma nahshuru min kul li 'ummat fawja mmimmany yyukazzibu biayaatinaa fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'oo qaal a 'akazzabtum biayaati wal am tuheetu bihaa 'il maan aammaazaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wawaqa'a aal qawlu 'al ayhim bimaa zal amu fahum laa yantiqoon
'al am yarawaa aannaa ja'al naa aal yla leeaskunu feehi waan-nahaara mubsiraan ainna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yoominoon
Wayawma yunfakhu fi ais-soori fafazi'a man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail aardi 'il laa man shaa'a aal laahu wakul lun aatoohu daakhireen
Wataraa aal jibaal a tahsibuhaa jaamidat waheea tamurru marra aas-sahaabi sun'a aal laahi ail ziaa 'atqana kul la sha'in ainnahu khabeeru bimaa taf'al oon
Man jaa'a bial hasanati fal ahu khayr mminhaa wahum mmin faza'i yawma'izin aaminoon
Waman jaa'a bias-sayyeeati fakubbat wujoohuhum fi ain-nari hal tujzawna 'il laa maa kuntum ta'mal oon
'innamaa 'umirtu 'ana aa'buda rabba haazihi ail bal dati ail zi harramahaa wal ahu kul lu sha' waumirtu 'ana aakoona mina aal muslimeen
Waana aatlooaa aal qur'aana famani aihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadi linafsihi waman dal la faqul i ainnamaa 'anaa mina aal munzireen
Waqul i ail hamdu lil hi sayureekumuaa 'ayaatihi fata'rifoonahaa wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Tasiaammiaa til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail mubeen
Natlu 'al ayka min nnabai moosaa wafir'awna bial haqqi liqawm yoominoon
'inna fir'awna 'al aa fi ail aardi waja'al a 'ahlahaa sheea'a yastad'ifu taa'ifat mminhum yuzabbihu 'abnaa'ahum wayastahyi nisaa'ahumuaa 'innahu kaana mina aal mufsideen
Wanureedu 'an nnamunna 'al aa aal zeena aastud'ifu fi ail aardi wanaj'al ahumuaa 'a'immat wanaj'al ahumu aul waaritheen
Wanumakkina lahum fi ail aardi wanureea fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa minhum mmaa kaanu yahzaroon
Waawhaynaa 'il aa 'ummi moosaa 'ana aardi'eehi faizaa khifti 'al ayhi faal qeehi fi ail yammi wal aa takhaafi wal aa tahzaniaa 'innaa raaddoohu 'il ayki wajaa'il oohu mina aal mursal een
Faal taqatahuaa 'aal u fir'awna leeakoona lahum 'adoowa wahazanaan ainna fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa kaanu khaatieen
Waqaal ati aimraatu fir'awna qurratu 'ayn lli wal aka laa taqtul oohu 'asaa 'any yyanfa'anaa 'aw nattakhizahu wal ada wahum laa yash'uroon
Waasbaha fu'aadu 'ummi moosaa faarighaan ain kaadat latubdi bihi lawlaa 'ar rrabatnaa 'al aa qal bihaa litakoona mina aal moomineen
Waqaal at liukhtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi 'an junub wahum laa yash'uroon
Waharramnaa 'al ayhi ail maraadi'a min qablu faqaal at hal a aadul lukum 'al aa 'ahli bayt yakful oonahu lakum wahum lahu naasihoon
Faradadnaahu 'il aa 'ummihi ka taqarra 'aynuhaa wal aa tahzana wal ita'lama 'anna wa'da aal laahi haqq wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa bal agha 'ashuddahu waastawaa 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wakazaal ika najzi ail muhsineen

Wadakhal a aal madeenata 'al aa heeni ghaflat mmina aahlihaa fawajada feehaa rajul ayni yaqtatil aani haazaa min shee'atihi wahaazaa min 'adoowihi faastaghaathahu aul zi min shee'atihi 'al aa aal zi min 'adoowihi fawakazahu moosaa faqadaa 'al ayhi qaal a haazaa min 'amal i aish-shaytaani 'innahu 'adoow mmudil l mmubeen
Qaal a rabbi 'inni zal amtu nafsi faaghfir li faghafara lahuaa 'innahu hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Qaal a rabbi bimaa 'an'amta 'al ayya fal ana aakoona zaheera llil mujrimeen
Faasbaha fi ail madeenati khaa'ifa yataraqqabu faizaa aal zi aistansarahu bial aamsi yastasrikhuhu qaal a lahu moosaa 'innaka laghaweey mmubeen

Fal ammaa 'ana aaraada 'any yyabtisha bial zi hooa 'adoow llaahumaa qaal a yaamoosaa 'atureedu 'an taqtul ani kamaa qatal ta nafsaa bial aamsi 'in tureedu 'il laa 'an takoona jabbaara fi ail aardi wamaa tureedu 'an takoona mina aal musliheen
Wajaa'a rajul mmina aaqsaa aal madeenati yas'aa qaal a yaamoosaa 'inna aal mal aa yaatamiroona bika leeaqtul ooka faakhruji ainni laka mina aan-naasiheen
Fakharaja minhaa khaa'ifa yataraqqabu qaal a rabbi najjini mina aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wal ammaa tawajjaha til qaa'a madyana qaal a 'asaa rabbeea 'any yyahdeeani sawaa'a aas-sabeel
Wal ammaa warada maa'a madyana wajada 'al ayhi 'ummat mmina aan-naasi yasqoon
Wawajada min doonihimu aumraatayni tazoodaani qaal a maa khatbukumaa qaal ataa laa nasqi hattaa yusdira aar-ri'aa'u waaboonaa shaykh kabeer
Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawal laa 'il aa aaz-zil li faqaal a rabbi 'inni limaa 'anzal ta 'il ayya min khayr faqeer

Fajaa'athu 'ihdyaahumaa tamshi 'al aa aastihyaa' qaal ati ainna 'abi yad'ooka leeajzeeaka 'ajra maa saqayta lanaa fal ammaa jaa'ahu waqassa 'al ayhi ail qasasa qaal a laa takhaf najawta mina aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Qaal ati aihdyaahumaa yaabati aistaajirhu 'inna khayra mani aistaajarta aal qaweeyu aul aameen

Qaal a 'inneea 'ureedu 'anu ankihaka 'ihdaa aabnatayya haatayni 'al aa 'an taajurani thamaaneea hijaj faina aatmamta 'ashra famin 'indika wamaa 'ureedu 'ana aashuqqa 'al ayka satajiduneea 'in shaa'a aal laahu mina aas-saal iheen
Qaal a zaal ika bayni wabaynaka 'ayyamaa aal aajal ayni qadaytu fal aa 'udwaana 'al ayya waal laahu 'al aa maa naqoolu wakeel

Fal ammaa qadaa moosaa aal aajal a wasaara biahlihiaa 'aanasa min jaanibi ait-toori naara qaal a liahlihi aimkuthooaa 'inneea 'aanastu naara lla'al leea 'aateekum mminhaa bikhabarin aaw jizwat mmina aan-nari la'al lakum tastal oon
Fal ammaa 'atyaahaa noodeea min shaatii ail waadi ail aymani fi ail buq'ati ail mubaarakati mina aash-shajarati 'any yyaamoosaa 'inneea 'anaa aal laahu rabbu aul'aal ameen
Waana aal qi 'asaaka fal ammaa r'ahaa tahtazzu kaannahaa jaann wal laa mudbira wal am yu'aqqib yaamoosaa 'aqbil wal aa takhafi ainnaka mina aal aamineen
Aasluk yadaka fi jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri sooaa' waadmumi ail ayka janaahaka mina aar-rahabi fazaanika burhaanaani mir rrabbika 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehiaa 'innahum kaanu qawma faasiqeen
Qaal a rabbi 'inni qatal tu minhum nafsa faakhaafu 'any yyaqtul oon
Waakhi haaroonu hooa 'afsahu minni lisaana faarsil hu ma'i rida yusaddiqniaa 'inneea 'akhaafu 'any yyukazziboon
Qaal a sanashuddu 'adudaka biakheeka wanaj'al u lakumaa sul taana fal aa yasil oona 'il aykumaa biayaatinaa 'antumaa wamani aittaba'akumaa aal ghaal iboon
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum mmoosaa biayaatinaa bayyinaat qaal u maa haazaa 'il laa sihr mmuftara wamaa sami'naa bihaazaa fiaa 'aabaa'inaa aal aawwal een
Waqaal a moosaa rabbeea 'a'lamu biman jaa'a bial hudaa min 'indihi waman takoonu lahu 'aaqibatu aud-dari 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon

Waqaal a fir'awnu yayyuhaa aal mal au maa 'al imtu lakum mmini ail aahin ghayri faawqid li yaahaamaanu 'al aa aat-teeni faaj'al-li sarha lla'al leea 'attal i'u 'il aa 'il aahi moosaa wainni laazunnuhu mina aal kaazibeen
Waastakbara hooa wajunooduhu fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi wazannooaa 'annahumuaa 'il aynaa laa yarji'oon
Faakhaznaahu wajunoodahu fanabaznaahum fi ail yammi faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu auz-zaal imeen
Waja'al naahumuaa 'a'immat yad'oona 'il aa aan-nari wayawma aal qeeaamati laa yunsaroon
Waatba'naahum fi haazihi aid-dunya la'nat wayawma aal qeeaamati hum mmina aal maqbooheen
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba mim ba'di maa 'ahlaknaa aal quroona aal uawlaa basaa'ira lin-naasi wahuda warahmat lla'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wamaa kunta bijaanibi ail gharbeeyi 'iz qadaynaa 'il aa moosaa aal aamra wamaa kunta mina aash-shaahideen
Wal aakinnaa 'anshanaa quroona fatataawal a 'al ayhimu aul'umuru wamaa kunta thaaweea fiaa 'ahli madyana tatlu 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatinaa wal aakinnaa kunnaa mursil een
Wamaa kunta bijaanibi ait-toori 'iz naadaynaa wal aakir rrahmat mmir rrabbika litunzira qawma mmaa 'atyaahum mmin nnazeer mmin qablika la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wal awlaa 'an tuseebahum mmuseebatu bimaa qaddamata aydeehim fayaqoolu rabbanaa lawlaa 'arsal ta 'il aynaa rasoola fanattabi'a 'ayaatika wanakoona mina aal moomineen

Fal ammaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu min 'indinaa qaal u lawlaa 'ooteea mithla maa 'ooteea moosaa 'awal am yakfuru bimaa 'ooteea moosaa min qablu qaal u saahiraani tazaaharaa waqaal ooaa 'innaa bikul l kaafiroon
Qul faatu bikitaab mmin 'indi ail laahi hooa 'ahdaa minhumaa 'attabi'hu 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail llam yastajeebu laka faa'lama aannamaa yattabi'oona 'ahwaa'ahum wamana aadal lu mimmani aittaba'a hawyaahu bighayri huda mmina aal laahi 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Wal aqad wassal naa lahumu aul qawla la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba min qablihi hum bihi yoominoon
Waizaa yutlaa 'al ayhim qaal ooaa 'aamannaa bihiaa 'innahu aul haqqu mir rrabbinaa 'innaa kunnaa min qablihi muslimeen
'ul aa'ika yootawna 'ajrahum mmarratayni bimaa sabaru wayadra'oona bial hasanati ais-sayyeeata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Waizaa sami'u aul laghwa 'a'radu 'anhu waqaal u lanaa 'a'maal unaa wal akumuaa 'a'maal ukum sal aamun 'al aykum laa nabtaghi ail jaahil een
'innaka laa tahdi mana aahbabta wal aakinna aal laaha yahdi many yyashaa'u wahooa 'a'lamu bial muhtadeen

Waqaal ooaa 'in nnattabi'i ail hudaa ma'aka nutakhattaf mina aardinaa 'awal am numakkil llaahum haramaan aamina tujbaa 'il ayhi thamaraatu kul li sha' rrizqa mmil lladunnaa wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wakama aahlaknaa min qaryati batirat ma'eeshatahaa fatil ka masaakinuhum lam tuskam mmim ba'dihimuaa 'il laa qal eela wakunnaa nahnu aul waaritheen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka muhlika aal quraa hattaa yab'atha fiaa 'ummihaa rasoola yatlu 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatinaa wamaa kunnaa muhliki ail quraa 'il laa waahluhaa zaal imoon
Wamaa 'ooteetum mmin sha' famataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunya wazeenatuhaa wamaa 'inda aal laahi khayr waabqaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
'afamanw wwa'adnaahu wa'daan hasana fahooa laaqeehi kamam mmatta'naahu mataa'a aal hayawaati aid-dunya thumma hooa yawma aal qeeaamati mina aal muhdareen
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eea aal zeena kuntum taz'umoon
Qaal a aal zeena haqqa 'al ayhimu aul qawlu rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i ail zeena 'aghwaynaa 'aghwaynaahum kamaa ghawaynaa tabarranaa 'il ayka maa kaanooaa 'iyyaanaa ya'budoon
Waqeela aad'u shurakaa'akum fada'awhum fal am yastajeebu lahum waraawua aul'azaaba lawa aannahum kaanu yahtadoon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu maazaa 'ajabtumu aul mursal een
Fa'ameeat 'al ayhimu aul aanbaa'u yawma'iz fahum laa yatasaa'al oon
Faammaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a saal iha fa'asaa 'any yyakoona mina aal mufliheen
Warabbuka yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wayakhtaaru maa kaana lahumu aul kheearatu subhaana aal laahi wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Warabbuka ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu'linoon
Wahooa aal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa lahu aul hamdu fi ail uawlaa waal aakhirati wal ahu aul hukmu wail ayhi turja'oon
Qul a aaraytumuaa 'in ja'al a aal laahu 'al aykumu aul yla sarmadaan ail aa yawmi ail qeeaamati mani ail aahun ghayru aul laahi yaateekum bideeaa'in aafal aa tasma'oon
Qul a aaraytumuaa 'in ja'al a aal laahu 'al aykumu aun-nahaara sarmadaan ail aa yawmi ail qeeaamati mani ail aahun ghayru aul laahi yaateekum bil ayl taskunoona feehi 'afal aa tubsiroon
Wamir rrahmatihi ja'al a lakumu aul yla waan-nahaara litaskunu feehi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eea aal zeena kuntum taz'umoon
Wanaza'naa min kul li 'ummat shaheeda faqul naa haatu burhaanakum fa'al imooaa 'anna aal haqqa lil hi wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

'inna qaaroona kaana min qawmi moosaa fabaghaa 'al ayhim wa'aataynaahu mina aal kunoozi maa 'inna mafaatihahu latanooaau bial'usbati 'ooli ail qoowati 'iz qaal a lahu qawmuhu laa tafrahi ainna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul fariheen

Waabtaghi feemaa 'aatyaaka aal laahu aud-daara aal aakhirata wal aa tansa naseebaka mina aad-dunya waahsin kamaa 'ahsana aal laahu 'il ayka wal aa tabghi ail fasaada fi ail aardi 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul mufsideen

Qaal a 'innamaa 'ooteetuhu 'al aa 'il min 'indeea 'awal am ya'lama aanna aal laaha qada aahlaka min qablihi mina aal qurooni man hooa 'ashaddu minhu qoowat waaktharu jam'a wal aa yusal u 'an zunoobihimu aul mujrimoon
Fakharaja 'al aa qawmihi fi zeenatihi qaal a aal zeena yureedoona aal hayawaata aad-dunya yaal ayta lanaa mithla maa 'ooteea qaaroonu 'innahu lazoo hazzin 'azeem
Waqaal a aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma waylakum thawaabu aul laahi khayr llimana aamana wa'amil a saal iha wal aa yul aqqyaahaa 'il laa aas-saabiroon
Fakhasafnaa bihi wabidarihi ail aarda famaa kaana lahu min feeat yansuroonahu min dooni ail laahi wamaa kaana mina aal muntasireen

Waasbaha aal zeena tamannawa makaanahu bial aamsi yaqooloona waykaanna aal laaha yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lawlaa 'am mmanna aal laahu 'al aynaa lakhusifa binaa waykaannahu laa yuflihu aul kaafiroon
Til ka aad-daaru aul aakhiratu naj'al uhaa lil zeena laa yureedoona 'ul oowa fi ail aardi wal aa fasaada waal'aaqibatu lil muttaqeen
Man jaa'a bial hasanati fal ahu khayr mminhaa waman jaa'a bias-sayyeeati fal aa yujzaa aal zeena 'amil u aus-sayyiaati 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
'inna aal zi farada 'al ayka aal qur'aana laraadduka 'il aa ma'aad qur-rabbeea 'a'lamu man jaa'a bial hudaa waman hooa fi dal aal mmubeen
Wamaa kunta tarjooaa 'any yyul qaa 'il ayka aal kitaabu 'il laa rahmat mmir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna zaheera llil kaafireen
Wal aa yasuddunnaka 'ana ayaati ail laahi ba'da 'izu anzil ati ail ayka waad'u 'il aa rabbika wal aa takoonanna mina aal mushrikeen
Wal aa tad'u ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa  kul lu sha'in haal ikun ail laa wajhahu lahu aul hukmu wail ayhi turja'oon
'al aammiaa aahasiba aan-naasu 'any yyutrakooaa 'any yyaqoolooaa 'aamannaa wahum laa yuftanoon
Wal aqad fatannaa aal zeena min qablihim fal aya'lamanna aal laahu aul zeena sadaqu wal aya'lamanna aal kaazibeen
'am hasiba aal zeena ya'mal oona aas-sayyiaati 'any yyasbiqoonaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Man kaana yarju liqaa'a aal laahi fainna 'ajal a aal laahi laat wahooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Waman jaahada fainnamaa yujaahidu linafsihiaa 'inna aal laaha laghaneeyun 'ani ail'aal ameen
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lanukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal anajzeeannahumuaa 'ahsana aal zi kaanu ya'mal oon
Wawassaynaa aal iansaana biwaal idayhi husna wain jaahadaaka litushrika bi maa laysa laka bihi 'il m fal aa tuti'humaa 'il ayya marji'ukum faunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lanudkhil annahum fi ais-saal iheen

Wamina aan-naasi many yyaqoolu 'aamannaa bial laahi faizaa 'oozeea fi ail laahi ja'al a fitnata aan-naasi ka'azaabi ail laahi wal a'in jaa'a nasr mmir rrabbika layaqoolunna 'innaa kunnaa ma'akumuaa 'awal aysa aal laahu bia'lama bimaa fi sudoori ail'aal ameen
Wal aya'lamanna aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu wal aya'lamanna aal munaafiqeen
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lil zeena 'aamanu auttabi'u sabeelanaa wal nahmil khatayaakum wamaa hum bihaamil eena min khatayaahum mmin sha'in ainnahum lakaaziboon
Wal ayahmil unna 'athqaal ahum waathqaal a mma'a 'athqaal ihim wal ayusal unna yawma aal qeeaamati 'ammaa kaanu yaftaroon
Wal aqada aarsal naa noohaan ail aa qawmihi fal abitha feehimuaa 'al fa sanatin ail laa khamseena 'aama faakhazahumu aut-toofaanu wahum zaal imoon
Faanjaynaahu waashaaba aas-safeenati waja'al naahaa 'ayat llil'aal ameen
Waibraaheema 'iz qaal a liqawmihi ai'budu aul laaha waattaqoohu zaal ikum khayr llakumuaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

'innamaa ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi 'awthaana watakhluqoona 'ifkaan ainna aal zeena ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqa faabtaghu 'inda aal laahi air-rizqa waa'budoohu waashkuru lahuaa 'il ayhi turja'oon
Wain tukazzibu faqad kazzaba 'umam mmin qablikum wamaa 'al aa aar-rasooli 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen
'awal am yarawa kayfa yubdiu aul laahu aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhuaa 'inna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Qul seeru fi ail aardi faanzuru kayfa badaa aal khal qa thumma aal laahu yunshiu aun-nashata aal aakhirata 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Yu'azzibu many yyashaa'u wayarhamu many yyashaa'u wail ayhi tuqlaboon
Wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeena fi ail aardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'i wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Waal zeena kafaru biayaati ail laahi wal iqaa'ihiaa 'ul aa'ika ya'isu mir rrahmati waul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun aal eem
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal u auqtul oohu 'aw harriqoohu faanjyaahu aul laahu mina aan-nari 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yoominoon

Waqaal a 'innamaa aattakhazttum mmin dooni ail laahi 'awthaana mmawaddata baynakum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya thumma yawma aal qeeaamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'd wayal'anu ba'dukum ba'da wamawyaakumu aun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin nnaasireen
Faamana lahu loot waqaal a 'inni muhaajirun ail aa rabbeea 'innahu hooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Wawahabnaa lahuaa 'ishaaqa waya'qooba waja'al naa fi zurriyyatihi ain-nubooaa'ata waal kitaaba wa'aataynaahu 'ajrahu fi aid-dunya wainnahu fi ail aakhirati lamina aas-saal iheen
Wal ootaan aiz qaal a liqawmihiaa 'innakum lataatoona aal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa mina aahad mmina aal'aal ameen
'a'innakum lataatoona aar-rijaal a wataqta'oona aas-sabeel
Wataatoona fi naadeekumu aul munkara famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal u auytinaa bi'azaabi ail laahi 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Qaal a rabbi ainsurni 'al aa aal qawmi ail mufsideen
Wal ammaa jaa'at rusul unaa 'ibraaheema bial bushraa qaal ooaa 'innaa muhlikooaa 'ahli haazihi ail qaryati 'inna 'ahlahaa kaanu zaal imeen
Qaal a 'inna feehaa loota qaal u nahnu 'a'lamu biman feehaa lanunajjeeannahu waahlahuaa 'il laa aamraatahu kaanat mina aal ghaabireen
Wal ammaa 'an jaa'at rusul unaa loota saa'a bihim wadaaqa bihim zar'a waqaal u laa takhaf wal aa tahzani ainnaa munajjooka waahlaka 'il laa aamraataka kaanat mina aal ghaabireen
'innaa munzil oona 'al aa 'ahli haazihi ail qaryati rijza mmina aas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Wal aqad ttaraknaa minhaa 'ayata bayyinat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba faqaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha waarju aul yawma aal aakhira wal aa ta'thawa fi ail aardi mufsideen
Fakazzaboohu faakhazathumu aur-rajfatu faasbahu fi darihim jaathimeen
Wa'aada wathamooda waqad ttabayyana lakum mmim mmasaakinihim wazayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum fasaddahum 'ani ais-sabeeli wakaanu mustabsireen
Waqaaroona wafir'awna wahaamaana wal aqad jaa'ahum mmoosaa bial bayyinaati faastakbaru fi ail aardi wamaa kaanu saabiqeen

Fakul laan aakhaznaa bizanbihi faminhum mmana aarsal naa 'al ayhi haasiba waminhum mmana aakhazathu aus-sayhatu waminhum mman khasafnaa bihi ail aarda waminhum mmana aaghraqnaa wamaa kaana aal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Mathal u aul zeena aattakhazu min dooni ail laahi 'awleeaa'a kamathal i ail'ankabooti aittakhazat bayta wainna 'awhana aal buyooti labaytu aul'ankabooti law kaanu ya'lamoon
'inna aal laaha ya'lamu maa tad'oona min doonihi min sha' wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Watil ka aal aamthaal u nadribuhaa lin-naasi wamaa ya'qil uhaa 'il laa aal'aal imoon
Khal aqa aal laahu aus-samaawaati waal aarda bial haqqi 'inna fi zaal ika layat llil moomineen
Aatlu maa 'ooheea 'il ayka mina aal kitaabi waaqimi ais-sal awaata 'inna aas-sal awaata tanhaa 'ani ail fahshaa'i waal munkari wal azikru aul laahi 'akbaru waal laahu ya'lamu maa tasna'oon

Wal aa tujaadil ooaa 'ahla aal kitaabi 'il laa bial ti heea 'ahsanu 'il laa aal zeena zal amu minhum waqoolooaa 'aamannaa bial ziaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa waunzil a 'il aykum wail aahunaa wail aahukum waahid wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naa 'il ayka aal kitaaba faal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba yoominoona bihi wamin haa'ul aa'i many yyoominu bihi wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa aal kaafiroon
Wamaa kunta tatlu min qablihi min kitaab wal aa takhuttuhu beeameenika 'iza llaartaaba aal mubtil oon
Bal hooa 'ayaatu bayyinaat fi sudoori ail zeena 'ootu aul'il ma wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa aaz-zaal imoon
Waqaal u lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayaat mmir rrabbihi qul i ainnamaa aal ayaatu 'inda aal laahi wainnamaa 'anaa nazeer mmubeen
Aawal am yakfihimuaa 'annaa 'anzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba yutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'inna fi zaal ika larahmat wazikraa liqawm yoominoon
Qul kafaa bial laahi bayni wabaynakum shaheeda ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi waal zeena 'aamanu bial baatil i wakafaru bial laahi 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Wayasta'jil oonaka bial'azaabi wal awlaa 'ajal mmusamma llajaa'ahumu aul'azaabu wal ayaateeannahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Yasta'jil oonaka bial'azaabi wainna jahannama lamuheetatu bial kaafireen
Yawma yaghshyaahumu aul'azaabu min fawqihim wamin tahti 'arjul ihim wayaqoolu zooqu maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yaa'ibaadeea aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'inna 'ardi waasi'at faiyyaya faa'budoon
Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatu aul mawti thumma 'il aynaa turja'oon
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lanubawweeannahum mmina aal jannati ghurafa tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa ni'ma 'ajru aul'aamil een
Aal zeena sabaru wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wakayyim mmin daabbat llaa tahmil u rizqahaa aal laahu yarzuquhaa waiyyaakum wahooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara layaqoolunna aal laahu faannaa yoofakoon
Aal laahu yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lahuaa 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Wal a'in saal tahum mman nnazzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faahya bihi ail aarda mim ba'di mawtihaa layaqoolunna aal laahu qul i ail hamdu lil hi bal a aaktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Wamaa haazihi ail hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa lahw wal a'ib wainna aad-daara aal aakhirata laheea aal hayawaanu law kaanu ya'lamoon
Faizaa rakibu fi ail ful ki da'awua aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena fal ammaa najjyaahumuaa 'il aa aal barri 'izaa hum yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum wal eeatamatta'u fasawfa ya'lamoon
'awal am yarawaa aannaa ja'al naa haramaan aamina wayutakhattafu aun-naasu min hawlihimuaa 'afabial baatil i yoominoona wabini'mati ail laahi yakfuroon
Wamana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan aaw kazzaba bial haqqi lammaa jaa'ahuaa 'al aysa fi jahannama mathwa llil kaafireen
Waal zeena jaahadu feenaa lanahdeeannahum subul anaa wainna aal laaha lama'a aal muhsineen
'al aammiaa ghul ibati air-roomu fiaa 'adnaa aal aardi wahum mmim ba'di ghal abihim sayaghliboon
Fi bid'i sineen
Lil hi ail aamru min qablu wamim ba'du wayawma'iz yafrahu aul moominoon
Binasri ail laahi yansuru many yyashaa'u wahooa aal'azeezu aur-raheem
Wa'da aal laahi laa yukhlifu aul laahu wa'dahu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Ya'lamoona zaahira mmina aal hayawaati aid-dunya wahum 'ani ail aakhirati hum ghaafil oon

'awal am yatafakkaru fiaa 'anfusihim mmaa khal aqa aal laahu aus-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi waajal mmusamma wainna katheera mmina aan-naasi bil iqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiroon

'awal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim kaanooaa 'ashadda minhum qoowat waathaaru aul aarda wa'amaroohaa 'akthara mimmaa 'amaroohaa wajaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati famaa kaana aal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena 'asaau aus-sooaa 'an kazzabu biayaati ail laahi wakaanu bihaa yastahzi'oon
Aal laahu yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yublisu aul mujrimoon
Wal am yakul llaahum mmin shurakaa'ihim shufa'aa'ua wakaanu bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
Wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yawma'iz yatafarraqoon
Faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fahum fi rawdat yuhbaroon
Waammaa aal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa wal iqaa'i ail aakhirati faul aa'ika fi ail'azaabi muhdaroon
Fasubhaana aal laahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoon
Wal ahu aul hamdu fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wa'ashiyya waheena tuzhiroon
Yukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti wayukhriju aul mayyita mina aal hayyi wayuhyi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa wakazaal ika tukhrajoon
Wamina ayaatihiaa 'an khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma 'izaa 'antum bashar tantashiroon
Wamina ayaatihiaa 'an khal aqa lakum mmina aanfusikumuaa 'azwaaja llitaskunooaa 'il ayhaa waja'al a baynakum mmawaddat warahmatan ainna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wamina ayaatihi khal qu aus-samaawaati waal aardi waakhtil aafu 'al sinatikum waal waanikumuaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llil'aal ameen
Wamina ayaatihi manaamukum bial yli waan-nahari waabtighaa'ukum mmin fadlihiaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yasma'oon
Wamina ayaatihi yureekumu aul barqa khawfa watama'a wayunazzil u mina aas-samaa'i maa' fayuhyi bihi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wamina ayaatihiaa 'an taqooma aas-samaa'u waal aardu biamrihi thumma 'izaa da'aakum da'wat mmina aal aardi 'izaa 'antum takhrujoon
Wal ahu man fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi kul l llaahu qaanitoon
Wahooa aal zi yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu wahooa 'ahwanu 'al ayhi wal ahu aul mathal u aul aa'laa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Daraba lakum mmathal a mmina aanfusikum hal-lakum mmim mmaa mal akata aymaanukum mmin shurakaa'a fi maa razaqnaakum faantum feehi sawaa' takhaafoonahum kakheefatikumuaa 'anfusakum kazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'qil oon
Bal i aittaba'a aal zeena zal amooaa 'ahwaa'ahum bighayri 'il m famany yyahdi mana aadal la aal laahu wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Faaqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefa fitrata aal laahi ail ti fatara aan-naasa 'al ayhaa laa tabdeela likhal qi ail laahi zaal ika aad-deenu aul qayyimu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Muneebeena 'il ayhi waattaqoohu waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wal aa takoonu mina aal mushrikeen
Mina aal zeena farraqu deenahum wakaanu sheea'a kul lu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Waizaa massa aan-naasa durr da'awa rabbahum mmuneebeena 'il ayhi thumma 'izaa 'azaaqahum mminhu rahmatan aizaa fareeq mminhum birabbihim yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum fatamatta'u fasawfa ta'lamoon
'ama aanzal naa 'al ayhim sul taana fahooa yatakal lamu bimaa kaanu bihi yushrikoon
Waizaa 'azaqnaa aan-naasa rahmat farihu bihaa wain tusibhum sayyeeatu bimaa qaddamata aydeehimuaa 'izaa hum yaqnatoon
'awal am yarawaa aanna aal laaha yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yoominoon
Faati zaa aal qurbaa haqqahu waal miskeena waabna aas-sabeeli zaal ika khayr llil zeena yureedoona wajha aal laahi waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wamaa 'aataytum mmir rriba lliturbu fiaa 'amwaal i ain-naasi fal aa yarbu 'inda aal laahi wamaa 'aataytum mmin zakawaat tureedoona wajha aal laahi faul aa'ika humu aul mud'ifoon
Aal laahu aul zi khal aqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yyaf'al u min zaal ikum mmin sha' subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Zahara aal fasaadu fi ail barri waal bahri bimaa kasabata aydi ain-naasi leeuzeeqahum ba'da aal zi 'amil u la'al laahum yarji'oon
Qul seeru fi ail aardi faanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablu kaana 'aktharuhum mmushrikeen
Faaqim wajhaka lid-deeni ail qayyimi min qabli 'any yyaateea yawm llaa maradda lahu mina aal laahi yawma'iz yassadda'oon
Man kafara fa'al ayhi kufruhu waman 'amil a saal iha fal ianfusihim yamhadoon
Leeajzeea aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati min fadlihiaa 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul kaafireen
Wamina ayaatihiaa 'any yyursil a aar-reeaaha mubashshiraat wal eeuzeeqakum mmir rrahmatihi wal itajreea aal ful ku biamrihi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wal aqada aarsal naa min qablika rusul aan ail aa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bial bayyinaati faantaqamnaa mina aal zeena 'ajramu wakaana haqqaan 'al aynaa nasru aul moomineen

Aal laahu aul zi yursil u aur-reeaaha fatutheeru sahaaba fayabsutuhu fi ais-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wayaj'al uhu kisafa fataraa aal wadqa yakhruju min khil aal ihi faizaa 'asaaba bihi many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihiaa 'izaa hum yastabshiroon
Wain kaanu min qabli 'any yyunazzal a 'al ayhim mmin qablihi lamubliseen
Faanzuri ail aa 'athari rahmati ail laahi kayfa yuhyi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna zaal ika lamuhyi ail mawtaa wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wal a'ina aarsal naa reeha faraawhu musfarra llazal lu mim ba'dihi yakfuroon
Fainnaka laa tusmi'u aul mawtaa wal aa tusmi'u aus-summa aad-du'aa'a azaa wal lawa mudbireen
Wamaa 'anta bihaadi ail'umyi 'an dal aal atihimuaa 'in tusmi'u 'il laa many yyoominu biayaatinaa fahum mmuslimoon
Aal laahu aul zi khal aqakum mmin du'f thumma ja'al a mim ba'di du'f qoowat thumma ja'al a mim ba'di qoowat du'fa washaybat yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wahooa aal'al eemu aul qadeer
Wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yuqsimu aul mujrimoona maa labithu ghayra saa'at kazaal ika kaanu yoofakoon
Waqaal a aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma waal iaymaana laqad labithtum fi kitaabi ail laahi 'il aa yawmi ail ba'thi fahaazaa yawmu aul ba'thi wal aakinnakum kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Fayawma'iz llaa tanfa'u aul zeena zal amu ma'ziratuhum wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Wal aqad ddarabnaa lin-naasi fi haazaa aal qur'aani min kul li mathal wal a'in jeetahum biayat llayaqoolanna aal zeena kafarooaa 'ina aantumuaa 'il laa mubtil oon
Kazaal ika yatba'u aul laahu 'al aa qul oobi ail zeena laa ya'lamoon
Faasbiri ainna wa'da aal laahi haqq wal aa yastakhiffannaka aal zeena laa yooqinoon
'al aammiaa til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail hakeem
Huda warahmat llil muhsineen
Aal zeena yuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wayootoona aaz-zakawaata wahum bial aakhirati hum yooqinoon
'ul aa'ika 'al aa huda mmir rrabbihim waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wamina aan-naasi many yyashtari lahwa aal hadeethi leeudil la 'an sabeeli ail laahi bighayri 'il m wayattakhizuhaa huzu'aan awlaa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhi 'ayaatunaa wal laa mustakbira kaal llam yasma'haa kaanna fiaa 'uznayhi waqra fabashshirhu bi'azaabin aal eem
Ainna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum jannaatu aun-na'eem
Khaal ideena feehaa wa'da aal laahi haqqa wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Khal aqa aas-samaawaati bighayri 'amad tarawnahaa waal qaa fi ail aardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bikum wabaththa feehaa min kul li daabbat waanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' faanbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawj kareem
Haazaa khal qu aul laahi faarooni maazaa khal aqa aal zeena min doonihi bal i aiz-zaal imoona fi dal aal mmubeen
Wal aqada aataynaa luqmaana aal hikmata 'anu aushkur lil hi wamany yyashkur fainnamaa yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna aal laaha ghaneeyun hameed
Waiz qaal a luqmaanu liabnihi wahooa ya'izuhu yaabunayyi laa tushrik bial laahi 'inna aash-shirka lazul mun 'azeem
Wawassaynaa aal iansaana biwaal idayhi hamal athu 'ummuhu wahnaan 'al aa wahn wafisaal uhu fi 'aamayni 'anu aushkur li wal iwaal idayka 'il ayya aal maseer

Wain jaahadaaka 'al aa 'an tushrika bi maa laysa laka bihi 'il m fal aa tuti'humaa wasaahibhumaa fi aid-dunya ma'roofa waattabi' sabeela mana aanaaba 'il ayya thumma 'il ayya marji'ukum faunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yaabunayyi 'innahaa 'in taku mithqaal u habbat mmin khardal fatakun fi sakhratin aaw fi ais-samaawaati 'aw fi ail aardi yaati bihaa aal laahu 'inna aal laaha lateefun khabeer
Yaabunayyi 'aqimi ais-sal awaata waamur bial ma'roofi waanha 'ani ail munkari waasbir 'al aa maa 'asaabaka 'inna zaal ika min 'azmi ail uamoor
Wal aa tusaa'ir khaddaka lin-naasi wal aa tamshi fi ail aardi marahaan ainna aal laaha laa yuhibbu kul la mukhtaal fakhoor
Waaqsid fi mashyika waaghdud min sawtika 'inna 'ankara aal aaswaati lasawtu aul hameer

'al am tarawaa aanna aal laaha sakhkhara lakum mmaa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi waasbagha 'al aykum ni'amahu zaahirat wabaatinat wamina aan-naasi many yyujaadil u fi ail laahi bighayri 'il m wal aa huda wal aa kitaab mmuneer
Waizaa qeela lahumu auttabi'u maa 'anzal a aal laahu qaal u bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana aash-shaytaanu yad'oohumuaa 'il aa 'azaabi ais-sa'eer
Wamany yyuslim wajhahuaa 'il aa aal laahi wahooa muhsin faqadi aistamsaka bial'urwati ail wuthqaa wail aa aal laahi 'aaqibatu aul uamoor
Waman kafara fal aa yuhzinka kufruhuaa 'il aynaa marji'uhum fanunabbeeuhum bimaa 'amil ooaa 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Numatti'uhum qal eela thumma nadtarruhumuaa 'il aa 'azaabin ghal eez
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda layaqoolunna aal laahu qul i ail hamdu lil hi bal a aaktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi 'inna aal laaha hooa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed
Wal awa aannamaa fi ail aardi min shajaratin aaqlaam waal bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu 'abhur mmaa nafidat kal imaatu aul laahi 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Mmaa khal qukum wal aa ba'thukumuaa 'il laa kanafs waahidatin ainna aal laaha samee'u baseer

Aal am tara 'anna aal laaha yooliju aul yla fi ain-nahari wayooliju aun-nahaara fi ail yli wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara kul l yajriaa 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma waanna aal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu waanna maa tad'oona min doonihi ail baatil u waanna aal laaha hooa aal'al eeyu aul kabeer
'al am tara 'anna aal ful ka tajri fi ail bahri bini'mati ail laahi leeureeakum mmina ayaatihiaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbar shakoor
Waizaa ghasheeahum mmawj kaaz-zul al i da'awua aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena fal ammaa najjyaahumuaa 'il aa aal barri faminhum mmuqtasid wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa kul lu khattar kafoor

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auttaqu rabbakum waakhshawa yawma llaa yajzi waal idun 'anw wwal adihi wal aa mawloodun hooa jaazin 'anw wwaal idihi shayaan ainna wa'da aal laahi haqq fal aa taghurrannakumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunya wal aa yaghurrannakum bial laahi ail gharoor

'inna aal laaha 'indahu 'il mu aus-saa'ati wayunazzil u aul ghaytha waya'lamu maa fi ail aarhaami wamaa tadri nafs mmaazaa taksibu ghada wamaa tadri nafsu biayyi 'ard tamootu 'inna aal laaha 'al eemun khabeer
Aal aammiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'am yaqooloona aaftaryaahu bal hooa aal haqqu mir rrabbika litunzira qawma mmaa 'atyaahum mmin nnazeer mmin qablika la'al laahum yahtadoon
Aal laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi maa lakum mmin doonihi minw wwal eey wal aa shafee'in aafal aa tatazakkaroon
Yudabbiru aul aamra mina aas-samaa'i al aa aal aardi thumma ya'ruju 'il ayhi fi yawm kaana miqdaaruhuaa 'al fa sanat mmimmaa ta'uddoon
Zaal ika 'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati ail'azeezu aur-raheem
Aul ziaa 'ahsana kul la sha'in khal aqahu wabadaa khal qa aal iansaani min teen
Thumma ja'al a naslahu min sul aal at mmim mmaa' mmaheen
Thumma sawwyaahu wanafakha feehi mir rroohihi waja'al a lakumu aus-sam'a waal aabsaara waal aafidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Waqaal ooaa 'azaa dal al naa fi ail aardi 'innaa lafi khal q jadeed
Bal hum bil iqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
Qul yatawaffyaakum mmal aku aul mawti ail zi wukkil a bikum thumma 'il aa rabbikum turja'oon
Wal aw taraa 'izi ail mujrimoona naakisu ru'oosihim 'inda rabbihim rabbanaa 'absarnaa wasami'naa faarji'naa na'mal saal ihaan ainnaa mooqinoon
Wal aw sheenaa laataynaa kul la nafsin hudyaahaa wal aakin haqqa aal qawlu minni laamlaanna jahannama mina aal jinnati waan-naasi 'ajma'een
Fazooqu bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa 'innaa naseenaakum wazooqu 'azaaba aal khul di bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
'innamaa yoominu biayaatinaa aal zeena 'izaa zukkiru bihaa kharru sujjada wasabbahu bihamdi rabbihim wahum laa yastakbiroon
Tatajaafaa junoobuhum 'ani ail madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfa watama'a wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Fal aa ta'lamu nafs mmaa 'ukhfeea lahum mmin qurrati 'a'yun jazaa'a bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
'afaman kaana moomina kaman kaana faasiqa llaa yastawun
'ammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fal ahum jannaatu aul mawaa nuzul aa bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waammaa aal zeena fasaqu famawyaahumu aun-naaru kul lamaa 'araadooaa 'any yyakhruju minhaa 'u'eedu feehaa waqeela lahum zooqu 'azaaba aan-nari ail zi kuntum bihi tukazziboon
Wal anuzeeqannahum mmina aal'azaabi ail aadnaa doona aal'azaabi ail aakbari la'al laahum yarji'oon
Wamana aazlamu mimman zukkira biayaati rabbihi thumma 'a'rada 'anhaa 'innaa mina aal mujrimeena muntaqimoon
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba fal aa takun fi miryat mmil lliqaa'ihi waja'al naahu huda llibaniaa 'israa'eel
Waja'al naa minhumuaa 'a'immat yahdoona biamrinaa lammaa sabaru wakaanu biayaatinaa yooqinoon
'inna rabbaka hooa yafsil u baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
'awal am yahdi lahum kama aahlaknaa min qablihim mmina aal qurooni yamshoona fi masaakinihimuaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaatin aafal aa yasma'oon
'awal am yarawaa aannaa nasooqu aul maa'a al aa aal aardi ail juruzi fanukhriju bihi zar'a taakul u minhu 'an'aamuhum waanfusuhumuaa 'afal aa yubsiroon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal fathu 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul yawma aal fathi laa yanfa'u aul zeena kafarooaa 'eemaanuhum wal aa hum yunzaroon
Faa'rid 'anhum waantaziri ainnahum mmuntaziroon
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u auttaqi ail laaha wal aa tuti'i ail kaafireena waal munaafiqeena 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan hakeem
Waattabi' maa yoohaa 'il ayka mir rrabbika 'inna aal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi wakeel

Mmaa ja'al a aal laahu lirajul mmin qal bayni fi jawfihi wamaa ja'al a 'azwaajakumu aul tazzahharoona minhunna 'ummahaatikum wamaa ja'al a 'ad'eeaa'akumuaa 'abnaa'akum zaal ikum qawlukum biafwaahikum waal laahu yaqoolu aul haqqa wahooa yahdi ais-sabeel

Aad'oohum liaabaa'ihim hooa 'aqsatu 'inda aal laahi fail llam ta'lamooaa 'aabaa'ahum faikhwaanukum fi aid-deeni wamawaal eekum wal aysa 'al aykum junaah feemaa 'akhtatum bihi wal aakim mmaa ta'ammadat qul oobukum wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheema

Ain-nabiaa'u aawlaa bial moomineena mina aanfusihim waazwaajuhuaa 'ummahaatuhum waoolu aul aarhaami ba'duhumuaa 'awlaa biba'd fi kitaabi ail laahi mina aal moomineena waal muhaajireena 'il laa 'an taf'al ooaa 'il aa 'awleeaa'ikum mma'roofa kaana zaal ika fi ail kitaabi mastoor
Waiza aakhaznaa mina aan-nabeeaaina meethaaqahum waminka wamin nnooh waibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa aabni maryama waakhaznaa minhum mmeethaaqaan ghal eez
