Waiz yaqoolu aul munaafiqoona waal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad mmaa wa'adanaa aal laahu warasooluhuaa 'il laa ghuroor

Waiz qaal at ttaa'ifat mminhum yaahla yathriba laa maqaama lakum faarji'u wayastaazinu fareeq mminhumu aun-nabiaa'a yaqooloona 'inna buyootanaa 'awrat wamaa heea bi'awratin ainy yyureedoona 'il laa firaar
Wal aw dukhil at 'al ayhim mmina aaqtarihaa thumma su'il u aul fitnata laatawhaa wamaa tal abbathu bihaa 'il laa yaseer
Wal aqad kaanu 'aahadu aul laaha min qablu laa yooal loona aal aadbaara wakaana 'ahdu aul laahi masool
Qul-lany yyanfa'akumu aul firaaru 'in farartum mmina aal mawti 'awi ail qatli waiza llaa tumatta'oona 'il laa qal eel
Qul man zaa aal zi ya'simukum mmina aal laahi 'ina aaraada bikum sooaa'aan aawa aaraada bikum rahmat wal aa yajidoona lahum mmin dooni ail laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Qad ya'lamu aul laahu aul mu'awwiqeena minkum waal qaa'il eena liikhwaanihim hal umma 'il aynaa wal aa yaatoona aal basa 'il laa qal eela

Aashihhatan 'al aykum faizaa jaa'a aal khawfu raytahum yanzuroona 'il ayka tadooru 'a'yunuhum kaal zi yughshaa 'al ayhi mina aal mawti faizaa zahaba aal khawfu sal aqookum bial sinatin hidaadin aashihhatan 'al aa aal khayri 'ul aa'ika lam yoominu faahbata aal laahu 'a'maal ahum wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Yahsiboona aal aahzaaba lam yazhabu wainy yyaati ail aahzaabu yawaddu lawa aannahum baadoona fi ail aa'raabi yasal oona 'ana aanbaa'ikum wal aw kaanu feekum mmaa qaatal ooaa 'il laa qal eel
Llaqad kaana lakum fi rasooli ail laahi 'iswatun hasanat lliman kaana yarju aul laaha waal yawma aal aakhira wazakara aal laaha katheer
Wal ammaa ra'aa aal moominoona aal aahzaaba qaal u haazaa maa wa'adanaa aal laahu warasooluhu wasadaqa aal laahu warasooluhu wamaa zaadahumuaa 'il laa 'eemaana watasleem
Mmina aal moomineena rijaal sadaqu maa 'aahadu aul laaha 'al ayhi faminhum mman qadaa nahbahu waminhum mmany yyantaziru wamaa baddal u tabdeel
Lleeajzeea aal laahu aus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wayu'azziba aal munaafiqeena 'in shaa'a aw yatooba 'al ayhimuaa 'inna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Waradda aal laahu aul zeena kafaru bighayzihim lam yanaal u khayra wakafaa aal laahu aul moomineena aal qitaal a wakaana aal laahu qawiyyaan 'azeez
Waanzal a aal zeena zaaharoohum mmina aahli ail kitaabi min sayaaseehim waqazafa fi qul oobihimu aur-ru'ba fareeqa taqtul oona wataasiroona fareeq
Waawrathakumuaa 'ardahum wadeeaarahum waamwaal ahum waarda llam tataoohaa wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u qul-liazwaajika 'in kuntunna turidna aal hayawaata aad-dunya wazeenatahaa fata'aal ayna 'umatti'kunna wausarrihkunna saraaha jameel
Wain kuntunna turidna aal laaha warasoolahu waad-daara aal aakhirata fainna aal laaha 'a'adda lil muhsinaati minkunna 'ajraan 'azeem
Yaanisaa'a aan-nabiaa'i many yyaati minkunna bifaahishat mmubayyinat yudaa'af lahaa aal'azaabu di'fayni wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Wamany yyaqnut minkunna lil hi warasoolihi wata'mal saal iha nnootihaa 'ajrahaa marratayni waa'tadnaa lahaa rizqa kareem
Yaanisaa'a aan-nabiaa'i lastunna kaahad mmina aan-nisaa'i ani aittaqaytunna fal aa takhda'na bial qawli fayatma'a aal zi fi qal bihi marad waqul na qawla mma'roof

Waqarna fi buyootikunna wal aa tabarrajna tabarruja aal jaahil iyyati ail uawlaa waaqimna aas-sal awaata wa'aateena aaz-zakawaata waati'na aal laaha warasoolahuaa 'innamaa yureedu aul laahu leeuzhiba 'ankumu aur-rijsa 'ahla aal bayti wayutahhirakum tatheer
Waazkurna maa yutlaa fi buyootikunna mina ayaati ail laahi waal hikmati 'inna aal laaha kaana lateefaan khabeera

Ainna aal muslimeena waal muslimaati waal moomineena waal moominaati waal qaaniteena waal qaanitaati waas-saadiqeena waas-saadiqaati waas-saabireena waas-saabiraati waal khaashi'eena waal khaashi'aati waal mutasaddiqeena waal mutasaddiqaati waas-saa'imeena waas-saa'imaati waal haafizeena furoojahum waal haafizaati waaz-zaakireena aal laaha katheera waaz-zaakiraati 'a'adda aal laahu lahum mmaghfirat waajraan 'azeem
Wamaa kaana limoominw wal aa moominatin aizaa qadaa aal laahu warasooluhuaa 'amraan aan takoona lahumu aul kheearatu mina aamrihim wamany yya'si ail laaha warasoolahu faqad ddal la dal aal a mmubeen

Waiz taqoolu lil ziaa 'an'ama aal laahu 'al ayhi waan'amta 'al ayhi 'amsik 'al ayka zawjaka waattaqi ail laaha watukhfi fi nafsika maa aal laahu mubdeehi watakhshaa aan-naasa waal laahu 'ahaqqu 'an takhshyaahu fal ammaa qadaa zayd mminhaa watara zawwajnaakahaa lika laa yakoona 'al aa aal moomineena haraj fiaa 'azwaaji 'ad'eeaa'ihimuaa 'izaa qadawa minhunna watara wakaana 'amru aul laahi maf'ool
Mmaa kaana 'al aa aan-nabiaa'i min haraj feemaa farada aal laahu lahu sunnata aal laahi fi ail zeena khal awa min qablu wakaana 'amru aul laahi qadara mmaqdoora
Ail zeena yubal lighoona risaal aati ail laahi wayakhshawnahu wal aa yakhshawna 'ahadaan ail laa aal laaha wakafaa bial laahi haseeb

Tahiyyatuhum yawma yal qawnahu sal aam waa'adda lahumuaa 'ajra kareem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa nakahtumu aul moominaati thumma tal laqtumoohunna min qabli 'an tamassoohunna famaa lakum 'al ayhinna min 'iddat ta'taddoonahaa famatti'oohunna wasarrihoohunna saraaha jameel

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u ainnaa 'ahlal naa laka 'azwaajaka aal tiaa 'aatayta 'ujoorahunna wamaa mal akat yameenuka mimmaa 'afaa'a aal laahu 'al ayka wabanaati 'ammika wabanaati 'ammaatika wabanaati khaal ika wabanaati khaal aatika aal ti haajarna ma'aka waamraat mmoominatan ainw wwahabat nafsahaa lin-nabiaa'i ana aaraada aan-nabiaa'u aany yyastankihahaa khaal isat llaka min dooni ail moomineena qad 'al imnaa maa faradnaa 'al ayhim fiaa 'azwaajihim wamaa mal akata aymaanuhum likaylaa yakoona 'al ayka haraj wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Turji man tashaa'u minhunna watooiaa 'il ayka man tashaa'u wamani aibtaghayta mimman 'azal ta fal aa junaaha 'al ayka zaal ika 'adnaa 'an taqarra 'a'yunuhunna wal aa yahzanna wayardayna bimaa 'aataytahunna kul luhunna waal laahu ya'lamu maa fi qul oobikum wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hal eem
Llaa yahil lu laka aan-nisaa'u mim ba'du wal aa 'an tabaddal a bihinna mina aazwaaj wal awa aa'jabaka husnuhunna 'il laa maa mal akat yameenuka wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' rraqeeb

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tadkhul u buyoota aan-nabiaa'i al laa 'any yyoozana lakumuaa 'il aa ta'aamin ghayra naazireena 'inyaahu wal aakini aizaa du'eetum faadkhul u faizaa ta'imtum faantashiru wal aa mustaaniseena lihadeethin ainna zaal ikum kaana yoozi ain-nabiaa'a fayastahyi minkum waal laahu laa yastahyi mina aal haqqi waizaa saal tumoohunna mataa'a fasal oohunna minw wwaraa'i hijaab zaal ikumuaa 'atharu liqul oobikum waqul oobihinna wamaa kaana lakumuaa 'an toozu rasoola aal laahi wal aa 'an tankihooaa 'azwaajahu mim ba'dihiaa 'abadaan ainna zaal ikum kaana 'inda aal laahi 'azeema
Ain tubdu shayaan aaw tukhfoohu fainna aal laaha kaana bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Llaa junaaha 'al ayhinna fiaa 'aabaa'ihinna wal aa 'abnaa'ihinna wal aa 'ikhwaanihinna wal aa 'abnaa'i akhwaanihinna wal aa 'abnaa'i aakhawaatihinna wal aa nisaa'ihinna wal aa maa mal akata aymaanuhunna waattaqeena aal laaha 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li sha' shaheeda
Ainna aal laaha wamal aa'ikatahu yusal loona 'al aa aan-nabiaa'i yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu sal lu 'al ayhi wasal limu tasleema
Ainna aal zeena yoozoona aal laaha warasoolahu la'anahumu aul laahu fi aid-dunya waal aakhirati waa'adda lahum 'azaaba mmuheen

Lla'il llam yantahi ail munaafiqoona waal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad waal murjifoona fi ail madeenati lanughreeannaka bihim thumma laa yujaawiroonaka feehaa 'il laa qal eel

Yasal uka aan-naasu 'ani ais-saa'ati qul i ainnamaa 'il muhaa 'inda aal laahi wamaa yudreeka la'al la aas-saa'ata takoonu qareeba
Ainna aal laaha la'ana aal kaafireena waa'adda lahum sa'eera

Yuslih lakumuaa 'a'maal akum wayaghfir lakum zunoobakum wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu faqad faaza fawzaan 'azeema
Ainnaa 'aradnaa aal aamaanata 'al aa aas-samaawaati waal aardi waal jibaal i faabayna 'any yyahmil nahaa waashfaqna minhaa wahamal ahaa aal iansaanu 'innahu kaana zal ooma jahool
Lleeu'azziba aal laahu aul munaafiqeena waal munaafiqaati waal mushrikeena waal mushrikaati wayatooba aal laahu 'al aa aal moomineena waal moominaati wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheema
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi wal ahu aul hamdu fi ail aakhirati wahooa aal hakeemu aul khabeer
Ya'lamu maa yal iju fi ail aardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzil u mina aas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa wahooa aar-raheemu aul ghafoor

Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru laa taateenaa aas-saa'atu qul bal aa warabbi lataateeannakum 'aal imu aul ghaybi laa ya'zubu 'anhu mithqaal u zarrat fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail aardi wal aa 'asgharu min zaal ika wal aa 'akbaru 'il laa fi kitaab mmubeen
Lleeajzeea aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Waal zeena sa'aw fiaa 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmir rrijzin aal eem

Wal isul aymaana aar-reeha ghudoowuhaa shahr warawaahuhaa shahr waasal naa lahu 'ayna aal qitri wamina aal jinni many yya'mal u bayna yadayhi biizni rabbihi wamany yyazigh minhum 'ana aamrinaa nuziqhu min 'azaabi ais-sa'eer
Ya'mal oona lahu maa yashaa'u mim mmahaareeba watamaatheela wajifaan kaal jawaabi waqudoor rraaseeaatin ai'mal ooaa 'aal a daawuda shukra waqal eel mmin 'ibaadeea aash-shakoor

Fal ammaa qadaynaa 'al ayhi ail mawta maa dal laahum 'al aa mawtihiaa 'il laa daabbatu aul aardi taakul u minsaatahu fal ammaa kharra tabayyanati ail jinnu 'al llaw kaanu ya'lamoona aal ghayba maa labithu fi ail'azaabi ail muheen
Laqad kaana lisaba fi masaakinihimuaa 'ayat jannataani 'any yyameen washimaal kul u mir rrizqi rabbikum waashkuru lahu bal dat tayyibat warabbun ghafoor
Faa'radu faarsal naa 'al ayhim sayla aal'arimi wabaddal naahum bijannatayhim jannatayni zawaatayu aklin khamt waathl washa' mmin sidr qal eel
Zaal ika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaru wahal yujaazaa 'il laa aal kafoor
Waja'al naa baynahum wabayna aal quraa aal ti baaraknaa feehaa qura zaahirat waqaddarnaa feehaa aas-sayra seeru feehaa layaal eea wayyaamaan aamineen
Faqaal u rabbanaa baa'id bayna 'asfarinaa wazal amooaa 'anfusahum faja'al naahumuaa 'ahaadeetha wamazzaqnaahum kul la mumazzaqin ainna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbar shakoor
Wal aqad sadaqa 'al ayhimuaa 'ibleesu zannahu faattaba'oohu 'il laa fareeqa mmina aal moomineen
Wamaa kaana lahu 'al ayhim mmin sul taanin ail laa lina'lama many yyoominu bial aakhirati mimman hooa minhaa fi shakk warabbuka 'al aa kul li sha'in hafeez
Qul u aud'u aul zeena za'amtum mmin dooni ail laahi laa yamlikoona mithqaal a zarrat fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail aardi wamaa lahum feehimaa min shirk wamaa lahu minhum mmin zaheer
Wal aa tanfa'u aush-shafaa'atu 'indahuaa 'il laa limana aazina lahu hattaa 'izaa fuzzi'a 'an qul oobihim qaal u maazaa qaal a rabbukum qaal u aul haqqa wahooa aal'al eeyu aul kabeer
Qul many yyarzuqukum mmina aas-samaawaati waal aardi qul i ail laahu wainnaa 'awi aiyyaakum la'al aa hudaan aaw fi dal aal mmubeen
Qul-laa tusal oona 'ammaa 'ajramnaa wal aa nusal u 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Qul yajma'u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bial haqqi wahooa aal fattaahu aul'al eem
Qul a aarooneea aal zeena 'al haqtum bihi shurakaa'a kal laa bal hooa aal laahu aul'azeezu aul hakeem
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa kaaffat llin-naasi basheera wanazeera wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-lakum mmee'aadu yawm llaa tastaakhiroona 'anhu saa'at wal aa tastaqdimoon

Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lan nnoomina bihaazaa aal qur'aani wal aa bial zi bayna yadayhi wal aw taraa 'izi aiz-zaal imoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhumuaa 'il aa ba'din ail qawla yaqoolu aul zeena aastud'ifu lil zeena aastakbaru lawlaa 'antum lakunnaa moomineen
Qaal a aal zeena aastakbaru lil zeena aastud'ifooaa 'anahnu sadadnaakum 'ani ail hudaa ba'da 'iz jaa'akum bal kuntum mmujrimeen

Waqaal a aal zeena aastud'ifu lil zeena aastakbaru bal makru aul yli waan-nahari 'iz taamuroonanaa 'an nnakfura bial laahi wanaj'al a lahuaa 'andaada waasarru aun-nadaamata lammaa raawua aul'azaaba waja'al naa aal aaghlaal a fiaa 'a'naaqi ail zeena kafaru hal yujzawna 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamaa 'arsal naa fi qaryat mmin nnazeerin ail laa qaal a mutrafoohaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Waqaal u nahnu 'aktharu 'amwaal a waawlaada wamaa nahnu bimu'azzabeen
Qul i ainna rabbi yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa 'amwaal ukum wal aa 'awlaadukum bial ti tuqarribukum 'indanaa zul faa 'il laa mana aamana wa'amil a saal iha faul aa'ika lahum jazaa'u aud-di'fi bimaa 'amil u wahum fi ail ghurufaati 'aaminoon
Waal zeena yas'awna fiaa 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika fi ail'azaabi muhdaroon
Qul i ainna rabbi yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lahu wamaa 'anfaqtum mmin sha' fahooa yukhlifuhu wahooa khayru aur-raaziqeen
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil mal aa'ikati 'ahaa'ul aa'i ayyaakum kaanu ya'budoon
Qaal u subhaanaka 'anta wal eeyunaa min doonihim bal kaanu ya'budoona aal jinna 'aktharuhum bihim mmoominoon
Faal yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'd nnaf'a wal aa darra wanaqoolu lil zeena zal amu zooqu 'azaaba aan-nari ail ti kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal u maa haazaa 'il laa rajul yureedu 'any yyasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'ukum waqaal u maa haazaa 'il laa 'ifk mmuftara waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahumuaa 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Wamaa 'aataynaahum mmin kutub yadrusoonahaa wamaa 'arsal naa 'il ayhim qablaka min nnazeer
Wakazzaba aal zeena min qablihim wamaa bal aghu mi'shaara maa 'aataynaahum fakazzabu rusul i fakayfa kaana nakeer
Qul i ainnamaa 'a'izukum biwaahidatin aan taqoomu lil hi mathnaa wafuraadaa thumma tatafakkaru maa bisaahibikum mmin jinnatin ain hooa 'il laa nazeer llakum bayna yada 'azaab shadeed
Qul maa saal tukum mmina aajr fahooa lakumuaa 'ina aajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed
Qul i ainna rabbi yaqzifu bial haqqi 'al laamu aul ghuyoob
Qul jaa'a aal haqqu wamaa yubdiu aul baatil u wamaa yu'eed
Qul i ain dal al tu fainnamaa 'adil lu 'al aa nafsi waini aihtadaytu fabimaa yoohiaa 'il ayya rabbeea 'innahu samee' qareeb
Wal aw taraa 'iz fazi'u fal aa fawta waukhizu mim mmakaan qareeb
Waqaal ooaa 'aamannaa bihi waannaa lahumu aut-tanaawushu mim mmakaani ba'eed
Waqad kafaru bihi min qablu wayaqzifoona bial ghaybi mim mmakaani ba'eed
Waheela baynahum wabayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'il a biashyaa'ihim mmin qablu 'innahum kaanu fi shakk mmureeb

Ail hamdu lil hi faatiri ais-samaawaati waal aardi jaa'il i ail mal aa'ikati rusul aan awliaa 'ajnihat mmathnaa wathul aatha warubaa'a yazeedu fi ail khal qi maa yashaa'u ainna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Mmaa yaftahi ail laahu lin-naasi mir rrahmat fal aa mumsika lahaa wamaa yumsik fal aa mursil a lahu mim ba'dihi wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auzkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum hal min khaal iqin ghayru aul laahi yarzuqukum mmina aas-samaa'i waal aardi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa toofakoon
Wainy yyukazzibooka faqad kuzzibat rusul mmin qablika wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul uamoor
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq fal aa taghurrannakumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunya wal aa yaghurrannakum bial laahi ail gharoor
'inna aash-shaytaana lakum 'adoow faattakhizoohu 'adoowaan ainnamaa yad'u hizbahu leeakoonu mina aashaabi ais-sa'eer
Ail zeena kafaru lahum 'azaab shadeed waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer

Aafaman zuyyina lahu sooaa'u 'amal ihi far'ahu hasana fainna aal laaha yudil lu many yyashaa'u wayahdi many yyashaa'u fal aa tazhab nafsuka 'al ayhim hasaraatin ainna aal laaha 'al eemu bimaa yasna'oon
Waal laahu aul ziaa 'arsal a aar-reeaaha fatutheeru sahaaba fasuqnaahu 'il aa bal ad mmayyit faahyaynaa bihi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa kazaal ika aan-nushoor

Man kaana yureedu aul'izzata fal il hi ail'izzatu jamee'aan ail ayhi yas'adu aul kal imu aut-tayyibu waal'amal u aus-saal ihu yarfa'uhu waal zeena yamkuroona aas-sayyiaati lahum 'azaab shadeed wamakru 'ul aa'ika hooa yaboor

Waal laahu khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma ja'al akumuaa 'azwaaja wamaa tahmil u minu anthaa wal aa tada'u 'il laa bi'il mihi wamaa yu'ammaru mim mmu'ammar wal aa yunqasu min 'umurihiaa 'il laa fi kitaabin ainna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer

Wamaa yastawi ail bahraani haazaa 'azb furaat saa'igh sharaabuhu wahaazaa mil hun ajaaj wamin kul l taakul oona lahma tariyya watastakhrijoona hil yat tal basoonahaa wataraa aal ful ka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon

Yooliju aul yla fi ain-nahari wayooliju aun-nahaara fi ail yli wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara kul l yajri liajal mmusamma zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum lahu aul mul ku waal zeena tad'oona min doonihi maa yamlikoona min qitmeer
Ain tad'oohum laa yasma'u du'aa'akum wal aw sami'u maa aastajaabu lakum wayawma aal qeeaamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wal aa yunabbeeuka mithlu khabeer
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'antumu aul fuqaraa'u ail aa aal laahi waal laahu hooa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed
'iny yyasha yuzhibkum wayaati bikhal q jadeed
Wamaa zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi bi'azeez

Wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa wain tad'u muthqal atun ail aa himlihaa laa yuhmal minhu sha' wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa 'innamaa tunziru aul zeena yakhshawna rabbahum bial ghaybi waaqaamu aus-sal awaata waman tazakkaa fainnamaa yatazakkaa linafsihi wail aa aal laahi ail maseer
Wamaa yastawi ail aa'maa waal baseer
Wal aa aaz-zul umaatu wal aa aan-noor
Wal aa aaz-zil lu wal aa aal haroor
Wamaa yastawi ail aahyaa'u wal aa aal aamwaatu 'inna aal laaha yusmi'u many yyashaa'u wamaa 'anta bimusmi' mman fi ail quboor
'ina aanta 'il laa nazeer
Ainnaa 'arsal naaka bial haqqi basheera wanazeera waim mminu ammatin ail laa khal aa feehaa nazeer
Wainy yyukazzibooka faqad kazzaba aal zeena min qablihim jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati wabiaz-zuburi wabial kitaabi ail muneer
Thumma 'akhazttu aul zeena kafaru fakayfa kaana nakeeria
'al am tara 'anna aal laaha 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faakhrajnaa bihi thamaraat mmukhtal ifaan aal waanuhaa wamina aal jibaal i judadu beed wahumr mmukhtal ifun aal waanuhaa wagharaabeebu sood
Wamina aan-naasi waad-dawaabbi waal aan'aami mukhtal ifun aal waanuhu kazaal ika 'innamaa yakhshaa aal laaha min 'ibaadihi ail'ul amaa'ua ainna aal laaha 'azeezun ghafoor
Ainna aal zeena yatloona kitaaba aal laahi waaqaamu aus-sal awaata waanfaqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat yarjoona tijaarat llan taboor
Leeooaffeeahumuaa 'ujoorahum wayazeedahum mmin fadlihiaa 'innahu ghafoor shakoor
Waal ziaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka mina aal kitaabi hooa aal haqqu musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi 'inna aal laaha bi'ibaadihi lakhabeeru baseer
Thumma 'awrathnaa aal kitaaba aal zeena aastafaynaa min 'ibaadinaa faminhum zaal im llinafsihi waminhum mmuqtasid waminhum saabiqu bial khayraati biizni ail laahi zaal ika hooa aal fadlu aul kabeer
Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa yuhal lawna feehaa mina aasaawira min zahab wal u'lu'a wal ibaasuhum feehaa hareer
Waqaal u aul hamdu lil hi ail ziaa 'azhaba 'annaa aal hazana 'inna rabbanaa laghafoor shakoor
Ail ziaa 'ahal lanaa daara aal muqaamati min fadlihi laa yamassunaa feehaa nasab wal aa yamassunaa feehaa lughoob
Waal zeena kafaru lahum naaru jahannama laa yuqdaa 'al ayhim fayamootu wal aa yukhaffafu 'anhum mmin 'azaabihaa kazaal ika najzi kul la kafoor

Wahum yastarikhoona feehaa rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa na'mal saal ihaan ghayra aal zi kunnaa na'mal u 'awal am nu'ammirkum mmaa yatazakkaru feehi man tazakkara wajaa'akumu aun-nazeeru fazooqu famaa liz-zaal imeena min nnaseer
Ainna aal laaha 'aal imu ghaybi ais-samaawaati waal aardi 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor

Hooa aal zi ja'al akum khal aa'ifa fi ail aardi faman kafara fa'al ayhi kufruhu wal aa yazeedu aul kaafireena kufruhum 'inda rabbihimuaa 'il laa maqta wal aa yazeedu aul kaafireena kufruhumuaa 'il laa khasaar

Qul a aaraytum shurakaa'akumu aul zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'arooni maazaa khal aqu mina aal aardi 'am lahum shirk fi ais-samaawaati 'ama aataynaahum kitaaba fahum 'al aa bayyinaat mminhu bal i ainy yya'idu auz-zaal imoona ba'duhum ba'daan ail laa ghuroora
Ainna aal laaha yumsiku aus-samaawaati waal aarda 'an tazoolaa wal a'in zaal ataa 'ina aamsakahumaa mina aahad mmim ba'dihiaa 'innahu kaana hal eemaan ghafoor
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in jaa'ahum nazeer llayakoonunna 'ahdaa mini aihdaa aal uamami fal ammaa jaa'ahum nazeer mmaa zaadahumuaa 'il laa nufoora
Aistikbaara fi ail aardi wamakra aas-sayyii wal aa yaheequ aul makru aus-sayyiu ail laa biahlihi fahal yanzuroona 'il laa sunnata aal aawwal eena fal an tajida lisunnati ail laahi tabdeel
Wal an tajida lisunnati ail laahi tahweela

Aawal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim wakaanooaa 'ashadda minhum qoowat wamaa kaana aal laahu leeu'jizahu min sha' fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail aardi 'innahu kaana 'al eema qadeer

Wal aw yooaakhizu aul laahu aun-naasa bimaa kasabu maa taraka 'al aa zahrihaa min daabbat wal aakiny yyooakhkhiruhumuaa 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faizaa jaa'a ajal uhum fainna aal laaha kaana bi'ibaadihi baseer
Yasiaa waal qur'aani ail hakeem
'innaka lamina aal mursal een
'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Tanzeelu aul'azeezi air-raheem
Litunzira qawma mmaa 'unzira 'aabaa'uhum fahum ghaafil oon
Laqad haqqa aal qawlu 'al aa 'aktharihim fahum laa yoominoon
'innaa ja'al naa fiaa 'a'naaqihimuaa 'aghlaal a faheea 'il aa aal aazqaani fahum mmuqmahoon
Waja'al naa mim bayni 'aydeehim sudda wamin khal fihim sudda faaghshaynaahum fahum laa yubsiroon
Wasawaa'un 'al ayhimuaa 'aanzartahumuaa 'am lam tunzirhum laa yoominoon
'innamaa tunziru mani aittaba'a aaz-zikra wakhasheea aar-rahmaana bial ghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfirat waajr kareem
Ainnaa nahnu nuhyi ail mawtaa wanaktubu maa qaddamu wa'aathaarahum wakul la sha'in aahsaynaahu fiaa 'imaam mmubeen
Waadrib lahum mmathal aan aashaaba aal qaryati 'iz jaa'ahaa aal mursal oon
'iza aarsal naa 'il ayhimu authnayni fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bithaal ith faqaal ooaa 'innaa 'il aykum mmursal oon
Qaal u maa 'antumuaa 'il laa bashar mmithlunaa wamaa 'anzal a aar-rahmaanu min sha'in aina aantumuaa 'il laa takziboon
Qaal u rabbunaa ya'lamu 'innaa 'il aykum lamursal oon
Wamaa 'al aynaa 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen
Qaal ooaa 'innaa tatayyarnaa bikum la'il llam tantahu lanarjumannakum wal ayamassannakum mminnaa 'azaabun aal eem
Qaal u taa'irukum mma'akumuaa 'a'in zukkirtum bal a aantum qawm mmusrifoon
Wajaa'a mina aaqsaa aal madeenati rajul yas'aa qaal a yaaqawmi aittabi'u aul mursal een
Aattabi'u mal llaa yasal ukumuaa 'ajra wahum mmuhtadoon
Wamaal eea laa 'a'budu aul zi fatarani wail ayhi turja'oon
'aattakhizu min doonihiaa 'aal ihatan ainy yyuridni air-rahmaanu bidurr llaa tughni 'anni shafaa'atuhum shaya wal aa yunqizoonia
'inneea 'iza llafi dal aal mmubeen
Ainneea 'aamantu birabbikum faasma'oon
Qeela aadkhul i ail jannata qaal a yaal ayta qawmi ya'lamoon
Bimaa ghafara li rabbi waja'al ani mina aal mukrameen
Wamaa 'anzal naa 'al aa qawmihi mim ba'dihi min jund mmina aas-samaa'i wamaa kunnaa munzil een
'in kaanati ail laa sayhat waahidat faizaa hum khaamidoon
Yaahasratan 'al aa aal'ibaadi maa yaateehim mmir rrasoolin ail laa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
'al am yarawa kama aahlaknaa qablahum mmina aal qurooni 'annahumuaa 'il ayhim laa yarji'oon
Wain kul l llamaa jamee' lladaynaa muhdaroon
Wa'ayat llaahumu aul aardu aul mayyitatu 'ahyaynaahaa waakhrajnaa minhaa habba faminhu yaakul oon
Waja'al naa feehaa jannaat mmin nnakheel waa'naab wafajjarnaa feehaa mina aal'uyoon
Leeaakul u min thamarihi wamaa 'amil athu 'aydeehimuaa 'afal aa yashkuroon
Subhaana aal zi khal aqa aal aazwaaja kul laahaa mimmaa tunbitu aul aardu wamina aanfusihim wamimmaa laa ya'lamoon
Wa'ayat llaahumu aul ylu naslakhu minhu aun-nahaara faizaa hum mmuzlimoon
Waash-shamsu tajri limustaqarr llaahaa zaal ika taqdeeru aul'azeezi ail'al eem
Waal qamaru qaddarnaahu manaazil a hattaa 'aada kaal'urjooni ail qadeem
Laa aash-shamsu yanbaghi lahaa 'an tudrika aal qamara wal aa aal ylu saabiqu aun-nahari wakul l fi fal ak yasbahoon
Wa'ayat llaahumuaa 'annaa hamal naa zurriyyaatihim fi ail ful ki ail mashhoon
Wakhal aqnaa lahum mmim mmithlihi maa yarkaboon
Wain nnasha nughriqhum fal aa sareekha lahum wal aa hum yunqazoon
'il laa rahmat mminnaa wamataa'aan ail aa heen
Waizaa qeela lahumu auttaqu maa bayna 'aydeekum wamaa khal fakum la'al lakum turhamoon
Wamaa taateehim mmina ayat mmina ayaati rabbihimuaa 'il laa kaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Waizaa qeela lahumuaa 'anfiqu mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu qaal a aal zeena kafaru lil zeena 'aamanooaa 'anut'imu mal llaw yashaa'u aul laahu 'at'amahuaa 'ina aantumuaa 'il laa fi dal aal mmubeen
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Maa yanzuroona 'il laa sayhat waahidat taakhuzuhum wahum yakhassimoon
Fal aa yastatee'oona tawseeat wal aa 'il aa 'ahlihim yarji'oon
Wanufikha fi ais-soori faizaa hum mmina aal aajdaathi 'il aa rabbihim yansil oon
Qaal u yaawaylanaa mam ba'athanaa mim mmarqadinaa haazaa maa wa'ada aar-rahmaanu wasadaqa aal mursal oon
'in kaanati ail laa sayhat waahidat faizaa hum jamee' lladaynaa muhdaroon
Faal yawma laa tuzlamu nafs shaya wal aa tujzawna 'il laa maa kuntum ta'mal oon
'inna 'ashaaba aal jannati ail yawma fi shughl faakihoon
Hum waazwaajuhum fi zil aal in 'al aa aal aaraa'iki muttakioon
Lahum feehaa faakihat wal ahum mmaa yadda'oon
Sal aam qawla mmir rrabb rraheem
Waamtaazu aul yawma 'ayyuhaa aal mujrimoon
'al ama aa'hadi ail aykum yaabaniaa 'aadama 'al llaa ta'budu aush-shaytaana 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Waanu au'budooni haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aqada aadal la minkum jibil la katheeraan aafal am takoonu ta'qil oon
Haazihi jahannamu aul ti kuntum too'adoon
Aaslawhaa aal yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Aal yawma nakhtimu 'al aa 'afwaahihim watukal limunaa 'aydeehim watashhadu 'arjul uhum bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wal aw nashaa'u latamasnaa 'al aa 'a'yunihim faastabaqu aus-siraata faannaa yubsiroon
Wal aw nashaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'al aa makaanatihim famaa aastataa'u mudiyya wal aa yarji'oon
Waman nnu'ammirhu nankushu fi ail khal qi 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wamaa 'al lamnaahu aush-shi'ra wamaa yanbaghi lahuaa 'in hooa 'il laa zikr waqur'aam mmubeen
Llitunzira man kaana hayya wayahiqqa aal qawlu 'al aa aal kaafireen
'awal am yarawaa aannaa khal aqnaa lahum mmimmaa 'amil ata aydeenaa 'an'aama fahum lahaa maal ikoon
Wazal lal naahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum waminhaa yaakul oon
Wal ahum feehaa manaafi'u wamashaaribu 'afal aa yashkuroon
Waattakhazu min dooni ail laahi 'aal ihat lla'al laahum yunsaroon
