Lahum mmin fawqihim zul al mmina aan-nari wamin tahtihim zul al zaal ika yukhawwifu aul laahu bihi 'ibaadahu yaa'ibaadi faattaqoon
Waal zeena aajtanabu aut-taaghoota 'any yya'budoohaa waanaabooaa 'il aa aal laahi lahumu aul bushraa fabashshir 'ibaad
Ail zeena yastami'oona aal qawla fayattabi'oona 'ahsanahuaa 'ul aa'ika aal zeena hadyaahumu aul laahu waul aa'ika humuaa 'oolu aul aal baab
'afaman haqqa 'al ayhi kal imatu aul'azaabi 'afaanta tunqizu man fi ain-nar
Laakini ail zeena aattaqawa rabbahum lahum ghuraf mmin fawqihaa ghuraf mmabniyyat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru wa'da aal laahi laa yukhlifu aul laahu aul mee'aad

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' fasal akahu yanaabee'a fi ail aardi thumma yukhriju bihi zar'a mmukhtal ifaan aal waanuhu thumma yaheeju fataryaahu musfarra thumma yaj'al uhu hutaamaan ainna fi zaal ika lazikraa liooli ail aal baab
'afaman sharaha aal laahu sadrahu lil iaslaami fahooa 'al aa noor mmir rrabbihi fawayl llil qaaseeati qul oobuhum mmin zikri ail laahi 'ul aa'ika fi dal aal mmubeen

Ail laahu nazzal a 'ahsana aal hadeethi kitaaba mmutashaabiha mmathaaneea taqsha'irru minhu jul oodu aul zeena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma tal eenu jul ooduhum waqul oobuhumuaa 'il aa zikri ail laahi zaal ika hudaa aal laahi yahdi bihi many yyashaa'u wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad
Aafamany yyattaqi biwajhihi sooaa'a aal'azaabi yawma aal qeeaamati waqeela liz-zaal imeena zooqu maa kuntum taksiboon
Kazzaba aal zeena min qablihim faatyaahumu aul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Faazaaqahumu aul laahu aul khizya fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wal a'azaabu aul aakhirati 'akbaru law kaanu ya'lamoon
Wal aqad ddarabnaa lin-naasi fi haazaa aal qur'aani min kul li mathal-la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Qur'aanaan 'arabiyyaan ghayra zi 'iwaj lla'al laahum yattaqoon
Daraba aal laahu mathal a rrajul a feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoona warajul a sal ama llirajul in hal yastaweeaani mathal aan ail hamdu lil hi bal a aaktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
'innaka mayyit wainnahum mmayyitoon
Thumma 'innakum yawma aal qeeaamati 'inda rabbikum takhtasimoon
Famana aazlamu mimman kazaba 'al aa aal laahi wakazzaba bias-sidqi 'iz jaa'ahuaa 'al aysa fi jahannama mathwa llil kaafireen
Waal zi jaa'a bias-sidqi wasaddaqa bihiaa 'ul aa'ika humu aul muttaqoon
Lahum mmaa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim zaal ika jazaa'ua aul muhsineen
Leeukaffira aal laahu 'anhumuaa 'aswaa aal zi 'amil u wayajzeeahumuaa 'ajrahum biahsani ail zi kaanu ya'mal oon

'al aysa aal laahu bikaafin 'abdahu wayukhawwifoonaka bial zeena min doonihi wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad wamany yyahdi ail laahu famaa lahu mim mmudil lin aal aysa aal laahu bi'azeez zi aintiqaam

Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda layaqoolunna aal laahu qul a aafaraytum mmaa tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'ina aaraadaneea aal laahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashifaatu durrihiaa 'awa aaraadani birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatihi qul hasbeea aal laahu 'al ayhi yatawakkal u aul mutawakkil oon
Qul yaaqawmi ai'mal u 'al aa makaanatikumuaa 'inni 'aamil fasawfa ta'lamoona many yyaateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi wayahil lu 'al ayhi 'azaab mmuqeem
Ainnaa 'anzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba lin-naasi bial haqqi famani aihtadaa fal inafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel

Ail laahu yatawaffaa aal aanfusa heena mawtihaa waal ti lam tamut fi manaamihaa fayumsiku aul ti qadaa 'al ayhaa aal mawta wayursil u aul uakhraa 'il aa 'ajal mmusammaan ainna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
'ami aittakhazu min dooni ail laahi shufa'aa'a qul a aawal aw kaanu laa yamlikoona shaya wal aa ya'qil oon
Qul-lil hi aish-shafaa'atu jamee'a llaahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Waizaa zukira aal laahu wahdahu aushmaazzat qul oobu aul zeena laa yoominoona bial aakhirati waizaa zukira aal zeena min doonihiaa 'izaa hum yastabshiroon
Qul i ail laahumma faatira aas-samaawaati waal aardi 'aal ima aal ghaybi waash-shahaadati 'anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika fi maa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wal awa aanna lil zeena zal amu maa fi ail aardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu laaftadawa bihi min sooaa'i ail'azaabi yawma aal qeeaamati wabadaa lahum mmina aal laahi maa lam yakoonu yahtasiboon
Wabadaa lahum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Faizaa massa aal iansaana durr da'aanaa thumma 'izaa khawwal naahu ni'mat mminnaa qaal a 'innamaa 'ooteetuhu 'al aa 'il mi bal heea fitnat wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Qad qaal ahaa aal zeena min qablihim famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Faasaabahum sayyiaatu maa kasabu waal zeena zal amu min haa'ul aa'i sayuseebuhum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wamaa hum bimu'jizeen
'awal am ya'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yoominoon
Qul yaa'ibaadeea aal zeena 'asrafu 'al aa 'anfusihim laa taqnatu mir rrahmati ail laahi 'inna aal laaha yaghfiru auz-zunooba jamee'aan ainnahu hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Waaneebooaa 'il aa rabbikum waaslimu lahu min qabli 'any yyaateeakumu aul'azaabu thumma laa tunsaroon
Waattabi'ooaa 'ahsana maa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum mmin qabli 'any yyaateeakumu aul'azaabu baghtat waantum laa tash'uroon
'an taqoola nafs yaahasrataa 'al aa maa farratttu fi janbi ail laahi wain kuntu lamina aas-saakhireen
'aw taqoola lawa aanna aal laaha hadyaani lakuntu mina aal muttaqeen
'aw taqoola heena taraa aal'azaaba lawa aanna li karrat faakoona mina aal muhsineen
Bal aa qad jaa'atka 'ayaati fakazzabta bihaa waastakbarta wakunta mina aal kaafireen
Wayawma aal qeeaamati taraa aal zeena kazabu 'al aa aal laahi wujoohuhum mmuswaddatun aal aysa fi jahannama mathwa llil mutakabbireen
Wayunajji ail laahu aul zeena aattaqawa bimafaazatihim laa yamassuhumu aus-sooaa'u wal aa hum yahzanoon
Aal laahu khaal iqu kul li sha' wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' wakeel
Llaahu maqaal eedu aus-samaawaati waal aardi waal zeena kafaru biayaati ail laahi 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Qul a aafaghayra aal laahi taamurooneea 'a'budu 'ayyuhaa aal jaahil oon
Wal aqadu awheea 'il ayka wail aa aal zeena min qablika la'ina aashrakta layahbatanna 'amal uka wal atakoonanna mina aal khaasireen
Bal i ail laaha faa'bud wakum mmina aash-shaakireen
Wamaa qadaru aul laaha haqqa qadrihi waal aardu jamee'a qabdatuhu yawma aal qeeaamati waas-samaawaatu matwiyyaatu beeameenihi subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Wanufikha fi ais-soori fasa'iqa man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail aardi 'il laa man shaa'a aal laahu thumma nufikha feehi 'ukhraa faizaa hum qeeaam yanzuroon
Waashraqati ail aardu binoori rabbihaa wawudi'a aal kitaabu wajiaa'a bian-nabeeaaina waash-shuhadaa'i waqudeea baynahum bial haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wawuffeeat kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at wahooa 'a'lamu bimaa yaf'al oon

Waseeqa aal zeena kafarooaa 'il aa jahannama zumaraan hattaa 'izaa jaa'oohaa futtihata aabwaabuhaa waqaal a lahum khazanatuhaa 'al am yaatikum rusul mminkum yatloona 'al aykumuaa 'ayaati rabbikum wayunziroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa qaal u bal aa wal aakin haqqat kal imatu aul'azaabi 'al aa aal kaafireen
Qeela aadkhul ooaa 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fabeesa mathwaa aal mutakabbireen
Waseeqa aal zeena aattaqawa rabbahumuaa 'il aa aal jannati zumaraan hattaa 'izaa jaa'oohaa wafuttihata aabwaabuhaa waqaal a lahum khazanatuhaa sal aamun 'al aykum tibtum faadkhul oohaa khaal ideen
Waqaal u aul hamdu lil hi ail zi sadaqanaa wa'dahu waawrathanaa aal aarda natabawwau mina aal jannati haythu nashaa'u fani'ma 'ajru aul'aamil een
Wataraa aal mal aa'ikata haaffeena min hawli ail'arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudeea baynahum bial haqqi waqeela aal hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Hmiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi mina aal laahi ail'azeezi ail'al eem
Ghaafiri aiz-zanbi waqaabil i ait-tawbi shadeedi ail'iqaabi zi ait-tawli laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'il ayhi ail maseer
Maa yujaadil u fiaa 'ayaati ail laahi 'il laa aal zeena kafaru fal aa yaghrurka taqal lubuhum fi ail bil aad
Kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh waal aahzaabu mim ba'dihim wahammat kul lu 'ummati birasoolihim leeaakhuzoohu wajaadal u bial baatil i leeudhidu bihi ail haqqa faakhazttuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab
Wakazaal ika haqqat kal imaatu rabbika 'al aa aal zeena kafarooaa 'annahumuaa 'ashaabu aun-nar

Ail zeena yahmil oona aal'arsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayoominoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lil zeena 'aamanu rabbanaa wasi'ta kul la sha' rrahmat wa'il ma faaghfir lil zeena taabu waattaba'u sabeelaka waqihim 'azaaba aal jaheem
Rabbanaa waadkhil hum jannaati 'adnin ail ti wa'adttahum waman sal aha mina aabaa'ihim waazwaajihim wazurriyyaatihimuaa 'innaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Waqihimu aus-sayyiaati waman taqi ais-sayyiaati yawma'iz faqad rahimtahu wazaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
'inna aal zeena kafaru yunaadawna lamaqtu aul laahi 'akbaru mim mmaqtikumuaa 'anfusakumuaa 'iz tud'awna 'il aa aal iaymaani fatakfuroon
Qaal u rabbanaa 'amattanaa aathnatayni waahyaytanaa aathnatayni faa'tarafnaa bizunoobinaa fahal i ail aa khurooj mmin sabeel
Zaal ikum biannahuaa 'izaa du'eea aal laahu wahdahu kafartum wainy yyushrak bihi toominu faal hukmu lil hi ail'al eeyi ail kabeer
Hooa aal zi yureekumuaa 'ayaatihi wayunazzil u lakum mmina aas-samaa'i rizqa wamaa yatazakkaru 'il laa many yyuneeb
Faad'u aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena wal aw kariha aal kaafiroon
Rafee'u aud-darajaati zoo aul'arshi yul qi air-rooha mina aamrihi 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi leeunzira yawma aat-tal aaq
Yawma hum baarizoona laa yakhfaa 'al aa aal laahi minhum sha' llimani ail mul ku aul yawma lil hi ail waahidi ail qahhar
Ail yawma tujzaa kul lu nafsi bimaa kasabat laa zul ma aal yawma 'inna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab
Waanzirhum yawma aal aazifati 'izi ail qul oobu ladaa aal hanaajiri kaazimeen
Maa liz-zaal imeena min hameem wal aa shafee' yutaa'
Ya'lamu khaa'inata aal aa'yuni wamaa tukhfi ais-sudoor
Waal laahu yaqdi bial haqqi waal zeena tad'oona min doonihi laa yaqdoona bisha'in ainna aal laaha hooa aas-samee'u aul baseer

'awal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena kaanu min qablihim kaanu humuaa 'ashadda minhum qoowat wa'aathaara fi ail aardi faakhazahumu aul laahu bizunoobihim wamaa kaana lahum mmina aal laahi minw wwaaq
Zaal ika biannahum kaanat ttaateehim rusul uhum bial bayyinaati fakafaru faakhazahumu aul laahu 'innahu qaweey shadeedu aul'iqaab
Wal aqada aarsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
Ail aa fir'awna wahaamaana waqaaroona faqaal u saahir kazzaab
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum bial haqqi min 'indinaa qaal u auqtul ooaa 'abnaa'a aal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu waastahyu nisaa'ahum wamaa kaydu aul kaafireena 'il laa fi dal aal
Waqaal a fir'awnu zarooniaa 'aqtul moosaa wal yad'u rabbahuaa 'inneea 'akhaafu 'any yyubaddil a deenakum waany yyuzhira fi ail aardi ail fasaad
Waqaal a moosaa 'inni 'uztu birabbi warabbikum mmin kul li mutakabbir llaa yoominu beeawmi ail hisaab

Waqaal a rajul mmoomim mmina aal i fir'awna yaktumu 'eemaanahuaa 'ataqtul oona rajul aan aany yyaqoola rabbeea aal laahu waqad jaa'akum bial bayyinaati mir rrabbikum wainy yyaku kaaziba fa'al ayhi kazibuhu wainy yyaku saadiqa yusibkum ba'du aul zi ya'idukumuaa 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi man hooa musrif kazzaab

Yaaqawmi lakumu aul mul ku aul yawma zaahireena fi ail aardi famany yyansurunaa mim basi ail laahi 'in jaa'anaa qaal a fir'awnu maa 'ureekumuaa 'il laa maa 'araa wamaa 'ahdeekumuaa 'il laa sabeela aar-rashaad
Waqaal a aal ziaa 'aamana yaaqawmi 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum mmithla yawmi ail aahzaab
Mithla dabi qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamooda waal zeena mim ba'dihim wamaa aal laahu yureedu zul ma llil'ibaad
Wayaaqawmi 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum yawma aat-tanaad
Yawma tooal loona mudbireena maa lakum mmina aal laahi min 'aasim wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad

Wal aqad jaa'akum yoosufu min qablu bial bayyinaati famaa zil tum fi shakk mmimmaa jaa'akum bihi hattaa 'izaa hal aka qul tum lany yyab'atha aal laahu mim ba'dihi rasoola kazaal ika yudil lu aul laahu man hooa musrif mmurtaab

Ail zeena yujaadil oona fiaa 'ayaati ail laahi bighayri sul taanin aatyaahum kabura maqtaan 'inda aal laahi wa'inda aal zeena 'aamanu kazaal ika yatba'u aul laahu 'al aa kul li qal bi mutakabbir jabbar
Waqaal a fir'awnu yaahaamaanu aubni li sarha lla'al leea 'ablughu aul aasbaab
'asbaaba aas-samaawaati faattal i'u 'il aa 'il aahi moosaa wainni laazunnuhu kaaziba wakazaal ika zuyyina lifir'awna sooaa'u 'amal ihi wasadda 'ani ais-sabeeli wamaa kaydu fir'awna 'il laa fi tabaab
Waqaal a aal ziaa 'aamana yaaqawmi aittabi'ooni 'ahdikum sabeela aar-rashaad
Yaaqawmi 'innamaa haazihi ail hayawaatu aud-dunya mataa' wainna aal aakhirata heea daaru aul qarar
Man 'amil a sayyeeat fal aa yujzaa 'il laa mithlahaa waman 'amil a saal iha mmin zakarin aawu anthaa wahooa moomin faul aa'ika yadkhul oona aal jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighayri hisaab
Wayaaqawmi maa leea 'ad'ookumuaa 'il aa aan-najawaati watad'oonaniaa 'il aa aan-nar
Tad'oonani liakfura bial laahi waushrika bihi maa laysa li bihi 'il m waanaa 'ad'ookumuaa 'il aa aal'azeezi ail ghaffaar
Laa jarama 'annamaa tad'oonaniaa 'il ayhi laysa lahu da'wat fi aid-dunya wal aa fi ail aakhirati waanna maraddanaa 'il aa aal laahi waanna aal musrifeena humuaa 'ashaabu aun-nar
Fasatazkuroona maa 'aqoolu lakum waufawwidu 'amreea 'il aa aal laahi 'inna aal laaha baseeru bial'ibaad
Fawaqyaahu aul laahu sayyiaati maa makaru wahaaqa biaal i fir'awna sooaa'u aul'azaab
Ain-naaru yu'radoona 'al ayhaa ghudoowa wa'ashiyya wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu 'adkhil ooaa 'aal a fir'awna 'ashadda aal'azaab
Waiz yatahaajjoona fi ain-nari fayaqoolu aud-du'afaa'ua lil zeena aastakbarooaa 'innaa kunnaa lakum taba'a fahal a aantum mmughnoona 'annaa naseeba mmina aan-nar
Qaal a aal zeena aastakbarooaa 'innaa kul l feehaa 'inna aal laaha qad hakama bayna aal'ibaad
Waqaal a aal zeena fi ain-nari likhazanati jahannama aad'u rabbakum yukhaffif 'annaa yawma mmina aal'azaab
Qaal ooaa 'awal am taku taateekum rusul ukum bial bayyinaati qaal u bal aa qaal u faad'u wamaa du'aa'ua aul kaafireena 'il laa fi dal aal
Ainnaa lanansuru rusul anaa waal zeena 'aamanu fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wayawma yaqoomu aul aashhaad
Yawma laa yanfa'u auz-zaal imeena ma'ziratuhum wal ahumu aul la'natu wal ahum sooaa'u aud-dar
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal hudaa waawrathnaa baniaa 'israa'eela aal kitaaba huda wazikraa liooli ail aal baab
Faasbiri ainna wa'da aal laahi haqq waastaghfir lizanbika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bial'asheeyi waal iabkaar

'inna aal zeena yujaadil oona fiaa 'ayaati ail laahi bighayri sul taanin aatyaahumuaa 'in fi sudoorihimuaa 'il laa kibr mmaa hum bibaal igheehi faasta'iz bial laahi 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul baseer
Lakhal qu aus-samaawaati waal aardi 'akbaru min khal qi ain-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa yastawi ail aa'maa waal baseer
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati wal aa aal musiaa'u qal eela mmaa yatazakkaroon
'inna aas-saa'ata laateeat llaa rayba feehaa wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yoominoon
Waqaal a rabbukumu aud'ooniaa 'astajib lakumuaa 'inna aal zeena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadati sayadkhul oona jahannama daakhireen
Aal laahu aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul yla litaskunu feehi waan-nahaara mubsiraan ainna aal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum khaal iqu kul li sha' llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa toofakoon
Kazaal ika yoofaku aul zeena kaanu biayaati ail laahi yajhadoon

Aal laahu aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul aarda qaraara waas-samaa'a binaa' wasawwarakum faahsana sooarakum warazaqakum mmina aat-tayyibaati zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum fatabaaraka aal laahu rabbu aul'aal ameen
Hooa aal hayyu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faad'oohu mukhliseena lahu aud-deena aal hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Qul i ainni nuheetu 'ana aa'buda aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi lammaa jaa'aneea aal bayyinaatu mir rrabbi waumirtu 'anu aslima lirabbi ail'aal ameen

Hooa aal zi khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma min 'al aqat thumma yukhrijukum tifla thumma litablughooaa 'ashuddakum thumma litakoonu shuyookha waminkum mmany yyutawaffaa min qablu wal itablughooaa 'ajal a mmusamma wal a'al lakum ta'qil oon
Hooa aal zi yuhyi wayumeetu faizaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena yujaadil oona fiaa 'ayaati ail laahi 'annaa yusrafoon
Aal zeena kazzabu bial kitaabi wabimaa 'arsal naa bihi rusul anaa fasawfa ya'lamoon
'izi ail aaghlaal u fiaa 'a'naaqihim waas-sal aasil u yushaboon
Fi ail hameemi thumma fi ain-nari yusjaroon
Thumma qeela lahumuaa 'ayna maa kuntum tushrikoona min dooni ail laahi qaal u dal lu 'annaa bal-lam nakun nnad'u min qablu shaya kazaal ika yudil lu aul laahu aul kaafireen
Zaal ikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi wabimaa kuntum tamrahoon
Aadkhul ooaa 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fabeesa mathwaa aal mutakabbireen
Faasbiri ainna wa'da aal laahi haqq faimmaa nureeannaka ba'da aal zi na'iduhumuaa 'aw natawaffayannaka fail aynaa yurja'oon

Wal aqada aarsal naa rusul a mmin qablika minhum mman qasasnaa 'al ayka waminhum mmal llam naqsus 'al ayka wamaa kaana lirasoolin aany yyaateea biayatin ail laa biizni ail laahi faizaa jaa'a amru aul laahi qudeea bial haqqi wakhasira hunaal ika aal mubtil oon
Aal laahu aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul aan'aama litarkabu minhaa waminhaa taakul oon
Wal akum feehaa manaafi'u wal itablughu 'al ayhaa haajat fi sudoorikum wa'al ayhaa wa'al aa aal ful ki tuhmal oon
Wayureekumuaa 'ayaatihi fayya 'ayaati ail laahi tunkiroon
'afal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim kaanooaa 'akthara minhum waashadda qoowat wa'aathaara fi ail aardi famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Fal ammaa jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati farihu bimaa 'indahum mmina aal'il mi wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Fal ammaa raawa basanaa qaal ooaa 'aamannaa bial laahi wahdahu wakafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihi mushrikeen
Fal am yaku yanfa'uhumuaa 'eemaanuhum lammaa raawa basanaa sunnata aal laahi ail ti qad khal at fi 'ibaadihi wakhasira hunaal ika aal kaafiroon
Hmiaa tanzeel mmina aar-rahmaani air-raheem
Kitaab fussil ata ayaatuhu qur'aanaan 'arabiyya lliqawm ya'lamoon
Basheera wanazeera faa'rada 'aktharuhum fahum laa yasma'oon
Waqaal u qul oobunaa fiaa 'akinnat mmimmaa tad'oonaa 'il ayhi wafiaa 'aazaaninaa waqr wamim bayninaa wabaynika hijaab faa'mal i ainnanaa 'aamil oon
Qul i ainnamaa 'anaa bashar mmithlukum yoohaa 'il ayya 'annamaa 'il aahukumuaa 'il aah waahid faastaqeemooaa 'il ayhi waastaghfiroohu wawayl llil mushrikeen
Aal zeena laa yootoona aaz-zakawaata wahum bial aakhirati hum kaafiroon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahumuaa 'ajrun ghayru mamnoon
Qul a aa'innakum latakfuroona bial zi khal aqa aal aarda fi yawmayni wataj'al oona lahuaa 'andaada zaal ika rabbu aul'aal ameen
Waja'al a feehaa rawaaseea min fawqihaa wabaaraka feehaa waqaddara feehaa 'aqwaatahaa fiaa 'arba'ati 'ayyaam sawaa' llis-saa'il een
Thumma aastawaa 'il aa aas-samaa'i waheea dukhaan faqaal a lahaa wal il aardi aeeteeaa taw'aan aaw karha qaal ataa 'ataynaa taa'i'een
Faqadyaahunna sab'a samaawaat fi yawmayni waawhaa fi kul li samaa'in aamrahaa wazayyannaa aas-samaa'a aad-dunya bimasaabeeha wahifza zaal ika taqdeeru aul'azeezi ail'al eem
Faina aa'radu faqul a aanzartukum saa'iqat mmithla saa'iqati 'aad wathamood
'iz jaa'athumu aur-rusul u mim bayni 'aydeehim wamin khal fihimuaa 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laa aal laaha qaal u law shaa'a rabbunaa laanzal a mal aa'ikat fainnaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon

Faammaa 'aad faastakbaru fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi waqaal u mana aashaddu minnaa qoowatan aawal am yarawaa aanna aal laaha aal zi khal aqahum hooa 'ashaddu minhum qoowat wakaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Faarsal naa 'al ayhim reeha sarsara fiaa 'ayyaam nnahsaat llinuzeeqahum 'azaaba aal khizyi fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wal a'azaabu aul aakhirati 'akhzaa wahum laa yunsaroon
Waammaa thamoodu fahadaynaahum faastahabbu aul'amaa 'al aa aal hudaa faakhazathum saa'iqatu aul'azaabi ail hooni bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wanajjaynaa aal zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wayawma nahshuru 'a'daa'a aal laahi 'il aa aan-nari fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa 'izaa maa jaa'oohaa shahida 'al ayhim sam'uhum waabsaaruhum wajul ooduhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waqaal u lijul oodihim lima shahidttum 'al aynaa qaal ooaa 'antaqanaa aal laahu aul ziaa 'antaqa kul la sha' wahooa khal aqakumuaa 'awwal a marrat wail ayhi turja'oon
Wamaa kuntum tastatiroona 'any yyashhada 'al aykum sam'ukum wal aa 'absaarukum wal aa jul oodukum wal aakin zanantumuaa 'anna aal laaha laa ya'lamu katheera mmimmaa ta'mal oon
Wazaal ikum zannukumu aul zi zanantum birabbikumuaa 'ardyaakum faasbahtum mmina aal khaasireen
Fainy yyasbiru faan-naaru mathwa llaahum wainy yyasta'tibu famaa hum mmina aal mu'tabeen
Waqayyadnaa lahum quranaa'a fazayyanu lahum mmaa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wahaqqa 'al ayhimu aul qawlu fiaa 'umam qad khal at min qablihim mmina aal jinni waal iansi 'innahum kaanu khaasireen
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru laa tasma'u lihaazaa aal qur'aani waal ghawa feehi la'al lakum taghliboon
Fal anuzeeqanna aal zeena kafaru 'azaaba shadeeda wal anajzeeannahumuaa 'aswaa aal zi kaanu ya'mal oon
Zaal ika jazaa'u aa'daa'i ail laahi ain-naaru lahum feehaa daaru aul khul di jazaa'a bimaa kaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru rabbanaa 'arinaa aal zayni 'adal laanaa mina aal jinni waal iansi naj'al humaa tahta 'aqdaaminaa leeakoonaa mina aal aasfal een
'inna aal zeena qaal u rabbunaa aal laahu thumma aastaqaamu tatanazzal u 'al ayhimu aul mal aa'ikatu 'al laa takhaafu wal aa tahzanu waabshiru bial jannati ail ti kuntum too'adoon
Nahnu 'awleeaa'ukum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya wafi ail aakhirati wal akum feehaa maa tashtahiaa 'anfusukum wal akum feehaa maa tadda'oon
Nuzul a mmin ghafoor rraheem
Wamana aahsanu qawla mmimman da'aa 'il aa aal laahi wa'amil a saal iha waqaal a 'innani mina aal muslimeen
Wal aa tastawi ail hasanatu wal aa aas-sayyeeatu audfa' bial ti heea 'ahsanu faizaa aal zi baynaka wabaynahu 'adaawat kaannahu wal eeyun hameem
Wamaa yul aqqyaahaa 'il laa aal zeena sabaru wamaa yul aqqyaahaa 'il laa zoo hazzin 'azeem
Waimmaa yanzaghannaka mina aash-shaytaani nazgh faasta'iz bial laahi 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wamina ayaatihi ail ylu waan-nahaaru waash-shamsu waal qamaru laa tasjudu lish-shamsi wal aa lil qamari waasjudu lil hi ail zi khal aqahunna 'in kuntumuaa 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
Faini aistakbaru faal zeena 'inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu bial yli waan-nahari wahum laa yasamoon
Wamina ayaatihiaa 'annaka taraa aal aarda khaashi'at faizaa 'anzal naa 'al ayhaa aal maa'a aahtazzat warabati ainna aal ziaa 'ahyahaa lamuhyi ail mawtaa 'innahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Ainna aal zeena yul hidoona fiaa 'ayaatinaa laa yakhfawna 'al aynaa 'afamany yyul qaa fi ain-nari khayrun aam mmany yyaatiaa 'aamina yawma aal qeeaamati ai'mal u maa sheetumuaa 'innahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Ainna aal zeena kafaru biaz-zikri lammaa jaa'ahum wainnahu lakitaabun 'azeez
Llaa yaateehi ail baatil u mim bayni yadayhi wal aa min khal fihi tanzeel mmin hakeemin hameed
Mmaa yuqaal u laka 'il laa maa qad qeela lir-rusul i min qablika 'inna rabbaka lazoo maghfirat wazoo 'iqaabin aal eem

Wal aw ja'al naahu qur'aanaan aa'jamiyya llaqaal u lawlaa fussil ata ayaatuhuaa 'aa'jameey wa'arabeey qul hooa lil zeena 'aamanu huda washifaa' waal zeena laa yoominoona fiaa 'aazaanihim waqr wahooa 'al ayhim 'amaan awlaa'ika yunaadawna mim mmakaani ba'eed
Wal aqada aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba faakhtul ifa feehi wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum wainnahum lafi shakk mminhu mureeb
Mman 'amil a saal iha fal inafsihi wamana aasaa'a fa'al ayhaa wamaa rabbuka bizal laam llil'abeed

'il ayhi yuraddu 'il mu aus-saa'ati wamaa takhruju min thamaraat mmina aakmaamihaa wamaa tahmil u minu anthaa wal aa tada'u 'il laa bi'il mihi wayawma yunaadeehimuaa 'ayna shurakaa'i qaal ooaa 'aazannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
Wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yad'oona min qablu wazannu maa lahum mmim mmahees
Llaa yasamu aul iansaanu min du'aa'i ail khayri waim mmassahu aush-sharru fayaoos qanooh

Wal a'ina aazaqnaahu rahmat mminnaa mim ba'di darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna haazaa li wamaa 'azunnu aus-saa'ata qaa'imat wal a'ir rruji'tu 'il aa rabbeea 'inna li 'indahu lal husnaa fal anunabbeeanna aal zeena kafaru bimaa 'amil u wal anuzeeqannahum mmin 'azaabin ghal eez
Waizaa 'an'amnaa 'al aa aal iansaani 'a'rada wanaa bijaanibihi waizaa massahu aush-sharru fazoo du'aa'in 'areed
Qul a aaraytumuaa 'in kaana min 'indi ail laahi thumma kafartum bihi mana aadal lu mimman hooa fi shiqaaqi ba'eed
Sanureehimuaa 'ayaatinaa fi ail aafaaqi wafiaa 'anfusihim hattaa yatabayyana lahumuaa 'annahu aul haqqu 'awal am yakfi birabbika 'annahu 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed
Aal aa 'innahum fi miryat mmil lliqaa'i rabbihimuaa 'al aa 'innahu bikul li sha' mmuheeh
Hmiaa 'aasiaaqaa kazaal ika yoohiaa 'il ayka wail aa aal zeena min qablika aal laahu aul'azeezu aul hakeem
Lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi wahooa aal'al eeyu aul'azeem
Yakaadu aus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna waal mal aa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fi ail aardi 'al aa 'inna aal laaha hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Waal zeena aattakhazu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a aal laahu hafeezun 'al ayhim wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel
Wakazaal ika 'awhaynaa 'il ayka qur'aanaan 'arabiyya llitunzira 'umma aal quraa waman hawlahaa watunzira yawma aal jam'i laa rayba feehi fareeq fi ail jannati wafareeq fi ais-sa'eer
Wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laja'al ahumuaa 'ummat waahidat wal aakiny yyudkhil u many yyashaa'u fi rahmatihi waaz-zaal imoona maa lahum mminw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Aami aittakhazu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a faal laahu hooa aal wal eeyu wahooa yuhyi ail mawtaa wahooa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wamaa aakhtal aftum feehi min sha' fahukmuhuaa 'il aa aal laahi zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi 'uneeb
Faatiru aus-samaawaati waal aardi ja'al a lakum mmina aanfusikumuaa 'azwaaja wamina aal aan'aami 'azwaaja yazra'ukum feehi laysa kamithlihi sha' wahooa aas-samee'u aul baseer
Lahu maqaal eedu aus-samaawaati waal aardi yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'innahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Shara'a lakum mmina aad-deeni maa wassaa bihi nooha waal ziaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka wamaa wassaynaa bihiaa 'ibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa 'ana aaqeemu aud-deena wal aa tatafarraqu feehi kabura 'al aa aal mushrikeena maa tad'oohumuaa 'il ayhi ail laahu yajtabiaa 'il ayhi many yyashaa'u wayahdiaa 'il ayhi many yyuneeb

Wamaa tafarraqooaa 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu baghyaa baynahum wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma llaqudeea baynahum wainna aal zeena 'oorithu aul kitaaba mim ba'dihim lafi shakk mminhu mureeb

Fal izaal ika faad'u waastaqim kamaa 'umirta wal aa tattabi'a aahwaa'ahum waqul a aamantu bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu min kitaab waumirtu lia'dil a baynakumu aul laahu rabbunaa warabbukum lanaa 'a'maal unaa wal akumuaa 'a'maal ukum laa hujjata baynanaa wabaynakumu aul laahu yajma'u baynanaa wail ayhi ail maseer
Waal zeena yuhaajjoona fi ail laahi mim ba'di maa aastujeeba lahu hujjatuhum daahidatun 'inda rabbihim wa'al ayhim ghadab wal ahum 'azaab shadeed
Ail laahu aul ziaa 'anzal a aal kitaaba bial haqqi waal meezaana wamaa yudreeka la'al la aas-saa'ata qareeb
Yasta'jil u bihaa aal zeena laa yoominoona bihaa waal zeena 'aamanu mushfiqoona minhaa waya'lamoona 'annahaa aal haqqu 'al aa 'inna aal zeena yumaaroona fi ais-saa'ati lafi dal aal i ba'eed
Ail laahu lateefu bi'ibaadihi yarzuqu many yyashaa'u wahooa aal qaweeyu aul'azeez
Man kaana yureedu hartha aal aakhirati nazid lahu fi harthihi waman kaana yureedu hartha aad-dunya nootihi minhaa wamaa lahu fi ail aakhirati min nnaseeb
Aam lahum shurakaa'ua shara'u lahum mmina aad-deeni maa lam yaazam bihi ail laahu wal awlaa kal imatu aul fasli laqudeea baynahum wainna aaz-zaal imeena lahum 'azaabun aal eem

Taraa aaz-zaal imeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasabu wahooa waaqi'u bihim waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fi rawdaati ail jannaati lahum mmaa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim zaal ika hooa aal fadlu aul kabeer

Zaal ika aal zi yubashshiru aul laahu 'ibaadahu aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati qul-laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajraan ail laa aal mawaddata fi ail qurbaa wamany yyaqtarif hasanat nnazid lahu feehaa husnaan ainna aal laaha ghafoor shakoor
Aam yaqooloona aaftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kaziba fainy yyashai ail laahu yakhtim 'al aa qal bika wayamhu aul laahu aul baatil a wayuhiqqu aul haqqa bikal imaatihiaa 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Wahooa aal zi yaqbal u aut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihi waya'fu 'ani ais-sayyiaati waya'lamu maa yaf'al oon
Wayastajeebu aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati wayazeeduhum mmin fadlihi waal kaafiroona lahum 'azaab shadeed
Wal aw basata aal laahu aur-rizqa li'ibaadihi labaghawa fi ail aardi wal aakiny yyunazzil u biqadar mmaa yashaa'u ainnahu bi'ibaadihi khabeeru baseer
Wahooa aal zi yunazzil u aul ghaytha mim ba'di maa qanatu wayanshuru rahmatahu wahooa aal wal eeyu aul hameed
Wamina ayaatihi khal qu aus-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa baththa feehimaa min daabbat wahooa 'al aa jam'ihimuaa 'izaa yashaa'u qadeer
Wamaa 'asaabakum mmim mmuseebati bimaa kasabata aydeekum waya'fu 'an katheer
Wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeena fi ail aardi wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Wamina ayaatihi ail jawaari fi ail bahri kaal aa'laami 'iny yyasha yuskini air-reeaaha fayazlal na rawaakida 'al aa zahrihiaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbar shakoor
Aaw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasabu waya'fu 'an katheer
Waya'lamu aul zeena yujaadil oona fiaa 'ayaatinaa maa lahum mmim mmahees
Famaa 'ooteetum mmin sha' famataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunya wamaa 'inda aal laahi khayr waabqaa lil zeena 'aamanu wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Waal zeena yajtaniboona kabaa'ira aal iathmi waal fawaahisha waizaa maa ghadibu hum yaghfiroon
Waal zeena aastajaabu lirabbihim waaqaamu aus-sal awaata waamruhum shooraa baynahum wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Waal zeena 'izaa 'asaabahumu aul baghyu hum yantasiroon
Wajazaa'ua sayyeeat sayyeeat mmithluhaa faman 'afaa waaslaha faajruhu 'al aa aal laahi 'innahu laa yuhibbu auz-zaal imeen
Wal amani aintasara ba'da zul mihi faul aa'ika maa 'al ayhim mmin sabeel
Ainnamaa aas-sabeelu 'al aa aal zeena yazlimoona aan-naasa wayabghoona fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun aal eem
Wal aman sabara waghafara 'inna zaal ika lamin 'azmi ail uamoor
Wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu minw wwal eey mmim ba'dihi wataraa aaz-zaal imeena lammaa raawua aul'azaaba yaqooloona hal i ail aa maradd mmin sabeel

Wataryaahum yu'radoona 'al ayhaa khaashi'eena mina aaz-zul li yanzuroona min tarfin khafeey waqaal a aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'inna aal khaasireena aal zeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum waahleehim yawma aal qeeaamati 'al aa 'inna aaz-zaal imeena fi 'azaab mmuqeem
Wamaa kaana lahum mmina aawleeaa'a yansuroonahum mmin dooni ail laahi wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min sabeel
Aistajeebu lirabbikum mmin qabli 'any yyaateea yawm llaa maradda lahu mina aal laahi maa lakum mmim mmal ja yawma'iz wamaa lakum mmin nnakeer

Faina aa'radu famaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim hafeezaan ain 'al ayka 'il laa aal bal aaghu wainnaa 'izaa 'azaqnaa aal iansaana minnaa rahmat fariha bihaa wain tusibhum sayyeeatu bimaa qaddamata aydeehim fainna aal iansaana kafoor
Llil hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi yakhluqu maa yashaa'u yahabu limany yyashaa'u ainaatha wayahabu limany yyashaa'u auz-zukoor
'aw yuzawwijuhum zukraana wainaatha wayaj'al u many yyashaa'u 'aqeemaan ainnahu 'al eem qadeer
Wamaa kaana libasharin aany yyukal limahu aul laahu 'il laa wahyaan aaw minw wwaraa'i hijaabin aaw yursil u rasoola fayoohi biiznihi maa yashaa'u ainnahu 'al eeyun hakeem

Wakazaal ika 'awhaynaa 'il ayka rooha mmina aamrinaa maa kunta tadri maa aal kitaabu wal aa aal iaymaanu wal aakin ja'al naahu noora nnahdi bihi man nnashaa'u min 'ibaadinaa wainnaka latahdiaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Siraati ail laahi ail zi lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi 'al aa 'il aa aal laahi taseeru aul uamoor
Hmiaa waal kitaabi ail mubeen
'innaa ja'al naahu qur'aanaan 'arabiyya lla'al lakum ta'qil oon
Wainnahu fiaa 'ummi ail kitaabi ladaynaa la'al eeyun hakeem
Aafanadribu 'ankumu auz-zikra safhaan ain kuntum qawma mmusrifeen
Wakama aarsal naa min nnabiaa' fi ail aawwal een
Wamaa yaateehim mmin nnabiaa'in ail laa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Faahlaknaa 'ashadda minhum batsha wamadaa mathal u aul aawwal een
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda layaqoolunna khal aqahunna aal'azeezu aul'al eem
Aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul aarda mihaada waja'al a lakum feehaa subul a lla'al lakum tahtadoon
Waal zi nazzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa'a biqadar faansharnaa bihi bal dat mmayta kazaal ika tukhrajoon
Waal zi khal aqa aal aazwaaja kul laahaa waja'al a lakum mmina aal ful ki waal aan'aami maa tarkaboon
Litastawua 'al aa zuhoorihi thumma tazkuru ni'mata rabbikumuaa 'izaa aastawaytum 'al ayhi wataqoolu subhaana aal zi sakhkhara lanaa haazaa wamaa kunnaa lahu muqrineen
Wainnaa 'il aa rabbinaa lamunqal iboon
Waja'al u lahu min 'ibaadihi juz'aan ainna aal iansaana lakafoor mmubeen
Aami aittakhaza mimmaa yakhluqu banaat waasfyaakum bial baneen
Waizaa bushshira 'ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-rahmaani mathal a zal la wajhuhu muswadda wahooa kazeem
Aawamany yyansha'ua fi ail hil yati wahooa fi ail khisaami ghayru mubeen
Waja'al u aul mal aa'ikata aal zeena hum 'inda aar-rahmaani 'inaathaan aashhidu khal qahum satuktabu shahaadatuhum wayusal oon
Waqaal u law shaa'a aar-rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum mmaa lahum bizaal ika min 'il min ain humuaa 'il laa yakhrusoon
'ama aataynaahum kitaaba mmin qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoon
Bal qaal ooaa 'innaa wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa 'al aa 'ummat wainnaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim mmuhtadoon
Wakazaal ika maa 'arsal naa min qablika fi qaryat mmin nnazeerin ail laa qaal a mutrafoohaa 'innaa wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa 'al aa 'ummat wainnaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim mmuqtadoon
Qul a aawal aw jeetukum biahdaa mimmaa wajadttum 'al ayhi 'aabaa'akum qaal ooaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Faantaqamnaa minhum faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu liabeehi waqawmihiaa 'innani baraa' mmimmaa ta'budoon
'il laa aal zi fatarani fainnahu sayahdeen
Waja'al ahaa kal imata baaqeeat fi 'aqibihi la'al laahum yarji'oon
Bal matta'tu haa'ul aa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu warasool mmubeen
Wal ammaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu qaal u haazaa sihr wainnaa bihi kaafiroon
Waqaal u lawlaa nuzzil a haazaa aal qur'aanu 'al aa rajul mmina aal qaryatayni 'azeem

Aahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamnaa baynahum mma'eeshatahum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunya warafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'd darajaat lleeattakhiza ba'duhum ba'da sukhriyya warahmatu rabbika khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Wal awlaa 'any yyakoona aan-naasu 'ummat waahidat llaja'al naa limany yyakfuru biar-rahmaani libuyootihim suqufa mmin fiddat wama'aarija 'al ayhaa yazharoon
Wal ibuyootihimuaa 'abwaaba wasururaan 'al ayhaa yattakioon
Wazukhrufa wain kul lu zaal ika lamaa mataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunya waal aakhiratu 'inda rabbika lil muttaqeen
Wamany yya'shu 'an zikri air-rahmaani nuqayyid lahu shaytaana fahooa lahu qareen
Wainnahum layasuddoonahum 'ani ais-sabeeli wayahsiboona 'annahum mmuhtadoon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'aanaa qaal a yaal ayta bayni wabaynaka bu'da aal mashriqayni fabeesa aal qareen
Wal any yyanfa'akumu aul yawma 'iz zzal amtumuaa 'annakum fi ail'azaabi mushtarikoon
'afaanta tusmi'u aus-summa 'aw tahdi ail'umya waman kaana fi dal aal mmubeen
Faimmaa nazhabanna bika fainnaa minhum mmuntaqimoon
'aw nureeannaka aal zi wa'adnaahum fainnaa 'al ayhim mmuqtadiroon
Faastamsik bial ziaa 'ooheea 'il ayka 'innaka 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wainnahu lazikr llaka wal iqawmika wasawfa tusal oon
Wasal mana aarsal naa min qablika mir rrusul inaa 'aja'al naa min dooni air-rahmaani 'aal ihat yu'badoon
Wal aqada aarsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faqaal a 'inni rasoolu rabbi ail'aal ameen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum biayaatinaa 'izaa hum mminhaa yadhakoon
Wamaa nureehim mmina ayatin ail laa heea 'akbaru minu akhtihaa waakhaznaahum bial'azaabi la'al laahum yarji'oon
Waqaal u yayyuha aas-saahiru aud'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka 'innanaa lamuhtadoon
Fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhumu aul'azaaba 'izaa hum yankuthoon
Wanaadaa fir'awnu fi qawmihi qaal a yaaqawmi 'al aysa li mul ku misra wahaazihi ail aanhaaru tajri min tahteea 'afal aa tubsiroon
'ama aanaa khayr mmin haazaa aal zi hooa maheen
Wal aa yakaadu yubeen
Fal awlaa 'ul qeea 'al ayhi 'asaawirat mmin zahabin aaw jaa'a ma'ahu aul mal aa'ikatu muqtarineen
Faastakhaffa qawmahu faataa'oohu 'innahum kaanu qawma faasiqeen
Fal ammaa 'aasafoonaa aantaqamnaa minhum faaghraqnaahumuaa 'ajma'een
Faja'al naahum sal afa wamathal a llil aakhireen
Wal ammaa duriba aabnu maryama mathal aan aizaa qawmuka minhu yasuddoon
Waqaal ooaa 'aal ihatunaa khayrun aam hooa maa daraboohu laka 'il laa jadal aa bal hum qawmun khasimoon
'in hooa 'il laa 'abdun aan'amnaa 'al ayhi waja'al naahu mathal a llibaniaa 'israa'eel
Wal aw nashaa'u laja'al naa minkum mmal aa'ikat fi ail aardi yakhlufoon
Wainnahu la'il m llis-saa'ati fal aa tamtarunna bihaa waattabi'ooni haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aa yasuddannakumu aush-shaytaanu 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Wal ammaa jaa'a 'eesaa bial bayyinaati qaal a qad jeetukum bial hikmati wal iubayyina lakum ba'da aal zi takhtal ifoona feehi faattaqu aul laaha waatee'oon
'inna aal laaha hooa rabbi warabbukum faa'budoohu haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Faakhtal afa aal aahzaabu mim baynihim fawayl llil zeena zal amu min 'azaabi yawmin aal eem
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa aas-saa'ata 'an taateeahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Aal aakhil laa'u yawma'izi ba'duhum liba'din 'adoowun ail laa aal muttaqeen
Yaa'ibaadi laa khawfun 'al aykumu aul yawma wal aa 'antum tahzanoon
Aal zeena 'aamanu biayaatinaa wakaanu muslimeen
Aadkhul u aul jannata 'antum waazwaajukum tuhbaroon
Yutaafu 'al ayhim bisihaaf mmin zahab waakwaab wafeehaa maa tashtaheehi ail aanfusu watal azzu aul aa'yunu waantum feehaa khaal idoon
Watil ka aal jannatu aul tiaa 'oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Lakum feehaa faakihat katheerat mminhaa taakul oon
'inna aal mujrimeena fi 'azaabi jahannama khaal idoon
Laa yufattaru 'anhum wahum feehi mublisoon
Wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin kaanu humu auz-zaal imeen
Wanaadawa yaamaal iku leeaqdi 'al aynaa rabbuka qaal a 'innakum mmaakithoon
Laqad jeenaakum bial haqqi wal aakinna 'aktharakum lil haqqi kaarihoon
'ama aabramooaa 'amra fainnaa mubrimoon
'am yahsiboona 'annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wanajwyaahum bal aa warusul unaa ladayhim yaktuboon
Qul i ain kaana lir-rahmaani wal ad faanaa 'awwal u aul'aabideen
Subhaana rabbi ais-samaawaati waal aardi rabbi ail'arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
Fazarhum yakhoodu wayal'abu hattaa yul aaqu yawmahumu aul zi yoo'adoon
Wahooa aal zi fi ais-samaa'i al aah wafi ail aardi 'il aah wahooa aal hakeemu aul'al eem
Watabaaraka aal zi lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa baynahumaa wa'indahu 'il mu aus-saa'ati wail ayhi turja'oon
Wal aa yamliku aul zeena yad'oona min doonihi aish-shafaa'ata 'il laa man shahida bial haqqi wahum ya'lamoon
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqahum layaqoolunna aal laahu faannaa yoofakoon
Waqeelahu yaarabbi 'inna haa'ul aa'i qawm llaa yoominoon
Faasfah 'anhum waqul sal aam fasawfa ta'lamoon
Hmiaa waal kitaabi ail mubeen
'innaa 'anzal naahu fi laylat mmubaarakatin ainnaa kunnaa munzireen
Feehaa yufraqu kul lu 'amrin hakeem
Aamra mmin 'indinaa 'innaa kunnaa mursil een
Rahmat mmir rrabbika 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Rabbu aus-samaawaati waal aardi wamaa baynahumaa 'in kuntum mmooqineen
Laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa yuhyi wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu 'aabaa'ikumu aul aawwal een
Bal hum fi shakk yal'aboon
Faartaqib yawma taati ais-samaa'u bidukhaam mmubeen
Yaghshaa aan-naasa haazaa 'azaabun aal eem
Rrabbanaa aakshif 'annaa aal'azaaba 'innaa moominoon
'annaa lahumu auz-zikraa waqad jaa'ahum rasool mmubeen
Thumma tawal lawa 'anhu waqaal u mu'al lam mmajnoon
Ainnaa kaashifu aul'azaabi qal eelaan ainnakum 'aa'idoon
Yawma nabtishu aul batshata aal kubraa 'innaa muntaqimoon
Wal aqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir'awna wajaa'ahum rasool kareem
Aana aaddooaa 'il ayya 'ibaada aal laahi 'inni lakum rasoolun aameen
Waal llaa ta'lu 'al aa aal laahi 'inneea 'aateekum bisul taam mmubeen
Wainni 'uztu birabbi warabbikumuaa 'an tarjumoon
Wail llam toominu leea faa'tazil oon
Fada'aa rabbahuaa 'anna haa'ul aa'i qawm mmujrimoon
Faasri bi'ibaadi laylaan ainnakum mmuttaba'oon
Waatruki ail bahra rahwaan ainnahum jund mmughraqoon
Kam taraku min jannaat wa'uyoon
Wazuroo' wamaqaam kareem
Wana'mat kaanu feehaa faakiheen
Kazaal ika waawrathnaahaa qawmaan aakhareen
Famaa bakat 'al ayhimu aus-samaa'u waal aardu wamaa kaanu munzareen
Wal aqad najjaynaa baniaa 'israa'eela mina aal'azaabi ail muheen
Min fir'awna 'innahu kaana 'aal eea mmina aal musrifeen
Wal aqadi aikhtarnaahum 'al aa 'il min 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Wa'aataynaahum mmina aal ayaati maa feehi bal aa'a mmubeen
Ainna haa'ul aa'i layaqooloona 'in heea 'il laa mawtatunaa aal uawlaa wamaa nahnu bimunshareen
Faatu biaabaa'inaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
'ahum khayrun aam qawmu tubba' waal zeena min qablihimuaa 'ahlaknaahumuaa 'innahum kaanu mujrimeen
Wamaa khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
Maa khal aqnaahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
'inna yawma aal fasli meeqaatuhumuaa 'ajma'een
Yawma laa yughni mawlaan 'am mmawla shaya wal aa hum yunsaroon
'il laa mar rrahima aal laahu 'innahu hooa aal'azeezu aur-raheem
'inna shajarata aaz-zaqqoomi ta'aamu aul aatheem
Kaal muhli taghli fi ail butoon
Kaghal yi ail hameem
Khuzoohu faa'tul oohu 'il aa sawaa'i ail jaheem
Thumma subbu fawqa rasihi min 'azaabi ail hameem
Zuqi ainnaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul kareem
'inna haazaa maa kuntum bihi tamtaroon
'inna aal muttaqeena fi muqaamin aameen
Fi jannaat wa'uyoon
Yal basoona min sundus waistabraq mmutaqaabil een
Kazaal ika wazawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een
Yad'oona feehaa bikul li faakihatin aamineen
Laa yazooqoona feehaa aal mawta 'il laa aal mawtata aal uawlaa wawaqyaahum 'azaaba aal jaheem
Fadla mmir rrabbika zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
Fainnamaa yassarnaahu bil isaanika la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Faartaqibi ainnahum mmurtaqiboon
Hmiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi mina aal laahi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
'inna fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi layaat llil moomineen
Wafi khal qikum wamaa yabuththu min daabbatin ayaat lliqawm yooqinoon
Waakhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahari wamaa 'anzal a aal laahu mina aas-samaa'i mir rrizq faahya bihi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa watasreefi air-reeaahi 'ayaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Til ka 'ayaatu aul laahi natloohaa 'al ayka bial haqqi fabiayyi hadeethi ba'da aal laahi wa'ayaatihi yoominoon
Wayl llikul li 'affaakin aatheem
Yasma'u 'ayaati ail laahi tutlaa 'al ayhi thumma yusirru mustakbira kaal llam yasma'haa fabashshirhu bi'azaabin aal eem
Waizaa 'al ima mina ayaatinaa shayaan aittakhazahaa huzu'aan awlaa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Mminw wwaraa'ihim jahannamu wal aa yughni 'anhum mmaa kasabu shaya wal aa maa aattakhazu min dooni ail laahi 'awleeaa'a wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Haazaa huda waal zeena kafaru biayaati rabbihim lahum 'azaab mmir rrijzin aal eem
Ail laahu aul zi sakhkhara lakumu aul bahra litajreea aal ful ku feehi biamrihi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wasakhkhara lakum mmaa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi jamee'a mminhu 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Qul-lil zeena 'aamanu yaghfiru lil zeena laa yarjoona 'ayyaama aal laahi leeajzeea qawmaa bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Man 'amil a saal iha fal inafsihi wamana aasaa'a fa'al ayhaa thumma 'il aa rabbikum turja'oon
Wal aqada aataynaa baniaa 'israa'eela aal kitaaba waal hukma waan-nubooaa'ata warazaqnaahum mmina aat-tayyibaati wafaddal naahum 'al aa aal'aal ameen

Wa'aataynaahum bayyinaat mmina aal aamri famaa aakhtal afooaa 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu baghyaa baynahumuaa 'inna rabbaka yaqdi baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Thumma ja'al naaka 'al aa sharee'at mmina aal aamri faattabi'haa wal aa tattabi'a aahwaa'a aal zeena laa ya'lamoon
'innahum lany yyughnu 'anka mina aal laahi shaya wainna aaz-zaal imeena ba'duhumuaa 'awleeaa'u ba'd waal laahu wal eeyu aul muttaqeen
Haazaa basaa'iru lin-naasi wahuda warahmat lliqawm yooqinoon
'am hasiba aal zeena aajtarahu aus-sayyiaati 'an nnaj'al ahum kaal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati sawaa' mmahyahum wamamaatuhum saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakhal aqa aal laahu aus-samaawaati waal aarda bial haqqi wal itujzaa kul lu nafsi bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon

'afarayta mani aittakhaza 'il aahahu hawyaahu waadal laahu aul laahu 'al aa 'il m wakhatama 'al aa sam'ihi waqal bihi waja'al a 'al aa basarihi ghishaawat famany yyahdeehi mim ba'di ail laahi 'afal aa tazzakkaroon
Waqaal u maa heea 'il laa hayaatunaa aad-dunya namootu wanahya wamaa yuhlikunaa 'il laa aad-dahru wamaa lahum bizaal ika min 'il min ain humuaa 'il laa yazunnoon
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat mmaa kaana hujjatahumuaa 'il laa 'an qaal u auytu biaabaa'inaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul i ail laahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma'ukumuaa 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laa rayba feehi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yawma'iz yakhsaru aul mubtil oon
Wataraa kul la 'ummat jaatheeat kul lu 'ummat tud'aa 'il aa kitaabihaa aal yawma tujzawna maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Haazaa kitaabunaa yantiqu 'al aykum bial haqqi 'innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fayudkhil uhum rabbuhum fi rahmatihi zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul mubeen
Waammaa aal zeena kafarooaa 'afal am takuna ayaati tutlaa 'al aykum faastakbartum wakuntum qawma mmujrimeen
Waizaa qeela 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq waas-saa'atu laa rayba feehaa qul tum mmaa nadri maa aas-saa'atu 'in nnazunnu 'il laa zanna wamaa nahnu bimustayqineen
Wabadaa lahum sayyiaatu maa 'amil u wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Waqeela aal yawma nansyaakum kamaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa wamawyaakumu aun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin nnaasireen
Zaal ikum biannakumu auttakhazttumuaa 'ayaati ail laahi huzu'a wagharratkumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunya faal yawma laa yukhrajoona minhaa wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Fal il hi ail hamdu rabbi ais-samaawaati warabbi ail aardi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Wal ahu aul kibreeaa'u fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Hmiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi mina aal laahi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
Maa khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi waajal mmusamma waal zeena kafaru 'ammaa 'unziru mu'ridoon

Qul a aaraytum mmaa tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'arooni maazaa khal aqu mina aal aardi 'am lahum shirk fi ais-samaawaati aeetooni bikitaab mmin qabli haazaa 'awa aathaarat mmin 'il min ain kuntum saadiqeen
Wamana aadal lu mimmany yyad'u min dooni ail laahi mal llaa yastajeebu lahuaa 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati wahum 'an du'aa'ihim ghaafil oon
Waizaa hushira aan-naasu kaanu lahumuaa 'a'daa' wakaanu bi'ibaadatihim kaafireen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal a aal zeena kafaru lil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum haazaa sihr mmubeen
Aam yaqooloona aaftaryaahu qul i aini aiftaraytuhu fal aa tamlikoona li mina aal laahi shayaan hooa 'a'lamu bimaa tufeedoona feehi kafaa bihi shaheedaa bayni wabaynakum wahooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Qul maa kuntu bid'a mmina aar-rusul i wamaa 'adri maa yuf'al u bi wal aa bikumuaa 'ina aattabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya wamaa 'anaa 'il laa nazeer mmubeen
Qul a aaraytumuaa 'in kaana min 'indi ail laahi wakafartum bihi washahida shaahid mmim baniaa 'israa'eela 'al aa mithlihi faamana waastakbartumuaa 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lil zeena 'aamanu law kaana khayra mmaa sabaqoonaa 'il ayhi waiz lam yahtadu bihi fasayaqooloona haazaa 'ifk qadeem
Wamin qablihi kitaabu moosaa 'imaama warahmat wahaazaa kitaab mmusaddiq llisaanaan 'arabiyya llitunzira aal zeena zal amu wabushraa lil muhsineen
'inna aal zeena qaal u rabbunaa aal laahu thumma aastaqaamu fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati khaal ideena feehaa jazaa'a bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon

Wawassaynaa aal iansaana biwaal idayhi husnaan hamal athu 'ummuhu karha wawada'athu karha wahamluhu wafisaal uhu thal aathoona shahraan hattaa 'izaa bal agha 'ashuddahu wabal agha 'arba'eena sanat qaal a rabbi 'awzi'neea 'ana aashkura ni'mataka aal tiaa 'an'amta 'al ayya wa'al aa waal idayya waana aa'mal a saal iha tardyaahu waaslih li fi zurriyyatiaa 'inni tubtu 'il ayka wainni mina aal muslimeen
'ul aa'ika aal zeena yutaqabbal u 'anhumuaa 'ahsanu maa 'amil u wayutajaawazu 'an sayyiaatihim fiaa 'ashaabi ail jannati wa'da aas-sidqi ail zi kaanu yoo'adoon

Waal zi qaal a liwaal idayhi 'uff llakumaa 'ata'idaanineea 'anu akhraja waqad khal ati ail quroonu min qabli wahumaa yastagheethaani ail laaha waylaka 'aamini ainna wa'da aal laahi haqq fayaqoolu maa haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul aawwal een
'ul aa'ika aal zeena haqqa 'al ayhimu aul qawlu fiaa 'umam qad khal at min qablihim mmina aal jinni waal iansi 'innahum kaanu khaasireen
Wal ikul l darajaat mmimmaa 'amil u wal inooaffeeahumuaa 'a'maal ahum wahum laa yuzlamoon

Wayawma yu'radu aul zeena kafaru 'al aa aan-nari 'azhabtum tayyibaatikum fi hayaatikumu aud-dunya waastamta'tum bihaa faal yawma tujzawna 'azaaba aal hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fi ail aardi bighayri ail haqqi wabimaa kuntum tafsuqoon

Waazkura aakhaa 'aadin aiza aanzara qawmahu bial aahqaafi waqad khal ati ain-nuzuru mim bayni yadayhi wamin khal fihiaa 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laa aal laaha 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qaal ooaa 'ajeetanaa litaafikanaa 'ana aal ihatinaa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Qaal a 'innamaa aal'il mu 'inda aal laahi waubal lighukum mmaa 'ursil tu bihi wal aakinneea 'aryaakum qawma tajhal oon
Fal ammaa raawhu 'aarida mmustaqbil a 'awdeeatihim qaal u haazaa 'aarid mmumtirunaa bal hooa maa aasta'jal tum bihi reeh feehaa 'azaabun aal eem
Tudammiru kul la sha'i biamri rabbihaa faasbahu laa taraa 'il laa masaakinahum kazaal ika najzi ail qawma aal mujrimeen

Wal aqad makkannaahum feemaa 'im mmakkannaakum feehi waja'al naa lahum sam'a waabsaara waafidat famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum sam'uhum wal aa 'absaaruhum wal aa 'afidatuhum mmin sha'in aiz kaanu yajhadoona biayaati ail laahi wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Wal aqada aahlaknaa maa hawlakum mmina aal quraa wasarrafnaa aal ayaati la'al laahum yarji'oon
Fal awlaa nasarahumu aul zeena aattakhazu min dooni ail laahi qurbaanaan aal ihata bal dal lu 'anhum wazaal ika 'ifkuhum wamaa kaanu yaftaroon
Waiz sarafnaa 'il ayka nafara mmina aal jinni yastami'oona aal qur'aana fal ammaa hadaroohu qaal ooaa 'ansitu fal ammaa qudeea wal lawia ail aa qawmihim mmunzireen
Qaal u yaaqawmanaa 'innaa sami'naa kitaabaan anzil a mim ba'di moosaa musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi yahdiaa 'il aa aal haqqi wail aa tareeq mmustaqeem
Yaaqawmanaa 'ajeebu daa'eea aal laahi wa'aaminu bihi yaghfir lakum mmin zunoobikum wayujirkum mmin 'azaabin aal eem
Wamal llaa yujib daa'eea aal laahi fal aysa bimu'jiz fi ail aardi wal aysa lahu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'u awlaa'ika fi dal aal mmubeen
Aawal am yarawaa aanna aal laaha aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wal am ya'ya bikhal qihinna biqaadirin 'al aa 'any yyuheea aal mawtaa bal aa 'innahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wayawma yu'radu aul zeena kafaru 'al aa aan-nari 'al aysa haazaa bial haqqi qaal u bal aa warabbinaa qaal a fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Faasbir kamaa sabara 'oolu aul'azmi mina aar-rusul i wal aa tasta'jil-laahum kaannahum yawma yarawna maa yoo'adoona lam yal bathooaa 'il laa saa'at mmin nnahari bal aagh fahal yuhlaku 'il laa aal qawmu aul faasiqoon
Aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi 'adal la 'a'maal ahum
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati wa'aamanu bimaa nuzzil a 'al aa muhammad wahooa aal haqqu mir rrabbihim kaffara 'anhum sayyiaatihim waaslaha baal ahum
Zaal ika bianna aal zeena kafaru auttaba'u aul baatil a waanna aal zeena 'aamanu auttaba'u aul haqqa mir rrabbihim kazaal ika yadribu aul laahu lin-naasi 'amthaal ahum
Faizaa laqeetumu aul zeena kafaru fadarba aar-riqaabi hattaa 'izaa 'athkhantumoohum fashuddu aul wathaaqa faimmaa mannaa ba'du waimmaa fidaa'an hattaa tada'a aal harbu 'awzaaraha
Zaal ika wal aw yashaa'u aul laahu laantasara minhum wal aakil lleeablooaa ba'dakum biba'd waal zeena qaatal u fi sabeeli ail laahi fal any yyudil la 'a'maal ahum
Sayahdeehim wayuslihu baal ahum
Wayudkhil uhumu aul jannata 'arrafahaa lahum
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'in tansuru aul laaha yansurkum wayuthabbita aaqdaamakum
Waal zeena kafaru fata'sa llaahum waadal la 'a'maal ahum
Zaal ika biannahum karihu maa 'anzal a aal laahu faahbata 'a'maal ahumua
'afal am yaseeru fi ail aardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim dammara aal laahu 'al ayhim wal il kaafireena 'amthaal uha
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha mawlaa aal zeena 'aamanu waanna aal kaafireena laa mawlaa lahumua

'inna aal laaha yudkhil u aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru waal zeena kafaru yatamatta'oona wayaakul oona kamaa taakul u aul aan'aamu waan-naaru mathwa llaahum
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin heea 'ashaddu qoowat mmin qaryatika aal tiaa 'akhrajatka 'ahlaknaahum fal aa naasira lahumua
'afaman kaana 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooaa'u 'amal ihi waattaba'ooaa 'ahwaa'ahum

Mmathal u aul jannati ail ti wu'ida aal muttaqoona feehaa 'anhaar mmim mmaa'in ghayri 'aasinw waanhaar mmil llabal llam yataghayyar ta'muhu waanhaar mmin khamr llazzat llish-shaaribeena waanhaar mmin 'asal mmusaffa wal ahum feehaa min kul li aith-thamaraati wamaghfirat mmir rrabbihim kaman hooa khaal id fi ain-nari wasuqu maa'an hameema faqatta'a 'am'aa'ahum

Waminhum mmany yyastami'u 'il ayka hattaa 'izaa kharaju min 'indika qaal u lil zeena 'ootu aul'il ma maazaa qaal a 'aanifaan awlaa'ika aal zeena taba'a aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim waattaba'ooaa 'ahwaa'ahum
Waal zeena aahtadawa zaadahum huda wa'aatyaahum taqwyaahum
Fahal yanzuroona 'il laa aas-saa'ata 'an taateeahum baghtat faqad jaa'a ashraatuhaa faannaa lahumuaa 'izaa jaa'athum zikryaahum
Faa'lama aannahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa aal laahu waastaghfir lizanbika wal il moomineena waal moominaati waal laahu ya'lamu mutaqal labakum wamathwyaakum

Wayaqoolu aul zeena 'aamanu lawlaa nuzzil at soorat faizaa 'unzil at soorat mmuhkamat wazukira feehaa aal qitaal u rayta aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad yanzuroona 'il ayka nazara aal maghsheeyi 'al ayhi mina aal mawti faawlaa lahum
Taa'at waqawl mma'roof faizaa 'azama aal aamru fal aw sadaqu aul laaha lakaana khayra llaahum
Fahal 'aseetumuaa 'in tawal laytumuaa 'an tufsidu fi ail aardi watuqatti'ooaa 'arhaamakumua
'ul aa'ika aal zeena la'anahumu aul laahu faasammahum waa'maa 'absaarahumua
'afal aa yatadabbaroona aal qur'aana 'am 'al aa qul oobin aaqfaal uha
'inna aal zeena aartaddu 'al aa 'adbaarihim mmim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumu aul hudaa aash-shaytaanu sawwal a lahum waamlaa lahum
Zaal ika biannahum qaal u lil zeena karihu maa nazzal a aal laahu sanutee'ukum fi ba'di ail aamri waal laahu ya'lamu 'asraarahum
Fakayfa 'izaa tawaffathumu aul mal aa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbaarahum
Zaal ika biannahumu auttaba'u maa 'askhata aal laaha wakarihu ridwaanahu faahbata 'a'maal ahumua
'am hasiba aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmaradun aal llany yyukhrija aal laahu 'adghaanahum
Wal aw nashaa'u laaraynaakahum fal a'araftahum biseemaahum wal ata'rifannahum fi lahni ail qawli waal laahu ya'lamu 'a'maal akum
Wal anablooannakum hattaa na'lama aal mujaahideena minkum waas-saabireena wanablooaa 'akhbaarakumua
'inna aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi washaaqqu aur-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumu aul hudaa lany yyadurru aul laaha shaya wasayuhbitu 'a'maal ahum
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'atee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola wal aa tubtil ooaa 'a'maal akumua
'inna aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi thumma maatu wahum kuffaar fal any yyaghfira aal laahu lahum
Fal aa tahinu watad'ooaa 'il aa aas-sal mi waantumu aul aa'lawna waal laahu ma'akum wal any yyatirakumuaa 'a'maal akumua
'innamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunya la'ib wal ahw wain toominu watattaqu yootikumuaa 'ujoorakum wal aa yasal kumuaa 'amwaal akumua
'iny yyasal kumoohaa fayuhfikum tabkhal u wayukhrija aadghaanakum

Haantum haa'ul aa'i tud'awna litunfiqu fi sabeeli ail laahi faminkum mmany yyabkhal u wamany yyabkhal fainnamaa yabkhal u 'an nnafsihi waal laahu aul ghaneeyu waantumu aul fuqaraa'u wain tatawal lawa yastabdil qawmaan ghayrakum thumma laa yakoonooaa 'amthaal akumua
'innaa fatahnaa laka fatha mmubeen
Lleeaghfira laka aal laahu maa taqaddama min zanbika wamaa taakhkhara wayutimma ni'matahu 'al ayka wayahdeeaka siraata mmustaqeem
Wayansuraka aal laahu nasraan 'azeeza
Hooa aal ziaa 'anzal a aas-sakeenata fi qul oobi ail moomineena leeazdaadooaa 'eemaana mma'a 'eemaanihim wal il hi junoodu aus-samaawaati waal aardi wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem
Lleeudkhil a aal moomineena waal moominaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wayukaffira 'anhum sayyiaatihim wakaana zaal ika 'inda aal laahi fawzaan 'azeem

Wayu'azziba aal munaafiqeena waal munaafiqaati waal mushrikeena waal mushrikaati aiz-zaanneena bial laahi zanna aas-saw'i 'al ayhim daa'iratu aus-saw'i waghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhim wal a'anahum waa'adda lahum jahannama wasaa'at maseer
Wal il hi junoodu aus-samaawaati waal aardi wakaana aal laahu 'azeezaan hakeema
Ainnaa 'arsal naaka shaahida wamubashshira wanazeer
Llitoominu bial laahi warasoolihi watu'azziroohu watooaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukrat waaseela

Ainna aal zeena yubayi'oonaka 'innamaa yubayi'oona aal laaha yadu aul laahi fawqa 'aydeehim faman nnakatha fainnamaa yankuthu 'al aa nafsihi wamana aawfaa bimaa 'aahada 'al ayhi ail laaha fasanooteehi 'ajraan 'azeem

Sayaqoolu laka aal mukhal lafoona mina aal aa'raabi shaghal atnaa 'amwaal unaa waahloonaa faastaghfir lanaa yaqooloona bial sinatihim mmaa laysa fi qul oobihim qul famany yyamliku lakum mmina aal laahi shayaan aina aaraada bikum darraan aawa aaraada bikum naf'aa bal kaana aal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeera
Bal zanantumuaa 'al llany yyanqal iba aar-rasoolu waal moominoona 'il aa 'ahleehimuaa 'abada wazuyyina zaal ika fi qul oobikum wazanantum zanna aas-saw'i wakuntum qawmaa boor
Wamal llam yoomim bial laahi warasoolihi fainnaa 'a'tadnaa lil kaafireena sa'eer
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal aardi yaghfiru limany yyashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yyashaa'u wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Sayaqoolu aul mukhal lafoona 'izaa aantal aqtumuaa 'il aa maghaanima litaakhuzoohaa zaroonaa nattabi'kum yureedoona 'any yyubaddil u kal aama aal laahi qul-lan tattabi'oonaa kazaal ikum qaal a aal laahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonanaa bal kaanu laa yafqahoona 'il laa qal eel

Qul-lil mukhal lafeena mina aal aa'raabi satud'awna 'il aa qawmin awli bas shadeed tuqaatil oonahumuaa 'aw yuslimoona fain tutee'u yootikumu aul laahu 'ajraan hasana wain tatawal lawa kamaa tawal laytum mmin qablu yu'azzibkum 'azaabaan aal eem

Llaysa 'al aa aal aa'maa haraj wal aa 'al aa aal aa'raji haraj wal aa 'al aa aal mareedi haraj wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu nudkhil hu jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru wamany yyatawal la nu'azzibhu 'azaabaan aal eem
Llaqad radeea aal laahu 'ani ail moomineena 'iz yubayi'oonaka tahta aash-shajarati fa'al ima maa fi qul oobihim faanzal a aas-sakeenata 'al ayhim waathaabahum fatha qareeb
Wamaghaanima katheerat yaakhuzoonahaa wakaana aal laahu 'azeezaan hakeem
Wa'adakumu aul laahu maghaanima katheerat taakhuzoonahaa fa'ajjal a lakum haazihi wakaffa 'aydeea aan-naasi 'ankum wal itakoona 'ayat llil moomineena wayahdeeakum siraata mmustaqeem
Waukhraa lam taqdiru 'al ayhaa qada aahaata aal laahu bihaa wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wal aw qaatal akumu aul zeena kafaru lawal lawua aul aadbaara thumma laa yajidoona wal iyya wal aa naseer
Sunnata aal laahi ail ti qad khal at min qablu wal an tajida lisunnati ail laahi tabdeel
Wahooa aal zi kaffa 'aydeeahum 'ankum waydeeakum 'anhum bibatni makkata mim ba'di 'ana aazfarakum 'al ayhim wakaana aal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseera

Humu aul zeena kafaru wasaddookum 'ani ail masjidi ail haraami waal hadya ma'koofaan aany yyablugha mahil laahu wal awlaa rijaal mmoominoona wanisaa' mmoominaat llam ta'lamoohumuaa 'an tataoohum fatuseebakum mminhum mma'arratu bighayri 'il m lleeudkhil a aal laahu fi rahmatihi many yyashaa'u law tazayyal u la'azzabnaa aal zeena kafaru minhum 'azaabaan aal eema

Aiz ja'al a aal zeena kafaru fi qul oobihimu aul hamiyyata hamiyyata aal jaahil iyyati faanzal a aal laahu sakeenatahu 'al aa rasoolihi wa'al aa aal moomineena waal zamahum kal imata aat-taqwaa wakaanooaa 'ahaqqa bihaa waahlahaa wakaana aal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Llaqad sadaqa aal laahu rasoolahu aur-ru'ya bial haqqi latadkhul unna aal masjida aal haraama 'in shaa'a aal laahu 'aamineena muhal liqeena ru'oosakum wamuqassireena laa takhaafoona fa'al ima maa lam ta'lamu faja'al a min dooni zaal ika fatha qareeba
Hooa aal ziaa 'arsal a rasoolahu bial hudaa wadeeni ail haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aa aad-deeni kul lihi wakafaa bial laahi shaheed

Mmuhammad rrasoolu aul laahi waal zeena ma'ahuaa 'ashiddaa'u 'al aa aal kuffari ruhamaa'u baynahum taryaahum rukka'a sujjada yabtaghoona fadla mmina aal laahi waridwaana seemahum fi wujoohihim mmina aathari ais-sujoodi zaal ika mathal uhum fi ait-tawryaati wamathal uhum fi ail ianjeeli kazar'in aakhraja shatahu faazarahu faastaghlaza faastawaa 'al aa sooqihi yu'jibu auz-zurraa'a leeagheeza bihimu aul kuffaara wa'ada aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati minhum mmaghfirat waajraan 'azeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tuqaddimu bayna yadayi ail laahi warasoolihi waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tarfa'ooaa 'aswaatakum fawqa sawti ain-nabiaa'i wal aa tajharu lahu bial qawli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din aan tahbata 'a'maal ukum waantum laa tash'uroon
'inna aal zeena yaghuddoona 'aswaatahum 'inda rasooli ail laahi 'ul aa'ika aal zeena aamtahana aal laahu qul oobahum lit-taqwaa lahum mmaghfirat waajrun 'azeem
Ainna aal zeena yunaadoonaka minw wwaraa'i ail hujuraati 'aktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Wal awa aannahum sabaru hattaa takhruja 'il ayhim lakaana khayra llaahum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'in jaa'akum faasiqu binaba fatabayyanooaa 'an tuseebu qawmaa bijahaal at fatusbihu 'al aa maa fa'al tum naadimeen

Waa'lamooaa 'anna feekum rasoola aal laahi law yutee'ukum fi katheer mmina aal aamri la'anittum wal aakinna aal laaha habbaba 'il aykumu aul iaymaana wazayyanahu fi qul oobikum wakarraha 'il aykumu aul kufra waal fusooqa waal'isyaana 'ul aa'ika humu aur-raashidoon
Fadla mmina aal laahi wani'mat waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Wain taa'ifataani mina aal moomineena aaqtatal u faaslihu baynahumaa faim baghati aihdyaahumaa 'al aa aal uakhraa faqaatil u aul ti tabghi hattaa tafiaa'a al aa 'amri ail laahi fain faa'at faaslihu baynahumaa bial'adli waaqsitooaa 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muqsiteen
'innamaa aal moominoona 'ikhwat faaslihu bayna 'akhawaykum waattaqu aul laaha la'al lakum turhamoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa yaskhar qawm mmin qawmin 'asaa 'any yyakoonu khayra mminhum wal aa nisaa' mmin nnisaa'in 'asaa 'any yyakunna khayra mminhunna wal aa tal mizooaa 'anfusakum wal aa tanaabazu bial aal qaabi beesa aal iasmu aul fusooqu ba'da aal iaymaani wamal llam yatub faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu aujtanibu katheera mmina aaz-zanni 'inna ba'da aaz-zanni 'ithm wal aa tajassasu wal aa yaghtab bba'dukum ba'daan ayuhibbu 'ahadukumuaa 'any yyaakul a lahma 'akheehi mayyita fakarihtumoohu waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha tawwaab rraheem
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'innaa khal aqnaakum mmin zakar waunthaa waja'al naakum shu'ooba waqabaa'il a lita'aarafooaa 'inna 'akramakum 'inda aal laahi 'atqyaakumuaa 'inna aal laaha 'al eemun khabeer

Qaal ati ail aa'raabu 'aamannaa qul-lam toominu wal aakin qoolooaa 'aslamnaa wal ammaa yadkhul i ail iaymaanu fi qul oobikum wain tutee'u aul laaha warasoolahu laa yal itkum mmina aa'maal ikum shayaan ainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Ainnamaa aal moominoona aal zeena 'aamanu bial laahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaabu wajaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fi sabeeli ail laahi 'ul aa'ika humu aus-saadiqoon
Qul a aatu'al limoona aal laaha bideenikum waal laahu ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Yamunnoona 'al ayka 'ana aaslamu qul-laa tamunnu 'al ayya 'islaamakum bal i ail laahu yamunnu 'al aykumuaa 'an hadyaakum lil iaymaani 'in kuntum saadiqeen
'inna aal laaha ya'lamu ghayba aas-samaawaati waal aardi waal laahu baseeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Qaa waal qur'aani ail majeed
Bal 'ajibooaa 'an jaa'ahum mmunzir mminhum faqaal a aal kaafiroona haazaa sha'un 'ajeeb
Aazaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaaba zaal ika raj'u ba'eed
Qad 'al imnaa maa tanqusu aul aardu minhum wa'indanaa kitaabun hafeez
Bal kazzabu bial haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fahum fiaa 'amr mmareej
Aafal am yanzurooaa 'il aa aas-samaa'i fawqahum kayfa banaynaahaa wazayyannaahaa wamaa lahaa min furooj
Waal aarda madadnaahaa waal qaynaa feehaa rawaaseea waanbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawji baheej
Tabsirat wazikraa likul li 'abd mmuneeb
Wanazzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' mmubaaraka faanbatnaa bihi jannaat wahabba aal haseed
Waan-nakhla baasiqaat llaahaa tal' nnadeed
Rrizqa llil'ibaadi waahyaynaa bihi bal dat mmayta kazaal ika aal khurooj
Kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh waashaabu aur-rassi wathamood
Wa'aad wafir'awnu waikhwaanu looh
Waashaabu aul aykati waqawmu tubba' kul l kazzaba aar-rusul a fahaqqa wa'eedia
'afa'ayeenaa bial khal qi ail aawwal i bal hum fi labs mmin khal q jadeed
Wal aqad khal aqnaa aal iansaana wana'lamu maa tooaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu 'aqrabu 'il ayhi min habli ail wareed
'iz yatal aqqaa aal mutal aqqeeaani 'ani ail yameeni wa'ani aish-shimaal i qa'eed
Mmaa yal fizu min qawlin ail laa ladayhi raqeebun 'ateed
Wajaa'at sakratu aul mawti bial haqqi zaal ika maa kunta minhu taheed
Wanufikha fi ais-soori zaal ika yawmu aul wa'eed
Wajaa'at kul lu nafs mma'ahaa saa'iq washaheed
Llaqad kunta fi ghaflat mmin haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaa'aka fabasaruka aal yawma hadeed
Waqaal a qareenuhu haazaa maa ladayya 'ateed

Ail zi ja'al a ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan aakhara faal qeeaahu fi ail'azaabi aish-shadeed
Qaal a qareenuhu rabbanaa maa 'atghaytuhu wal aakin kaana fi dal aal i ba'eed
Qaal a laa takhtasimu ladayya waqad qaddamtu 'il aykum bial wa'eed
Maa yubaddal u aul qawlu ladayya wamaa 'anaa bizal laam llil'abeed
Yawma yaqoolu lijahannama hal i aimtal ati wataqoolu hal mim mmazeed
Wauzlifati ail jannatu lil muttaqeena ghayra ba'eed
Haazaa maa too'adoona likul li 'awwaabin hafeez
Mman khasheea aar-rahmaana bial ghaybi wajaa'a biqal b mmuneeb
Audkhul oohaa bisal aam zaal ika yawmu aul khul ood
Lahum mmaa yashaa'oona feehaa wal adaynaa mazeed
Wakama aahlaknaa qablahum mmin qarnin humuaa 'ashaddu minhum batsha fanaqqabu fi ail bil aadi hal mim mmahees
Ainna fi zaal ika lazikraa liman kaana lahu qal bun aawa aal qaa aas-sam'a wahooa shaheed
Wal aqad khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal aarda wamaa baynahumaa fi sittati 'ayyaam wamaa massanaa mil llughoob
Faasbir 'al aa maa yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tul oo'i aish-shamsi waqabla aal ghuroob
Wamina aal yli fasabbihhu waidbaara aas-sujood

Yawma yasma'oona aas-sayhata bial haqqi zaal ika yawmu aul khurooj
'innaa nahnu nuhyi wanumeetu wail aynaa aal maseer
