Wamaa lakumuaa 'al laa tunfiqu fi sabeeli ail laahi wal il hi meeraathu aus-samaawaati waal aardi laa yastawi minkum mmana aanfaqa min qabli ail fathi waqaatal a 'ul aa'ika 'a'zamu darajat mmina aal zeena 'anfaqu mim ba'du waqaatal u wakul la wa'ada aal laahu aul husnaa waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Mman zaa aal zi yuqridu aul laaha qardaan hasana fayudaa'ifuhu lahu wal ahuaa 'ajr kareem

Yawma taraa aal moomineena waal moominaati yas'aa nooruhum bayna 'aydeehim wabiaymaanihim bushryaakumu aul yawma jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem

Yawma yaqoolu aul munaafiqoona waal munaafiqaatu lil zeena 'aamanu aunzuroonaa naqtabis min nnoorikum qeela aarji'u waraa'akum faal tamisu noora faduriba baynahum bisoor llaahu baabu baatinuhu feehi air-rahmatu wazaahiruhu min qibal ihi ail'azaabu yunaadoonahumuaa 'al am nakum mma'akum qaal u bal aa wal aakinnakum fatantumuaa 'anfusakum watarabbastum waartabtum wagharratkumu aul aamaaneeyu hattaa jaa'a amru aul laahi wagharrakum bial laahi ail gharoor
Faal yawma laa yookhazu minkum fidyat wal aa mina aal zeena kafaru mawyaakumu aun-naaru heea mawlyaakum wabeesa aal maseer

'al am yaani lil zeena 'aamanooaa 'an takhsha'a qul oobuhum lizikri ail laahi wamaa nazal a mina aal haqqi wal aa yakoonu kaal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablu fataal a 'al ayhimu aul aamadu faqasat qul oobuhum wakatheer mminhum faasiqoon
Aa'lamooaa 'anna aal laaha yuhyi ail aarda ba'da mawtihaa qad bayyannaa lakumu aul ayaati la'al lakum ta'qil oon
'inna aal mussaddiqeena waal mussaddiqaati waaqradu aul laaha qardaan hasana yudaa'afu lahum wal ahumuaa 'ajr kareem

Waal zeena 'aamanu bial laahi warusul ihiaa 'ul aa'ika humu aus-siddeeqoona waash-shuhadaa'u 'inda rabbihim lahumuaa 'ajruhum wanooruhum waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jaheem

Ai'lamooaa 'annamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunya la'ib wal ahw wazeenat watafaakhuru baynakum watakaathur fi ail aamwaal i waal aawlaadi kamathal i ghaythin aa'jaba aal kuffaara nabaatuhu thumma yaheeju fataryaahu musfarra thumma yakoonu hutaama wafi ail aakhirati 'azaab shadeed wamaghfirat mmina aal laahi waridwaanw wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa mataa'u aul ghuroor

Saabiqooaa 'il aa maghfirat mmir rrabbikum wajannatin 'arduhaa ka'ardi ais-samaa'i waal aardi 'u'iddat lil zeena 'aamanu bial laahi warusul ihi zaal ika fadlu aul laahi yooteehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem
Maa 'asaaba mim mmuseebat fi ail aardi wal aa fiaa 'anfusikumuaa 'il laa fi kitaab mmin qabli 'an nnabraahaa 'inna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Llikaylaa taasawa 'al aa maa faatakum wal aa tafrahu bimaa 'aatyaakum waal laahu laa yuhibbu kul la mukhtaal fakhoor
Ail zeena yabkhal oona wayaamuroona aan-naasa bial bukhli wamany yyatawal la fainna aal laaha aal ghaneeyu aul hameed

Laqada aarsal naa rusul anaa bial bayyinaati waanzal naa ma'ahumu aul kitaaba waal meezaana leeaqooma aan-naasu bial qisti waanzal naa aal hadeeda feehi bas shadeed wamanaafi'u lin-naasi wal eea'lama aal laahu many yyansuruhu warusul ahu bial ghaybi 'inna aal laaha qaweeyun 'azeez
Wal aqada aarsal naa nooha waibraaheema waja'al naa fi zurriyyatihimaa aan-nubooaa'ata waal kitaaba faminhum mmuhtad wakatheer mminhum faasiqoon

Thumma qaffaynaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim birusul inaa waqaffaynaa bi'eesaa aabni maryama wa'aataynaahu aul ianjeela waja'al naa fi qul oobi ail zeena aattaba'oohu rafat warahmat warahbaaniyyatan aibtada'oohaa maa katabnaahaa 'al ayhimuaa 'il laa aabtighaa'a ridwaani ail laahi famaa ra'awhaa haqqa ri'ayatihaa faataynaa aal zeena 'aamanu minhumuaa 'ajrahum wakatheer mminhum faasiqoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha wa'aaminu birasoolihi yootikum kiflayni mir rrahmatihi wayaj'al-lakum noora tamshoona bihi wayaghfir lakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Lleeal laa ya'lama 'ahlu aul kitaabi 'al laa yaqdiroona 'al aa sha' mmin fadli ail laahi waanna aal fadla beeadi ail laahi yooteehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem
Qad sami'a aal laahu qawla aal ti tujaadil uka fi zawjihaa watashtakiaa 'il aa aal laahi waal laahu yasma'u tahaawurakumaa 'inna aal laaha samee'u baseer

Ail zeena yazzahharoona minkum mmin nnisaa'ihim mmaa hunna 'ummahaatihimuaa 'inu ammahaatuhumuaa 'il laa aal wal adnahum wainnahum layaqooloona munkara mmina aal qawli wazoora wainna aal laaha la'afoowun ghafoor
Waal zeena yazzahharoona min nnisaa'ihim thumma ya'oodoona limaa qaal u fatahreeru raqabat mmin qabli 'any yyatamaassaa zaal ikum too'azoona bihi waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Famal llam yajid faseeaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni min qabli 'any yyatamaassaa famal llam yastati' fait'aamu sitteena miskeena zaal ika litoominu bial laahi warasoolihi watil ka hudoodu aul laahi wal il kaafireena 'azaabun aal eem
Ainna aal zeena yuhaaddoona aal laaha warasoolahu kubitu kamaa kubita aal zeena min qablihim waqada aanzal naa 'ayaati bayyinaat wal il kaafireena 'azaab mmuheen
Yawma yab'athuhumu aul laahu jamee'a fayunabbeeuhum bimaa 'amil ooaa 'ahsyaahu aul laahu wanasoohu waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed

Aal am tara 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi maa yakoonu min nnajwaa thal aathatin ail laa hooa raabi'uhum wal aa khamsatin ail laa hooa saadisuhum wal aa 'adnaa min zaal ika wal aa 'akthara 'il laa hooa ma'ahumuaa 'ayna maa kaanu thumma yunabbeeuhum bimaa 'amil u yawma aal qeeaamati 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena nuhu 'ani ain-najwaa thumma ya'oodoona limaa nuhu 'anhu wayatanaajawna bial iathmi waal'udwaani wama'seeati air-rasooli waizaa jaa'ooka hayyawka bimaa lam yuhayyika bihi ail laahu wayaqooloona fiaa 'anfusihim lawlaa yu'azzibunaa aal laahu bimaa naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnahaa fabeesa aal maseer
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa tanaajaytum fal aa tatanaajawa bial iathmi waal'udwaani wama'seeati air-rasooli watanaajawa bial birri waat-taqwaa waattaqu aul laaha aal ziaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
'innamaa aan-najwaa mina aash-shaytaani leeuhzina aal zeena 'aamanu wal aysa bidaarrihim shayaan ail laa biizni ail laahi wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail moominoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa qeela lakum tafassahu fi ail majlisi faafsahu yafsahi ail laahu lakum waizaa qeela aanshuzu faanshuzu yarfa'i ail laahu aul zeena 'aamanu minkum waal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma darajaat waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa naajaytumu aur-rasoola faqaddimu bayna yada najwyaakum sadaqat zaal ika khayr llakum waatharu fail llam tajidu fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Aashfaqtumuaa 'an tuqaddimu bayna yada najwyaakum sadaqaat faiz lam taf'al u wataaba aal laahu 'al aykum faaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waatee'u aul laaha warasoolahu waal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena tawal lawa qawmaan ghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhim mmaa hum mminkum wal aa minhum wayahlifoona 'al aa aal kazibi wahum ya'lamoon
'a'adda aal laahu lahum 'azaaba shadeedaan ainnahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Aattakhazooaa 'aymaanahum junnat fasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi fal ahum 'azaab mmuheen
Llan tughneea 'anhumuaa 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mmina aal laahi shayaan awlaa'ika 'ashaabu aun-nari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yawma yab'athuhumu aul laahu jamee'a fayahlifoona lahu kamaa yahlifoona lakum wayahsiboona 'annahum 'al aa sha'in aal aa 'innahum humu aul kaaziboon
Aastahwaza 'al ayhimu aush-shaytaanu faansyaahum zikra aal laahi 'ul aa'ika hizbu aush-shaytaani 'al aa 'inna hizba aash-shaytaani humu aul khaasiroon
'inna aal zeena yuhaaddoona aal laaha warasoolahuaa 'ul aa'ika fi ail aazal leena kataba aal laahu laaghlibanna 'anaa warusul eea 'inna aal laaha qaweeyun 'azeez

Llaa tajidu qawma yoominoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri yooaaddoona man haadda aal laaha warasoolahu wal aw kaanooaa 'aabaa'ahumuaa 'awa aabnaa'ahumuaa 'awi aikhwaanahumuaa 'aw 'asheeratahumuaa 'ul aa'ika kataba fi qul oobihimu aul iaymaana wayyadahum birooh mminhu wayudkhil uhum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru khaal ideena feehaa radeea aal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu 'ul aa'ika hizbu aul laahi 'al aa 'inna hizba aal laahi humu aul muflihoon
Sabbaha lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Hooa aal ziaa 'akhraja aal zeena kafaru mina aahli ail kitaabi min deeaarihim liawwal i ail hashri maa zanantumuaa 'any yyakhruju wazannooaa 'annahum mmaani'atuhum husoonuhum mmina aal laahi faatyaahumu aul laahu min haythu lam yahtasibu waqazafa fi qul oobihimu aur-ru'ba yukhriboona buyootahum biaydeehim waydi ail moomineena faa'tabiru yaaooli ail aabsaar
Wal awlaa 'an kataba aal laahu 'al ayhimu aul jal aa'a la'azzabahum fi aid-dunya wal ahum fi ail aakhirati 'azaabu aun-nar
Zaal ika biannahum shaaqqu aul laaha warasoolahu wamany yyushaaqqi ail laaha fainna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Maa qata'tum mmil lleenatin aaw taraktumoohaa qaa'imatan 'al aa 'usoolihaa fabiizni ail laahi wal eeukhzeea aal faasiqeen
Wamaa 'afaa'a aal laahu 'al aa rasoolihi minhum famaa 'awjaftum 'al ayhi min khayl wal aa rikaab wal aakinna aal laaha yusal litu rusul ahu 'al aa many yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Mmaa 'afaa'a aal laahu 'al aa rasoolihi mina aahli ail quraa fal il hi wal ir-rasooli wal izi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waabni ais-sabeeli ka laa yakoona doolata bayna aal aaghneeaa'i minkum wamaa 'aatyaakumu aur-rasoolu fakhuzoohu wamaa nahyaakum 'anhu faantahu waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Lil fuqaraa'i ail muhaajireena aal zeena 'ukhriju min deeaarihim waamwaal ihim yabtaghoona fadla mmina aal laahi waridwaana wayansuroona aal laaha warasoolahuaa 'ul aa'ika humu aus-saadiqoon

Waal zeena tabawwa'oo aud-daara waal iaymaana min qablihim yuhibboona man haajara 'il ayhim wal aa yajidoona fi sudoorihim haajat mmimmaa 'ootu wayoothiroona 'al aa 'anfusihim wal aw kaana bihim khasaasat wamany yyooqa shuhha nafsihi faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon

Waal zeena jaa'oo mim ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbanaa aaghfir lanaa wal iikhwaaninaa aal zeena sabaqoonaa bial iaymaani wal aa taj'al fi qul oobinaa ghil la llil zeena 'aamanu rabbanaa 'innaka ra'oof rraheem

Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena naafaqu yaqooloona liikhwaanihimu aul zeena kafaru mina aahli ail kitaabi la'inu akhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma'akum wal aa nutee'u feekumuaa 'ahadaan aabada wain qootil tum lanansurannakum waal laahu yashhadu 'innahum lakaaziboon
La'inu akhriju laa yakhrujoona ma'ahum wal a'in qootil u laa yansuroonahum wal a'in nnasaroohum layooal lunna aal aadbaara thumma laa yunsaroon
Laantumuaa 'ashaddu rahbat fi sudoorihim mmina aal laahi zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon
Laa yuqaatil oonakum jamee'aan ail laa fi qura mmuhassanatin aaw minw wwaraa'i juduri basuhum baynahum shadeed tahsibuhum jamee'a waqul oobuhum shattaa zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'qil oon
Kamathal i ail zeena min qablihim qareeba zaaqu wabaal a 'amrihim wal ahum 'azaabun aal eem
Kamathal i aish-shaytaani 'iz qaal a lil iansaani aikfur fal ammaa kafara qaal a 'inni bariaa' mminka 'inneea 'akhaafu aul laaha rabba aal'aal ameen
Fakaana 'aaqibatahumaa 'annahumaa fi ain-nari khaal idayni feehaa wazaal ika jazaa'ua auz-zaal imeen
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha wal tanzur nafs mmaa qaddamat lighad waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena nasu aul laaha faansyaahumuaa 'anfusahumuaa 'ul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
Laa yastawiaa 'ashaabu aun-nari waashaabu aul jannati 'ashaabu aul jannati humu aul faa'izoon
Lawa aanzal naa haazaa aal qur'aana 'al aa jabal-laraytahu khaashi'a mmutasaddi'a mmin khashyati ail laahi watil ka aal aamthaal u nadribuhaa lin-naasi la'al laahum yatafakkaroon
Hooa aal laahu aul zi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati hooa aar-rahmaanu aur-raheem
Hooa aal laahu aul zi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aal mal iku aul quddoosu aus-sal aamu aul moominu aul muhayminu aul'azeezu aul jabbaaru aul mutakabbiru subhaana aal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
Hooa aal laahu aul khaal iqu aul baariu aul musawwiru lahu aul aasmaa'u aul husnaa yusabbihu lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal aardi wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu 'adoowi wa'adoowakumuaa 'awleeaa'a tul qoona 'il ayhim bial mawaddati waqad kafaru bimaa jaa'akum mmina aal haqqi yukhrijoona aar-rasoola waiyyaakumuaa 'an toominu bial laahi rabbikumuaa 'in kuntum kharajtum jihaada fi sabeeli waabtighaa'a mardaati tusirroona 'il ayhim bial mawaddati waanaa 'a'lamu bimaa 'akhfaytum wamaa 'a'lantum wamany yyaf'al hu minkum faqad ddal la sawaa'a aas-sabeel
'iny yyathqafookum yakoonu lakumuaa 'a'daa' wayabsutooaa 'il aykumuaa 'aydeeahum waal sinatahum bias-sooaa'i wawaddu law takfuroon
Lan tanfa'akumuaa 'arhaamukum wal aa 'awlaadukum yawma aal qeeaamati yufsal u baynakum waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Qad kaanat lakumuaa 'iswatun hasanat fiaa 'ibraaheema waal zeena ma'ahuaa 'iz qaal u liqawmihimuaa 'innaa bura'aa'ua minkum wamimmaa ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi kafarnaa bikum wabadaa baynanaa wabaynakumu aul'adaawatu waal baghdaa'u aabadaan hattaa toominu bial laahi wahdahuaa 'il laa qawla 'ibraaheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wamaa 'amliku laka mina aal laahi min sha' rrabbanaa 'al ayka tawakkal naa wail ayka 'anabnaa wail ayka aal maseer
Rabbanaa laa taj'al naa fitnat llil zeena kafaru waaghfir lanaa rabbanaa 'innaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Laqad kaana lakum feehimuaa 'iswatun hasanat lliman kaana yarju aul laaha waal yawma aal aakhira wamany yyatawal la fainna aal laaha hooa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed
'asaa aal laahu 'any yyaj'al a baynakum wabayna aal zeena 'aadaytum mminhum mmawaddat waal laahu qadeer waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Llaa yanhyaakumu aul laahu 'ani ail zeena lam yuqaatil ookum fi aid-deeni wal am yukhrijookum mmin deeaarikumuaa 'an tabarroohum watuqsitooaa 'il ayhimuaa 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muqsiteen

'innamaa yanhyaakumu aul laahu 'ani ail zeena qaatal ookum fi aid-deeni waakhrajookum mmin deeaarikum wazaaharu 'al aa 'ikhraajikumuaa 'an tawal lawhum wamany yyatawal laahum faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa jaa'akumu aul moominaatu muhaajiraat faamtahinoohunna aal laahu 'a'lamu bieemaanihinna fain 'al imtumoohunna moominaat fal aa tarji'oohunna 'il aa aal kuffari laa hunna hil l llaahum wal aa hum yahil loona lahunna wa'aatoohum mmaa 'anfaqu wal aa junaaha 'al aykumuaa 'an tankihoohunna 'izaa 'aataytumoohunna 'ujoorahunna wal aa tumsiku bi'isami ail kawaafiri wasal u maa 'anfaqtum wal yasal u maa 'anfaqu zaal ikum hukmu aul laahi yahkumu baynakum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Wain faatakum sha' mmina aazwaajikumuaa 'il aa aal kuffari fa'aaqabtum faatu aul zeena zahabata aazwaajuhum mmithla maa 'anfaqu waattaqu aul laaha aal ziaa 'antum bihi moominoon

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u aizaa jaa'aka aal moominaatu yubayi'naka 'al aa 'al llaa yushrikna bial laahi shaya wal aa yasriqna wal aa yazneena wal aa yaqtul na 'awlaadahunna wal aa yaateena bibuhtaany yaftareenahu bayna 'aydeehinna waarjul ihinna wal aa ya'seenaka fi ma'roof fabayi'hunna waastaghfir lahunna aal laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tatawal lawa qawmaan ghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhim qad ya'isu mina aal aakhirati kamaa ya'isa aal kuffaaru mina aashaabi ail quboor
Sabbaha lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu lima taqooloona maa laa taf'al oon
Kabura maqtaan 'inda aal laahi 'an taqoolu maa laa taf'al oon
'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul zeena yuqaatil oona fi sabeelihi saffa kaannahum bunyaam mmarsoos

Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmi lima toozoonani waqad tta'lamoona 'anni rasoolu aul laahi 'il aykum fal ammaa zaaghooaa 'azaagha aal laahu qul oobahum waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen

Waiz qaal a 'eesaa aabnu maryama yaabaniaa 'israa'eela 'inni rasoolu aul laahi 'il aykum mmusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayya mina aat-tawryaati wamubashshiraa birasool yaati mim ba'deea aasmuhuaa 'ahmadu fal ammaa jaa'ahum bial bayyinaati qaal u haazaa sihr mmubeen
Wamana aazlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba wahooa yud'aa 'il aa aal iaslaami waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Yureedoona leeutfiu noora aal laahi biafwaahihim waal laahu mutimm nnoorahu wal aw kariha aal kaafiroon
Hooa aal ziaa 'arsal a rasoolahu bial hudaa wadeeni ail haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aa aad-deeni kul lihi wal aw kariha aal mushrikoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu hal a aadul lukum 'al aa tijaarat tunjeekum mmin 'azaabin aal eem
Toominoona bial laahi warasoolihi watujaahidoona fi sabeeli ail laahi biamwaal ikum waanfusikum zaal ikum khayr llakumuaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Yaghfir lakum zunoobakum wayudkhil kum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal aanhaaru wamasaakina tayyibat fi jannaati 'adn zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Waukhraa tuhibboonahaa nasr mmina aal laahi wafath qareeb wabashshiri ail moomineen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu koonooaa 'ansaara llil hi kamaa qaal a 'eesaa aabnu maryama lil hawaareeyina mana aansaareea 'il aa aal laahi qaal a aal hawaareeyoona nahnu 'ansaaru aul laahi faamanat ttaa'ifat mmim baniaa 'israa'eela wakafarat ttaa'ifat fayyadnaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'al aa 'adoowihim faasbahu zaahireen
Yusabbihu lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail aardi ail mal iki ail quddoosi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
Hooa aal zi ba'atha fi ail uammeeyina rasoola mminhum yatlu 'al ayhimuaa 'ayaatihi wayuzakkeehim wayu'al limuhumu aul kitaaba waal hikmata wain kaanu min qablu lafi dal aal mmubeen
Wa'aakhareena minhum lammaa yal haqu bihim wahooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Zaal ika fadlu aul laahi yooteehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem
